articles.title: Returning the first samples from a Martian moon: Inside the science of Japan's bold MMX mission to Mars
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: Japan's mission to Mars is one of the most ambitious in spaceflight history. It aims to become the first spacecraft to return to Earth from Mars orbit, carrying with it the first-ever samples from the Red Planet system.
paras.zh: 日本的火星任务是航天史上最雄心勃勃的任务之一。它的目标是成为第一艘从火星轨道返回地球的航天器，并携带来自红色行星系统的第一批样本。

paras.en: The mission, known as Martian Moons eXploration (MMX), is a first-of-its-kind endeavor to study the origin of Mars' moons Phobos and Deimos. The robust undertaking includes a landing on Phobos to collect the samples — which will likely be the first from the Mars system to return to Earth — and a search for evidence that could shed light on events during the formation of the solar system billions of years ago.
paras.zh: 这项任务被称为火星卫星探索（MMX），是研究火星卫星火卫一和火卫二起源的首次尝试。这项艰巨的任务包括登陆火卫一收集样本——这可能是第一个从火星系统返回地球的样本——以及寻找可能揭示数十亿年前太阳系形成过程中事件的证据。

paras.en: MMX is scheduled to launch on an H3 rocket from Japan's Tanegashima Space Center on Monday (Oct. 19) at 3:41 p.m. EDT (1941 GMT; 4:41 a.m. local time in Japan, Oct. 20). After a 10-month journey to reach Mars, the spacecraft will spend about three years studying Phobos, deploying a rover and landing to collect its samples. The mission will then shift its focus to Deimos for a series of flybys before departing for Earth in November 2030. If all goes according to plan, the MMX sample-return capsule is scheduled to land in Australia in 2031.
paras.zh: MMX 计划于周一（10 月 19 日）下午 3:41 使用 H3 火箭从日本种子岛航天中心发射升空。美国东部时间（1941 GMT；日本当地时间 10 月 20 日凌晨 4:41）。经过 10 个月的旅程到达火星后，该航天器将花费大约三年的时间研究火卫一，部署漫游车并着陆收集样本。随后，该任务将把重点转移到火卫二上，进行一系列飞越，然后于 2030 年 11 月飞往地球。如果一切按计划进行，MMX 样本返回舱计划于 2031 年降落在澳大利亚。

paras.en: The MMX spacecraft is comprised of three main parts, as well as a small rover. After release from its H3 launch vehicle, a propulsion module will provide the boost to put MMX on course for Mars. MMX's main exploration module carries the microwave-size IDEFIX rover and most of the mission's scientific instruments, while the return module houses the sample-return capsule.
paras.zh: MMX 航天器由三个主要部分以及一个小型漫游车组成。从 H3 运载火箭发射后，推进模块将为 MMX 提供动力，让其走上火星航线。 MMX 的主探索舱携带微波大小的 IDEFIX 流动站和大部分任务科学仪器，而返回舱则装有样本返回舱。

paras.en: Japan's Mitsubishi Electric built MMX's three main modules, with the French space agency CNES (Centre National d'Études Spatiales) and Germany's DLR (Deutsches Zentrum für Luft-und Raumfahrt) jointly developing IDEFIX. The little rover is named for a dog in the 1960s French comic "Asterix," in a nod to the country's first satellite, Astérix, which launched in 1965.
paras.zh: 日本三菱电机建造了MMX的三个主要模块，法国航天局CNES（国家空间研究中心）和德国DLR（德国航空航天中心）共同开发IDEFIX。这款小型漫游车以 20 世纪 60 年代法国漫画《Asterix》中的一只狗命名，以纪念该国于 1965 年发射的第一颗卫星 Astérix。

paras.en: IDEFIX carries a suite of cameras, as well as the Raman Spectrometer for MMX (RAX) and miniaturized radiometer (miniRAD) instruments to analyze Phobos' surface composition and temperature.
paras.zh: IDEFIX 携带一套相机以及用于 MMX (RAX) 的拉曼光谱仪和小型辐射计 (miniRAD) 仪器来分析火卫一的表面成分和温度。

paras.en: Most of MMX's scientific instruments are housed on the exploration module, like NASA's Mars-moon Exploration with Gamma rays and Neutrons (MEGANE, pronounced "meh-gah-nay") device, a gamma-ray and neutron spectrometer built by the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL), and France's MIRS (MMX InfraRed Spectrometer) instrument.
paras.zh: MMX的大部分科学仪器都安装在探索舱上，例如美国宇航局的火星-月球伽马射线和中子探测（MEGANE，发音为“meh-gah-nay”）装置、约翰·霍普金斯应用物理实验室（APL）建造的伽马射线和中子光谱仪以及法国的MIRS（MMX红外光谱仪）仪器。

paras.en: The exploration module also houses the Japanese-built TENGOO (TElescopic Nadir imager for GeOmOrphology) tight-zoom camera, wide-angle OROCHI (Optical RadiOmeter composed of CHromatic Imagers) multispectral camera, laser altimeter (LIDAR) and Mass Spectrum Analyzer (MSA). The return module, meanwhile, carries Japan's Circum-Martian Dust Monitor (CMDM) and Interplanetary Radiation Environment Monitor (IREM).
paras.zh: 探索舱还配备了日本制造的TENGOO（地质学天底成像仪）近变焦相机、广角OROCHI（由彩色成像仪组成的光学辐射计）多光谱相机、激光高度计（LIDAR）和质谱分析仪（MSA）。同时，返回舱还携带日本的环火星尘埃监测器（CMDM）和行星际辐射环境监测器（IREM）。

paras.en: MMX will arrive in orbit around Mars in August 2027, at which point it will shed its propulsion module and transition into a quasi-satellite orbit (QSO) around Phobos that allows the probe to fly in a sort of formation with the small, asteroid-sized moon as they both circle the Red Planet.
paras.zh: MMX 将于 2027 年 8 月抵达火星周围轨道，届时它将卸下推进模块并过渡到火卫一周围的准卫星轨道 (QSO)，这使得探测器能够与这颗小行星大小的卫星以某种编队飞行，同时它们都围绕这颗红色行星运行。

paras.en: The spacecraft will spend its first few months in the Martian system observing Phobos from different altitudes, using its TENGOO and OROCHI cameras, LIDAR and MSA to map the moon's surface, study its composition and select potential landing sites.
paras.zh: 该航天器将在火星系统中度过最初的几个月，从不同高度观察火卫一，使用其 TENGOO 和 OROCHI 相机、激光雷达和 MSA 绘制月球表面地图，研究其组成并选择潜在的着陆点。

paras.en: IDEFIX will be released in late 2028 or early 2029, during the first of two MMX landing rehearsals, at about 130 feet (40 meters) above Phobos. Due to the 14-mile-wide (22 kilometers) moon's extremely low gravity, the rover will be able free-fall to the surface damage-free (hopefully), right itself after a few bounces and begin exploring to gather data on the terrain and surface conditions.
paras.zh: IDEFIX 将于 2028 年底或 2029 年初发布，期间将在火卫一上方约 130 英尺（40 米）处进行两次 MMX 着陆演习中的第一次。由于 14 英里宽（22 公里）的月球重力极低，月球车将能够（希望）毫发无伤地自由落体到月球表面，在几次反弹后恢复正常，并开始探索收集地形和表面状况的数据。

paras.en: MMX sample collection could begin as early as December 2028, the acting director of NASA's Planetary Science Division, Lindsay Hays, said during a mission briefing on Oct. 15. The spacecraft will attempt two collection landings, with its exploration and return modules descending and returning to orbit as one vehicle.
paras.zh: NASA 行星科学部代理主任 Lindsay Hays 在 10 月 15 日的任务简报会上表示，MMX 样本收集最早可能于 2028 年 12 月开始。该航天器将尝试两次收集着陆，其探索和返回模块作为一个飞行器下降并返回轨道。

paras.en: On Phobos' surface, two different sampling mechanisms — the Corer Sampling Mechanism (C-sampler) and Pneumatic Sampling Mechanism (P-sampler) — will extract and collect at least 10 grams (0.35 ounces) of material for stowage inside the spacecraft's return capsule before MMX lifts off again for orbit. After its first touchdown and sample collection, MMX will return to QSO near Phobos before descending to a second landing site for a similar attempt and subsequent return to orbit.
paras.zh: 在火卫一表面，两种不同的采样机制——取芯采样机制（C-采样器）和气动采样机制（P-采样器）——将提取并收集至少 10 克（0.35 盎司）的材料，以便在 MMX 再次升空进入轨道之前存放在航天器返回舱内。在首次着陆和样本收集后，MMX 将返回火卫一附近的 QSO，然后下降到第二个着陆点进行类似的尝试并随后返回轨道。

paras.en: MMX will end its observations of Phobos after about three years focused on the Martian moon, and will transition into a higher, resonant orbit around Mars in 2030. That course will repeatedly intersect Deimos' path for a series of flybys to collect and compare data with those from Phobos observations as scientists aim to investigate the moons' origins.
paras.zh: MMX 将在专注于火星卫星约三年后结束对火卫一的观测，并将于 2030 年过渡到围绕火星的更高共振轨道。该路线将反复与火卫一的路径相交，进行一系列飞越，以收集数据并将其与火卫一观测数据进行比较，因为科学家们旨在调查卫星的起源。

paras.en: Near the end of 2030, the exploration module will separate, leaving the return module to fire its engine out of Mars' gravitational influence and begin an eight-month journey back to Earth with the collected samples. As MMX closes the last stretch of void during its approach to Earth in 2031, the sample-return capsule will separate and enter the atmosphere for a targeted parachute landing in Australia's Woomera region, where its contents will be recovered for laboratory analysis by Japan and its mission partners.
paras.zh: 到 2030 年底，探索舱将分离，返回舱将启动其发动机以摆脱火星引力的影响，并开始带着收集到的样本返回地球的为期八个月的旅程。当 MMX 在 2031 年接近地球期间关闭最后一段空隙时，样本返回舱将分离并进入大气层，在澳大利亚伍默拉地区进行有针对性的降落伞着陆，在那里，其内容物将被回收，供日本及其任务伙伴进行实验室分析。

paras.en: Those samples, and the data collected by MMX, could tell scientists a lot — about the moons' composition, geography and, perhaps most importantly, how they came to exist in the first place. There are two leading theories for Phobos and Deimos' origins, both of which point to very different versions of ancient Martian history.
paras.zh: 这些样本以及 MMX 收集的数据可以告诉科学家很多信息——关于卫星的组成、地理，也许最重要的是，它们最初是如何存在的。关于火卫一和火卫二的起源有两种主要理论，它们都指向古代火星历史的截然不同的版本。

paras.en: "Phobos and Deimos are interesting, but not just in their own right. Their presence is a key piece of the larger story of the Mars system," said Tom Statler, MMX program executive and scientist in NASA's Planetary Science Division, during the Oct. 15 mission briefing. "By uncovering the moons' origin, we'll gain new insights into the history of both Mars and Earth, especially those events that shaped both planets billions of years ago and helped create the worlds we see today."
paras.zh: “火卫一和火卫二很有趣，但不仅仅是它们本身。它们的存在是火星系统更大故事的关键部分，”美国宇航局行星科学部 MMX 项目执行官兼科学家汤姆·斯塔特勒 (Tom Statler) 在 10 月 15 日的任务简报会上说道。 “通过揭示卫星的起源，我们将对火星和地球的历史有新的了解，特别是那些数十亿年前塑造这两个行星并帮助创造我们今天看到的世界的事件。”

paras.en: Both Phobos and Deimos are relatively small and irregularly shaped, and bear several resemblances and spectral characteristics to primitive D-type asteroids — ancient bodies thought to preserve material dating back to the solar system's formation about 4.6 billion years ago. Those similarities suggest Phobos and Deimos may have formed elsewhere in the solar system and were later captured by Mars' gravity.
paras.zh: 火卫一和火卫二都相对较小，形状不规则，与原始 D 型小行星有一些相似之处和光谱特征，这些古老的天体被认为保存着可追溯到大约 46 亿年前太阳系形成的物质。这些相似之处表明火卫一和火卫二可能是在太阳系的其他地方形成的，后来被火星的引力捕获。

paras.en: Their near-circular, equatorially-aligned orbits around the Red Planet, however, somewhat complicate that theory. For example, a captured asteroid would be much more likely to have entered an elongated and tilted orbit akin to the direction and velocity of its original approach, scientists say. A competing hypothesis, therefore, offers a much more violent, but somewhat familiar, narrative for the moons' origins.
paras.zh: 然而，它们围绕红色星球的近圆形、与赤道对齐的轨道在某种程度上使这一理论变得复杂。例如，科学家表示，一颗被捕获的小行星更有可能进入一个细长且倾斜的轨道，与其最初接近时的方向和速度相似。因此，一个相互竞争的假说为卫星的起源提供了一种更加暴力但又有些熟悉的叙述。

paras.en: An enormous collision with ancient Mars could have blasted material into orbit to form a debris disk from which the two moons eventually coalesced. Such a process, which would be similar to the formation of Earth's moon, could explain their circular, equatorial orbits.
paras.zh: 与古代火星的巨大碰撞可能会将物质喷射到轨道上，形成碎片盘，两颗卫星最终从碎片盘中合并。这一过程类似于地球月球的形成，可以解释它们的圆形赤道轨道。

paras.en: The contradicting geological and orbital observations for Phobos and Deimos collected to date have prevented scientists from definitively establishing one hypothesis over the other. MMX aims to provide an answer.
paras.zh: 迄今为止收集到的火卫一和火卫二相互矛盾的地质和轨道观测结果使科学家无法明确建立一种假设而不是另一种假设。 MMX旨在提供答案。

paras.en: "It's two totally different lines of evidence that point in two different directions. That's what makes it an interesting puzzle," Statler said. Several theories have also been presented for hybrid scenarios combining the two, he added.
paras.zh: “这是两条完全不同的证据，指向两个不同的方向。这就是它成为一个有趣的谜题的原因，”斯塔特勒说。他补充说，针对将两者结合起来的混合场景，也提出了几种理论。

paras.en: "There's all kinds of different ways, all kinds of different combinations of those two basic scenarios," Statler explained. "But that's the puzzle from the start, the two seemingly contradictory lines of evidence that are pointing us to what … the real history was, but we don't know what it is yet."
paras.zh: “这两种基本场景有各种不同的方式、各种不同的组合，”斯塔特勒解释道。 “但这从一开始就是一个谜题，两条看似矛盾的证据向我们指出……真正的历史是什么，但我们还不知道它是什么。”

paras.en: Each theory for where Mars' moons came from predicts different chemical characteristics for their surfaces. Presumably, captured asteroids would preserve chemical signatures of material originating elsewhere in the solar system, potentially rich in volatile elements like hydrogen. Moons formed through a planetary impact, however, would contain a mixture of Mars and impact material, altered by the intense heat of such a violent collision.
paras.zh: 关于火星卫星来源的每种理论都预测了其表面的不同化学特征。据推测，捕获的小行星将保留源自太阳系其他地方的物质的化学特征，这些物质可能富含氢等挥发性元素。然而，通过行星撞击形成的卫星将含有火星和撞击物质的混合物，这种混合物会因这种剧烈碰撞的高温而改变。

paras.en: Determining which scenario is more likely could reveal whether Mars experienced a massive moon-forming collision or acquired its moons from elsewhere in the early solar system. Either answer could offer new insights into the planet's evolution and the events that shaped the terrestrial planets like Earth billions of years ago, mission team members say.
paras.zh: 确定哪种情况更有可能发生，可以揭示火星是经历了一次大规模的月球形成碰撞，还是从早期太阳系的其他地方获得了它的卫星。任务小组成员表示，这两种答案都可以为地球的演化以及数十亿年前塑造地球等类地行星的事件提供新的见解。

paras.en: "At this point, we know nothing about the composition of Phobos," David Lawrence, MEGANE principal investigator at APL, said during the Oct. 15 briefing. "We have information about mineralogy, but no elemental composition. And so, elements are really a key way to get at some of these foundational questions."
paras.zh: APL MEGANE 首席研究员 David Lawrence 在 10 月 15 日的新闻发布会上表示：“目前，我们对火卫一的构成一无所知。” “我们有关于矿物学的信息，但没有元素组成。因此，元素确实是解决这些基本问题的关键方法。”

paras.en: MMX's scientific suite has been carefully calibrated to make those determinations. The cameras and sensors on the MMX exploration module's TENGOO, OROCHI and LIDAR instruments will map Phobos' terrain, geological features and variations in surface materials from orbit, to provide clues about the moon's formation and evolution. Complementing those measurements, MIRS is designed to detect and classify Phobos' surface minerals and search for organic compounds to further differentiate its possible origin as an asteroid or ancient chunk of Mars.
paras.zh: MMX 的科学套件经过仔细校准才能做出这些决定。 MMX 探测模块的 TENGOO、OROCHI 和 LIDAR 仪器上的摄像机和传感器将绘制火卫一的地形、地质特征和轨道上表面物质的变化，以提供有关月球形成和演化的线索。作为这些测量的补充，MIRS 旨在检测和分类火卫一的表面矿物质，并寻找有机化合物，以进一步区分其可能起源为小行星或古老的火星块。

paras.en: The RAX spectrometer and miniRAD instrument aboard IDEFIX will add localized context to those observations by examining surface mineralogy and their thermal properties up close.
paras.zh: IDEFIX 上的 RAX 光谱仪和 miniRAD 仪器将通过近距离检查表面矿物学及其热特性，为这些观测添加局部背景。

paras.en: Back in orbit, NASA's MEGANE instrument will measure Phobos' elemental composition through gamma-ray and neutron spectroscopy that can scan tens of centimeters beneath the moon's surface for signs of volatile elements. Higher abundances of hydrogen, chlorine, sodium and potassium, for instance, would favor the asteroid-capture hypothesis, while lower abundances of those compounds could point to the heat and chemical deterioration associated with a planetary impact.
paras.zh: 返回轨道后，美国宇航局的 MEGANE 仪器将通过伽马射线和中子光谱测量火卫一的元素成分，这些光谱可以扫描月球表面下数十厘米的地方，寻找挥发性元素的迹象。例如，较高丰度的氢、氯、钠和钾将有利于小行星捕获假说，而这些化合物的丰度较低可能表明与行星撞击相关的热量和化学恶化。

paras.en: "In Japanese, 'megane' means eyeglasses," Lawrence said. "So we like to think of MEGANE as being an instrument that will look at Phobos with gamma ray and neutron glasses."
paras.zh: “在日语中，‘megane’的意思是眼镜，”劳伦斯说。 “所以我们认为 MEGANE 是一种用伽马射线和中子眼镜观察火卫一的仪器。”

paras.en: When compared to the samples MMX will return to Earth, MEGANE's findings could help scientists determine if volatile depletion found on Phobos reflects the intense heat of a post-impact formation or billions of years of subsequent erosion from the natural effects of space exposure.
paras.zh: 与 MMX 将返回地球的样本相比，MEGANE 的发现可以帮助科学家确定火卫一上发现的挥发物消耗是否反映了撞击后形成的强烈热量或数十亿年的后续太空暴露自然影响的侵蚀。

paras.en: MSA, meanwhile, will measure charged particles around Phobos, searching for evidence of subsurface ice and investigating how solar wind exposure has altered the moon's surface. It will also study atmospheric particles escaping from Mars. CMDM will measure dust around Mars, including particles potentially ejected from its moons by impacts.
paras.zh: 与此同时，MSA 将测量火卫一周围的带电粒子，寻找地下冰的证据，并调查太阳风暴露如何改变了月球表面。它还将研究从火星逃逸的大气颗粒。 CMDM 将测量火星周围的尘埃，包括可能因撞击而从其卫星中喷出的颗粒。

paras.en: Comparative observations of Deimos after MMX's final departure from Phobos will help establish whether the moons share similar compositions and, potentially, a common origin.
paras.zh: MMX 最终离开火卫一后对火卫二的比较观测将有助于确定这些卫星是否具有相似的成分，并且可能具有共同的起源。

paras.en: Once safely returned to Earth, laboratory analysis of the Phobos samples will allow scientists to examine chemical composition and mineralogy with a precision beyond that of MMX's onboard instruments. Tests like isotopic analyses — measuring subtle differences in the atomic makeup of elements — can help identify the samples' origins by comparing their chemical fingerprints with those of Martian rocks and asteroid material.
paras.zh: 一旦安全返回地球，火卫一样本的实验室分析将使科学家能够以超越 MMX 机载仪器的精度检查化学成分和矿物学。同位素分析等测试（测量元素原子组成的细微差异）可以通过将样品的化学指纹与火星岩石和小行星材料的化学指纹进行比较，帮助识别样品的来源。

paras.en: JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) scientists think some returned material could even originate from Mars itself, deposited on Phobos after ancient asteroid impacts blasted rocks off the Red Planet's surface, potentially holding evidence of its geological past.
paras.zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构（JAXA）的科学家认为，一些返回的物质甚至可能来自火星本身，在古代小行星撞击将红色星球表面的岩石炸飞后沉积在火卫一上，可能保存着其地质历史的证据。

paras.en: The JAXA-led mission represents interagency partnerships with NASA and the European Space Agency (ESA), which are providing hardware and communications support through the Deep Space and Estrack networks.
paras.zh: JAXA 领导的任务代表了与 NASA 和欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的跨机构合作伙伴关系，它们通过深空和 Estrack 网络提供硬件和通信支持。

paras.en: NASA's contributions to MMX also include MEGANE, the Honeybee Robotics-built P-sampler, and an approximately $87 million investment through the end of the mission. NASA is funding the United States scientists on the MMX team, who will, alongside NASA's astromaterials experts, "be fully involved in the examination and scientific analysis of the Phobos samples when they are delivered to Earth," Hays said during the mission briefing. "We get all of the value and all of the scientific participation at a lower cost total [than funding the entire mission]."
paras.zh: NASA 对 MMX 的贡献还包括 Honeybee Robotics 制造的 MEGANE P 采样器，以及到任务结束为止约 8700 万美元的投资。海斯在任务简报中说，美国宇航局正在资助 MMX 团队的美国科学家，他们将与美国宇航局的天体材料专家一起，“在火卫一样本运送到地球时全面参与对它们的检查和科学分析”。 “我们以较低的总成本（比资助整个任务）获得了所有的价值和所有的科学参与。”

paras.en: For its role, NASA will receive at least 15% of the returned samples, with materials to be preserved at the agency's Johnson Space Center in Houston for analysis and long-term preservation. To that end, MMX's scientific impact could extend far beyond the mission's conclusion.
paras.zh: 为了发挥其作用，NASA 将收到至少 15% 的返回样本，这些材料将保存在该机构位于休斯敦的约翰逊航天中心进行分析和长期保存。为此，MMX 的科学影响可能远远超出任务的结论。

paras.en: "The Phobos samples will be historic," Statler said, with the potential "for future research to answer the questions we don't even know yet how to ask."
paras.zh: “火卫一样本将具有历史意义，”斯塔特勒说，“未来的研究有可能回答我们甚至不知道如何提出的问题。”

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and space exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Josh Dining) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和太空探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系的演变、太空海岸载人飞行任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划以及人类重返月球等内容。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Strengthens Board and Corporate Development to Support Continued Growth
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: DURANGO, Colo., Oct. 5, 2026 — Agile Space Industries today announced that Jonathan Baliff has joined its Board of Directors, bringing extensive experience in aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. His appointment, alongside the addition of Theo Squires as Director of Strategy & Corporate Development, strengthens Agile’s ability to execute its long-term growth strategy, support capital formation, and pursue strategic opportunities as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州杜兰戈，2026 年 10 月 5 日 — Agile Space Industries 今天宣布 Jonathan Baliff 加入其董事会，带来了航空航天、金融和企业领导方面的丰富经验。他的任命以及 Theo Squires 担任战略与企业发展总监的任命，增强了雅居乐执行长期增长战略、支持资本形成以及随着公司规模不断扩大而寻求战略机遇的能力。

paras.en: Agile is entering its next phase with growing opportunities across the commercial and national security space. In particular, the company’s recent selection for the SpaceWERX Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI) program reflects support for adding the ability to supply complete propulsion subsystems. As Agile expands its capabilities and production capacity, the company is also strengthening the financial and strategic foundation needed to support its long-term objectives.
paras.zh: 敏捷正在进入下一阶段，商业和国家安全领域的机会越来越多。特别是，该公司最近选择的 SpaceWERX 战略资金增加 (STRATFI) 计划反映了对增加提供完整推进子系统的能力的支持。随着敏捷公司扩大其能力和生产能力，该公司也在加强支持其长期目标所需的财务和战略基础。

paras.en: “Agile has built significant momentum, and our next phase of growth requires the financial capability and oversight to match our technical expertise,” said Chris Pearson, CEO of Agile Space Industries. “Jonathan’s experience in aerospace, capital formation and corporate transformation, combined with Theo’s focus on strategy and corporate development, will help us evaluate new opportunities, make strategic investments and position Agile for sustainable, long-term growth.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席执行官克里斯·皮尔森 (Chris Pearson) 表示：“敏捷已经建立了强大的势头，我们下一阶段的增长需要与我们的技术专长相匹配的财务能力和监督。” “乔纳森在航空航天、资本形成和企业转型方面的经验，加上西奥对战略和企业发展的关注，将帮助我们评估新的机会，进行战略投资，并为敏捷的可持续、长期增长做好准备。”

paras.en: Jonathan Baliff Joins Board of Directors
paras.zh: 乔纳森·巴利夫 (Jonathan Baliff) 加入董事会

paras.en: Baliff brings extensive experience across aerospace, finance, and corporate leadership. A former U.S. Air Force aviator and engineer, he currently serves as an operating partner at Genesis Park, where he played a central role in the formation and financing of Redwire Corporation and later served as its chief financial officer. He previously served as president and CEO of Bristow Group and held senior leadership positions at NRG Energy and Credit Suisse. His experience raising capital, guiding strategic investments, and leading organizations through periods of growth and transformation will support Agile as the company continues to scale.
paras.zh: 巴利夫在航空航天、金融和企业领导方面拥有丰富的经验。他曾是美国空军飞行员和工程师，目前担任 Genesis Park 的运营合伙人，在 Redwire Corporation 的组建和融资过程中发挥了核心作用，后来担任该公司的首席财务官。他此前曾担任 Bristow Group 总裁兼首席执行官，并在 NRG Energy 和 Credit Suisse 担任高级领导职务。他在筹集资金、指导战略投资以及领导组织经历成长和转型时期的经验将为敏捷公司的不断扩张提供支持。

paras.en: “Agile has proven it has the technology and operational expertise to compete, win, and profitably grow in a rapidly evolving space market,” said Baliff. “Our customers and capital providers will partner with us as we scale Agile’s technology, expand capacity, and efficiently deploy capital to support the company’s growth. I look forward to working with Chris, our proven team and board to help Agile capitalize on the significant opportunities ahead.”
paras.zh: 巴利夫表示：“敏捷已经证明，它拥有在快速发展的太空市场中竞争、获胜并实现盈利增长的技术和运营专业知识。” “我们的客户和资本提供商将与我们合作，扩展 Agile 的技术、扩大产能并有效部署资本，以支持公司的发展。我期待与我们久经考验的团队和董事会 Chris 合作，帮助 Agile 抓住未来的重大机遇。”

paras.en: Expanding Corporate Development to Support Long-Term Strategy
paras.zh: 扩大企业发展以支持长期战略

paras.en: Squires serves as Agile’s Director of Strategy & Corporate Development. Before joining Agile, he served as an intelligence officer in the Royal Australian Navy, where his work included a bilateral space program involving the United States and Australia. He also worked at Boston Consulting Group, advising advanced manufacturing companies on strategy and operations. At Agile, his experience supports capital formation, strategic investments and potential acquisitions of complementary technologies and capabilities to support the company’s broader growth strategy.
paras.zh: Squires 担任 Agile 的战略与企业发展总监。在加入敏捷之前，他曾在澳大利亚皇家海军担任情报官，其工作包括涉​​及美国和澳大利亚的双边太空计划。他还曾在波士顿咨询集团工作，为先进制造公司提供战略和运营方面的咨询。在敏捷，他的经验支持资本形成、战略投资以及互补技术和能力的潜在收购，以支持公司更广泛的增长战略。

paras.en: “Scaling advanced propulsion hardware requires both technical innovation and a disciplined approach to capital investment,” said Squires. “Our focus is on building a financial foundation to support higher-rate production while identifying strategic opportunities that complement Agile’s existing capabilities. We see significant potential to expand what we can offer customers as the space propulsion market continues to evolve.”
paras.zh: “扩展先进的推进硬件需要技术创新和严格的资本投资方法，”斯奎尔斯说。 “我们的重点是建立财务基础以支持更高的生产速度，同时寻找补充敏捷现有能力的战略机会。随着太空推进市场的不断发展，我们看到了扩大我们为客户提供服务的巨大潜力。”

paras.en: As part of the board’s evolution, Tom Rubin is departing Agile’s Board of Directors and will continue to support the company in an advisory capacity.
paras.zh: 作为董事会发展的一部分，汤姆·鲁宾 (Tom Rubin) 将离开敏捷董事会，并将继续以顾问身份为公司提供支持。

paras.en: During his board service, Rubin contributed valuable legal expertise and counsel as Agile navigated a period of significant growth. The company is grateful for his contributions and looks forward to continuing to benefit from his experience and institutional knowledge in his advisory role.
paras.zh: 在担任董事会职务期间，鲁宾为敏捷公司度过了一段显着增长的时期，贡献了宝贵的法律专业知识和建议。该公司感谢他的贡献，并期待继续受益于他在顾问角色中的经验和机构知识。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to the high-rate production of flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate delivery. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到飞行硬件的高速生产，Agile 汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速交付。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Oct. 29: Applying AI/SI to the GEOINT Mission
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is changing how intelligence organizations collect, process and exploit satellite imagery. As the volume of Earth observation data grows, AI is becoming essential for identifying patterns, detecting anomalies and delivering intelligence at operational speed.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在改变情报组织收集、处理和利用卫星图像的方式。随着地球观测数据量的增长，人工智能对于识别模式、检测异常和以运行速度提供情报变得至关重要。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and Vantor on Oct. 29 for a virtual event that will explore how machine learning is transforming the GEOINT mission across defense, intelligence and commercial markets.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日与 SpaceNews 和 Vantor 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨机器学习如何改变国防、情报和商业市场的 GEOINT 任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in automated target recognition, change detection, multimodal data fusion and large language models, as well as the challenges of validating AI outputs and maintaining analyst trust. The conversation will consider where AI delivers its greatest operational value, where humans remain indispensable and how intelligence organizations can adapt to persistent, data-driven surveillance.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论自动目标识别、变化检测、多模式数据融合和大型语言模型方面的进展，以及验证人工智能输出和维持分析师信任的挑战。对话将考虑人工智能在哪些方面发挥最大的运营价值、人类在哪些方面仍然不可或缺，以及情报组织如何适应持续的、数据驱动的监视。

paras.en: - Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer, Vantor
paras.zh: - Peter Wilczynski，Vantor 首席产品官

paras.en: - Joe O’Callaghan, director, Super Intelligence (SI) Mission, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
paras.zh: - Joe O’Callaghan，国家地理空间情报局超级情报 (SI) 任务主任

paras.en: - Matt Maroofi, senior director of product, Shield AI
paras.zh: - Matt Maroofi，Shield AI 产品高级总监

paras.en: This virtual event will take place via Zoom. You will receive a unique link to join with your registration confirmation. A recording will be posted here shortly after the event concludes.
paras.zh: 该虚拟活动将通过 Zoom 进行。您将收到一个独特的加入链接以及您的注册确认信息。活动结束后不久将在此处发布录音。

paras.en: Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence to unlock a more autonomous, interoperable world. We give decision makers and operators the power to build a unified intelligence picture, delivering the clarity they need to navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. We fuse data from our constellation, which includes the most capable imaging satellites on orbit, with real-time sensor feeds from space, air, and ground to create an AI-ready digital twin of Earth. Our spatial intelligence platform automates every part of the cycle—from tasking to collection to production—to update and analyze this foundation at the pace of change. Our products drive deeper mission-critical insights and connect the next generation of autonomous systems across the defense, intelligence, and commercial landscape. To learn more, visit www.vantor.com
paras.zh: Vantor 正在开拓空间智能的新领域，以解锁一个更加自主、可互操作的世界。我们使决策者和操作员能够构建统一的情报图景，为他们提供所需的清晰度，以引导当前正在发生的事情并塑造接下来的情况。我们将来自我们的星座（包括在轨成像卫星）的数据与来自太空、空中和地面的实时传感器反馈相融合，创建一个支持人工智能的地球数字孪生。我们的空间智能平台可自动化周期的每个部分（从任务分配到收集再到生产），以根据变化的速度更新和分析这一基础。我们的产品推动更深入的关键任务洞察，并连接国防、情报和商业领域的下一代自主系统。要了解更多信息，请访问 www.vantor.com

articles.title: I Am Artemis: Allison Mjoen
articles.author: Jason Costa

paras.en: As the supercooled propellant flowed into the core stage, and NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket roared to life, Allison Mjoen and her family watched with awe and pride. Mjoen, NASA’s operations manager for the agency’s Exploration Ground Systems Program, helped shape the systems and ground operations that will one day send humans back to the Moon. Over her 20-year career at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, she supported missions across the Space Shuttle Program, the International Space Station, and now she is applying that experience to Artemis.
paras.zh: 当过冷推进剂流入核心阶段，美国宇航局 (NASA) 的 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭轰鸣而起时，艾莉森·姆约恩 (Allison Mjoen) 和她的家人满怀敬畏和自豪地看着。姆乔恩是美国宇航局地面探索系统计划的运营经理，他帮助塑造了有一天将人类送回月球的系统和地面操作。在美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心 20 年的职业生涯中，她为航天飞机计划和国际空间站的任务提供了支持，现在她正在将这些经验应用于阿耳忒弥斯。

paras.en: April 1, 2026, was a bright, crystal-clear day along the Florida Space Coast. The sunlight seemed to sharpen every color along the horizon. As Mjoen and her children counted down and the crowd’s voices rose around them, the rumble of the SLS rocket intensified beneath their feet. For her children, it was the chance to see what their mom had helped make possible. For Mjoen, it was a moment she would never forget.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 1 日，佛罗里达太空海岸天气晴朗、晴朗。阳光似乎使地平线上的每一种颜色都变得更加鲜明。当 Mjoen 和她的孩子们倒数时，周围人群的声音响起，SLS 火箭的隆隆声在他们脚下变得越来越大。对于她的孩子们来说，这是一个亲眼目睹母亲帮助实现的目标的机会。对于 Mjoen 来说，这是她永远不会忘记的时刻。

paras.en: That moment also offered a pause for reflection on the work that led her there. As the spacecraft offline operations manager, Mjoen coordinates the work that happens long before launch day. By supporting the ground systems’ senior vehicle operations manager, Matt Czech, she develops integration plans and oversees ground operations for Artemis vehicle processing, focusing on booster and Orion spacecraft operations.
paras.zh: 那一刻也让她停下来思考引导她到达那里的工作。作为航天器离线运营经理，Mjoen 负责协调发射日之前的工作。通过支持地面系统的高级车辆运营经理马特·捷克，她制定了集成计划并监督阿耳忒弥斯车辆处理的地面运营，重点关注助推器和猎户座航天器的运营。

paras.en: Mjoen began her career as a flight crew systems engineer with United Space Alliance supporting the Space Shuttle Program. Her team handled mission-specific cabin configurations, including the food, spacesuits, cargo, and payloads astronauts needed aboard the shuttle.
paras.zh: Mjoen 的职业生涯始于支持航天飞机计划的联合太空联盟，担任机组人员系统工程师。她的团队负责处理特定任务的机舱配置，包括航天飞机上所需的食物、宇航服、货物和宇航员所需的有效载荷。

paras.en: After the Space Shuttle Program retired, she supported the International Space Station Program as a payload integration engineer. In this role, she connected experiment investigators with the organizations developing their hardware. She later worked in the Project Office on the Test and Operations Support Contract before joining NASA’s Operations Project Engineering Office, where she served as the Spacecraft Payloads Integration and Evolution Element lead for Artemis I.
paras.zh: 航天飞机计划退役后，她作为有效载荷集成工程师支持国际空间站计划。在这个角色中，她将实验研究人员与开发硬件的组织联系起来。后来，她在项目办公室从事测试和运营支持合同工作，然后加入 NASA 运营项目工程办公室，担任阿耳忒弥斯 I 号航天器有效载荷集成和演化元件负责人。

paras.en: “Early on, I thought every decision had to be perfect, but everything is an opportunity to learn, especially the tasks that seem unrelated at the time. It’s about staying curious, working hard, building relationships, and trusting that each step is preparing you for the next one.
paras.zh: “早期，我认为每一个决定都必须是完美的，但一切都是一个学习的机会，尤其是那些当时看起来无关的任务。它是关于保持好奇心，努力工作，建立关系，并相信每一步都在为下一步做好准备。

paras.en: Operations Manager, NASA's Exploration Ground Systems
paras.zh: NASA 地面探索系统运营经理

paras.en: That preparation took on new meaning when she first supported integrated firing room operations as a certified operations project engineer during Artemis I. Earning the certification was a milestone. Applying it during real time operations brought a new level of responsibility.
paras.zh: 当她在阿耳忒弥斯一号期间首次作为认证操作项目工程师支持综合燃烧室操作时，这种准备工作有了新的意义。获得认证是一个里程碑。在实时操作中应用它带来了新的责任水平。

paras.en: “Every decision and communication directly supported the integrated team’s ability to execute safely and properly implement the test procedure,” said Mjoen.
paras.zh: “每一个决定和沟通都直接支持集成团队安全、正确执行测试程序的能力，”Mjoen 说。

paras.en: Working at the integration console underscored the importance of preparation, collaboration and trust — lessons she carries into her work coordinating across teams today.
paras.zh: 在集成控制台工作强调了准备、协作和信任的重要性——她将这些教训带入了今天跨团队协调的工作中。

paras.en: “I get to collaborate everyday with incredibly talented and dedicated people who are all working toward the same goal. It’s especially rewarding to know that our collective efforts directly contribute to the success of the mission.”
paras.zh: “我每天都能与才华横溢、敬业的人们合作，他们都在为同一个目标而努力。当我知道我们的集体努力直接为任务的成功做出贡献时，我感到特别高兴。”

paras.en: Operations Manager, NASA's Exploration Ground Systems
paras.zh: NASA 地面探索系统运营经理

paras.en: For Mjoen, the shared experience is part of what makes Artemis so important. As the Artemis program continues, she looks forward to another moment families will be able to share as astronauts return to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 对于 Mjoen 来说，共同的经历是阿耳忒弥斯如此重要的部分原因。随着阿耳忒弥斯计划的继续进行，她期待着宇航员返回月球表面时家人能够分享的另一个时刻。

paras.en: “That single moment captured the imagination of people around the world and showed what is possible when we come together for a bold goal,” she said of the first Apollo Moon landing. “Artemis is creating that kind of moment for a whole new generation, and this time to stay.”
paras.zh: “那一刻激发了世界各地人们的想象力，并展示了当我们齐心协力实现大胆目标时，一切皆有可能，”她在谈到首次阿波罗登月时说道。 “阿耳忒弥斯正在为全新一代创造这样的时刻，而这一次将留下来。”

articles.title: NASA Names Stephen Cash Marshall Space Flight Center Director
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has named Stephen Cash director of the agency’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, effective Monday, Oct. 19. Cash, a veteran NASA engineer and aerospace executive, returns to lead the center where he began his career more than four decades ago.
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 任命斯蒂芬·卡什 (Stephen Cash) 担任该机构位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心主任，该任命于 10 月 19 日星期一生效。卡什是 NASA 资深工程师和航空航天高管，他将重返该中心领导该中心，他在四十多年前就开始了自己的职业生涯。

paras.en: “Marshall contributions to NASA’s missions are historic and it’s no question why it’s the Center of Excellence for propulsion,” said Isaacman. “Steve Cash is a Marshall legend, has spent his career around the hardware, the people and has been in the seat before making the decisions when human spaceflight is on the line. As Marshall continues its critical role in Artemis and takes on new challenges in advanced propulsion, nuclear power, and the systems that will carry us deeper into the solar system, Steve brings the experience, technical judgment, and mission focus needed to lead the center into that next chapter. I am also grateful to Rae Ann Meyer for the leadership she has provided to Marshall during this transition and for her continued service to NASA.”
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼说：“马歇尔对美国宇航局任务的贡献是历史性的，毫无疑问为什么它是推进卓越中心。” “史蒂夫·卡什是马歇尔的传奇人物，他的职业生涯围绕着硬件和人员度过，并且在载人航天即将到来时做出决策之前一直在位。随着马歇尔继续在阿尔忒弥斯中发挥关键作用，并在先进推进、核能和将我们带入太阳系更深处的系统方面迎接新的挑战，史蒂夫带来了带领该中心进入下一个篇章所需的经验、技术判断和任务重点。我也感谢雷·安·迈耶为我们提供的领导。马歇尔在这一转变期间以及她继续为美国宇航局服务。”

paras.en: “Leading a NASA center requires a commitment to its people and to the technical capabilities entrusted to them,” said Amit Kshatriya, NASA associate administrator and chief engineer. “Steve understands that the jewel of Marshall is its workforce and that engineering excellence is sustained by giving talented people the opportunity to design, build, test, and learn through hands-on work. As Marshall continues strengthening the manufacturing, structural loads and dynamics, and propulsion capabilities that underpin NASA’s exploration enterprise, Steve’s leadership will help ensure the workforce has opportunities to develop and apply the expertise needed to deliver the agency’s most ambitious missions.”
paras.zh: NASA 副局长兼总工程师 Amit Kshatriya 表示：“领导 NASA 中心需要对其人员以及赋予他们的技术能力做出承诺。” “史蒂夫明白，马歇尔的瑰宝是其员工队伍，通过为人才提供设计、建造、测试和通过实践工作学习的机会来维持工程卓越性。随着马歇尔继续加强支撑 NASA 探索事业的制造、结构负载和动力以及推进能力，史蒂夫的领导将有助于确保员工有机会发展和应用实现该机构最雄心勃勃的任务所需的专业知识。”

paras.en: As center director, Cash will lead one of NASA’s largest field centers, overseeing a workforce of more than 5,000 civil service and contractor employees and a broad portfolio of propulsion, space systems, scientific research, and technology development activities. Marshall plays a critical role in NASA’s Artemis program, including the development of NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket, management of the Human Landing System Program, as well as other capabilities supporting sustained exploration of the Moon and future missions to Mars. Further, Marshall plays a key role in the advancement of nuclear power and propulsion, an area of focus that is expected to grow as NASA works towards sending the first humans to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为中心主任，卡什将领导 NASA 最大的现场中心之一，负责监督 5,000 多名公务员和承包商员工以及广泛的推进、空间系统、科学研究和技术开发活动。马歇尔在 NASA 的阿尔忒弥斯计划中发挥着关键作用，包括 NASA 的 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭的开发、人类着陆系统计划的管理，以及支持月球持续探索和未来火星任务的其他能力。此外，马歇尔在核能和推进力的进步中发挥着关键作用，随着美国宇航局致力于将第一批人类送上火星，这一领域预计将不断发展。

paras.en: “It is a profound honor to be back home at the Marshall Space Flight Center,” said Cash. “I am humbled to stand alongside the brilliant minds here as we continue to turn the impossible into everyday history.”
paras.zh: “能够回到马歇尔太空飞行中心，我感到非常荣幸，”卡什说。 “当我们继续将不可能变成日常历史时，我很荣幸能够与这里的才华横溢的人并肩作战。”

paras.en: Cash began his NASA career at Marshall in 1982 and spent 34 years with the agency, holding senior engineering and management positions supporting some of the nation’s most significant human spaceflight programs.
paras.zh: 卡什于 1982 年在马歇尔开始了他的 NASA 职业生涯，并在该机构工作了 34 年，担任高级工程和管理职位，支持美国一些最重要的载人航天计划。

paras.en: During his NASA career, Cash served as manager of Marshall’s Space Shuttle Propulsion Office, overseeing critical propulsion systems supporting shuttle through its final missions. He later served as director of Marshall’s Safety and Mission Assurance Directorate from 2011 until his retirement in 2016, providing leadership in safety, reliability, and quality engineering to support mission success across the center.
paras.zh: 在他的 NASA 职业生涯中，卡什曾担任马歇尔航天飞机推进办公室的经理，负责监督支持航天飞机完成最终任务的关键推进系统。后来，他从 2011 年起担任马歇尔安全和任务保证局局长，直至 2016 年退休，在安全、可靠性和质量工程方面发挥领导作用，以支持整个中心的任务成功。

paras.en: Following his retirement from NASA, Cash continued his work in the aerospace industry, including serving as vice president for advanced space systems at Axient, supporting the development and execution of major spaceflight programs. In 2024, he was inducted into the Alabama Engineering Hall of Fame in recognition of his contributions to engineering and the nation’s space program.
paras.zh: 从 NASA 退休后，卡什继续在航空航天业工作，包括担任 Axient 先进空间系统副总裁，支持重大航天项目的开发和执行。 2024 年，他入选阿拉巴马州工程名人堂，以表彰他对工程和国家太空计划的贡献。

paras.en: Cash succeeds Rae Ann Meyer, who has served as Marshall’s acting center director since September 2025. Meyer, who previously served as Marshall’s deputy center director and associate director, has provided leadership and continuity across the center’s programs and operations during her tenure as acting director. Meyer will return to her role as Deputy Center Director.
paras.zh: 卡什接替雷·安·迈耶 (Rae Ann Meyer)，雷·安·迈耶自 2025 年 9 月起担任马歇尔中心代理中心主任。迈耶曾担任马歇尔中心副中心主任和副主任，在担任代理中心主任期间，为该中心的项目和运营提供了领导和连续性。迈耶将继续担任中心副主任。

paras.en: Established in 1960, Marshall has played a central role in American space exploration for more than six decades, from developing the Saturn rockets that carried astronauts to the Moon during Apollo to advancing the propulsion systems, infrastructure, and technologies supporting the next era of human spaceflight.
paras.zh: 马歇尔公司成立于 1960 年，六十多年来在美国太空探索中发挥了核心作用，从开发阿波罗计划期间将宇航员送上月球的土星火箭，到推进支持人类航天下一个时代的推进系统、基础设施和技术。

paras.zh: 有关 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: Autumn Paints Poland’s Bieszczady Mountains

paras.en: As the air grows cooler and days shorter, brown bears prowl the Carpathian Mountains of southern Poland with the goal of fattening up ahead of winter hibernation. In a more conspicuous sign of autumn, beech and other deciduous trees blanketing the hillsides start to sport reds and golds. The seasonal transformation was underway in southeast Poland’s Bieszczady National Park on October 8, 2026, when the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on the NASA-USGS Landsat 9 satellite captured this image.
paras.zh: 随着空气变冷，白昼变短，棕熊在波兰南部的喀尔巴阡山脉徘徊，目的是在冬眠之前增肥。秋天的一个更明显的迹象是，覆盖山坡的山毛榉和其他落叶树开始呈现出红色和金色。 2026 年 10 月 8 日，波兰东南部的 Bieszczady 国家公园正在发生季节性变化，当时 NASA-USGS Landsat 9 卫星上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）捕获了这张图像。

paras.en: European beech (Fagus sylvatica) dominates the area’s forests, with other species such as sycamore maple (Acer pseudoplatanus) also contributing to vibrant color in the fall. Dropping air temperatures and waning daylight cause these trees to curtail the production of chlorophyll, the molecule that plants use to synthesize food. Without it, the leaves’ green pigments fade, allowing the yellows and reds of other pigments to show through.
paras.zh: 欧洲山毛榉 (Fagus sylvatica) 在该地区的森林中占主导地位，其他树种如梧桐枫 (Acerpseudoplatanus) 也为秋天带来了鲜艳的色彩。气温下降和日光减弱导致这些树木减少叶绿素的产生，叶绿素是植物用来合成食物的分子。如果没有它，叶子的绿色色素就会褪色，从而使其他色素的黄色和红色显现出来。

paras.en: A descendent of ice-age survivors, the European beech has persisted across millennia in a range of climates. After the glaciers retreated, beech forests spread northward across the European continent from isolated refugia in the Carpathians, Alps, and other mountain ranges, and played a crucial role in reforesting the previously ice-covered land. Portions of Bieszczady National Park are included within UNESCO’s network of ancient and primeval beech forests spanning 18 countries.
paras.zh: 欧洲山毛榉是冰河时代幸存者的后裔，在各种气候条件下已经存在了数千年。冰川退缩后，山毛榉林从喀尔巴阡山脉、阿尔卑斯山和其他山脉的孤立避难所向北蔓延到整个欧洲大陆，在以前冰雪覆盖的土地上重新造林方面发挥了至关重要的作用。 Bieszczady 国家公园的部分地区被纳入联合国教科文组织跨越 18 个国家的古代和原始山毛榉森林网络。

paras.en: Expansive as their footprint across Europe may be, beech forests reach only so high in elevation—about 1,000 to 1,260 meters (3,300 to 4,100 feet)—in this area. Above that is the realm of the polonina, a Slavic term for subalpine meadow, consisting of open grasslands and shrubby thickets of rowan (mountain ash), willows, and green alder. Patches of polonina stretch across ridge tops to the east-southeast of Smerek and appear tan, having lost their summer greenness.
paras.zh: 尽管山毛榉森林的足迹遍及整个欧洲，但该地区的海拔高度仅为 1,000 至 1,260 米（3,300 至 4,100 英尺）。其上方是波洛尼娜（polonina）的领域，这是斯拉夫语中亚高山草甸的意思，由开阔的草原和罗文（山梣）、柳树和绿桤木组成的灌木丛组成。成片的波洛尼娜从山脊顶部延伸到斯梅莱克的东南偏东，呈现出棕褐色，失去了夏季的绿色。

paras.en: The Bieszczady Mountains are renowned not only for forests and mountain meadows but also for charismatic wildlife. European bison, once extinct in the wild, were reintroduced to the area in the 1960s and now roam the hills by the hundreds, according to recent surveys. Additionally, populations of brown bears and Eurasian lynx find refuge and ample food sources in the forests.
paras.zh: Bieszczady 山脉不仅以森林和高山草甸而闻名，还以迷人的野生动物而闻名。根据最近的调查，曾经在野外灭绝的欧洲野牛在 20 世纪 60 年代被重新引入该地区，现在有数百只欧洲野牛在山上漫步。此外，棕熊和欧亚山猫种群在森林中找到了避难所和充足的食物来源。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory image by Michala Garrison, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像，由 Michala Garrison 拍摄，使用美国地质调查局的陆地卫星数据。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

paras.zh: - Bieszczadzki Park Narodowy，Bieszczady 国家公园。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 16 日。

paras.en: - Mitka, J, et al. (2022) Subalpine woody vegetation in the Eastern Carpathians after release from agropastoral pressure. Scientific Reports, 12, 17897.
paras.zh: - 米特卡，J 等人。 (2022) 东喀尔巴阡山脉的亚高山木本植被在农牧压力释放后。科学报告，12，17897。

articles.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualty rates among ‘deadliest’ in years, as energy attacks intensify

paras.en: Ukraine: Civilian casualty rates among ‘deadliest’ in years, as energy attacks intensify
paras.zh: 乌克兰：能源袭击加剧，平民伤亡率跻身多年来“最致命”之列

paras.en: Civilian casualties in Ukraine remain at record levels, with intensified Russian attacks in September continuing a pattern of harm in 2026 far exceeding previous years, UN human rights monitors in Ukraine said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国驻乌克兰人权监察员周五表示，乌克兰的平民伤亡人数仍处于创纪录水平，俄罗斯 9 月份加剧的袭击将延续 2026 年造成的伤害模式，远远超过往年。

paras.en: The mission verified that at least 328 civilians were killed and 2,105 injured in September – 85 per cent more than in September 2025.
paras.zh: 特派团核实，9 月份至少有 328 名平民死亡、2,105 人受伤，比 2025 年 9 月增加了 85%。

paras.en: Casualties were recorded across 22 regions and the city of Kyiv, where civilians were killed or injured on 22 of the month’s 30 days, more often than in any month since the start of the Russian Federation’s full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 22个地区和基辅市均出现人员伤亡，该月30天中有22天有平民伤亡，这一数字比俄罗斯联邦全面入侵开始以来的任何一个月都要多。

paras.en: The trend continued into October. On the night of 6 to 7 October alone, a Russian cruise missile and drone attack killed 22 civilians and injured 45 in Pryluky, in Chernihiv region.
paras.zh: 这一趋势一直持续到十月。仅 10 月 6 日至 7 日夜间，俄罗斯巡航导弹和无人机袭击就在切尔尼戈夫地区普雷卢基造成 22 名平民死亡、45 人受伤。

paras.en: “The first two weeks of October were among the deadliest periods for civilians in years,” said Danielle Bell, head of the human rights monitoring mission.
paras.zh: “10 月的前两周是多年来平民死亡最严重的时期之一，”人权监测团团长丹妮尔·贝尔 (Danielle Bell) 说。

paras.en: The high casualties came as Russian armed forces resumed systematic attacks on energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 造成大量伤亡之际，俄罗斯武装部队恢复了对能源基础设施的系统性攻击。

paras.en: On 13 and 14 October, strikes hit multiple energy facilities, including Kyiv’s three main power stations, temporarily leaving 600,000 people in the capital without electricity, according to Ukrainian authorities.
paras.zh: 据乌克兰当局称，10 月 13 日至 14 日，罢工袭击了多个能源设施，其中包括基辅的三个主要发电站，导致首都 60 万人暂时断电。

paras.en: Ukrainian armed forces also targeted electricity and heating infrastructure in occupied territory and in the Russian Federation, the mission said.
paras.zh: 代表团称，乌克兰武装部队还袭击了被占领土和俄罗斯联邦的电力和供暖基础设施。

paras.en: “Systematically attacking electricity and heating infrastructure as winter approaches is bound to inflict significant suffering on the civilian population,” Ms. Bell warned.
paras.zh: 贝尔女士警告说：“随着冬季的临近，系统性地攻击电力和供暖基础设施必将给平民带来巨大痛苦。”

paras.en: Damaged homes and attacks on energy also risk forcing Ukrainians who have returned home to flee again this winter, the International Organisation for Migration (IOM) warned.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织（IOM）警告说，房屋受损和能源袭击也有可能迫使今年冬天返回家园的乌克兰人再次逃离。

paras.en: “For millions of Ukrainians, the challenge is no longer simply whether they can return home. It is whether they can remain there safely and right now the conditions are making it difficult,” said Arthur Erken, IOM Regional Director for Europe and Central Asia.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织欧洲和中亚区域主任阿瑟·埃尔肯（Arthur Erken）表示：“对于数百万乌克兰人来说，挑战不再只是他们能否返回家园。而是他们能否安全地留在那里，而目前的情况让这变得很困难。”

paras.en: Some 1.45 million returnees now live in frontline districts, and during the last cold season only 32 per cent of households could heat their homes adequately.
paras.zh: 目前约有145万返乡人员生活在前线地区，在上个寒冷季节，只有32%的家庭能够充分取暖。

paras.en: Around 2.1 million older people live alone in apartment buildings, leaving them especially exposed to prolonged power and heating cuts.
paras.zh: 大约 210 万老年人独自居住在公寓楼中，这使他们特别容易遭受长期断电和供暖的影响。

paras.en: Less than seven per cent of IOM’s crisis response plan for Ukraine this year has been funded, Mr. Erken said, calling for urgent support to repair homes, improve insulation and maintain essential services.
paras.zh: 埃尔肯表示，国际移民组织今年针对乌克兰的危机应对计划中只有不到 7% 的资金到位，他呼吁紧急支持修复房屋、改善隔热和维持基本服务。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the eighth localised ceasefire brokered by the international nuclear energy watchdog (IAEA) between Ukraine and Russia, began on Thursday to allow repairs to a damaged backup transformer, strengthening the connection between the Zaporizhzhya Nuclear Power Plant and its sole remaining external power line.
paras.zh: 与此同时，由国际核能监管机构（IAEA）斡旋的乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的第八次局部停火于周四开始，允许修复受损的备用变压器，加强扎波罗热核电站与其唯一剩余的外部电力线之间的连接。

paras.en: IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi welcomed the cooperation of both sides but warned that diesel fuel at the plant was running low, with no deliveries since March.
paras.zh: 国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·马里亚诺·格罗西对双方的合作表示欢迎，但警告说，该工厂的柴油燃料不足，自三月份以来一直没有交付。

paras.en: “It is essential that steps are taken to increase the volume of diesel fuel available on-site prior to winter, when the situation may become acute,” he said, renewing his call for maximum military restraint from all sides.
paras.zh: 他说：“在冬季局势可能变得严峻之前，必须采取措施增加现场可用的柴油量。”他再次呼吁各方保持最大限度的军事克制。

articles.title: As disasters mount, next UN climate summit faces a test of trust

paras.en: As disasters mount, next UN climate summit faces a test of trust
paras.zh: 随着灾害加剧，下一届联合国气候峰会面临信任考验

paras.en: Less than a month before the UN climate conference COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye, representatives of three successive summit presidencies gathered to address a pressing question: How can the world restore trust in climate action when the consequences of a warming planet are already being felt?
paras.zh: 距离联合国气候大会 COP31 在土耳其安塔利亚开幕不到一个月，连续三届峰会主席国的代表齐聚一堂，讨论一个紧迫的问题：当地球变暖的后果已经显现时，世界如何才能恢复对气候行动的信任？

paras.en: The devastation in Nepal offered a stark reminder of what is at stake.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔的灾难清楚地提醒我们，危在旦夕。

paras.en: Opening the high-level meeting at UN Headquarters, General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman evoked the imagery of a wall of water barreling down a mountain valley, sweeping away people, homes and communities in its path.
paras.zh: 大会主席哈利勒·拉赫曼在联合国总部举行的高级别会议开幕式上，描绘了一道水墙从山谷中冲下，冲走沿途的人民、家园和社区的情景。

paras.en: “Scientists had long warned that such events were becoming a reality, yet none of us were prepared for the shocking footage”.
paras.zh: “科学家们早就警告说，此类事件正在成为现实，但我们没有人对这一令人震惊的镜头做好准备”。

paras.en: He reminded delegates that this year's strengthening El Niño could be among the strongest since at least 1950, while the world is on its way to hotting up by 2.8°C above pre-industrial levels under current climate policies, far beyond the Paris Agreement's goals.
paras.zh: 他提醒代表们，今年加强的厄尔尼诺现象可能是至少自 1950 年以来最强的之一，而在当前的气候政策下，世界气温将比工业化前水平高出 2.8°C，远远超出《巴黎协定》的目标。

paras.en: “Behind these figures are families uprooted, children's missing, school women walking farther for water, and communities confronting losses they cannot bear,” the assembly president added.
paras.zh: “这些数字的背后是家庭背井离乡、儿童失踪、女学生走更远的路去取水，以及社区面临无法承受的损失，”议会议长补充道。

paras.en: The task ahead for world leaders at the upcoming climate conference COP31 is to then turn commitments into action – and promises into trust, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，在即将召开的气候变化大会第三十一届会议上，世界领导人面临的任务是将承诺转化为行动，将承诺转化为信任。

paras.en: “COP31 must be more than another negotiating milestone. It must demonstrate that multilateralism delivers.”
paras.zh: “第三十一届缔约方会议必须不仅仅是另一个谈判里程碑。它必须证明多边主义能够发挥作用。”

paras.en: Türkiye, which will host the conference from 9 to 20 November, outlined plans to accelerate clean energy, reduce methane emissions and strengthen climate resilience.
paras.zh: 土耳其将于 11 月 9 日至 20 日主办这次会议，概述了加速清洁能源、减少甲烷排放和增强气候适应能力的计划。

paras.en: Among the key initiatives for this COP is the Climate Implementation Bridge, developed with the UN Development Programme (UNDP), which aims to transform national climate commitments into investment-ready projects and connect them with financing.
paras.zh: 本次缔约方会议的关键举措之一是与联合国开发计划署 (UNDP) 共同开发的气候实施桥梁，旨在将国家气候承诺转化为投资就绪项目，并将其与融资联系起来。

paras.en: “The issue is not simply the overall volume of finance. It is also whether finance is available, accessible, affordable and predictable,” Türkiye's Ambassador to the UN, Ahmet Yıldız said.
paras.zh: 土耳其驻联合国大使艾哈迈德·伊尔迪兹 (Ahmet Yıldız) 表示：“问题不仅仅在于融资总量。还在于融资是否可用、可获取、负担得起且可预测。”

paras.en: For Pacific island nations, the need for action is already immediate.
paras.zh: 对于太平洋岛国来说，采取行动已经迫在眉睫。

paras.en: Rising seas and extreme weather are threatening homes, livelihoods and infrastructure, a reality highlighted by Australia, which is leading the COP31 negotiations under an unprecedented arrangement that sees two countries thousands of miles apart, sharing responsibilities for the climate summit.
paras.zh: 海平面上升和极端天气正威胁着家园、生计和基础设施，澳大利亚强调了这一现实。澳大利亚在前所未有的安排下领导了 COP31 谈判，两国相距数千英里，共同承担气候峰会的责任。

paras.en: “By listening to our most vulnerable communities, partnering with those in need, and accelerating the implementation of practical initiatives, I believe we can restore trust through climate action,” Australian Ambassador James Larsen said.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚大使詹姆斯·拉森说：“通过倾听我们最脆弱社区的声音，与有需要的人合作，并加快实施实际举措，我相信我们可以通过气候行动恢复信任。”

paras.en: Mr Larsen called for more accessible climate financing and stronger adaptation plans grounded in science and local needs.
paras.zh: 拉森先生呼吁提供更容易获得的气候融资以及基于科学和当地需求的更强有力的适应计划。

paras.en: Brazil, which hosted COP30 last year, identified three priorities for Antalya:
paras.zh: 去年主办 COP30 的巴西确定了安塔利亚的三个优先事项：

paras.en: - Making the new just transition mechanism operational,
paras.zh: - 使新的公正过渡机制投入运行，

paras.en: - improving how countries measure progress on adaptation
paras.zh: - 改进各国衡量适应进展的方式

paras.en: - expanding climate investment in developing countries struggling with debt
paras.zh: - 扩大对债务缠身的发展中国家的气候投资

paras.en: “In a world of States with severe fiscal constraints and high indebtedness, the [finance] talks need to lead to viable solutions for expanding fiscal space for climate investment,” Ambassador Sérgio França Danese urged.
paras.zh: 塞尔吉奥·弗朗萨·达内塞大使敦促说：“在一个各国财政紧缩、负债累累的世界里，[金融]谈判需要找到可行的解决方案，扩大气候投资的财政空间。”

paras.en: The question of who pays, and who benefits, also runs through Ethiopia’s concerns, which will host COP32.
paras.zh: 谁付钱、谁受益的问题也贯穿了将主办 COP32 的埃塞俄比亚的担忧。

paras.en: Africa contributes only around three per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions, Ambassador Tesfaye Yilma Sabo reminded delegates, yet faces some of the most severe consequences of climate change.
paras.zh: 特斯法耶·伊尔玛·萨博大使提醒代表们，非洲仅占全球温室气体排放量的百分之三左右，但却面临着气候变化的一些最严重后果。

paras.en: “Delayed action carries a compounding cost for developing countries. The pace of action matters because the gap between current plans and what the science requires remains significant.
paras.zh: “拖延行动会给发展中国家带来复合成本。行动的步伐很重要，因为当前计划与科学要求之间的差距仍然很大。

paras.en: Financing and access to technology are increasingly determining who benefits from the transition and who is left behind,” he warned.
paras.zh: 融资和技术获取越来越决定着谁从转型中受益，谁被抛在后面，”他警告说。

paras.en: World leaders are expected to gather for a special summit in Antalya on 11 and 12 November, with negotiations set to test whether climate commitments can translate into meaningful change for communities most at risk.
paras.zh: 世界领导人预计将于 11 月 11 日至 12 日在安塔利亚举行特别峰会，届时将进行谈判，测试气候承诺是否能够转化为对面临最大风险的社区进行有意义的变革。

paras.en: But for Mr. Rahman, the measure of success will be found far beyond the negotiating rooms.
paras.zh: 但对拉赫曼来说，衡量成功与否的标准远远超出了谈判室。

paras.en: “Let COP31 be judged not by promises we repeat, but by the people we protect. That is how we restore trust.”
paras.zh: “让 COP31 的评判标准不是我们重复的承诺，而是我们保护的人民。这就是我们恢复信任的方式。”

articles.title: Inside the New York ‘time machine’ racing to save a century of sound and film

paras.en: Inside the New York ‘time machine’ racing to save a century of sound and film
paras.zh: 纽约“时间机器”竞相拯救一个世纪的声音和电影

paras.en: “I tell my kids I work in a time machine,” said Rhony Dostaly. In a basement beneath Lincoln Center, the media preservation engineer rescues moments from the past. “I go back in time, and I grab elements, and I make them available for people today.”
paras.zh: “我告诉我的孩子们我在时间机器上工作，”罗尼·多斯塔利说。在林肯中心地下的地下室里，媒体保存工程师挽救了过去的时刻。 “我回到过去，抓住元素，并将它们提供给今天的人们。”

paras.en: He and his colleagues at the New York Public Library (NYPL) are working against the clock to preserve the contents of film, tape, discs and cylinders that hold more than a century of sound and moving images.
paras.zh: 他和纽约公共图书馆 (NYPL) 的同事正在争分夺秒地保存保存了一个多世纪的声音和动态图像的胶片、磁带、光盘和滚筒的内容。

paras.en: The records are decaying, and the machines that can play them are disappearing.
paras.zh: 唱片正在腐烂，可以播放唱片的机器也在消失。

paras.en: For Mr. Dostaly, it’s not just about technology. He has watched other people’s lives unfold through the archive.
paras.zh: 对于多斯塔利先生来说，这不仅仅是技术的问题。他通过档案观察了其他人的生活。

paras.en: Harry Belafonte, the legendary American singer, actor, civil rights activist – and longtime UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador – filmed his family for decades, from teaching his son to ride a bike in Central Park to trips abroad.
paras.zh: 哈里·贝拉方特 (Harry Belafonte) 是美国传奇歌手、演员、民权活动家，也是联合国儿童基金会长期亲善大使，数十年来一直在拍摄他的家人，从教儿子在中央公园骑自行车到出国旅行。

paras.en: “I’ve actually seen his kids from toddlers all the way to adults,” Mr. Dostaly said.
paras.zh: “我实际上见过他的孩子从幼儿一直到成人，”多斯塔利先生说。

paras.en: Films of the African American civil rights leader Malcolm X’s travels, including footage from Mecca, moved him the most. “I’m the one who’s going to be making it available for everyone to see,” he remembered thinking.
paras.zh: 非裔美国民权领袖马尔科姆·X 旅行的电影，包括麦加的镜头，最令他感动。 “我是那个要让所有人都能看到它的人，”他记得当时的想法。

paras.en: By looking through footage like this – he hopes – young people “will realize the importance of events that took place before they were here on Earth.”
paras.zh: 他希望，通过观看这样的镜头，年轻人“将意识到在他们来到地球之前发生的事件的重要性。”

paras.en: Next door, Casey McNamara, a media preservation coordinator, bends over a reel of film with a jeweller’s loupe or magnifying glass, checking it frame by frame for tears, splices and shrinkage.
paras.zh: 隔壁，媒体保存协调员凯西·麦克纳马拉 (Casey McNamara) 用珠宝商的放大镜或放大镜弯腰查看一卷胶片，逐帧检查是否有撕裂、拼接和收缩。

paras.en: On the white leader she has written “BHARATA NATYAM,” the name of one of the oldest Indian classical dance forms.
paras.zh: 她在白色领舞上写下了“BHARATA NATYAM”，这是印度最古老的古典舞蹈形式之一的名称。

paras.en: Films may reach her “in a rusty tin, on an old projection reel, or in a rag box, in plastic bags.” Without the work she does, some collections “would remain mostly unseen.”
paras.zh: 她收到的电影可能是“装在生锈的罐子里、旧的放映卷轴上、或者装在破布盒里、装在塑料袋里”。如果没有她所做的工作，一些系列“将基本上无人问津”。

paras.en: The lab is part of NYPL’s Digital Collections Operations. Once digitized, most of the material will be accessible to anyone with a library card.
paras.zh: 该实验室是纽约公共图书馆数字馆藏运营的一部分。一旦数字化，任何拥有借书卡的人都可以访问大部分资料。

paras.en: “The tapes and the decks are no longer being manufactured, but the history needs to be preserved,” explained lab manager Shahed Dowlatshahi.
paras.zh: “磁带和录音带不再生产，但历史需要保存，”实验室经理 Shahed Dowlatshahi 解释道。

paras.en: Work like this is exactly the kind of project that the UN’s World Day for Audiovisual Heritage, marked annually on 27 October, is designed to highlight and assist.
paras.zh: 每年 10 月 27 日举行的联合国世界音像遗产日正是旨在强调和协助此类工作的项目。

paras.en: In the audio room, Jeffrey Willens slides a 16-inch disc from a brown paper sleeve marked: A Year To Remember.
paras.zh: 在音响室中，杰弗里·威伦斯 (Jeffrey Willens) 从棕色纸套中取出一张 16 英寸光盘，上面标有：值得纪念的一年。

paras.en: The UN Radio Division produced it for broadcast on New Year’s Day 1949, when the Organization was still headquartered at Lake Success on Long Island.
paras.zh: 联合国广播部门制作了该节目并于 1949 年元旦播出，当时联合国总部仍设在长岛的成功湖。

paras.en: Copies would have been mailed to radio stations and UN offices around the world. Mr. Willens places it on a turntable with a microscope mounted above it, and the voices of actor Fredric March and sportscaster Ted Husing fill the room.
paras.zh: 副本将被邮寄到世界各地的广播电台和联合国办事处。威伦斯先生将其放在转盘上，上面安装了显微镜，演员弗雷德里克·马奇和体育播音员泰德·胡辛的声音充满了整个房间。

paras.en: Down the corridor, engineers are digitizing the archive of William Greaves, a pioneering African American documentary filmmaker.
paras.zh: 沿着走廊，工程师们正在将非裔美国纪录片先驱威廉·格里夫斯 (William Greaves) 的档案数字化。

paras.en: His 2001 film Ralph Bunche: An American Odyssey tells the story of the American diplomat who won the 1950 Nobel Peace Prize for mediating the armistice agreements between Israel and Arab States.
paras.zh: 他 2001 年的电影《拉尔夫·邦奇：美国奥德赛》讲述了一位美国外交官因斡旋以色列和阿拉伯国家之间停战协议而获得 1950 年诺贝尔和平奖的故事。

paras.en: Mr. Bunche was the first Black Nobel laureate and later became UN Under-Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 邦奇先生是第一位黑人诺贝尔奖获得者，后来成为联合国副秘书长。

paras.en: The acetate film which the New York Public Library is trying to preserve suffers from “vinegar syndrome,” a chemical decay that leaves it brittle, warped and smelling of vinegar.
paras.zh: 纽约公共图书馆试图保存的醋酸盐薄膜患有“醋综合症”，这是一种化学腐烂现象，导致薄膜变脆、变形并散发出醋味。

paras.en: “Once that process starts, there’s no stopping it,” Ms. McNamara said. “You can slow it down with cold storage, but it will never reverse.”
paras.zh: “这个过程一旦开始，就无法停止，”麦克纳马拉女士说。 “你可以通过冷藏来减缓它的速度，但它永远不会逆转。”

paras.en: Audiotape can arrive crinkled or stuck together and must be repaired by hand. “To be able to repair it and then play it and get a successful transfer is kind of like surgery,” said media preservation engineer Victoria Fajardo. “It really is such a privilege to be one of the first people to listen to a lot of this content for the first time since it’s been recorded.”
paras.zh: 录音带到达时可能会起皱或粘在一起，必须手工修复。 “能够修复它，然后播放它并获得成功的传输有点像手术，”媒体保存工程师维多利亚·法哈多（Victoria Fajardo）说。 “自从这些内容录制以来，能够成为第一批第一次收听这些内容的人，真是一种荣幸。”

paras.en: Even Digital Betacam cassettes, once considered robust, have started to shed. Francis Dougherty, the specialist who originally built the video lab, now has to clean his deck between tapes. “Every year this job gets more difficult,” he said. “Every year physical media degrades.”
paras.zh: 甚至曾经被认为坚固的 Digital Betacam 磁带也开始脱落。最初建造视频实验室的专家弗朗西斯·多尔蒂（Francis Dougherty）现在必须在磁带之间清理他的磁带。 “这项工作每年都变得更加困难，”他说。 “物理媒体每年都会退化。”

paras.en: “The machines are getting rarer,” Mr. Dougherty added. “The old men who repair the machines are getting even rarer.”
paras.zh: “机器越来越少了，”多尔蒂先生补充道。 “修理机器的老人越来越少了。”

paras.en: Asked how urgent the work is, he does not hesitate: “It should have been dealt with 20 years ago.”
paras.zh: 当被问及这项工作有多紧迫时，他毫不犹豫地说：“20年前就应该处理了。”

paras.en: Universities train young specialists but there are fewer and fewer machines for them to work on.
paras.zh: 大学培养年轻的专家，但可供他们工作的机器却越来越少。

paras.en: “Without people to maintain and repair and service them, we won’t be able to do this,” Mr. Dowlatshahi added. “And there’s only a few people that do it now.”
paras.zh: “如果没有人来维护、修理和维修它们，我们将无法做到这一点，”道拉沙西先生补充道。 “而且现在只有少数人这样做。”

paras.en: Some solutions are built by hand. The turntable that played the UN disc was made by Nick Bergh, a California engineer who builds playback machines as “sort of a hobby.” The library has one of the first in the world.
paras.zh: 有些解决方案是手工构建的。播放联合国光盘的转盘是由加州工程师尼克·伯格（Nick Bergh）制造的，他“出于某种爱好”而制造播放机。该图书馆拥有世界上最早的图书馆之一。

paras.en: It isn’t even finished. For now, its microscope lets engineers inspect record grooves for scratches; eventually, a second arm will read discs optically, without touching them.
paras.zh: 它甚至还没有完成。目前，它的显微镜可以让工程师检查唱片凹槽是否有划痕。最终，第二只手臂将以光学方式读取光盘，而无需接触光盘。

paras.en: Bergh’s earlier machine uses lasers to align warped wax cylinders to within microns and to read broken ones without contact.
paras.zh: Bergh 早期的机器使用激光将翘曲的蜡筒对齐到微米以内，并在不接触的情况下读取破损的蜡筒。

paras.en: The library used it to re-transfer the Mapleson Cylinders, recorded at the Metropolitan Opera in the early 1900s. They hold “unique performances by singers who were never otherwise recorded.”
paras.zh: 图书馆用它重新传输了 1900 年代初在大都会歌剧院录制的 Mapleson Cylinders。他们举办“从未被录制过的歌手的独特表演”。

paras.en: The paradox according to Mr. Willens is that as playback technology improves, the original recordings keep deteriorating.
paras.zh: 威伦斯先生认为，矛盾之处在于，随着播放技术的进步，原始录音却不断恶化。

paras.en: Every year of waiting means less heritage left to save.
paras.zh: 每等待一年，就意味着可保存的遗产越来越少。

articles.title: Dubois vs Itauma is a heavyweight rivalry for the future

paras.en: Daniel Dubois vs Moses Itauma is an all-British heavyweight rivalry for the future | 'British boxing's in a great position'
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜布瓦 (Daniel Dubois) VS 摩西·伊塔玛 (Moses Itauma) 是一场全英国重量级的未来之战 | “英国拳击处于有利地位”

paras.en: Daniel Dubois scored a stunning two-round victory in Saturday's rematch with Fabio Wardley to defend the WBO heavyweight world title; Moses Itauma has to rebuild from his IBF world championship defeat to Filip Hrgovic but can return to set himself on a collision course with Dubois
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜波依斯在周六与法比奥·沃德利的复赛中取得惊人的两回合胜利，卫冕了 WBO 重量级世界拳王头衔；摩西·伊塔马 (Moses Itauma) 必须从 IBF 世界冠军赛输给菲利普·赫尔戈维奇 (Filip Hrgovic) 的经历中恢复过来，但他可以回归并与杜波依斯 (Dubois) 发生冲突。

paras.en: Daniel Dubois and Moses Itauma could become the heavyweight rivalry to define British boxing in the years to come.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜布瓦（Daniel Dubois）和摩西·伊塔玛（Moses Itauma）可能会成为未来几年定义英国拳击界的重量级对手。

paras.en: The sport in the UK has been dominated by the personalities and talents of Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury over the last decade. Although Fury and Joshua didn't box each other when they were both reigning world champions, they will finally fight in December in Cardiff.
paras.zh: 在过去的十年里，英国这项运动一直由安东尼·约书亚和泰森·富里的个性和才华主导。尽管富里和约书亚在卫冕世界冠军时并没有互相打斗，但他们最终将在12月在卡迪夫交锋。

paras.en: That really will be a swansong bout for Fury and Joshua. While it's hard to imagine Dubois and Itauma matching the levels of fame Fury and AJ enjoyed, they can emulate them as two British rivals taking over the top of the heavyweight division.
paras.zh: 对于富里和约书亚来说，这确实是一场绝唱。虽然很难想象杜波依斯和伊塔玛能与弗瑞和 AJ 享有的名气相媲美，但他们可以效仿他们，成为两位英国竞争对手，占据重量级拳王地位。

paras.en: - Dubois wants Usyk trilogy fight: 'We're coming out on top this time!'
paras.zh: - 杜波依斯希望乌西克三部曲之战：“这次我们会取得胜利！”

paras.en: - Dubois smashes through Wardley to win world title rematch in two rounds
paras.zh: - 杜波依斯横扫沃德利，两回合争夺世界冠军头衔

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW
paras.zh: - NOW 最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: They can also differ from Fury and AJ in a crucial regard - they don't have to leave actually fighting each other until the autumn of their careers. Both Dubois and Itauma are young, especially for heavyweights. Dubois is 29 years old and Itauma just 21.
paras.zh: 他们在一个关键方面也与Fury和AJ不同——他们不必在职业生涯的秋天之前真正互相争斗。杜波依斯和伊塔玛都很年轻，尤其是对于重量级人物来说。杜布瓦 (Dubois) 29 岁，伊塔玛 (Itauma) 年仅 21 岁。

paras.en: They can fight in their primes, and they've got the time to box twice, even three times, in their careers if merited.
paras.zh: 他们可以在巅峰时期参加比赛，如果值得的话，他们有机会在职业生涯中打两次甚至三次拳击。

paras.en: Dubois is riding high now. His two defeats to Oleksandr Usyk feel long distant after Dubois won an epic brawl in a first fight with Fabio Wardley to claim the WBO world title and most recently demolished Wardley in a rematch to defend the belt.
paras.zh: 杜波依斯现在正处于巅峰状态。杜波依斯在与法比奥·沃德利的首场比赛中赢得了一场史诗般的斗殴，夺得了WBO世界拳王头衔，并在最近的一场重赛中击败了沃德利，卫冕金腰带，之后他两次输给亚历山大·乌西克感觉已经很遥远了。

paras.en: Itauma has to come back from defeat to Filip Hrgovic, a first professional loss for the fast-rising star.
paras.zh: 伊塔马必须从输给菲利普·赫尔戈维奇的比赛中恢复过来，这是这位迅速崛起的新星的职业生涯首场失利。

paras.en: Fighting for the IBF world title, Itauma outboxed Hrgovic, only to suddenly tire and unravel. Hrgovic, after absorbing punishment for eight rounds, stopped Itauma in the ninth.
paras.zh: 在争夺 IBF 世界冠军的过程中，伊塔玛击败了赫尔戈维奇，但突然感到疲倦和崩溃。赫尔戈维奇在接受了八个回合的处罚后，在第九局阻止了伊塔玛。

paras.en: Itauma now finds himself with questions to answer and a point to prove, just as Dubois did in his first career defeat when he took a knee against Joe Joyce in 2020.
paras.zh: 伊塔玛现在发现自己有问题需要回答，也有需要证明的地方，就像杜波依斯在 2020 年对乔·乔伊斯单膝下跪时所做的那样，这是他职业生涯的第一次失败。

paras.en: Dubois is backing Itauma to come back and return to the heavyweight title picture.
paras.zh: 杜波依斯支持伊塔玛回归并重返重量级冠军头衔。

paras.en: "I hope so," Dubois said. "You need dance partners."
paras.zh: “我希望如此，”杜波依斯说。 “你需要舞伴。”

paras.en: Frank Warren promotes both Dubois and Itauma. He believes Itauma will be improved by the defeat. "That's what makes you a better fighter," Warren said.
paras.zh: 弗兰克·沃伦 (Frank Warren) 宣传杜波依斯 (Dubois) 和伊塔玛 (Itauma)。他相信伊塔马会因为这次失败而有所进步。 “这就是让你成为更好的战士的原因，”沃伦说。

paras.en: "He's 21 years of age. He'll have a comeback fight [in January] and I'm sure he'll come through it and then we'll look at all the various scenarios. But he'll want to be involved in it.
paras.zh: “他今年 21 岁了。（在一月份）他将有一场复出之战，我相信他会挺过去，然后我们会考虑所有不同的情况。但他会想参与其中。”

paras.en: "What a great position that British boxing's in," Warren added. "This is not something that just happened overnight, we worked hard for this.
paras.zh: “英国拳击处于多么有利的地位，”沃伦补充道。 “这不是一夜之间发生的事情，我们为此付出了努力。

paras.en: "We are on a mission to get these heavyweights under an umbrella but make the fights happen."
paras.zh: “我们的使命是让这些重量级人物受到保护，但让战斗发生。”

articles.title: What next for Kartal after 'unbelievable week' in Wuhan

paras.en: Sonay Kartal: What next for new British No 1 after 'unbelievable week' in run to the final at Wuhan Open
paras.zh: 索奈·卡尔塔尔：在进入武汉公开赛决赛“令人难以置信的一周”之后，英国新任世界第一的下一步是什么

paras.en: Britain's Sonay Kartal enjoyed the best week of her career so far as she surprisingly made the final at the Wuhan Open; Kartal only recently returned from injury, so what is her potential and can she kick on? Watch the Japan Open all this week, live on Sky Sports Tennis
paras.zh: 英国选手索奈·卡尔塔尔享受了职业生涯迄今为止最好的一周，她在武汉公开赛上令人惊讶地进入了决赛；卡塔尔最近才从伤病中恢复过来，那么她的潜力是什么？她能继续踢下去吗？本周观看天空体育网球直播的日本公开赛

paras.en: Sonay Kartal is the new British No 1 after her remarkable run to the Wuhan Open final where she was narrowly beaten by Poland's Maja Chwalinska in three sets.
paras.zh: 索奈·卡尔塔尔在武汉公开赛决赛中表现出色，在三盘险胜波兰选手玛雅·查瓦林斯卡之后，成为英国新一号选手。

paras.en: Kartal became just the second Briton, after Johanna Konta, to play in a WTA 1000 final with superb wins over Tokyo Olympic champion Belinda Bencic, two-time Grand Slam finalist Jasmine Paolini, world No 6 Elina Svitolina and former French Open champion Jelena Ostapenko.
paras.zh: 卡尔塔尔成为继约翰娜·孔塔之后第二位闯入WTA 1000决赛的英国人，她击败了东京奥运会冠军贝琳达·本西奇、两届大满贯决赛入围者茉莉·保利尼、世界排名第六的埃琳娜·斯维托丽娜和前法网冠军耶琳娜·奥斯塔彭科。

paras.en: It is arguably the most impressive tournament performance from a British female player since Emma Raducanu won the 2021 US Open, particularly given Kartal only returned to action last month following six months out due to a stress fracture in her back.
paras.zh: 这可以说是自艾玛·拉杜卡努 (Emma Raducanu) 赢得 2021 年美国公开赛冠军以来英国女选手在比赛中最令人印象深刻的表现，特别是考虑到卡尔塔尔因背部应力性骨折缺席六个月后上个月才重返赛场。

paras.en: "We have had an unbelievable week. Not many people expected me to be here and bring these levels," said the 24-year-old after losing 2-6 6-4 6-2 to this year's French Open runner-up Chwalinska.
paras.zh: “我们度过了令人难以置信的一周。没有多少人期望我能在这里并达到这样的水平，”这位24岁的选手在以2-6 6-4 6-2输给今年法网亚军查瓦林斯卡后说道。

paras.en: "I hope I can be in many more of these finals. It was not the result I wanted today but those people in my box are the reason I am healthy, I am here and why I am back to fitness."
paras.zh: “我希望我能参加更多这样的决赛。这不是我今天想要的结果，但我包厢里的那些人是我健康的原因，我在这里，也是我恢复健康的原因。”

paras.en: Kartal has slowly climbed up the WTA rankings over the last five years but emerged onto the public stage with runs to the third and fourth round at Wimbledon in 2024 and 2025.
paras.zh: 过去五年里，卡尔塔尔在 WTA 排名中缓慢攀升，并在 2024 年和 2025 年温网打进第三轮和第四轮，登上了公众舞台。

paras.en: She became known for her variety, athleticism and aggressive forehand from awkward angles - strengths that helped her last week in Wuhan.
paras.zh: 她因其多样性、运动能力和从尴尬角度进攻的正手而闻名——这些优势在上周的武汉比赛中为她提供了帮助。

paras.en: Kartal's stress fracture in her back saw her retire from the fourth round of Indian Wells in March against Elena Rybakina and led to her longest period out of tennis.
paras.zh: 卡尔塔尔背部应力性骨折导致她在三月份印第安维尔斯第四轮对阵埃琳娜·雷巴基娜的比赛中退赛，并导致她缺席网球比赛的时间最长。

paras.en: The long spell on the sidelines means Kartal can use her protected ranking - a provision that allows players to use the ranking they had at the time of their injury, if they have been out for at least six months, to enter tournaments over the next 12 months.
paras.zh: 长期缺席比赛意味着卡尔塔尔可以使用她受保护的排名——这项规定允许球员使用受伤时的排名（如果他们已经缺席至少六个月）来参加接下来 12 个月的比赛。

paras.en: "The rehab was tough. I think the main priority was to just get back on court and maybe I didn't do the big heavy lifting, which now I can do," said Kartal.
paras.zh: “康复过程很艰难。我认为首要任务是回到球场上，也许我没有做大重量的举重，但现在我可以做，”卡尔塔尔说。

paras.en: "I wanted to use these weeks to see where I'm at physically and what I need to improve and to see if I'm feeling how I was on the court from in March. The remainder of this year I'm going to work on those things and I'm excited to start next year already."
paras.zh: “我想用这几周的时间来看看我的身体状况以及需要改进的地方，并看看我从三月份开始在球场上的感觉如何。今年剩下的时间我将致力于这些事情，我很高兴明年就开始。”

paras.en: We have been here before with British tennis players - Katie Boulter won a WTA 500 event in 2024, Raducanu memorably won the 2021 US Open as a teenager, and reached the final at Queen's Club this summer before a stress fracture in her right leg forced her to miss Wimbledon, the US Open and likely the remainder of this season.
paras.zh: 我们之前曾与英国网球运动员一起来过这里 - 凯蒂·博尔特 (Katie Boulter) 在 2024 年赢得了 WTA 500 赛事，拉杜卡努 (Raducanu) 在青少年时期赢得了 2021 年美国网球公开赛，并在今年夏天进入了女王俱乐部的决赛，但右腿应力性骨折迫使她错过了温布尔登、美国网球公开赛以及本赛季剩余比赛。

paras.en: Kartal's week in Wuhan was arguably against stiffer opposition than what Boulter and Raducanu faced, plus it was only her second tour tournament back after injury.
paras.zh: 卡尔塔尔在武汉的一周可以说是遇到了比博尔特和拉杜卡努更强大的对手，而且这只是她受伤后第二场巡回赛。

paras.en: "There is no doubt in my mind that we will have the pleasure of watching Kartal have these sorts of runs in the future," said former doubles player and Sky Sports Tennis' Colin Fleming.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，在我看来，我们将来会很高兴看到卡尔塔尔有这样的表现，”前双打运动员、天空体育网球队的科林·弗莱明说。

paras.en: "She is playing at such a high level and will get better."
paras.zh: “她的比赛水平如此之高，而且会变得更好。”

paras.en: At 30 years old, Boulter is likely in the peak years of her career while Raducanu and Kartal should still have more to come.
paras.zh: 30 岁的博尔特很可能正处于职业生涯的巅峰期，而拉杜卡努和卡尔塔尔应该还会有更多的发展。

paras.en: For Kartal, her serve and ball-striking on both wings are two key areas which will need improvement if she's to become an established top player.
paras.zh: 对于卡尔塔尔来说，她的发球和两翼击球是两个关键领域，如果她想成为一名公认的顶级球员，这两个领域都需要改进。

paras.en: British tennis could benefit from an injury-free Raducanu and Kartal, both pushing each other on in 2027 because both have now shown tremendous potential, it's now a question of hitting those heights more consistently.
paras.zh: 英国网球可能会受益于没有受伤的拉杜卡努和卡尔塔尔，两人将在 2027 年互相推动，因为两人现在都表现出了巨大的潜力，现在的问题是如何更稳定地达到这些高度。

paras.en: In the immediate future, Kartal may withdraw from this week's Japan Open in Osaka to recover from her Wuhan efforts before looking to conclude her season in one of the WTA 500 or WTA 250s in China, Hong Kong and India - all live on Sky Sports Tennis over the next three weeks.
paras.zh: 在不久的将来，卡尔塔尔可能会退出本周在大阪举行的日本公开赛，以从武汉的训练中恢复过来，然后在中国、香港和印度的 WTA 500 或 WTA 250 赛事之一中结束她的赛季——所有赛事都将在未来三周内由天空体育网球直播。

paras.en: "I had one goal with this Asian swing was to just defend the points that I did from last year and I've done better than that so it's set me up incredibly for next year and put me in a very good spot," said Kartal.
paras.zh: “我在这次亚洲挥杆比赛中的一个目标就是捍卫我去年取得的分数，而且我做得比这更好，所以这为我明年的比赛奠定了难以置信的基础，让我处于一个非常好的位置，”卡尔塔尔说。

articles.title: US GP talking points: How will Hamilton, Norris move on from woes?

paras.en: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris moving on from Singapore woes among talking points for Austin race
paras.zh: 美国大奖赛：刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯摆脱新加坡困境成为奥斯汀比赛的话题

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli could seal his maiden F1 drivers' title at this weekend's United States GP; Lewis Hamilton and Lando Norris are both looking to bounce back from controversies; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 基米·安东内利可能会在本周末的美国大奖赛上锁定他的首个 F1 车手冠军头衔；刘易斯·汉密尔顿和兰多·诺里斯都希望从争议中恢复过来。观看 10 月 23 日至 25 日在奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛的每一场比赛，天空体育 F1 直播

paras.en: Formula 1 returns to Austin's Circuit of The Americas for the United States Grand Prix with a historic championship crowning potentially in the offing, along with several other hot topics on the agenda.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车重返奥斯汀美洲赛道，举行美国大奖赛，历史性的冠军争夺战即将加冕，议程上还有其他几个热门话题。

paras.en: All eyes on Antonelli as history beckons
paras.zh: 历史在召唤，所有人的目光都集中在安东内利身上

paras.en: The event in Texas kicks off the second of three triple-headers to end the season, with races in Mexico and Brazil immediately following this one.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州的比赛拉开了本赛季三场三赛中的第二场的序幕，紧随其后的是墨西哥和巴西的比赛。

paras.en: There is every chance that Antonelli will become F1's youngest ever world champion on one of the next three Sundays, but it would require something quite dramatic for that to be in Austin.
paras.zh: 安东内利很有可能在接下来的三个周日之一成为 F1 有史以来最年轻的世界冠军，但这需要在奥斯汀发生一些相当戏剧性的事情。

paras.en: - How Kimi Antonelli could win F1 world title as soon as the next race
paras.zh: - 基米·安东内利如何能够在下一场比赛中赢得 F1 世界冠军
