paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Antonelli would need to win the United States Grand Prix and for his Mercedes team-mate George Russell to finish ninth or lower, with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton also finishing fifth or lower.
paras.zh: 安东内利需要赢得美国大奖赛，而他的梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔则需要获得第九名或更低的成绩，而法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿也需要获得第五名或更低的成绩。

paras.en: However the weekend plays out, it will be fascinating to see how Antonelli handles the pressure of the title being attainable for the first time.
paras.zh: 不管周末的结果如何，看看安东内利如何应对首次夺冠的压力将会很有趣。

paras.en: Ultimately, there has been little evidence to suggest the 20-year-old will back far away from the aggressive approach that has served him so well this season, and why should he?
paras.zh: 最终，几乎没有证据表明这位 20 岁的球员会放弃本赛季对他大有裨益的进攻方式，他为什么要这么做呢？

paras.en: A key factor in determining when Antonelli seals the title could be the performance of his Mercedes car, and more specifically the upgrades that have been brought to it in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 决定安东内利何时夺得冠军的一个关键因素可能是他的梅赛德斯赛车的性能，更具体地说是最近几周对其进行的升级。

paras.en: The Silver Arrows had projected plenty of confidence over the major package they added to the W17 at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, but it appeared to have a negative impact as they delivered arguably their least performative weekend of the season.
paras.zh: 银箭队对他们在马来西亚巴林大奖赛上为 W17 添加的主要套件充满信心，但这似乎产生了负面影响，因为他们可以说是本赛季表现最差的周末。

paras.en: That led to the team taking the quite extreme step of running a full test of the upgrades the following weekend in Singapore as Antonelli drove with the new parts on his car and Russell drove with the pre-Sepang specification.
paras.zh: 这导致团队采取了相当极端的步骤，在接下来的周末在新加坡对升级进行了全面测试，安东内利驾驶着他的汽车上的新部件，拉塞尔驾驶着雪邦之前的规格。

paras.en: The extreme heat and nature of the surface in Malaysia made it tricky for all the teams to analyse their performance, while Singapore's Marina Bay Street Circuit is also something of an outlier on the calendar.
paras.zh: 马来西亚的极端高温和地表性质使得所有车队都很难分析他们的表现，而新加坡的滨海湾街道赛道也在日历上有些异常。

paras.en: A return to a more traditional circuit in Austin therefore makes it a crucial weekend for Mercedes, whose plans for the development of their 2027 car will be significantly impacted if this package simply doesn't work.
paras.zh: 因此，回归奥斯汀的传统赛道对于梅赛德斯来说是一个至关重要的周末，如果这个方案不起作用，梅赛德斯 2027 年赛车的开发计划将受到重大影响。

paras.en: There is no longer any doubt that Max Verstappen and Red Bull are well and truly back.
paras.zh: 毫无疑问，马克斯·维斯塔潘和红牛已经真正回归。

paras.en: The four-time world champion had to wait until the 16th round of the season for his first Grand Prix victory of 2026, but it was then just seven days before his second came along.
paras.zh: 这位四届世界冠军得等到本赛季第 16 轮才能获得 2026 年的首场大奖赛胜利，但仅仅 7 天后，他的第二场胜利就到来了。

paras.en: There's no doubt that the upgrades Red Bull have gradually added to the car are working, with Verstappen having been in a league of his own over the past two weekends.
paras.zh: 毫无疑问，红牛逐渐对赛车进行的升级正在发挥作用，维斯塔潘在过去的两个周末一直处于自己的联盟​​状态。

paras.en: Antonelli might be on the brink of glory, but there is already a growing sense in the paddock that Verstappen could end this year and start next season as the driver to beat.
paras.zh: 安东内利可能正处于荣耀的边缘，但围场里已经有越来越多的人意识到，维斯塔潘可能会在今年结束并在下个赛季开始，成为击败的车手。

paras.en: Antonelli himself admitted that it would be "very scary" if Verstappen was challenging him for the title in this form.
paras.zh: 安东内利本人承认，如果维斯塔潘以这种形式挑战他的冠军头衔，那将“非常可怕”。

paras.en: Verstappen is just eight points behind third-placed Lewis Hamilton and 17 points behind second-placed Russell in the drivers' standings, with both at major risk of being overhauled by the Dutchman in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 在车手积分榜上，维斯塔潘仅落后第三名刘易斯·汉密尔顿 8 分，落后第二名拉塞尔 17 分，两人在未来几周内都面临着被荷兰人彻底取代的巨大风险。

paras.en: While the positions below first in the Drivers' Championship count for little, Verstappen appears as though he may be in the process of laying down a major psychological marker for next year.
paras.zh: 虽然在车手积分榜上排名第一的位置意义不大，但维斯塔潘似乎正在为明年制定一个重要的心理标记。

paras.en: How will Hamilton handle strategy error?
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿将如何处理策略错误？

paras.en: In contrast to the late-season momentum that Verstappen is building, his old rival Hamilton's campaign is fizzling out.
paras.zh: 与维斯塔潘赛季末的势头形成鲜明对比的是，他的老对手汉密尔顿的赛季正在逐渐走向失败。

paras.en: The latest downturn came in Singapore when the seven-time world champion made an inexplicable decision to ignore Ferrari's call for him to come into the pits during a Virtual Safety Car period.
paras.zh: 最近的低迷发生在新加坡，这位七届世界冠军做出了一个莫名其妙的决定，无视法拉利在虚拟安全车期间要求他进站的呼吁。

paras.en: While stopping would have almost certainly condemned him to finishing behind team-mate Charles Leclerc, getting rid of his already worn tyres would have likely sealed a podium finish, or at worst, fourth place.
paras.zh: 虽然停车几乎肯定会让他落后于队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔，但摆脱已经磨损的轮胎很可能会登上领奖台，或者最坏的情况是获得第四名。

paras.en: Instead, he took the chequered flag in sixth, before not showing up for his post-race interviews amid concern over his physical condition following the gruelling race.
paras.zh: 相反，他以第六名的成绩获得了方格旗，但由于在这场艰苦的比赛后担心自己的身体状况，他没有出席赛后采访。

paras.en: The saga has led to speculation over a possible breakdown of trust between Hamilton and the Ferrari pit wall, with the 41-year-old having been unhappy with their choices on several other occasions this season.
paras.zh: 这一事件引发了人们对汉密尔顿和法拉利维修站之间的信任可能破裂的猜测，这位 41 岁的汉密尔顿在本赛季的其他几个场合都对他们的选择感到不满。

paras.en: Given the fact he didn't speak after the race in Singapore, there will be extra attention on his press briefings on Thursday in Austin.
paras.zh: 鉴于他在新加坡的比赛后没有发表讲话，周四他在奥斯汀举行的新闻发布会将受到额外关注。

paras.en: While that might be intriguing, the more pressing issue is that Ferrari need to sort their act out for 2027 with the threat of Verstappen looming.
paras.zh: 虽然这可能很有趣，但更紧迫的问题是，随着维斯塔潘迫在眉睫的威胁，法拉利需要在 2027 年解决他们的问题。

paras.en: If Red Bull need a warning against taking anything for granted after Verstappen's successive wins, it's glaring at them in the form of the papaya McLarens.
paras.zh: 如果红牛在维斯塔潘连续获胜后需要一个警告，不要把任何事情视为理所当然，那么木瓜迈凯伦车队的表现就是在向他们发出警告。

paras.en: Either side of the summer break, it was Lando Norris who claimed his first two victories of the season in successive races in Hungary and the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 暑假期间，兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利和荷兰的连续比赛中赢得了本赛季的前两场胜利。

paras.en: He should have had a third in Madrid soon after, with his hugely impressive pace at each of those events leading many to believe McLaren were going to be the team to beat for the remainder of the season.
paras.zh: 不久之后，他本应在马德里获得第三个冠军，他在每场比赛中令人印象深刻的速度让许多人相信迈凯伦将成为本赛季剩余比赛中击败的球队。

paras.en: Instead, the last triple-header saw them drop painfully backwards. Norris didn't qualify higher than fifth at the three events and his best result was fourth in Singapore.
paras.zh: 相反，最后一个三连球让他们痛苦地向后倒退。诺里斯在这三项赛事中的资格均未高于第五名，他的最好成绩是在新加坡获得第四名。

paras.en: The Brit was also guilty of creating negative headlines for the team by attempting a late overtake in the Singapore Sprint on his team-mate Oscar Piastri that resulted in the pair crashing and cost them both points.
paras.zh: 英国人还因在新加坡冲刺赛后期试图超越队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（Oscar Piastri）而为车队制造了负面头条新闻，导致两人撞车并双双失分。

paras.en: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella and chief executive Zak Brown made it clear they were extremely unhappy with the collision, but opted against publicly criticising Norris.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉和首席执行官扎克·布朗明确表示，他们对这次碰撞非常不满，但选择不公开批评诺里斯。

paras.en: Now that the team have had more time to review the incident, it will be interesting to see if Norris feels the need to make further apologies, or whether there are firmer words from the top.
paras.zh: 现在团队有更多的时间来审查这一事件，看看诺里斯是否觉得有必要进一步道歉，或者高层是否有更坚定的言论，这将是一件很有趣的事情。

articles.title: Tech stocks erase $1 trillion of wealth as oil surges to $110 for the first time since May
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Tech stocks shed more than $1 trillion in value Friday, as the price of oil soared to its highest levels in five months.
paras.zh: 随着石油价格飙升至五个月来的最高水平，科技股周五市值蒸发超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: The Nasdaq 100 index, which tracks most of the country’s largest tech and AI-linked companies, sold off by 2.5% and now sits about 7% below its most recent all-time high — a record it had only notched last week.
paras.zh: 追踪美国大部分最大的科技和人工智能相关公司的纳斯达克 100 指数下跌了 2.5%，目前比最近的历史高点低了约 7%——这是上周才创下的纪录。

paras.en: The S&P 500 dropped 1% and the Russell 2000 index fell 1.6%. The Philadelphia semiconductor index dropped 3.8% for its eight straight day of losses, the longest such streak since 2008.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1%，罗素 2000 指数下跌 1.6%。费城半导体指数下跌 3.8%，连续八个交易日下跌，这是自 2008 年以来最长的连续下跌趋势。

paras.en: The sharp drop in tech shares came as worries about ballooning debt, high interest rates and rising oil prices all resurfaced.
paras.zh: 随着对债务膨胀、高利率和油价上涨的担忧重新浮现，科技股大幅下跌。

paras.en: Brent crude oil, widely considered to be among the most important prices in global energy, surpassed $110 per barrel shortly after 2:30 p.m. ET, its highest level since May. It ended the week at $109.86 per barrel, still its highest closing level since May 19.
paras.zh: 布伦特原油被广泛认为是全球能源中最重要的价格之一，下午 2:30 后不久就突破了每桶 110 美元。 ET，为五月以来的最高水平。本周收盘价为每桶 109.86 美元，仍是 5 月 19 日以来的最高收盘水平。

paras.en: U.S. crude oil, which also steers gas prices, jumped 3.5% Friday to close at $101.41 per barrel. It was the first time West Texas Intermediate crude had crossed the $100 threshold, closely watched by both traders and the public, since September.
paras.zh: 同样影响天然气价格的美国原油周五上涨 3.5%，收于每桶 101.41 美元。这是西德克萨斯中质原油自 9 月份以来首次突破 100 美元大关，受到交易员和公众的密切关注。

paras.en: The continued upward trend in energy prices increases the likelihood that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates again this year. The Fed already boosted rates by 0.25% in September to tame inflation that had risen as a result of higher oil and gas prices.
paras.zh: 能源价格的持续上涨趋势增加了美联储今年再次加息的可能性。美联储已于 9 月份加息 0.25%，以抑制因石油和天然气价格上涨而上升的通胀。

paras.en: Diesel futures also jumped Friday by more than 1%. The cost of this commercial fuel critical for farming and other industrial sectors has risen even faster than regular gasoline in recent months.
paras.zh: 柴油期货周五也上涨超过 1%。近几个月来，这种对农业和其他工业部门至关重要的商业燃料的成本上涨速度甚至超过了普通汽油。

paras.en: The steady rise in the price of fuel around the world began this spring, when the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran in late February and triggered the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 今年春天，美国和以色列袭击伊朗并引发霍尔木兹海峡关闭，全球燃油价格开始稳步上涨。

paras.en: But an escalation in the Russia-Ukraine war in recent months has caused an even more dramatic price spike for diesel.
paras.zh: 但近几个月俄罗斯和乌克兰战争的升级导致柴油价格更加急剧上涨。

paras.en: Russia has traditionally been one of the world’s largest diesel exporters. But attacks by Ukrainian forces on its energy infrastructure has taken much of its refining capacity offline.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯历来是世界上最大的柴油出口国之一。但乌克兰军队对其能源基础设施的袭击已使其大部分炼油能力瘫痪。

paras.en: On Friday, another Russian refiner suspended some crude oil operations. The Russian Defense Ministry said Ukraine had “attempted a massive attack on the Ryazan oil refinery.”
paras.zh: 周五，另一家俄罗斯炼油厂暂停了部分原油业务。俄罗斯国防部表示，乌克兰“试图对梁赞炼油厂发动大规模袭击”。

paras.en: Energy assets in Ukraine have also been targeted by Russian strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰的能源资产也成为俄罗斯袭击的目标。

paras.en: As the world seeks alternative sources for diesel, there are few clear opportunities to expand diesel production. Refineries in the U.S. and Europe are already running at nearly maximum capacity to churn out as much diesel fuel as possible.
paras.zh: 随着全世界都在寻找柴油的替代来源，扩大柴油产量的明显机会却很少。美国和欧洲的炼油厂已经几乎以最大产能运转，以生产尽可能多的柴油。

paras.en: President Donald Trump is intensely focused on the high cost of diesel fuel because of its key role in driving up inflation — a top issue for American voters in the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统非常关注柴油的高成本，因为柴油在推高通胀方面发挥着关键作用，而通胀是美国选民在 11 月 3 日中期选举中面临的首要问题。

paras.en: Trump has tried multiple actions to lower prices, but those have not resulted in a significant step-down for diesel prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普已尝试采取多项降价行动，但这些行动并未导致柴油价格大幅下调。

paras.en: The president has also touted a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin as a way to lower prices, but as of Friday, no actual Russian diesel had been identified as having reached the global market.
paras.zh: 总统还宣扬与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成的一项协议，作为降低价格的一种方式，但截至周五，尚未确定真正的俄罗斯柴油已进入全球市场。

paras.en: Additionally, a group of American lawmakers introduced a bill that would block Trump’s Russian diesel deal. It has little chance of passing the Republican-controlled House.
paras.zh: 此外，一群美国议员提出了一项法案，将阻止特朗普与俄罗斯的柴油交易。它在共和党控制的众议院获得通过的机会很小。

paras.en: But polling indicates that Republicans are unlikely to maintain a majority in the House after November’s elections. The Russian diesel-blocking bill offers a preview of the kind of legislation that could advance under Democratic control.
paras.zh: 但民意调查显示，共和党人不太可能在 11 月选举后维持众议院多数席位。俄罗斯的柴油封锁法案为民主党控制下可能推进的立法提供了预览。

paras.en: Yet even now, the legislation adds to “growing doubts that a U.S.-Russia diesel deal will come to fruition,” said Mason Mendez, global real assets analyst at Wells Fargo.
paras.zh: 富国银行全球实物资产分析师梅森·门德斯表示，即使是现在，这项立法也加剧了“人们对美俄柴油交易能否取得成果的怀疑”。

paras.en: “Investors also remain concerned about further military escalation in the Middle East, as attacks on commercial shipping and regional infrastructure have increased in recent weeks,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“投资者仍对中东军事局势进一步升级感到担忧，因为最近几周对商业航运和地区基础设施的攻击有所增加。”

paras.en: “Looking into 2027, the need to rebuild depleted global inventories could create an additional source of demand and keep energy prices elevated for longer.”
paras.zh: “展望 2027 年，重建耗尽的全球库存的需要可能会创造额外的需求来源，并使能源价格在更长时间内保持高位。”

paras.en: At the same time that inflation pushes interest rates higher around the world, trillion-dollar tech companies are borrowing and spending hundreds of billions of dollars to develop AI and build their vast data centers.
paras.zh: 在通货膨胀推高全球利率的同时，价值数万亿美元的科技公司正在借贷并花费数千亿美元来开发人工智能并建立庞大的数据中心。

paras.en: This week, fresh cracks began to show in the AI business model, as investors raised questions about when their massive injections of cash into AI companies would pay off.
paras.zh: 本周，人工智能商业模式开始出现新的裂缝，投资者质疑他们向人工智能公司注入的大量现金何时能获得回报。

paras.en: The two worst performing stocks in the Nasdaq 100 on Friday were both data center companies: Nebuius and CoreWeave.
paras.zh: 周五纳斯达克 100 指数中表现最差的两只股票都是数据中心公司：Nebuius 和 CoreWeave。

paras.en: The value of CoreWeave’s shares has plunged more than 25% over the past month.
paras.zh: CoreWeave 的股价在过去一个月暴跌超过 25%。

paras.en: But these companies are just two of the dozens that have borrowed billions of dollars at high interest rates to expand at a breakneck pace.
paras.zh: 但这些公司只是数十家以高利率借入数十亿美元以极快的速度扩张的公司中的两家。

paras.en: Just a day before Friday’s sell-off, Ed Yardeni, a highly regarded market analyst, cut his year-end S&P 500 target to 7,900, down from 8,400, over what he said was rising investor caution about the artificial intelligence trade and lingering doubts about inflation and higher interest rates.
paras.zh: 就在周五抛售的前一天，备受推崇的市场分析师艾德·亚德尼 (Ed Yardeni) 将标普 500 指数年终目标从 8,400 点下调至 7,900 点，原因是投资者对人工智能行业的谨慎态度日益增强，以及对通胀和利率上升的疑虑挥之不去。

articles.title: Priest in Ecuador dies after crucifix falls on him during livestreamed Mass
articles.author: Maya Rosenberg

paras.en: A priest in Ecuador died Saturday after a crucifix fell on him during a livestreamed Mass, according to church officials and video of the incident.
paras.zh: 据教堂官员和事件视频显示，厄瓜多尔的一名牧师周六在直播弥撒中被耶稣受难像砸中身亡。

paras.en: The Rev. Patricio Alfredo Sánchez Molinari died Saturday, the Archdiocese of Guayaquil announced.
paras.zh: 瓜亚基尔总教区宣布，帕特里西奥·阿尔弗雷多·桑切斯·莫里纳里牧师于周六去世。

paras.en: He was the parish priest at the Church of Perpetual Relief of the Central Vicariate, the archdiocese said.
paras.zh: 总教区称，他是中央代牧区永久救济教堂的教区牧师。

paras.en: Molinari “has left to the House of the Father to enjoy his presence and glory,” it said in a news release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿中称，莫里纳利“已经离开天父之家，享受他的存在和荣耀”。

paras.en: The Mass was livestreamed, but the video was taken down. The video, reviewed by NBC News, showed a large crucifix hanging on a wall behind Molinari suddenly falling forward onto the back of his head.
paras.zh: 弥撒进行了现场直播，但视频已被删除。美国全国广播公司新闻频道评论的这段视频显示，莫里纳利身后墙上挂着一个巨大的十字架，突然向前倒在他的后脑勺上。

paras.en: Molinari was behind the altar, facing the congregation, and did not see the crucifix falling behind him.
paras.zh: 莫里纳利在祭坛后面，面向会众，没有看到十字架落在他身后。

paras.en: Molinari did not stand back up, and parishioners are heard on the video shrieking and crying. Some rush to tend to him.
paras.zh: 莫里纳里没有站起来，视频中可以听到教区居民的尖叫和哭泣。有些人急忙去照顾他。

paras.en: A Eucharist in his memory is scheduled for Sunday evening.
paras.zh: 周日晚上将举行纪念他的圣体圣事。

articles.title: Councils unite to make Yarra River swimmable by 2050
articles.author: Keira Proust

paras.en: Local governments and Melbourne Water are uniting to clean up the Yarra River and make it swimmable by 2050.
paras.zh: 地方政府和墨尔本水务局正在联手清理亚拉河，并使其在 2050 年之前可以畅游。

paras.en: They're looking to Europe for inspiration about how best to restore the river's health.
paras.zh: 他们正在向欧洲寻求灵感，了解如何最好地恢复河流的健康。

paras.en: Swimming in the city's waterway was restricted in the 1960s, and eventually banned, due to pollution and contamination.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代，由于污染和污染，在城市水道中游泳受到限制，并最终被禁止。

paras.en: As Melbourne sets it sights on a cleaner future for the Yarra River, local councils are looking to Europe for inspiration.
paras.zh: 随着墨尔本着眼于亚拉河更清洁的未来，当地议会正在向欧洲寻求灵感。

paras.en: Four Melbourne councils and Melbourne Water have united to push for the Yarra River, also known as the Birrarung, to become swimmable by 2050.
paras.zh: 墨尔本四个议会和墨尔本水务公司联合起来，推动亚拉河（也称为 Birrarung）在 2050 年之前变得可以游泳。

paras.en: Last year, the River Seine opened for public swimming for the first time since 1923 after huge restoration efforts that took place for the Paris Olympics.
paras.zh: 去年，经过为巴黎奥运会进行的大规模修复工作，塞纳河自 1923 年以来首次向公众开放游泳。

paras.en: City of Melbourne Lord Mayor Nick Reece said progress abroad was encouraging.
paras.zh: 墨尔本市市长 Nick Reece 表示，国外的进展令人鼓舞。

paras.en: "We have seen the way other cities around the world have done just this; Paris, Berlin, Copenhagen," he said.
paras.zh: “我们已经看到了世界上其他城市的做法：巴黎、柏林、哥本哈根，”他说。

paras.en: "The Seine River in Paris has had over 1,000 years of people dumping sewerage and waste in it.
paras.zh: “一千多年来，人们一直在巴黎的塞纳河里倾倒污水和废物。

paras.en: "They've managed to clean that river up and make it swimmable."
paras.zh: “他们已经成功清理了那条河，使其可以游泳。”

paras.en: Since colonisation, Melburnians enjoyed the Yarra River for leisure, and it was used by local First Nations people long before that.
paras.zh: 自殖民以来，墨尔本人就喜欢在雅拉河上休闲，早在很久以前，当地原住民就曾使用过雅拉河。

paras.en: In 1918, the world high diving record was broken when Alick Wickham dove from the cliffs at Fairfield into the Yarra River as more than 60,000 people watched from below.
paras.zh: 1918 年，阿里克·威克姆 (Alick Wickham) 从费尔菲尔德 (Fairfield) 的悬崖跳入亚拉河 (Yarra River)，打破了世界高位跳水纪录，超过 60,000 人在下方观看。

paras.en: But industrialisation and a booming population badly degraded the city's waterway, with swimming eventually banned across much of the river.
paras.zh: 但工业化和人口激增严重破坏了该市的水道，最终禁止在大部分河流游泳。

paras.en: Before it was forbidden, June Noble swam in the river as part of the Race to Prince's Bridge three-mile swim in 1955.
paras.zh: 在这项禁令被禁止之前，琼·诺布尔 (June Noble) 在 1955 年王子桥三英里游泳比赛中曾在河里游泳。

paras.en: "I didn't do much preparation; I just thought that the river would take me down and it was a very exciting day really," she said.
paras.zh: “我没有做太多准备；我只是觉得这条河会把我带下去，这确实是非常令人兴奋的一天，”她说。

paras.en: "There certainly was a good crowd of spectators as we went down the river."
paras.zh: “当我们顺流而下时，肯定有很多观众。”

paras.en: The 92-year-old now lives in Alice Springs but spent her childhood swimming and competing in races at the Brighton Baths.
paras.zh: 这位 92 岁的老人现在住在爱丽丝泉，但她的童年是在布莱顿浴场游泳和参加比赛中度过的。

paras.en: She said her dad encouraged her to take up swimming with the hope that she would be the first woman to complete the English Channel crossing.
paras.zh: 她说，她的父亲鼓励她学习游泳，希望她成为第一个完成穿越英吉利海峡的女性。

paras.en: "It's not the same as going down the Yarra River, three miles or so, but at least I did that for him," she laughed.
paras.zh: “这和沿着雅拉河顺流而下三英里左右不同，但至少我是为了他这么做的，”她笑着说。

paras.en: "I think people would love to have an event like that to look forward to now because we're such a swimming-focused nation."
paras.zh: “我认为人们现在很乐意举办这样的活动，因为我们是一个以游泳为重点的国家。”

paras.en: Rowers and boaters are often to be seen using the waterway, but swimming was restricted from the 1960s due to pollution and contamination.
paras.zh: 经常可以看到划船者和划船者使用这条水道，但由于污染和污染，游泳从 20 世纪 60 年代起就受到限制。

paras.en: The newly-formed group of councils along with Melbourne Water believe the Yarra will be swimmable once again, but acknowledges there is still a lot of work to do.
paras.zh: 新成立的议会小组和墨尔本水务局相信亚拉河将再次可供游泳，但也承认仍有很多工作要做。

paras.en: "It's at least a 10-year project," Mr Reece said.
paras.zh: “这至少是一个为期 10 年的项目，”里斯先生说。

paras.en: "We're going to have to look at upgrading water infrastructure and filtration systems."
paras.zh: “我们将不得不考虑升级供水基础设施和过滤系统。”

paras.en: Animal faecal matter, litter and petrochemicals are frequent contaminants in the river, chair of Melbourne Water Pat McCafferty said.
paras.zh: 墨尔本水务委员会主席帕特·麦卡弗蒂 (Pat McCafferty) 表示，动物粪便、垃圾和石化产品是河流中常见的污染物。

paras.en: "We're a fair way south of the safety levels for swimming ... but it is achievable,"
paras.zh: “我们距离游泳安全水平还差得很远……但这是可以实现的，”

paras.en: "There'll be treatment process, things like wetlands as well that naturally clean up the water, so there's all sorts of different mitigations that can be put in place."
paras.zh: “将会有处理过程，比如湿地以及自然净化水的东西，所以可以采取各种不同的缓解措施。”

paras.en: In some sections of the river, such as the Kew stretch, E. coli levels can sit about 25 times higher than safe levels for swimming, according to Melbourne Water.
paras.zh: 据墨尔本水务局称，在河流的某些河段，例如邱园河段，大肠杆菌水平可能比游泳安全水平高出约 25 倍。

paras.en: The project is yet to be costed, with more investigation needed into what measures to implement to restore the waterway.
paras.zh: 该项目的成本尚未计算，需要对采取哪些措施恢复水道进行更多调查。

paras.en: Once restoration and mitigation measures are in place, there are plans to identify locations along the river for designated swimming zones, which the public will have input into.
paras.zh: 一旦恢复和缓解措施到位，计划在河流沿岸确定指定游泳区的位置，并听取公众的意见。

articles.title: New tool to help GPs identify victims of modern slavery
articles.author: Lily Plass

paras.en: A new guide could help healthcare workers respond if they believe a patient is a victim of modern slavery.
paras.zh: 如果医护人员认为患者是现代奴隶制的受害者，一份新指南可以帮助他们做出反应。

paras.en: Health care can be a trusted setting where victim-survivors open up.
paras.zh: 医疗保健可以成为受害人幸存者敞开心扉的值得信赖的环境。

paras.en: The resource from the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner will be rolled out across the state.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州反奴隶制专员的资源将在全州范围内推广。

paras.en: Sarah never thought she would end up trapped in a modern slavery situation.
paras.zh: 莎拉从未想过她最终会陷入现代奴隶制的境地。

paras.en: Six years ago, she escaped from debt bondage after meeting a man who promised to help her set up a business.
paras.zh: 六年前，她在遇到一名承诺帮助她创业的男子后摆脱了债务束缚。

paras.en: Debt bondage is a form of modern slavery whereby a person is forced to work or pay off a real or fabricated debt.
paras.zh: 债役是现代奴隶制的一种形式，人们被迫工作或偿还真实或捏造的债务。

paras.en: According to the federal government's website on modern slavery in Australia, the employer or recruiter might keep adding to the debt making it impossible to ever repay.
paras.zh: 根据澳大利亚联邦政府关于现代奴隶制的网站，雇主或招聘人员可能会不断增加债务，使其无法偿还。

paras.en: "In the time I was being exploited, I would end up in emergency departments, sexual health clinics, GP offices," Sarah said.
paras.zh: “在我被剥削的时候，我最终会去急诊室、性健康诊所、全科医生办公室，”莎拉说。

paras.en: "But they weren't really able to understand what was happening to me and I wasn't able to tell them because I didn't have the right words and didn't feel safe enough to talk."
paras.zh: “但他们并不能真正理解发生在我身上的事情，我也无法告诉他们，因为我没有合适的语言，也觉得说话不够安全。”

paras.en: Sarah, who asked to only be identified by her first name, has used her lived experience to help inform a new guide for healthcare workers to identify and respond to signs of modern slavery.
paras.zh: 莎拉要求只透露自己的名字，她利用自己的生活经历为医护人员提供了一份新指南，以识别和应对现代奴隶制的迹象。

paras.en: It was launched earlier this month in Dubbo.
paras.zh: 它于本月初在 Dubbo 推出。

paras.en: NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner James Cockayne said the bindings of modern slavery were often invisible to the untrained eye.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州反奴隶制专员詹姆斯·科凯恩表示，现代奴隶制的束缚对于未经训练的人来说往往是看不见的。

paras.en: "These days it's not physical shackles that are used to restrain people," he said.
paras.zh: “如今，用来约束人们的不再是物理枷锁，”他说。

paras.en: "It's manipulation, coercion, often under the cover of a contract."
paras.zh: “这是操纵、胁迫，通常是在合同的掩护下进行的。”

paras.en: The booklet is not a mandatory reporting policy, but it teaches healthcare professionals how to ask trauma-informed questions and where to turn to if they believe a person is being victimised.
paras.zh: 这本小册子不是强制性的报告政策，但它教会医疗保健专业人员如何提出有关创伤的问题，以及如果他们认为某人受到了伤害，应该向何处求助。

paras.en: The Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (RACGP) made a submission to help inform the tools in the guide.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚皇家全科医生学院 (RACGP) 提交了一份意见书，以帮助了解指南中的工具。

paras.en: Jennifer Neil, deputy chair of the RACGP's Specific Interest Group in Abuse and Violence in Families, said modern slavery was a health issue as much as a social issue.
paras.zh: RACGP 家庭虐待和暴力特别利益小组副主席詹妮弗·尼尔 (Jennifer Neil) 表示，现代奴隶制既是一个社会问题，也是一个健康问题。

paras.en: "It causes significant health problems that can cause, obviously, injuries …" she said.
paras.zh: “它会导致严重的健康问题，显然会造成伤害……”她说。

paras.en: "But also mental health problems and chronic psychosomatic problems, such as chronic pain."
paras.zh: “还有心理健康问题和慢性心身问题，例如慢性疼痛。”

paras.en: Dr Neil said GPs were well placed to recognise signs of modern slavery because they came into repeated contact with the patients over time and could identify patterns.
paras.zh: 尼尔博士说，全科医生能够很好地识别现代奴隶制的迹象，因为随着时间的推移，他们与患者反复接触，并且可以识别模式。

paras.en: The guide includes signs healthcare workers can look out for such as another person inserting themselves into the patient's care, or the patient referencing ongoing debt or repayment obligations.
paras.zh: 该指南包括医护人员可以留意的迹象，例如另一个人介入患者的护理，或者患者提及持续的债务或还款义务。

paras.en: Sarah said people trapped in modern slavery might not grasp the severity of their situation, which could make direct questions confronting.
paras.zh: 莎拉说，陷入现代奴隶制的人们可能无法意识到自己处境的严重性，这可能会带来直接的问题。

paras.en: Instead, the focus should be on simpler questions and building a relationship.
paras.zh: 相反，重点应该放在更简单的问题和建立关系上。

paras.en: "I think if I had the opportunity to talk to a healthcare professional that could have pointed me in the direction of modern slavery services or helped me to understand my situation or given me access to the right support, it could have prevented a lot of harm and long-term impacts for me," Sarah said.
paras.zh: “我认为，如果我有机会与医疗保健专业人士交谈，他可以为我指明现代奴隶制服务的方向，或者帮助我了解我的处境，或者让我获得正确的支持，这可能会避免对我造成很多伤害和长期影响，”莎拉说。

paras.en: Dr Cockayne said victim-survivors often turned to healthcare professionals rather than speaking to law enforcement.
paras.zh: 科凯恩博士说，受害者幸存者经常求助于医疗保健专业人员，而不是与执法部门交谈。

paras.en: "[Healthcare workers] are more focused on our needs rather than necessarily judging our behaviours or judging us for the situation we find ourselves in.
paras.zh: “[医护人员]更关注我们的需求，而不是根据我们所处的情况来判断我们的行为或判断我们。

paras.en: "It's creating that kind of relationship between the healthcare worker and the patient that creates an opportunity for the disclosure of that kind of abuse."
paras.zh: “它在医护人员和患者之间建立了这种关系，为揭露这种虐待行为创造了机会。”

paras.en: Dr Neil said she hoped as many healthcare workers as possible became aware of the available resources to recognise modern slavery.
paras.zh: 尼尔博士说，她希望尽可能多的医护人员意识到可利用的资源来认识现代奴隶制。

paras.en: "I think disseminating this amongst healthcare workers is going to be one of the biggest challenges," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为在医护人员中传播这一点将是最大的挑战之一，”她说。

paras.en: "Actually letting people know it exists and getting people to have a look at it and read it."
paras.zh: “实际上是让人们知道它的存在，并让人们查看并阅读它。”

paras.en: According to the NSW Office of the Anti-slavery Commissioner, it is estimated that about 16,400 people are trapped in these invisible bindings, with the national number believed to be about 41,000.
paras.zh: 据新南威尔士州反奴隶制专员办公室称，估计约有 16,400 人被困在这些无形的束缚中，据信全国人数约为 41,000 人。

paras.en: "That's a football stadium of people who are in this situation right now," Dr Cockayne said.
paras.zh: “那是一个足球场，里面的人现在都处于这种情况，”科凯恩博士说。

paras.en: "This resource was developed for the NSW context, but we see no reason why it can't be used elsewhere as well."
paras.zh: “该资源是为新南威尔士州开发的，但我们认为它没有理由不能在其他地方使用。”

paras.en: Sarah said she hoped the guide would make it easier for the next person to break free.
paras.zh: 莎拉说，她希望指南能让下一个人更容易挣脱束缚。

paras.en: "I think we all have this perception that we're a person, we have choices, we have freedom," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为我们都有这样的观念：我们是一个人，我们有选择，我们有自由，”她说。

paras.en: "But when that's taken all of a sudden, that really challenges everything about the way that you see the world."
paras.zh: “但当突然采取这种做法时，这确实会挑战你看待世界的方式。”

paras.en: If you need support contact 1-800 FREEDOM or 1-800 373 3366.
paras.zh: 如果您需要支持，请联系 1-800 FREEDOM 或 1-800 373 3366。

articles.title: Breaking: Boy, 13, charged over drive-by shooting at Perth home
articles.author: Lucy Murray

paras.en: A 13-year-old boy has been charged after a drive-by shooting at a home in Perth's east.
paras.zh: 一名 13 岁男孩因在珀斯东部的一处住宅内发生驾车枪击事件而受到指控。

paras.en: Police say multiple shots were fired at a house on Bert Street in Gosnells at about 12:40am on Saturday.
paras.zh: 警方表示，周六凌晨 12 点 40 分左右，戈斯内尔斯伯特街的一所房屋遭到多枪射击。

paras.en: Bullets struck a bedroom window and external wall, and although three people were inside at the time, no injuries were reported.
paras.zh: 子弹击中卧室窗户和外墙，尽管当时屋内有三人，但没有人员受伤的报道。

paras.en: CCTV footage captured audio of the alleged drive-by shooting, with the sound of 27 shots fired on the recording.
paras.zh: 闭路电视录像捕捉到了所谓的驾车枪击事件的音频，录音中发出了 27 声枪响。

paras.en: Police arrested the teenager on Monday and charged him with eight offences including unlawful use of a firearm, endangering life, possession of stolen property and no authority to drive.
paras.zh: 警方周一逮捕了这名少年，并指控他犯有八项罪名，包括非法使用枪支、危害生命、持有被盗财产和无权驾驶。

paras.en: The 13-year-old appeared briefly in Perth Children's Court and did not apply for bail.
paras.zh: 这名 13 岁的男孩在珀斯儿童法庭短暂出庭，没有申请保释。

articles.title: Teacher threw cellphone, tackled shooter who killed 4 at Oregon school, police say

paras.en: Teacher threw cellphone, tackled shooter who killed 4 at Oregon school, police say
paras.zh: 警方称，俄勒冈州一所学校的老师扔手机并制服了导致四人死亡的枪手

paras.en: Police identify gunman as 16-year-old former student
paras.zh: 警方确认枪手为 16 岁前学生

paras.en: A teacher threw her phone at the teenage gunman who killed four people at an Oregon elementary school, then tackled and fought with him — likely saving lives before he was shot by a father who followed him into the building, police said Friday.
paras.zh: 警方周五表示，一名老师将手机扔向在俄勒冈州一所小学杀害四人的青少年枪手，然后与他发生冲突，可能是在他被跟随他进入大楼的父亲开枪射杀之前挽救了生命。

paras.en: Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz called her actions "heroic" during a news conference and said she was not injured. He identified the attacker as 16-year-old Griffin J. John II, a former student at the school, and said all of the victims were shot in the same classroom.
paras.zh: 本德警察局长迈克·克兰茨在新闻发布会上称她的行为“英勇”，并表示她没有受伤。他确认袭击者是 16 岁的格里芬·J·约翰二世 (Griffin J. John II)，他是该校的前学生，并表示所有受害者都是在同一间教室里被枪杀的。

paras.en: In a statement read to reporters on Friday, Kenda Freeman said her son, Kaylub Giamanco, shot the gunman in Thursday's attack at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend. She said he is the father of two girls at the school.
paras.zh: 肯达·弗里曼在周五向记者宣读的一份声明中说，她的儿子凯鲁布·贾曼科在周四本德银轨小学的袭击中射杀了枪手。她说他是学校两个女孩的父亲。

paras.en: "He is not seeking recognition, but instead wishes to express his gratitude to the first responders, school personnel and community for the outpouring of love and support," Freeman said, noting that her son is a lifelong resident of Bend, a mountain-ringed city of about 100,000 in central Oregon.
paras.zh: 弗里曼说：“他并不是在寻求认可，而是希望对急救人员、学校工作人员和社区所倾注的爱与支持表示感谢。”她指出，她的儿子是本德的终生居民，本德是俄勒冈州中部一座群山环抱的城市，约有 10 万人口。

paras.en: She said her family was asking for privacy "during this difficult time."
paras.zh: 她说，“在这个困难时期”，她的家人要求保护隐私。

paras.en: A makeshift memorial at a sign marking the Silver Rail Elementary School near a cordoned-off area in Bend, Ore., on Thursday. (David Ryder/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周四，俄勒冈州本德市一处封锁区附近银轨小学的标志牌上有一座临时纪念馆。 （大卫·莱德/路透社）

paras.en: Three students and a teacher were killed in the attack, and a fourth student and another teacher were critically injured.
paras.zh: 三名学生和一名教师在袭击中丧生，第四名学生和另一名教师受重伤。

paras.en: The shooter was found dead in the school minutes after the first calls for help, Krantz said. He shot through locked doors to get inside, police said.
paras.zh: 克兰茨说，在第一次求救后几分钟，枪手被发现死在学校里。警方称，他冲破锁着的门闯了进去。

paras.en: The children who were killed were ages five, eight and 11 years old, Krantz said. Authorities did not give details about the teacher who was killed. Another seven-year-old child and a 54-year-old teacher were wounded in the attack and taken to hospital in critical condition, he said.
paras.zh: 克兰茨说，遇难的儿童年龄分别为 5 岁、8 岁和 11 岁。当局没有透露遇害教师的详细信息。他说，另一名 7 岁儿童和一名 54 岁教师在袭击中受伤，被送往医院，情况危急。

paras.en: The youngest victim, five-year-old Rhoam Summer, was a fast runner and fearless climber who loved reading and his stuffed animals, his aunt said Friday.
paras.zh: 最小的受害者是五岁的罗姆·萨默 (Rhoam Summer)，他的姨妈周五表示，他是一位跑得快、无所畏惧的登山者，喜欢阅读和毛绒玩具。

paras.en: "He never met a stuffie that he didn't think needed to be rescued and cared for," said his aunt, Swan Sheridan, who described him as "a little ball of energy from the moment he was born."
paras.zh: 他的姨妈斯旺·谢里丹 (Swan Sheridan) 说：“他从来没有遇到过一个他认为不需要被拯救和照顾的玩具。”她形容他“从出生那一刻起就是一个充满活力的小球”。

paras.en: This undated photo provided by Swan Sheridan shows Rhoam Summer, a victim in the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Ore. (Swan Sheridan/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 斯旺·谢里丹 (Swan Sheridan) 提供的这张未注明日期的照片显示的是俄勒冈州本德市银轨小学 (Silver Rail Elementary School) 枪击事件的受害者罗姆·萨默 (Rhoam Summer)。（Swan Sheridan/美联社）

paras.en: The wounded teacher was identified by family as Becky Drury. Her mother-in-law, Yvonne Drury, said on Facebook that she had injuries to her left arm and right hand and was recovering from surgery.
paras.zh: 家人确认受伤教师名叫贝基·德鲁里 (Becky Drury)。她的婆婆伊冯娜·德鲁里(Yvonne Drury)在脸书上表示，她的左臂和右手受伤，正在从手术中恢复。

paras.en: Trump praises man who stopped shooter as 'great hero'
paras.zh: 特朗普称赞阻止枪手的人是“伟大的英雄”

paras.en: At a news conference hours after Thursday's attack, Gov. Tina Kotek — without naming him —praised Giamanco for following the gunman into the school, saying he helped end the rampage and likely saved lives as police began arriving on the scene.
paras.zh: 在周四袭击事件发生数小时后的新闻发布会上，州长蒂娜·科特克（未透露姓名）赞扬了贾曼科跟随枪手进入学校，称他帮助结束了骚乱，并可能在警察赶到现场时挽救了生命。

paras.en: "To the community member who heroically intervened to stop further loss of life: Your actions carry a heavy emotional burden, and I just want you to know that my thoughts are with you as well," said Kotek.
paras.zh: 科特克说：“对于英勇介入阻止进一步生命损失的社区成员：你的行为带来了沉重的情感负担，我只想让你知道，我的想法也与你同在。”

paras.en: President Donald Trump on Friday also praised the actions of a "great hero" who he said "took care of business."
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周五也赞扬了一位“伟大英雄”的行为，他说他“照顾了生意”。

paras.en: "It's a terrible thing, but thank goodness for a man that had a gun and knew how to use it," Trump told reporters at the White House, adding the tragedy likely would have been much worse.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫对记者说：“这是一件可怕的事情，但谢天谢地，这个人有枪并且知道如何使用它。”他补充说，这场悲剧可能会更严重。

paras.en: Memorials of flowers, balloons and stuffed animals appeared around the school, which sits in a densely packed neighbourhood filled with newly built homes.
paras.zh: 学校周围出现了鲜花、气球和毛绒玩具的纪念物，学校坐落在一个拥挤的社区，到处都是新建的房屋。

paras.en: Brooke Olsen, whose daughter is a kindergartner at Silver Rail, said she was amazed that a member of the public pursued the shooter.
paras.zh: 布鲁克·奥尔森 (Brooke Olsen) 的女儿是 Silver Rail 的一名幼儿园老师，她表示，一名公众追捕枪手让她感到惊讶。

paras.en: "I think it's miraculous that someone was there before law enforcement even arrived to stop further tragedy from happening," Olsen said Friday, weeping at times. "I'm feeling very grateful."
paras.zh: 奥尔森周五时不时哭泣，他说：“我认为，在执法部门到达之前就有人在场，阻止进一步的悲剧发生，这真是奇迹。” “我感到非常感激。”

paras.en: The attacker used a pump-action shotgun that was purchased by his mother, according to a law enforcement official briefed on the shooting. The official spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity because they were not authorized to publicly discuss the investigation.
paras.zh: 据一名了解枪击事件情况的执法官员透露，袭击者使用的是他母亲购买的泵动霰弹枪。该官员不愿透露姓名，因为他们无权公开讨论调查结果。

paras.en: Under Oregon law, a minor may possess a shotgun if it is provided by a parent or by someone else with the parent's consent.
paras.zh: 根据俄勒冈州法律，如果由父母或经父母同意的其他人提供，未成年人可以拥有猎枪。

paras.en: An officer stands behind police tape that surrounds Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Ore., where a shooting took place, on Thursday. (Joe Kline/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，俄勒冈州本德市发生枪击事件，一名警官站在包围银轨小学的警戒线后面。 （乔·克莱恩/美联社）

paras.en: The first 911 call came early in the afternoon from someone outside the school who reported being shot at by someone with a long gun, the police chief said. More 911 calls came from inside the school, and officers arrived within minutes, police spokesperson Sheila Miller said.
paras.zh: 警察局长说，第一个 911 电话是在下午早些时候打来的，校外有人报告说有人用长枪射击。警方发言人希拉·米勒 (Sheila Miller) 表示，更多的 911 电话来自学校内部，警察在几分钟内就赶到了。

paras.en: The attacker was shot and went down inside the school shortly after officers arrived, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，警察到达后不久，袭击者就被枪杀并倒在学校内。

paras.en: The school serves students from kindergarten through Grade 5, with about 450 enrolled last year, according to the Oregon Department of Education.
paras.zh: 据俄勒冈州教育部称，该校为从幼儿园到五年级的学生提供服务，去年约有 450 名学生入学。

paras.en: Children were taken by bus to a nearby church serving as a reunification centre for families. Parents hugged, kissed and held their kids' hands as they walked to their cars, with some bringing along favourite stuffed animals or other comfort items from home.
paras.zh: 孩子们被巴士带到附近的一座教堂，该教堂是家庭团聚中心。父母们在走向汽车时拥抱、亲吻和牵着孩子的手，有些人还从家里带来了最喜欢的毛绒动物或其他舒适物品。

paras.en: Shaken residents held a vigil Thursday night, where children drew hearts in chalk on the sidewalk and held candles side-by-side with adults.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，震惊的居民举行了守夜活动，孩子们在人行道上用粉笔画心，并与成年人并排举着蜡烛。

paras.en: Classes and all other activities were cancelled Friday for the area's 32 schools.
paras.zh: 该地区 32 所学校周五取消了课程和所有其他活动。

paras.en: Dara Crawford cries during a candlelight vigil at Drake Park following a deadly shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Ore. on Thursday. (Eli Imadali/Oregon Public Broadcasting/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，俄勒冈州本德银轨小学发生致命枪击事件后，达拉·克劳福德在德雷克公园的烛光守夜活动中哭泣。 （伊莱·伊玛达利/俄勒冈公共广播/美联社）

paras.en: Bend, the largest city in central Oregon, is about 125 miles (200 kilometres) southeast of Portland. It's population has grown rapidly over the past three decades, and it is a tourism and outdoor recreation hub.
paras.zh: 本德是俄勒冈州中部最大的城市，位于波特兰东南约 125 英里（200 公里）处。过去三十年来，它的人口迅速增长，是一个旅游和户外休闲中心。

paras.en: The shooting was the 28th mass killing in the U.S. this year, according to a database maintained by The Associated Press and USA Today in partnership with Northeastern University.
paras.zh: 据美联社、《今日美国》与东北大学合作维护的数据库显示，这起枪击事件是今年美国发生的第 28 起大规模杀戮事件。

paras.en: Four years ago in Bend, a grocery store employee who had served in the U.S. Army confronted a gunman who was firing inside the supermarket. Both the employee, whom police hailed as a hero, and a customer were killed. The gunman died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
paras.zh: 四年前，在本德，一名曾在美国陆军服役的杂货店员工与一名在超市内开枪的枪手发生冲突。这名被警方誉为英雄的员工和一名顾客均被杀害。枪手因自伤枪伤身亡。

articles.title: Homes burn in Southern California amid fast-moving fire, prompting evacuation orders

paras.en: Homes burn in Southern California amid fast-moving fire, prompting evacuation orders
paras.zh: 南加州房屋在快速蔓延的大火中燃烧，促使疏散命令

paras.en: Wildfire started in the coastal city of San Clemente
paras.zh: 沿海城市圣克莱门特发生野火

paras.en: A fast-moving fire fuelled by high winds burned at least six homes in Southern California on Friday, engulfing expensive coastal properties and prompting thousands to evacuate.
paras.zh: 周五，强风助长的一场快速蔓延的大火烧毁了南加州至少六所房屋，吞噬了昂贵的沿海房产，并促使数千人撤离。

paras.en: Black smoke — visible from kilometres away — billowed over tennis courts and swimming pools while firefighters doused blazing homes in San Juan Capistrano in Orange County. Some homeowners sprayed water on their properties before heeding evacuation orders.
paras.zh: 在奥兰治县圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺，黑烟在网球场和游泳池上空滚滚而过，消防队员正在浇灭着火的房屋，从几公里外都可以看到。一些房主在听从疏散命令之前向自己的房屋喷水。

paras.en: Two firefighters were taken to the hospital with heat-related injuries, officials said. Authorities have not said how the blaze started.
paras.zh: 官员称，两名消防员因热伤被送往医院。当局尚未透露火灾是如何开始的。

paras.en: "Had these winds been a little bit stronger, a little bit different direction, this could have been a whole lot worse," said San Clemente Mayor Rick Loeffler.
paras.zh: 圣克莱门特市市长里克·洛夫勒 (Rick Loeffler) 表示：“如果风再强一点，方向稍微不同一点，情况可能会更糟。”

paras.en: A man uses a water hose to battle the Norte Fire in San Clemente, Calif., on Friday. (Caroline Brehman/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五，一名男子使用水管扑灭加利福尼亚州圣克莱门特的北部大火。 （卡罗琳·布雷曼/路透社）

paras.en: Howard Hart, a councilmember for San Juan Capistrano, said he and his wife doused their roof with water and moved propane tanks away from their home before they evacuated Friday.
paras.zh: 圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺市议员霍华德·哈特 (Howard Hart) 表示，他和妻子在周五撤离之前，在屋顶上浇了水，并将丙烷罐移离了家。

paras.en: Laura Hart hasn't had to evacuate due to fire in the more than five decades she's lived in the community, she said.
paras.zh: 劳拉·哈特 (Laura Hart) 说，她在该社区生活了五十多年，从未因火灾而被迫疏散过。

paras.en: "This doesn't usually happen to us, we usually see it on the news," she said. "We always pray to God it's not us, but yeah, it was today."
paras.zh: “这通常不会发生在我们身上，我们通常会在新闻中看到它，”她说。 “我们总是向上帝祈祷，不是我们造成的，但是，是的，就是今天。”

paras.en: The Norte fire started in the coastal city of San Clemente and wind drove it into San Juan Capistrano. An evacuation shelter has opened in each city. By Friday night, about 16,000 residents had been ordered to evacuate, said Fire Chief TJ McGovern, of the Orange County Fire Authority.
paras.zh: 北部大火始于沿海城市圣克莱门特，并被风吹入圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺。每个城市都开设了避难所。奥兰治县消防局消防队长 TJ McGovern 表示，截至周五晚上，约 16,000 名居民已被命令撤离。

paras.en: It was one of several fires in the region that was hit by dry, warm gusts known as Santa Anas, which blow from the interior of Southern California toward the coast and offshore.
paras.zh: 这是该地区遭受圣安娜干燥温暖阵风袭击的几起火灾之一，这种阵风从南加州内陆吹向海岸和近海。

paras.en: The strongest winds were expected through Friday afternoon, but conditions that increase the fire risk were expected to last through Saturday night, with a heat advisory in effect until 8 p.m. Saturday on the Orange County and San Diego County coast, the U.S. National Weather Service said.
paras.zh: 预计最强风力将持续到周五下午，但增加火灾风险的情况预计将持续到周六晚上，高温警告将持续到晚上 8 点。美国国家气象局称，周六在奥兰治县和圣地亚哥县海岸。

paras.en: Firefighters attempt to save structures in San Clemente, Calif., while battling the Norte Fire on Friday. (Paul Bersebach/The Orange County Register/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周五，消防队员在与北部大火搏斗的同时，试图拯救加利福尼亚州圣克莱门特的建筑物。 （保罗·贝尔塞巴赫/奥兰治县纪事报/美联社）

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people in the state are without power after their electricity was turned off. A separate fire by the Marine Corps base Camp Pendleton shut down for hours a section of Interstate 5 that is a major artery connecting Orange County to San Diego. That added hours to commutes throughout Southern California.
paras.zh: 该州数万人在停电后断电。海军陆战队基地彭德尔顿营发生的另一起火灾导致 5 号州际公路的一段路段关闭数小时，该州际公路是连接奥兰治县和圣地亚哥的主要干道。这增加了整个南加州的通勤时间。

paras.en: The coastal cities are surrounded by hillsides. San Juan Capistrano, a city of 35,000, is known for horse trails and the historic Mission San Juan Capistrano. San Clemente, which is home to 62,000 people, is known as a "Spanish village by the sea" and popular with beachgoers and surfers.
paras.zh: 沿海城市四周都是山坡。圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺是一座拥有 35,000 人口的城市，以马道和历史悠久的圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺教堂而闻名。圣克莱门特拥有 62,000 人口，被誉为“西班牙海边村庄”，深受海滩游客和冲浪者的欢迎。

paras.en: "The fire is right up on the city," said Victor Cabral, a San Clemente council member. "It's on the perimeter of our homes on the north end."
paras.zh: 圣克莱门特市议会成员维克多·卡布拉尔表示：“火势已经蔓延至整座城市。” “它位于我们北端房屋的周边。”

paras.en: Nine schools were also closed Friday in San Juan Capistrano, the Capistrano Unified School District said.
paras.zh: 卡皮斯特拉诺联合学区表示，圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺的九所学校周五也关闭。

paras.en: Traffic is seen moving along Interstate 5, toward the Norte Fire, in San Juan Capistrano, Calif., on Friday. (Patrick T. Fallon/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周五，车辆沿着 5 号州际公路，驶向加利福尼亚州圣胡安卡皮斯特拉诺的北火场。 （帕特里克·T·法伦/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Nearby residents were also on edge as smoke darkened the sky.
paras.zh: 当烟雾笼罩天空时，附近的居民也感到紧张。

paras.en: Wyoming resident Shannon Needham was visiting her mother at her assisted living facility in Dana Point just north of San Clemente when she learned about the fire.
paras.zh: 怀俄明州居民香农·尼达姆 (Shannon Needham) 得知火灾消息时，正在圣克莱门特 (San Clemente) 北部达纳角 (Dana Point) 的辅助生活设施探望母亲。

paras.en: The facility director told her that two buses would be on standby in case they needed to evacuate, Needham said.
paras.zh: 尼达姆说，设施主管告诉她，两辆巴士将待命，以备需要疏散时使用。

paras.en: "You could hear the fire trucks, you could hear the helicopters and everything above. And it was so smoky, it was just dark smoke," Needham said.
paras.zh: “你可以听到消防车的声音，你可以听到直升机的声音以及上面的一切声音。而且烟雾很大，只是黑烟，”尼达姆说。

paras.en: Firefighters use hoses to battle the Norte Fire in San Clemente, Calif., on Friday. (Caroline Brehman/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五，消防员使用软管扑灭加利福尼亚州圣克莱门特的北火。 （卡罗琳·布雷曼/路透社）

paras.en: Some of California's worst wildfires have been sparked by power equipment, and utilities in recent years have begun proactively shutting off power in dry winds. More than 200,000 customers in California were without electricity as of Friday, according to poweroutage.com.
paras.zh: 加州一些最严重的野火是由电力设备引发的，近年来公用事业公司已开始在干燥风中主动关闭电力。据 poweroutage.com 称，截至周五，加州有超过 20 万用户断电。

paras.en: The weather service also issued a red flag warning for parts of central and Northern California through Friday morning, saying any fires would spread rapidly.
paras.zh: 截至周五上午，气象局还对加州中部和北部部分地区发出红旗警告，称任何火灾都会迅速蔓延。

articles.title: Trump pauses sanctions package targeted at Russian economy

paras.en: Trump pauses sanctions package targeted at Russian economy
paras.zh: 特朗普暂停针对俄罗斯经济的制裁方案

paras.en: Citing U.S. national interest, White House doesn't immediately explain rationale
paras.zh: 白宫以美国国家利益为由，没有立即解释理由

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday signed an executive order that puts on hold a sweeping new sanctions package targeting the Russian economy, telling Congress the pause was in the national interest.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五签署了一项行政命令，暂停针对俄罗斯经济的全面新制裁计划，并告诉国会暂停符合国家利益。

paras.en: Trump personally signed the legislation last month, and his move came just two days before a deadline set in the law itself for its implementation. Named after late South Carolina senator Lindsey Graham, it had sought to clamp down more quickly on the flow of financial resources fuelling the war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月亲自签署了该法案，而他的举动距离该法案本身规定的实施最后期限只有两天。它以已故南卡罗来纳州参议员林赛·格雷厄姆的名字命名，旨在更快地遏制助长对乌克兰战争的金融资源流动。

paras.en: Trump's unexpected move comes a week after he stunningly said the U.S. had agreed to purchase diesel from Russia to try to bring down global energy prices, despite potentially hurting Ukraine in its war with Russia.
paras.zh: 一周前，特朗普出人意料地表示，美国已同意从俄罗斯购买柴油，以试图降低全球能源价格，尽管可能会在与俄罗斯的战争中伤害乌克兰。

paras.en: A poll by The Associated Press and the NORC Center for Public Affairs Research published Oct. 1 found that Americans disapprove of the president's handling of the Iran war and blame him for higher prices.
paras.zh: 美联社和 NORC 公共事务研究中心 10 月 1 日公布的一项民意调查显示，美国人不赞成总统对伊朗战争的处理方式，并指责他抬高了物价。

paras.en: Trump's approval ratings have sunk to near-historic lows, and pressure is mounting as Republicans try to hold control of both chambers of Congress on election day Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 特朗普的支持率已跌至接近历史低点，随着共和党试图在 11 月 3 日选举日控制国会参众两院，特朗普的压力也越来越大。

paras.en: Graham, a close ally and friend of the president, had just returned from Ukraine when he unexpectedly died in July. He had advocated for stricter U.S. sanctions against Russia as a way of pressuring it to end its war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 格雷厄姆是总统的亲密盟友和朋友，七月份刚从乌克兰回来就意外去世。他曾主张美国对俄罗斯实施更严厉的制裁，以此迫使其结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: His colleagues in Congress responded with bipartisan support after his death, and Trump attached his signature to the legislation — then changed his mind on Friday.
paras.zh: 他在国会的同事在他去世后得到了两党的支持，特朗普在该法案上签名，但周五又改变了主意。

paras.en: Package aimed to restrict Russia's war effort
paras.zh: 旨在限制俄罗斯战争努力的一揽子计划

paras.en: The package had been meant to starve Russian President Vladimir Putin of the resources Moscow needs to continue its war in Ukraine after invading its neighbour more than four years ago. The bill, also drafted by Democratic Sen. Richard Blumenthal, sanctions Russian officials, banks and a shadow fleet of tankers that keeps Russian energy moving.
paras.zh: 该计划的目的是让俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)缺乏莫斯科在四年多前入侵邻国后继续在乌克兰进行战争所需的资源。该法案也由民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔起草，制裁俄罗斯官员、银行和维持俄罗斯能源运转的影子油轮船队。

paras.en: It also directs Trump to impose up to 100 per cent tariffs on the top five importers of Russian oil or natural gas, with an exception for countries that import less than 15 per cent of Russia's natural gas exports and have taken significant steps to reduce those imports.
paras.zh: 它还指示特朗普对俄罗斯石油或天然气的前五名进口国征收高达100%的关税，但进口量低于俄罗斯天然气出口量15%并已采取重大措施减少进口的国家除外。

paras.en: Democratic Rep. Don Beyer noted on social media shortly after the announcement of the sanctions being suspended that he and others had "warned" Trump might make such a move. The veteran congressman, who spoke out against the bill as it was debated, called on Congress to "fix this flawed law to stop Trump from capitulating to Putin and ensure that it truly supports Ukraine."
paras.zh: 民主党众议员唐·拜尔在宣布暂停制裁后不久在社交媒体上指出，他和其他人“警告”特朗普可能会采取这样的举动。这位资深国会议员在该法案辩论时公开反对该法案，呼吁国会“修正这项有缺陷的法律，以阻止特朗普向普京投降，并确保其真正支持乌克兰。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately explain how pausing the sanctions was in the national interest.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即解释暂停制裁如何符合国家利益。

paras.en: The decision was posted on the White House website late in the evening, and the notification noted that the report explaining the decision had been submitted to Congress.
paras.zh: 该决定于当晚发布在白宫网站上，通知指出解释该决定的报告已提交给国会。

paras.en: Still, it comes as Trump has increasingly lashed out at Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, blaming him for failing to make a deal with Putin to end the fighting.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，特朗普还是越来越多地猛烈抨击乌克兰总统泽伦斯基，指责他未能与普京达成协议以结束战斗。

paras.en: The Trump administration has remained mostly quiet since the recent passage of the bill with large bipartisan majorities in the U.S. House and Senate after Graham's sudden death — with lawmakers urged ahead by Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 自从格雷厄姆突然去世后，该法案最近在美国众议院和参议院以两党多数通过以来，特朗普政府基本上保持沉默——泽连斯基敦促议员们推进该法案。

paras.en: The U.S. president's latest action follows his announcement last week that he had reached an agreement with Putin.
paras.zh: 美国总统的最新行动是在上周宣布与普京达成协议之后采取的。

paras.en: Trump said Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, followed by an additional 500,000 tons in November and one million tons "immediately thereafter." Russia will deliver an additional three million tons "within a short period of time" after that, he wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，俄罗斯将立即供应超过30万吨柴油，随后在11月额外供应50万吨，“此后立即”供应100万吨。他写道，此后俄罗斯将“在短时间内”额外交付300万吨。

paras.en: Trump's decision to strike a deal with Putin on diesel on the world market has been pilloried by Republicans and Democrats alike who say it will help Russia execute its war against Ukraine — without making a difference to global fuel prices, which are elevated mostly due to Trump's war on Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京在世界市场上达成柴油协议的决定遭到了共和党和民主党的嘲笑，他们表示这将帮助俄罗斯执行对乌克兰的战争，而不会影响全球燃油价格，而全球燃油价格上涨主要是由于特朗普对伊朗的战争。

paras.en: The sanctions that Trump has now suspended, meanwhile, had become a campaign centrepiece for Sen. Darline Graham, the late senator's sister appointed to serve out the remaining months in his current term. She is also running to replace him in the Senate more permanently.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普现已暂停的制裁已成为参议员达林·格雷厄姆(Darline Graham)的竞选核心，已故参议员的妹妹被任命在特朗普当前任期的剩余几个月内任职。她还竞选以更永久地取代他在参议院的席位。

paras.en: In a debate earlier this week with Democratic nominee Annie Andrews, Graham — who has Trump's endorsement and is expected to campaign with him in South Carolina next week — said she had been "so proud" to help get the measure passed but acknowledged it was the president's purview as to how he implemented it.
paras.zh: 格雷厄姆得到了特朗普的支持，预计下周将在南卡罗来纳州与特朗普一起竞选。在本周早些时候与民主党候选人安妮·安德鲁斯的一场辩论中，格雷厄姆表示，她为帮助这项措施获得通过而感到“非常自豪”，但她承认，如何实施该措施是总统的职权范围。

paras.en: "It gives the president tools that he can use if he so chooses, to end the war through economic sanctions," Graham said on Sunday during a debate in Columbia, S.C.
paras.zh: 格雷厄姆周日在南卡罗来纳州哥伦比亚举行的一场辩论中表示：“这为总统提供了工具，如果他愿意的话，他可以使用这些工具通过经济制裁来结束战争。”

paras.en: "So, that's up to him as to whether or not he wants to use it, or whether he wants to use something else, but I think the purpose of it is to bring down the gas prices and ultimately end the war. And when the war ends, gas prices will fall."
paras.zh: “所以，这取决于他是否想使用它，或者他是否想使用其他东西，但我认为它的目的是降低天然气价格并最终结束战争。当战争结束时，天然气价格将会下降。”

articles.title: The murder of a young mother in Iran has once again sparked debate on femicide and the social acceptance of violence against women.

paras.en: The life of Maryam Yarmohammadi came to a violent end in the early hours of October 5, when the 28-year-old mother of two was attacked with knives by her brother and husband on Qeshm Island in southern Iran. Her genitalia were mutilated. She died shortly afterward in hospital. Both her husband and brother were arrested.
paras.zh: 10 月 5 日凌晨，28 岁的两个孩子的母亲玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪 (Maryam Yarmhammadi) 在伊朗南部的格什姆岛被她的兄弟和丈夫用刀袭击，她的生命以暴力结束。她的生殖器被肢解。不久后她在医院去世。她的丈夫和兄弟均被捕。

paras.en: Media reported that about 50 relatives gathered outside the hospital to protest the arrests. They reportedly believed that death had been the "least severe punishment" Maryam Yarmohammadi deserved.
paras.zh: 媒体报道称，约50名亲属聚集在医院外抗议逮捕。据报道，他们认为死亡是玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪应得的“最轻的惩罚”。

paras.en: What the young woman's relatives considered her guilty of has not been publicly reported. Yet both the circumstances of the case and the extreme violence involved follow a familiar pattern seen in so-called honor killings.
paras.zh: 这位年轻女子的亲属认为她犯下的罪行尚未公开报道。然而，该案的情况和所涉及的极端暴力都遵循所谓的名誉杀人中常见的模式。

paras.en: In such cases, the underlying belief is often that a man must erase a perceived "dishonor" brought upon the family by a sister, daughter or wife. Failure to do so may expose him to rejection, humiliation or social exclusion within his community.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，潜在的信念往往是男人必须消除姐妹、女儿或妻子给家庭带来的“耻辱”。如果不这样做，他可能会在社区内遭到拒绝、羞辱或社会排斥。

paras.en: What constitutes "honor" or "proper conduct" is often defined by family expectations or social and cultural norms. In some traditionally conservative regions, even laughing loudly or engaging in a friendly conversation with an unrelated man may be viewed as a violation of these norms.
paras.zh: “荣誉”或“适当行为”的构成通常由家庭期望或社会和文化规范来定义。在一些传统上保守的地区，即使大声笑或与无关的人进行友好交谈也可能被视为违反这些规范。

paras.en: Women accused of such transgressions are frequently denied any meaningful opportunity to defend themselves against the allegations.
paras.zh: 被指控犯有此类罪行的妇女经常被剥夺任何有意义的机会为自己辩护。

paras.en: For years, women's rights activists in Iran have sought to establish nationwide support networks offering counseling and protection to women at risk. One such initiative is the Campaign to End Honor Killings.
paras.zh: 多年来，伊朗的女权活动人士一直寻求建立全国性的支持网络，为面临风险的妇女提供咨询和保护。其中一项倡议是“结束荣誉谋杀运动”。

paras.en: Rezvan Moghaddam, a spokesperson for the campaign, told DW that there appeared to be no activist or local group in the region capable of supporting Maryam Yarmohammadi.
paras.zh: 该运动发言人雷兹万·莫加达姆 (Rezvan Moghaddam) 告诉德国之声，该地区似乎没有任何活动人士或当地团体有能力支持玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪 (Maryam Yarmhammadi)。

paras.en: Through civil society networks, the campaign has in some cases succeeded in relocating threatened women to safe locations and securing shelter for them.
paras.zh: 通过民间社会网络，该运动在某些情况下成功地将受到威胁的妇女转移到安全地点并为她们提供庇护。

paras.en: Moghaddam said that Maryam Yarmohammadi's death should not be interpreted as criticism of women's rights activists in those regions: "I myself come from Khuzestan in southern Iran and am fully aware of the restrictions that exist there."
paras.zh: 莫加达姆表示，玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪的死不应被解释为对这些地区女权活动人士的批评：“我本人来自伊朗南部的胡齐斯坦，完全了解那里存在的限制。”

paras.en: Based on interpretations of Shariah, or Islamic law, Iran's laws do not treat women as equal citizens in many areas of life. Their ability to make decisions about education, employment or travel may depend on the consent of their fathers or, later, their husbands.
paras.zh: 根据对伊斯兰教法的解释，伊朗法律在生活的许多领域并未将妇女视为平等公民。她们做出有关教育、就业或旅行的决定的能力可能取决于其父亲或后来的丈夫的同意。

paras.en: Even after a woman's death, male relatives can, under certain legal provisions, influence the course of criminal proceedings.
paras.zh: 即使在妇女去世后，根据某些法律规定，男性亲属也可以影响刑事诉讼的进程。

paras.en: Iranian criminal law applies the principle of retribution in certain offenses, including murder. In homicide cases, the victim's relatives may choose either to demand retribution, which can result in the death penalty, or to pardon the perpetrator.
paras.zh: 伊朗刑法对某些犯罪适用报应原则，包括谋杀。在凶杀案中，受害者的亲属可以选择要求报复（这可能导致死刑）或赦免犯罪者。

paras.en: These provisions raise particular concerns in cases of so-called honor killings. When an alleged perpetrator is also among the relatives empowered to influence decisions on punishment or forgiveness, a serious conflict of interest emerges.
paras.zh: 这些规定引起了所谓名誉杀人案件的特别关注。当被指控的犯罪者也是有权影响惩罚或宽恕决定的亲属之一时，就会出现严重的利益冲突。

paras.en: Such situations expose the protection gaps critics say exist within Iran's justice system regarding violence against women.
paras.zh: 这种情况暴露了批评者所说的伊朗司法系统在暴力侵害妇女问题上存在的保护差距。

paras.en: According to a 2020 study by Iran's Police Academy, honor killings — defined as the murder of a woman by male relatives such as her father, brother or uncle for allegedly violating social norms of modesty and family honor — accounted for up to 45% of all murders in some traditionally conservative provinces in western and southern Iran.
paras.zh: 根据伊朗警察学院 2020 年的一项研究，在伊朗西部和南部的一些传统保守省份，名誉杀人——被定义为女性因涉嫌违反谦虚和家庭荣誉的社会规范而被父亲、兄弟或叔叔等男性亲属谋杀的行为——占所有谋杀案的 45%。

paras.en: In March 2025, the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in Iran reported that at least 179 women were murdered by men within their family circles in 2024. These cases were recorded as femicides.
paras.zh: 2025 年 3 月，联合国伊朗人权问题特别报告员报告称，2024 年至少有 179 名女性被家庭成员谋杀。这些案件被记录为杀戮女性。

paras.en: It was the brutality of Maryam Yarmohammadi's murder that shocked Iranians. The murder triggered a wave of grief and outrage on social media. Many women reacted strongly to what they saw as a femicide driven by hatred in the name of "honor" and "shame."
paras.zh: 玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪被谋杀的残酷程度震惊了伊朗人。这起谋杀案在社交媒体上引发了悲痛和愤怒的浪潮。许多妇女对她们认为是出于“荣誉”和“耻辱”的仇恨而杀害女性的行为做出了强烈反应。

paras.en: At the same time, numerous comments focused on victim-blaming, or holding Maryam Yarmohammadi responsible for her own death. Others described the killing as the "punishment of an unfaithful woman" or attempted to justify it by "understanding the men's anger."
paras.zh: 与此同时，许多评论都集中在指责受害者或让玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪对自己的死亡负责。其他人将这起杀戮描述为“对不忠女性的惩罚”，或试图通过“理解男人的愤怒”来证明其合理性。

paras.en: Men have been socialized to believe they are responsible for controlling women and monitoring their behavior and decisions, the psychoanalyst Saba Alaleh said. Male identity, she said, is tied to a woman's "obedience."
paras.zh: 精神分析学家萨巴·阿拉勒说，男性已经被社会化，认为他们有责任控制女性并监督她们的行为和决定。她说，男性身份与女性的“服从”息息相关。

paras.en: Violence becomes normalized when beliefs, social approval and silence reinforce one another within this structure, Alaleh said.
paras.zh: 阿拉勒说，当信仰、社会认可和沉默在这一结构中相互加强时，暴力就会变得常态化。

paras.en: "When cultural, social, political, economic, legal and educational factors are closely intertwined, they acquire enormous power," she said. "Under such conditions, women are also highly economically dependent and lack sufficient social support. Preventive mechanisms are absent, as well. All of this increases the risk of violence."
paras.zh: “当文化、社会、政治、经济、法律和教育因素紧密交织在一起时，它们就会获得巨大的力量，”她说。 “在这种情况下，妇女在经济上也高度依赖，缺乏足够的社会支持。也缺乏预防机制。所有这些都增加了暴力风险。”

paras.en: Atefeh Rangriz, a sociologist and women's rights activist, told DW: "Femicides have always existed, and their political manifestations can be traced throughout history, from forced unveiling [under Reza Shah Pahlavi in the 1930s] to the slogan 'Either the headscarf or blows to the head' in the Islamic Republic."
paras.zh: 社会学家兼女权活动人士阿特费·朗格里兹（Atefeh Rangriz）告诉德国之声：“杀害女性的行为一直存在，其政治表现可以追溯到整个历史，从（20世纪30年代礼萨·沙·巴列维统治下的）强制揭开面纱，到伊斯兰共和国‘要么戴头巾，要么打头’的口号。”

paras.en: Rangriz said women understood the path toward liberation and, despite tremendous obstacles, had achieved significant progress over the past decades.
paras.zh: 兰格里兹说，妇女了解通往解放的道路，尽管面临巨大的障碍，但在过去几十年中取得了重大进展。

paras.en: Women in Iran have been driving since 1940. They have been allowed to vote and run for political office since 1963. Women account for half of all university graduates in the country. The number of women filing for divorce or mutually ending unhappy marriages has also continued to rise.
paras.zh: 伊朗女性自 1940 年起开始开车。自 1963 年起她们被允许投票并竞选政治职位。女性占该国所有大学毕业生的一半。申请离婚或双方结束不幸婚姻的女性人数也在持续增加。

paras.en: The "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement, which emerged from the nationwide protests following the death of Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody in 2022, has further transformed public perceptions of women in Iran.
paras.zh: 2022 年吉娜·马赫萨·阿米尼 (Jina Mahsa Amini) 在警方拘留期间死亡后，全国范围内的抗议活动引发了“妇女、生命、自由”运动，进一步改变了伊朗公众对女性的看法。

paras.en: "Women have learned to focus on the present rather than postponing justice to the future. They demand it now," Rangriz said. "They want to exercise autonomy over their own bodies, live as they choose, and free themselves from the structures of domination, oppression and exploitation. It is a kind of radical revolution."
paras.zh: “女性已经学会关注现在，而不是将正义推迟到未来。她们现在就要求这样做，”兰格里兹说。 “他们想要对自己的身体行使自主权，按照自己选择的方式生活，并将自己从统治、压迫和剥削的结构中解放出来。这是一种激进的革命。”

paras.en: Many Iranian women no longer wear the mandatory hijab in public, openly defying the Islamic Republic's dress regulations.
paras.zh: 许多伊朗妇女不再在公共场合强制戴头巾，公然违反伊斯兰共和国的着装规定。

paras.en: Yet it remains unknown what the young mother Maryam Yarmohammadi wanted, or how she wished to live. She was brutally killed.
paras.zh: 然而，我们仍然不知道年轻的母亲玛丽亚姆·亚莫哈马迪想要什么，或者她希望如何生活。她被残忍地杀害了。

paras.en: If you or someone you know have experienced gender-based violence, the website lila.help lists trustworthy helplines and NGOs that offer support in almost every country in the world.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人经历过基于性别的暴力，lila.help 网站列出了值得信赖的帮助热线和非政府组织，它们在世界上几乎每个国家/地区提供支持。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Hijab ban at schools in Azerbaijan: What's behind the rare wave of protests?

paras.en: A dispute over Islamic headscarves in Azerbaijani schools has triggered protests at home and an unusual exchange of criticism between politicians in Azerbaijan and Turkey, two countries whose leaders routinely describe their relationship as that of "one nation, two states". The row has raised questions about religious freedom, sovereignty and the limits of Turkish and Iranian influence in the south Caucasian country.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆学校关于伊斯兰头巾的争议引发了国内抗议，以及阿塞拜疆和土耳其政治家之间不同寻常的相互批评，这两个国家的领导人经常将两国关系描述为“一个民族，两个国家”。这场争吵引发了人们对宗教自由、主权以及土耳其和伊朗在这个南高加索国家影响力限制的质疑。

paras.en: The unprecedented protests have been taking place across Azerbaijan for a nearly week. Children have demonstrated against the headscarf ban introduced at schools. Among those rallying outside of schools are girls who wear Islamic headscarves; others, including boys, have joined classmates in solidarity.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆各地发生史无前例的抗议活动已持续近一周。孩子们举行示威抗议学校实施的头巾禁令。在学校外集会的人中，有戴着伊斯兰头巾的女孩；其他人，包括男孩，也与同学们一起声援。

paras.en: Rallies in general are rare in a country where police routinely disperse any public protests. But demonstrations involving children are unprecedented in Azerbaijan. As the videos showing the protests started spreading on social media, access to Instagram and TikTok was disrupted in the country, indicating how seriously the authorities are taking the issue. Internet monitors documented blocks; the authorities have not explained their cause.
paras.zh: 在一个警察经常驱散公众抗议活动的国家，集会通常很少见。但涉及儿童的示威活动在阿塞拜疆是史无前例的。随着展示抗议活动的视频开始在社交媒体上传播，Instagram 和 TikTok 在该国的访问被中断，这表明当局对这个问题的重视程度。互联网监控记录的区块；当局没有解释其原因。

paras.en: The dispute follows a series of legal changes. On July 7, Azerbaijan amended its general education law, reinforcing the principle of secular education and requiring pupils and teachers to comply with dress codes. On September 21, the government adopted Resolution No. 309, tightening school uniform rules.
paras.zh: 这场争议是在一系列法律变更之后发生的。 7月7日，阿塞拜疆修订了普通教育法，强化了世俗教育原则，并要求学生和教师遵守着装规范。 9月21日，政府通过第309号决议，收紧校服规定。

paras.en: The resolution prohibits additional clothing that disrupts the standard uniform or conflicts with secular education. It does not explicitly mention the hijab ― a Muslim headscarf covering the hair and neck ― or instruct schools to exclude pupils wearing one. But some school administrators have interpreted the rule as applying to hijabs and turned girls covering their heads away. The regulation gives each school's pedagogical council responsibility for resolving compliance issues.
paras.zh: 该决议禁止额外穿着破坏标准制服或与世俗教育相冲突的服装。它没有明确提及头巾（一种遮盖头发和脖子的穆斯林头巾），也没有指示学校禁止佩戴头巾的学生。但一些学校管理人员将此规则解释为适用于头巾，并禁止女孩遮住头。该法规赋予每所学校的教学委员会解决合规问题的责任。

paras.en: A separate decision on October 6 set dress requirements for teachers. Reports followed of women wearing headscarves being prevented from teaching.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日的另一项决定规定了教师的着装要求。随后有报道称，戴着头巾的女性被禁止教学。

paras.en: Azerbaijan is a predominantly Muslim country, but Article 18 of its constitution separates religion from the state and requires state education to be secular. Articles 42 and 48 protect the right to education and freedom of conscience.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆是一个以穆斯林为主的国家，但其宪法第18条将宗教与国家分开，并要求国家教育是世俗的。第42条和第48条保护受教育权和良心自由。

paras.en: Supporters of the schools' actions say the same dress rules should apply to all pupils. Critics argue that excluding girls because of religious clothing violates their rights. The dispute cuts across conventional political divisions: some government critics support the restrictions, while some non-religious Azerbaijanis oppose them. School headscarf restrictions also prompted protests in 2010 and subsequent years.
paras.zh: 学校行动的支持者表示，同样的着装规则应该适用于所有学生。批评者认为，因为宗教服装而将女孩排除在外侵犯了她们的权利。这场争端跨越了传统的政治分歧：一些政府批评者支持这些限制，而一些非宗教阿塞拜疆人则反对。学校头巾限制也引发了 2010 年及随后几年的抗议活动。

paras.en: Families and teachers describe the impact
paras.zh: 家人和老师描述了影响

paras.en: A Baku literature teacher with 40 years of experience, said that girls wearing headscarves were not admitted to classes at the teacher's school. Some removed their scarves; others went home or wanted to study at home. The teacher, who didn't want to be identified by name and provided only the initials M.C., supported enforcing the uniform rules, arguing that children were too young to make decisions about religious dress.
paras.zh: 巴库一位拥有40年经验的文学教师表示，戴头巾的女孩不被允许进入师范学校上课。有些人摘下了围巾；有些人则摘下了围巾。其他人回家或想在家学习。这位不愿透露姓名的老师只提供了姓名首字母 M.C.，他支持执行统一规则，认为孩子们还太小，无法就宗教着装做出决定。

paras.en: A parent identified as D.A. told DW this was not a nationwide hijab ban, but a matter of school uniforms. Another parent who opposed the restrictions withdrew an interview before publication.
paras.zh: 父母身份为 D.A.告诉德国之声，这不是全国范围内的头巾禁令，而是校服问题。另一位反对这些限制的家长在发表前撤回了采访。

paras.en: Facebook user Sarraf Cabbarov from Baku posted on his social media account that his daughter Sevil, a primary school teacher in Azerbaijan's capital, was dismissed for refusing to remove her headscarf. He also published a school order issuing her a written warning under the new dress regulations.
paras.zh: 来自巴库的Facebook用户萨拉夫·卡巴罗夫(Sarraf Cabbarov)在他的社交媒体账户上发帖称，他的女儿塞维尔(Sevil)是阿塞拜疆首都的一名小学教师，因拒绝摘下头巾而被解雇。他还发布了一份学校命令，根据新的着装规定向她发出书面警告。

paras.en: On October 12, the Interior Ministry said 37 people had been detained in connection with the protests. According to the ministry's statement, the group had confronted school staff, damaged property and attempted to obstruct school activities and traffic. A criminal case was opened under Article 233, concerning disruption of public order. The ministry did not identify those detained or say whether they included children.
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日，内政部表示，有 37 人因抗议活动而被拘留。根据教育部的声明，该组织与学校工作人员发生冲突，损坏财产，并试图阻碍学校活动和交通。根据第 233 条，就扰乱公共秩序提起刑事诉讼。该部没有透露被拘留者的身份，也没有透露其中是否包括儿童。

paras.en: Artist and activist Ilkin Huseynov went missing after launching a project linking volunteer tutors with pupils affected by the restrictions. Local media later reported, citing people close to him, that he had been given 30 days of administrative detention for allegedly disobeying police orders.
paras.zh: 艺术家兼活动家伊尔金·侯赛诺夫 (Ilkin Huseynov) 在发起一个将志愿者导师与受限制影响的学生联系起来的项目后失踪。当地媒体后来援引与他关系密切的人士的话报道称，他因涉嫌违反警方命令而被行政拘留 30 天。

paras.en: Some observers linked the introduction of the new rules for school uniform to the attempts by the Azerbaijani government to counter the influence of neighboring Iran and the growing strength of religious groups within the country. This interpretation is, in essence, echoed by government officials as well, although they stop short of explicitly naming Iran.
paras.zh: 一些观察人士将校服新规定的出台与阿塞拜疆政府试图对抗邻国伊朗的影响以及该国境内宗教团体日益增长的力量联系起来。这种解释本质上也得到了政府官员的响应，尽管他们没有明确点名伊朗。

paras.en: Fazil Mustafa, who chairs the Committee for Public Associations and Religious Institutions at Azerbaijan's parliament, said the authorities were concerned about religious groups influenced from abroad and defended the school rules. Allahshukur Pashazade, head of the Caucasus Muslims Office, also warned of outside interference but called for a peaceful solution. The alleged foreign involvement has not been independently established.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆议会公共协会和宗教机构委员会主席法齐尔·穆斯塔法表示，当局担心宗教团体受到国外影响，并捍卫学校规定。高加索穆斯林办公室负责人阿拉舒库尔·帕沙扎德也对外部干涉发出警告，但呼吁和平解决。所谓的外国参与尚未得到独立证实。

paras.en: Amnesty International condemned the exclusion of girls wearing hijabs and called for the release of anyone detained solely for protesting peacefully.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织谴责将戴头巾的女孩排除在外，并呼吁释放任何仅因和平抗议而被拘留的人。

paras.en: The controversy has also drawn criticism in Turkey, Azerbaijan's close ally. Protesters gathered outside Azerbaijan's consulate in Istanbul on October 3. Oktay Saral, an adviser to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, criticized the restrictions,saying it's unacceptable to deny education to students wearing headscarves. Azerbaijan's ruling New Azerbaijan Party replied that close relations did not justify interference in its internal affairs.
paras.zh: 这一争议也引起了阿塞拜疆亲密盟友土耳其的批评。 10月3日，抗议者聚集在阿塞拜疆驻伊斯坦布尔领事馆外。土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安的顾问奥克泰·萨拉尔批评了这些限制，称拒绝对戴头巾的学生进行教育是不可接受的。阿塞拜疆执政党新阿塞拜疆党回应称，密切关系并不能成为干涉其内政的理由。

paras.en: For affected families, the immediate question remains whether children can attend school without removing their headscarves.
paras.zh: 对于受影响的家庭来说，最紧迫的问题仍然是孩子们是否可以在不摘下头巾的情况下上学。

articles.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was applauded by EU leaders when he appeared at this week's summit in Brussels. But getting what he needs from Europe will be tough, and a public dispute with US President Donald Trump has put him in a very difficult position.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基出席本周在布鲁塞尔举行的峰会时受到了欧盟领导人的赞扬。但从欧洲获得他所需要的东西将是困难的，而且与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的公开争端使他陷入了非常困难的境地。

paras.en: Speaking to press at the summit, he said that "Putin wants to destroy us" and that Ukraine must prepare for a hard winter.
paras.zh: 他在峰会上向媒体发表讲话时表示，“普京想要摧毁我们”，乌克兰必须为艰难的冬天做好准备。

paras.en: Experts view the upcoming cold season as a rough one for Ukraine as well.
paras.zh: 专家认为即将到来的寒冷季节对乌克兰来说也将是一个艰难的季节。

paras.en: "Ukraine is arguably entering the most difficult winter since [Russia's] full scale invasion," Olena Prokopenko, a senior fellow at the German Marshall Fund of the United States, a nonpartisan think-tank, told DW.
paras.zh: 无党派智库美国德国马歇尔基金会高级研究员奥琳娜·普罗科彭科 (Olena Prokopenko) 告诉德国之声：“乌克兰可以说正在进入自（俄罗斯）全面入侵以来最艰难的冬天。”

paras.en: Three painful topics were on the table at the summit for discussion between Zelenskyy and EU leaders: US relations with Russia, Starlink ― and money.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基和欧盟领导人在峰会上讨论了三个令人痛苦的话题：美国与俄罗斯的关系、星链和金钱。

paras.en: Zelenskyy's visit to Brussels comes at a time when he needs European support more than ever. That's because his relationship with the US is worsening. Worries are growing in the EU and Ukraine that the US is growing more sympathetic to Russia.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基访问布鲁塞尔之际，他比以往任何时候都更需要欧洲的支持。这是因为他与美国的关系正在恶化。欧盟和乌克兰越来越担心美国越来越同情俄罗斯。

paras.en: President Trump told US news channel Newsmax: "I think I find Zelenskyy to be more difficult to deal with than [Russian President Vladimir] Putin."
paras.zh: 特朗普总统对美国新闻频道 Newsmax 表示：“我认为泽伦斯基比[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京更难对付。”

paras.en: Trump struck a deal to buy Russian diesel on October 12, which signifies a step back from sanctions placed on Russia and a blow for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普于10月12日达成了购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，这意味着对俄罗斯制裁的后退以及对乌克兰的打击。

paras.en: When Zelenskyy ordered Ukrainian forces to conduct fresh strikes on Russia's oil refineries, Trump labelled the Ukrainian leader's decision as "a disgrace."
paras.zh: 当泽连斯基命令乌克兰军队对俄罗斯炼油厂进行新的打击时，特朗普称乌克兰领导人的决定是“耻辱”。

paras.en: At the press conference at the summit on Friday, Zelenskyy told reporters that he knows that US-built missiles "are being sent to the Middle East, so it is no secret that we are not a priority."
paras.zh: 在周五峰会的新闻发布会上，泽伦斯基告诉记者，他知道美国制造的导弹“正在被送往中东，所以我们不是优先事项，这已经不是什么秘密了。”

paras.en: He is asking Europe instead to supply the military power Ukraine needs to get through the winter.
paras.zh: 他要求欧洲提供乌克兰度过冬天所需的军事力量。

paras.en: Since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, the US has been the biggest military donor to Ukraine. But the relationship between the two countries has become more difficult since the start of Donald Trump's second term in the White House.
paras.zh: 自2022年2月俄罗斯开始全面入侵乌克兰以来，美国一直是乌克兰最大的军事捐助国。但自唐纳德·特朗普入主白宫第二任期以来，两国关系变得更加困难。

paras.en: Ukraine uses Starlink, a satellite Internet service developed by tech billionaire Elon Musk. The country also uses Starshield, the military-grade version, for battlefield communications, mid-range strikes on Russian-occupied territory and interceptor drones, though not for long-range strikes in Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用星链，这是一项由科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克开发的卫星互联网服务。该国还使用军用级版本“星盾”进行战场通信、对俄罗斯占领领土的中程打击和拦截无人机，但不用于对俄罗斯境内的远程打击。

paras.en: At the summit, Zelenskyy spoke of his "deep and unpleasant" surprise upon finding out that Ukraine was experiencing disruptions to the systems. He said this has hobbled Ukraine's ability to defend itself.
paras.zh: 在峰会上，泽连斯基谈到了他在发现乌克兰的系统出现中断后感到“深深且不愉快”的惊讶。他说，这削弱了乌克兰的自卫能力。

paras.en: Both Elon Musk and the White House say they are not responsible for the slowdown.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克和白宫都表示，他们对经济放缓不负有责任。

paras.en: The EU's foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas told the press at the summit before the talks began: "Starlink is really necessary for Ukraine and unfortunately in [the] short term Europe can't replace this capability."
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯在会谈开始前的峰会上对媒体表示：“星链对于乌克兰来说确实是必要的，不幸的是，短期内欧洲无法取代这种能力。”

paras.en: Prokopenko said that this was the reason "why Ukraine's most credible medium-term solution here is to continue relying on the US. And the EU is critical in this context in terms of backing Ukraine's requests for the US administration to keep those technologies on offer" for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 普罗科彭科表示，这就是为什么“乌克兰最可信的中期解决方案是继续依赖美国。在这种情况下，欧盟在支持乌克兰要求美国政府继续向基辅提供这些技术方面至关重要”。

paras.en: Speaking to journalists at the summit, Zelenskyy said the speed of Starlink had still not been fully restored but had improved. He said Ukraine is cooperating with various countries, including France, to search for a partial solution.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在峰会上对记者表示，星链的速度尚未完全恢复，但已经有所改善。他说，乌克兰正在与包括法国在内的各国合作，寻求部分解决方案。

paras.en: Zelenskyy urged EU leaders Friday to keep backing Kyiv financially as well, asking for nearly $80 billion (€70 billion) more next year.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周五敦促欧盟领导人继续在财政上支持基辅，并要求明年再提供近 800 亿美元（700 亿欧元）的资金。

paras.en: "This is a realistic amount and I ask you to find this support," Zelenskyy said. "It will help us hold Russia back."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基说：“这是一个现实的数额，我请求你们寻求这种支持。” “这将帮助我们阻止俄罗斯。”

paras.en: The EU gave Kyiv an approximately $100 billion (€90 billion) loan last year, making the EU Ukraine's biggest international backer. But the Ukrainian government is saying it needs more.
paras.zh: 欧盟去年向基辅提供了约1000亿美元（900亿欧元）的贷款，使欧盟成为乌克兰最大的国际支持者。但乌克兰政府表示需要更多。

paras.en: "The war is becoming objectively more expensive, and the Ukrainian economy is increasingly affected by the Russian strikes, leading to a drastic decline in tax and customs revenues," Prokopenko said. "So the needs will continue growing."
paras.zh: 普罗科彭科说：“战争客观上变得更加昂贵，乌克兰经济越来越受到俄罗斯袭击的影响，导致税收和海关收入急剧下降。” “因此需求将继续增长。”

paras.en: So will Ukraine get what it needs? Closing the summit, President of the European Council Antonio Costa said that Ukraine "remains a priority" and asked the European Commission to come up with a proposal to pull together more funds for the country in 2027.
paras.zh: 那么乌克兰会得到它所需要的吗？欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔在峰会闭幕式上表示，乌克兰“仍然是一个优先事项”，并要求欧盟委员会提出一项提案，在 2027 年为该国筹集更多资金。

paras.en: Essentially, it looks as though the EU will try to find a way to meet Ukraine's cash demands ― though it is not yet clear how.
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，欧盟似乎将试图找到一种方法来满足乌克兰的现金需求——尽管目前尚不清楚如何实现。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen promised the EU will "continue to lead" but urged international partners to step up as well.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩承诺欧盟将“继续发挥领导作用”，但敦促国际伙伴也加紧努力。

paras.en: Ukraine to 'keep living and fighting with dignity'
paras.zh: 乌克兰“继续有尊严地生活和战斗”

paras.en: Zelenskyy will leave Brussels without concrete promises or numbers, but with renewed commitments for support from Europe.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基将在没有具体承诺或数字的情况下离开布鲁塞尔，但会重新承诺获得欧洲的支持。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president concluded his press conference with an emotional statement: "We will keep living and fighting with dignity."
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统在结束新闻发布会时发表了感人的声明：“我们将继续有尊严地生活和战斗。”

articles.title: Trump defends Russian sanctions relief, lashes out at Zelenskyy

paras.en: United States President Donald Trump has defended sanction waivers for Russia, saying he wants to keep Moscow at the bargaining table and accusing his counterpart in Kyiv of not wanting to end the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普为俄罗斯的制裁豁免辩护，称他希望让莫斯科留在谈判桌上，并指责基辅总统不想结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Trump made the comments on Truth Social on Sunday in response to criticism of his decision to block numerous sanctions on Russia just days before they were due to take effect.
paras.zh: 特朗普周日在《真相社会》上发表了上述言论，回应了外界对其决定在制裁生效前几天阻止对俄罗斯实施多项制裁的批评。

paras.en: “My decision on Russia is a very simple one. I am in the process of negotiating Peace in the war between Russia and Ukraine, and don’t want to do anything that will drive, foolishly, Russia away from the bargaining table,” he said.
paras.zh: “我对俄罗斯的决定非常简单。我正在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争中进行和平谈判，我不想做任何会愚蠢地将俄罗斯赶出谈判桌的事情，”他说。

paras.en: The move has triggered a significant diplomatic fallout between Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy over the past week.
paras.zh: 过去一周，此举引发了特朗普和乌克兰总统泽连斯基之间的重大外交影响。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said that waiving sanctions on Russia, which launched a full-scale invasion of its neighbour in 2022, “will hurt Ukraine”, telling NBC’s Meet the Press on Sunday that it would strengthen Russian President Vladimir Putin’s war effort.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，放弃对俄罗斯的制裁“将伤害乌克兰”，俄罗斯将于2022年对其邻国发动全面入侵。他在周日接受美国全国广播公司(NBC)采访时表示，这将加强俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的战争努力。
