articles.title: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea

paras.en: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea
paras.zh: 物理学家创造了一种奇怪的新量子态，称为分数费米海

paras.en: - Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a highly excited yet surprisingly orderly configuration called a "fractional Fermi sea." The discovery challenges established quantum theories and hints at exotic quasiparticles that scientists have dubbed potential "super-Fermions."
paras.zh: - 物理学家发现了一种奇怪的新量子物质状态，其中超冷原子违背了熟悉的组织规则，形成了一种高度激发但令人惊讶的有序结构，称为“分数费米海”。这一发现挑战了已建立的量子理论，并暗示了科学家们称之为潜在“超级费米子”的奇异准粒子。

paras.en: Physicists have uncovered a strange new form of quantum behavior in which particles organize themselves in ways that challenge established theories. Even more surprising, the particles maintain a remarkable hidden order despite being driven into an extremely energetic state.
paras.zh: 物理学家发现了一种奇怪的新形式的量子行为，其中粒子以挑战现有理论的方式组织自身。更令人惊讶的是，尽管粒子被驱动进入极高的能量状态，但仍保持着显着的隐藏秩序。

paras.en: In a study published in Physical Review Letters, researchers from the group led by Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, working with theoretical physicist Alvise Bastianello of the CNRS and Université Paris-Dauphine, describe how to engineer an exotic quantum state known as a "fractional Fermi sea."
paras.zh: 在《物理评论快报》上发表的一项研究中，由 Hanns-Christoph Nägerl 领导的小组的研究人员与法国国家科学研究中心和巴黎第九大学的理论物理学家阿尔维斯·巴斯蒂安内洛合作，描述了如何设计一种被称为“分数费米海”的奇特量子态。

paras.en: The breakthrough involves pushing ultracold cesium atoms far beyond their normal conditions by repeatedly changing how strongly they attract or repel one another. Rather than simply becoming disordered, the particles rearrange themselves into an unusual configuration that behaves differently from the quantum systems scientists have traditionally studied.
paras.zh: 这一突破涉及通过反复改变超冷铯原子相互吸引或排斥的强度，使它们远远超出其正常条件。这些粒子并不是简单地变得无序，而是将自身重新排列成一种不寻常的结构，其行为与科学家传统上研究的量子系统不同。

paras.en: The theoretical findings provide the foundation for recent experimental research conducted by Nägerl's team at the Department of Experimental Physics.
paras.zh: 这些理论发现为实验物理系 Nägerl 团队最近进行的实验研究奠定了基础。

paras.en: Pushing Quantum Particles Beyond Their Normal Limits
paras.zh: 推动量子粒子超越其正常极限

paras.en: Under ordinary conditions, quantum particles follow well-established rules that determine how they arrange themselves, particularly at extremely low temperatures.
paras.zh: 在普通条件下，量子粒子遵循既定的规则来决定它们如何排列自己，特别是在极低的温度下。

paras.en: One important example involves fermions, a category of particles that includes electrons. These particles cannot all occupy the same quantum state, so they fill available energy levels according to specific restrictions. At very low temperatures, this arrangement produces what physicists call a Fermi sea.
paras.zh: 一个重要的例子涉及费米子，这是一类包含电子的粒子。这些粒子不可能全部占据相同的量子态，因此它们根据特定的限制填充可用的能级。在非常低的温度下，这种排列会产生物理学家所说的费米海。

paras.en: But what happens when researchers deliberately disrupt the conditions that normally govern how particles behave?
paras.zh: 但是，当研究人员故意破坏通常控制粒子行为的条件时，会发生什么？

paras.en: As Alvise Bastianello explains: "Fermions, for instance, stack neatly into the available energy states to form the so-called 'Fermi sea'. But what happens if one forces interacting atoms to continuously cycle through extreme conditions, smoothly shifting them from strongly repelling each other to strongly attracting each other?"
paras.zh: 正如阿尔维斯·巴斯蒂安内洛（Alvise Bastianello）所解释的那样：“例如，费米子整齐地堆积成可用的能量状态，形成所谓的‘费米海’。但是，如果迫使相互作用的原子在极端条件下不断循环，顺利地将它们从相互强烈排斥转变为强烈相互吸引，会发生什么？”

paras.en: To investigate this possibility, the researchers studied ultracold cesium atoms confined to a one-dimensional system. This means the atoms are restricted to moving along a single direction, creating an environment in which their quantum interactions can be studied with exceptional control.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种可能性，研究人员研究了限制在一维系统中的超冷铯原子。这意味着原子被限制沿单一方向移动，创造了一个可以通过特殊控制来研究它们的量子相互作用的环境。

paras.en: The team examined what happens when the interactions between these atoms are repeatedly adjusted, cycling between powerful repulsion and attraction.
paras.zh: 研究小组研究了当这些原子之间的相互作用反复调整、在强大的排斥力和吸引力之间循环时会发生什么。

paras.en: Their calculations revealed something unexpected. Starting from the ground state, the lowest energy configuration available to the system, the atoms could be driven into a highly excited state without losing their underlying organization.
paras.zh: 他们的计算揭示了一些意想不到的事情。从基态（系统可用的最低能量配置）开始，原子可以被驱动到高度激发态，而不会失去其底层组织。

paras.en: The researchers call this unusual arrangement a fractional Fermi sea because its particles appear to obey a modified rule governing how quantum states are occupied.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种不寻常的排列称为分数费米海，因为它的粒子似乎遵守控制量子态如何占据的修改规则。

paras.en: "Instead of simply heating the system, the interaction cycle reorganizes the atoms into a new many-body state," says Yi Zeng, the leading author of this study. "This gives us a controlled way to explore quantum matter beyond the usual equilibrium paradigms."
paras.zh: 这项研究的主要作者 Yi Zeng 表示：“相互作用循环不是简单地加热系统，而是将原子重新组织成新的多体状态。” “这为我们提供了一种超越通常平衡范式探索量子物质的受控方法。”

paras.en: A Strange New Quantum State With Hidden Order
paras.zh: 具有隐藏秩序的奇怪的新量子态

paras.en: One of the most intriguing features of the fractional Fermi sea is that its particles remain organized even though the system has been pushed far from equilibrium.
paras.zh: 分数费米海最有趣的特征之一是，即使系统已远离平衡，其粒子仍保持有序。

paras.en: In physics, equilibrium describes a condition in which a system's overall properties have settled into a stable balance. Systems driven far from equilibrium can behave in complicated and unexpected ways, making them particularly challenging to understand.
paras.zh: 在物理学中，平衡描述了系统的整体属性达到稳定平衡的状态。远离平衡的系统可能会以复杂且意想不到的方式运行，这使得它们特别难以理解。

paras.en: Yet the fractional Fermi sea is not simply a collection of excited particles behaving randomly. Instead, it contains distinctive mathematical patterns that reveal a deeper structure.
paras.zh: 然而，分数费米海不仅仅是随机行为的受激粒子的集合。相反，它包含揭示更深层次结构的独特数学模式。

paras.en: Among these patterns are pronounced ripples called Friedel oscillations. These are wave-like variations associated with the way quantum particles influence one another. The researchers also identified unusual patterns in how correlations between particles weaken with increasing distance, even when the repulsive interactions are relatively weak.
paras.zh: 在这些模式中，有一种明显的波纹，称为弗里德尔振荡。这些是与量子粒子相互影响的方式相关的波状变化。研究人员还发现了粒子之间的相关性随着距离的增加而减弱的不寻常模式，即使排斥相互作用相对较弱。

paras.en: These signatures are important because they differ from predictions associated with Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory, a long-established framework for describing how interacting quantum particles behave in one-dimensional systems.
paras.zh: 这些特征很重要，因为它们与 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体理论相关的预测不同，这是一个长期建立的框架，用于描述相互作用的量子粒子在一维系统中的行为方式。

paras.en: The findings therefore point toward a previously unexplored type of quantum behavior that cannot be fully described using this familiar theoretical picture.
paras.zh: 因此，这些发现指向了一种以前未探索过的量子行为类型，这种行为无法使用这种熟悉的理论图景来完全描述。

paras.en: "This state is highly excited, but it is not random," says Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, the group leader. "It has a hidden order that becomes visible in its correlations."
paras.zh: “这种状态是高度兴奋的，但它不是随机的，”小组负责人汉斯-克里斯托夫·纳格尔 (Hanns-Christoph Nägerl) 说。 “它有一个隐藏的顺序，在其相关性中变得可见。”

paras.en: The strange behavior also raises questions about the effective particles that emerge within the system. Physicists call these collective excitations quasiparticles because they can behave like individual particles even though they arise from the coordinated motion of many interacting particles.
paras.zh: 这种奇怪的行为也引发了人们对系统内出现的有效粒子的疑问。物理学家将这些集体激发称为准粒子，因为它们的行为可以像单个粒子一样，尽管它们是由许多相互作用的粒子的协调运动产生的。

paras.en: Nägerl suggests that the unusual excitations might eventually deserve a name of their own.
paras.zh: 纳格尔认为，这种不寻常的兴奋最终可能值得拥有自己的名字。

paras.en: "We are not yet sure how we should name these new quasiparticles. Perhaps 'super-Fermions'?"
paras.zh: “我们还不确定应该如何命名这些新的准粒子。也许是‘超级费米子’？”

paras.en: Opening a New Frontier in Quantum Physics
paras.zh: 开辟量子物理新领域

paras.en: The discovery suggests that fractional Fermi seas represent an exotic critical phase of quantum matter, with characteristic patterns of particle correlations that extend beyond existing descriptions of one-dimensional quantum systems.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，分数费米海代表了量子物质的一种奇异的临界相，其粒子相关性的特征模式超出了对一维量子系统的现有描述。

paras.en: It also demonstrates the growing power of quantum simulation, a technique that allows scientists to use carefully controlled quantum systems to investigate physical behavior that would otherwise be difficult to reproduce or study.
paras.zh: 它还展示了量子模拟日益强大的力量，这种技术使科学家能够使用精心控制的量子系统来研究否则难以重现或研究的物理行为。

paras.en: Ultracold atoms are particularly useful for this purpose because researchers can precisely adjust their interactions and observe how the resulting quantum states change.
paras.zh: 超冷原子对于此目的特别有用，因为研究人员可以精确调整它们的相互作用并观察由此产生的量子态如何变化。

paras.en: Rather than limiting these experiments to recreating phenomena already understood through established theories, scientists can now explore deliberately engineered states that reveal entirely new possibilities.
paras.zh: 科学家们现在可以探索故意设计的状态，揭示全新的可能性，而不是将这些实验限制在重现通过既定理论已经理解的现象。

paras.en: As Hanns-Christoph Nägerl says: "The discovery of fractional Fermi seas shows how far we can push quantum simulation: not only reproducing known models, but creating and probing states that go beyond established paradigms."
paras.zh: 正如 Hanns-Christoph Nägerl 所说：“分数费米海的发现表明我们可以将量子模拟推向多远：不仅复制已知模型，而且创建和探索超越既定范式的状态。”

paras.en: The current publication establishes the theoretical framework for fractional Fermi seas. A companion study describing their experimental realization through quantum simulation is undergoing peer review.
paras.zh: 当前出版物建立了分数费米海的理论框架。一项描述他们通过量子模拟实现实验的配套研究正在接受同行评审。

paras.en: Together, the research points toward new ways of investigating the fundamental behavior of quantum matter, including unusual collective excitations and hidden forms of order that emerge only when particles are pushed far outside their normal conditions.
paras.zh: 总之，这些研究指出了研究量子物质基本行为的新方法，包括不寻常的集体激发和隐藏的秩序形式，这些秩序只有当粒子被远远超出其正常条件时才会出现。

articles.title: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt

paras.en: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt
paras.zh: 科学家发现一种天然化合物可以保护大脑免受过多盐的影响

paras.en: A soy-derived compound protected mice from high blood pressure and memory problems linked to excessive salt consumption, offering a promising new avenue for research.
paras.zh: 一种源自大豆的化合物可以保护小鼠免受与过量盐摄入有关的高血压和记忆问题的影响，为研究提供了一个有希望的新途径。

paras.en: - Eating too much salt may do more than raise blood pressure. It could also harm memory and social behavior. In a new study, Japanese researchers discovered that a soy-derived compound called LPC70 helped protect mice from several damaging effects of a high-salt diet. Mice given the supplement had lower blood pressure, better memory, and improved social interactions compared with mice consuming excess salt alone.
paras.zh: - 吃太多盐不仅会导致血压升高。它还可能损害记忆和社交行为。在一项新研究中，日本研究人员发现，一种名为 LPC70 的大豆衍生化合物有助于保护小鼠免受高盐饮食的多种破坏性影响。与单独摄入过量盐的小鼠相比，服用补充剂的小鼠血压更低，记忆力更好，社交互动也得到改善。

paras.en: Consuming too much salt can affect more than blood pressure. Growing evidence suggests that excessive salt intake may also interfere with memory, thinking, and emotional well-being. High salt (HS) consumption is already a major public health concern because of its connection to hypertension, but its potential effects on the brain make finding ways to reduce the damage even more important.
paras.zh: 摄入过多的盐不仅会影响血压。越来越多的证据表明，摄入过多的盐还可能会干扰记忆、思维和情绪健康。高盐 (HS) 摄入量由于与高血压有关，已经成为一个主要的公共卫生问题，但它对大脑的潜在影响使得寻找减少损害的方法变得更加重要。

paras.en: Researchers in Japan have identified a promising possibility in LPC70, a compound derived from soy. Previous research found that this ingredient could reduce high blood pressure and cognitive problems associated with a high-salt diet (HSD) in mice. The latest study takes a closer look at how it works, revealing that the compound influences important chemical signals in the brain and kidneys.
paras.zh: 日本研究人员在 LPC70（一种从大豆中提取的化合物）中发现了一种有希望的可能性。先前的研究发现，这种成分可以降低小鼠的高血压和与高盐饮食 (HSD) 相关的认知问题。最新的研究仔细研究了它的工作原理，揭示了该化合物影响大脑和肾脏中的重要化学信号。

paras.en: How a Soy Compound May Counter the Effects of Excess Salt
paras.zh: 大豆化合物如何对抗过量盐的影响

paras.en: The research centers on prostaglandins (PGs), signaling molecules made from a fatty acid called arachidonic acid (AA). These substances act much like local hormones, helping regulate essential functions throughout the body.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是前列腺素（PG），这是一种由花生四烯酸（AA）脂肪酸制成的信号分子。这些物质的作用很像局部激素，有助于调节整个身体的基本功能。

paras.en: In the cardiovascular system, prostaglandins help control blood pressure by balancing the widening and narrowing of blood vessels. Their effects in the brain are more complicated. Depending on which receptors they activate, they can trigger signals that either protect nerve cells or contribute to harmful processes, potentially affecting memory, thinking, and emotional responses.
paras.zh: 在心血管系统中，前列腺素通过平衡血管的扩张和狭窄来帮助控制血压。它们对大脑的影响更为复杂。根据它们激活的受体，它们可以触发保护神经细胞或促进有害过程的信号，从而可能影响记忆、思维和情绪反应。

paras.en: LPC70 is a form of soy lysolecithin in which lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) accounts for more than 70% of the phospholipids. Although earlier experiments showed that LPC70 could ease salt-related hypertension and cognitive difficulties, scientists had not fully understood the mechanisms responsible, particularly its influence on prostaglandin signaling.
paras.zh: LPC70 是大豆溶血卵磷脂的一种形式，其中溶血磷脂酰胆碱 (LPC) 占磷脂的 70% 以上。尽管早期的实验表明 LPC70 可以缓解与盐相关的高血压和认知困难，但科学家们尚未完全了解其机制，特别是它对前列腺素信号传导的影响。

paras.en: To investigate, a research team led by Professor Akihiro Mouri and Dr. Hisayoshi Kubota, working with Dr. Kazuhiro Kagotani, examined how LPC70 affected these signaling pathways in mice consuming a high-salt diet.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，由 Akihiro Mouri 教授和 Hisayoshi Kubota 博士领导的研究小组与 Kazuhiro Kagotani 博士合作，研究了 LPC70 如何影响高盐饮食小鼠的这些信号通路。

paras.en: Dr. Kubota, the study's first author, played a central role in the experiments. He assessed blood pressure, monitored behavioral changes, and analyzed molecular activity associated with prostaglandins. His work helped clarify how LPC70 produces different effects in the organs involved in salt-related cardiovascular and cognitive problems.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者久保田博士在实验中发挥了核心作用。他评估了血压，监测了行为变化，并分析了与前列腺素相关的分子活性。他的工作有助于阐明 LPC70 如何对涉及盐相关心血管和认知问题的器官产生不同的影响。

paras.en: Prof. Mouri and Dr. Kubota are affiliated with the Department of Regulatory Science for Evaluation and Development of Pharmaceuticals & Devices at Fujita Health University Graduate School of Medical Science, as well as the International Center for Brain Science (ICBS) at Fujita Health University in Japan. Dr. Kagotani is affiliated with Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd, in Japan and the Tsuji Health and Beauty Science Laboratory at Mie University, Japan.
paras.zh: Mouri 教授和 Kubota 博士隶属于藤田保健大学医学研究生院药品与器械评估和开发监管科学系以及日本藤田保健大学国际脑科学中心 (ICBS)。 Kagotani 博士隶属于日本辻制油有限公司和日本三重大学辻健康与美容科学实验室。

paras.en: The findings were released online on May 14, 2026, and published in Volume 197 of Neurochemistry International on July 1, 2026.
paras.zh: 研究结果于2026年5月14日在线发布，并于2026年7月1日发表在《神经化学国际》第197卷上。

paras.en: "We wanted to understand the role of LPC70 in coordinating changes in PG signaling across organ systems," mentioned Prof. Mouri. "Our study originated from a collaborative research project with Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd, a company that develops naturally derived food ingredients," he added.
paras.zh: “我们想了解 LPC70 在协调跨器官系统 PG 信号传导变化中的作用，”Mouri 教授说道。 “我们的研究源于与辻油磨株式会社的合作研究项目，这是一家开发天然食品成分的公司，”他补充道。

paras.en: Soy Compound Improves Blood Pressure and Memory in Mice
paras.zh: 大豆化合物可改善小鼠的血压和记忆力

paras.en: As expected, mice that consumed a high-salt diet developed elevated blood pressure. However, the consequences extended beyond their cardiovascular health.
paras.zh: 正如预期的那样，食用高盐饮食的小鼠血压升高。然而，其后果超出了心血管健康的范围。

paras.en: The animals also became less socially interactive and had difficulty recognizing objects they had encountered before, indicating problems with memory. Interestingly, their general movement and anxiety-like behavior showed no substantial changes. This pattern suggests that excessive salt selectively disrupted more complex cognitive and social functions rather than causing widespread behavioral impairment.
paras.zh: 这些动物的社交互动也变得更少，并且难以识别它们以前遇到过的物体，这表明它们存在记忆问题。有趣的是，他们的一般运动和焦虑样行为没有表现出实质性变化。这种模式表明，过量的盐选择性地破坏了更复杂的认知和社会功能，而不是造成广泛的行为障碍。

paras.en: When researchers supplemented the animals' diets with LPC70, several of these effects were reduced. Blood pressure improved, and the mice performed better on tests of social interaction and object recognition memory.
paras.zh: 当研究人员在动物的饮食中添加 LPC70 时，其中一些影响会减弱。血压有所改善，小鼠在社交互动和物体识别记忆测试中表现更好。

paras.en: These improvements prompted the researchers to examine what was happening inside the animals' kidneys and brains.
paras.zh: 这些改进促使研究人员检查动物肾脏和大脑内部发生的情况。

paras.en: Different Protective Effects in the Kidneys and Brain
paras.zh: 对肾脏和大脑的不同保护作用

paras.en: In the kidneys, a high-salt diet increased the expression of two components involved in prostaglandin signaling: cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and the PGE2 receptor EP3. Both may contribute to the development of high blood pressure associated with excessive salt consumption.
paras.zh: 在肾脏中，高盐饮食增加了参与前列腺素信号转导的两种成分的表达：环氧合酶-2 (COX-2) 和 PGE2 受体 EP3。两者都可能导致与过量食盐相关的高血压的发生。

paras.en: LPC70 reduced these salt-related increases, suggesting that the compound helps correct changes in kidney signaling that can interfere with normal blood pressure regulation.
paras.zh: LPC70 减少了这些与盐相关的增加，表明该化合物有助于纠正可能干扰正常血压调节的肾脏信号传导的变化。

paras.en: The researchers found a different response in the prefrontal cortex, a brain region essential for thinking, memory, and social behavior.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现前额叶皮层有不同的反应，前额叶皮层是思考、记忆和社会行为所必需的大脑区域。

paras.en: Excess salt reduced the expression of the PGD2 receptor DP1, which plays a role in protective and anti-inflammatory signaling in the brain. LPC70 restored expression of this receptor without changing DP2, another receptor associated with potentially harmful effects on nerve cells.
paras.zh: 过量的盐会降低 PGD2 受体 DP1 的表达，该受体在大脑中的保护和抗炎信号传导中发挥作用。 LPC70 在不改变 DP2 的情况下恢复了该受体的表达，DP2 是另一种与神经细胞潜在有害影响相关的受体。

paras.en: This distinction is important because it suggests that LPC70 does not simply increase or suppress all prostaglandin activity. Instead, it may selectively favor signaling pathways that help protect the brain, potentially explaining the improvements in memory and social behavior observed in the mice.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为它表明 LPC70 不仅仅增加或抑制所有前列腺素活性。相反，它可能选择性地支持有助于保护大脑的信号通路，这可能解释了在小鼠中观察到的记忆力和社会行为的改善。

paras.en: A Surprising Change in Chemical Signaling
paras.zh: 化学信号的惊人变化

paras.en: The team also discovered an unexpected change involving arachidonic acid, the fatty acid the body uses to produce prostaglandins.
paras.zh: 研究小组还发现了与花生四烯酸有关的意外变化，花生四烯酸是人体用来产生前列腺素的脂肪酸。

paras.en: Mice consuming excess salt had lower levels of circulating arachidonic acid. Yet when they received LPC70, levels of prostaglandins derived from this fatty acid, including PGE2 and PGD2, increased.
paras.zh: 摄入过量盐的小鼠循环花生四烯酸水平较低。然而，当他们接受 LPC70 时，源自这种脂肪酸的前列腺素（包括 PGE2 和 PGD2）的水平增加。

paras.en: This seemingly contradictory result suggests that LPC70 may help the body use available arachidonic acid more efficiently to produce prostaglandins under high-salt conditions.
paras.zh: 这一看似矛盾的结果表明，LPC70 可能有助于身体在高盐条件下更有效地利用可用的花生四烯酸来产生前列腺素。

paras.en: Taken together, the findings reveal a coordinated but highly selective response. In the kidneys, LPC70 appears to suppress signaling changes associated with hypertension. In the brain, it restores signaling linked to protection against inflammation and damage.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这些发现揭示了一种协调但高度选择性的反应。在肾脏中，LPC70 似乎可以抑制与高血压相关的信号传导变化。在大脑中，它恢复与防止炎症和损伤相关的信号传导。

paras.en: The compound's effects therefore depend on both the organ involved and the specific prostaglandin receptors being regulated.
paras.zh: 因此，该化合物的作用取决于所涉及的器官和所调节的特定前列腺素受体。

paras.en: Could Soy-Based Ingredients Help Protect Against Excess Salt?
paras.zh: 大豆成分可以帮助防止过量的盐吗？

paras.en: The results suggest that LPC70 could eventually become a useful functional food ingredient for reducing some of the health consequences of excessive salt intake.
paras.zh: 结果表明，LPC70 最终可能成为一种有用的功能性食品成分，用于减少过量盐摄入对健康的一些影响。

paras.en: Its ability to improve blood pressure and cognitive performance in mice raises the possibility that it could support cardiovascular and brain health, particularly among people whose diets contain high amounts of salt.
paras.zh: 它改善小鼠血压和认知能力的能力增加了它支持心血管和大脑健康的可能性，特别是对于饮食中含有大量盐的人来说。

paras.en: However, the findings come from animal experiments, and further clinical studies are needed to determine whether the same benefits occur in humans.
paras.zh: 然而，这些发现来自动物实验，还需要进一步的临床研究来确定是否对人类也有同样的好处。

paras.en: "Our study elucidates LPC70's role in PG signaling, laying the groundwork for future clinical research and dietary interventions aimed at reducing hypertension-related cognitive decline and promoting healthy aging globally," concluded Prof. Mouri.
paras.zh: Mouri 教授总结道：“我们的研究阐明了 LPC70 在 PG 信号传导中的作用，为未来的临床研究和饮食干预奠定了基础，旨在减少高血压相关的认知能力下降并促进全球健康老龄化。”

paras.en: The research provides a clearer picture of how a soy-derived compound can influence the body's response to excessive salt, opening new possibilities for nutritional approaches to protecting long-term health.
paras.zh: 该研究更清楚地揭示了大豆衍生化合物如何影响身体对过量盐的反应，为保护长期健康的营养方法开辟了新的可能性。

paras.en: The study received support through Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS: 20K07931, 22K07606, 22K11891, and 23H02843).
paras.zh: 该研究得到了日本学术振兴会科学研究补助金的支持（JSPS：20K07931、22K07606、22K11891 和 23H02843）。

paras.en: Additional support came from the Fujita Mind-Brain Research & Innovation Center for Drug Generation (Fujita Mind-BRIDGe) through Japan's Peak Research Universities (J-PEAKS) Program (JPJS00420240019), along with the Japan Science and Technology Agency FOREST Program (JPMJFR215H).
paras.zh: 藤田药物生成心脑研究与创新中心 (Fujita Mind-BRIDGe) 通过日本顶尖研究大学 (J-PEAKS) 计划 (JPJS00420240019) 以及日本科学技术振兴机构森林计划 (JPMJFR215H) 提供了额外的支持。

paras.en: Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd. provided funding for the research. Grants and other support were also supplied by the Education and Research Facility of Animal Models for Human Diseases at Fujita Health University, the Smoking Research Foundation, and the Takeda Science Foundation.
paras.zh: 辻制油株式会社为这项研究提供了资金。藤田保健大学人类疾病动物模型教育和研究机构、吸烟研究基金会和武田科学基金会也提供了赠款和其他支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by Fujita Health University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由藤田保健大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Hisayoshi Kubota, Kazuo Kunisawa, Masaya Hasegawa, Hitomi Kurahashi, Kazuhiro Kagotani, Kazuki Nakajima, Yuki Fujimoto, Akihito Hayashi, Ryoji Sono, Takehiko Tsuji, Kuniaki Saito, Toshitaka Nabeshima, Akihiro Mouri. Soy lysolecithin attenuates hypertension and behavioral impairments in mice fed a high-salt diet through receptor-specific regulation of prostaglandin signaling and arachidonic acid-derived prostaglandin production. Neurochemistry International, 2026; 197: 106184 DOI: 10.1016/j.neuint.2026.106184
paras.zh: - 久保田久义、国泽一夫、长谷川雅也、仓桥仁美、鹿谷一宏、中岛一树、藤本佑纪、林明仁、园野亮司、辻雄彦、斋藤国明、锅岛俊孝、毛利明宏。大豆溶血卵磷脂通过受体特异性调节前列腺素信号传导和花生四烯酸衍生的前列腺素产生，减轻高盐饮食小鼠的高血压和行为障碍。国际神经化学，2026； 197: 106184 DOI: 10.1016/j.neuint.2026.106184

articles.title: Astronomers want your help finding 'missing' black holes in the Milky Way
articles.author: Sharmila Kuthunur

paras.en: Astronomers estimate that our home galaxy, the Milky Way, has churned out more than 10 million black holes over its 13-billion-year history. Yet so far, they have found only 70.
paras.zh: 天文学家估计，我们的家乡银河系在其 130 亿年的历史中已经产生了超过 1000 万个黑洞。但到目前为止，他们只发现了 70 个。

paras.en: Now, a group of astronomers in the U.K. is trying to close that vast gap by enlisting the public. Their project, called Black Hole Hunters, is looking for volunteers with a computer and a few spare minutes to sift through troves of data gathered by a NASA space telescope. By flagging recognizable patterns that could point to a "missing" black hole, volunteers can help fast-track a search that would otherwise take years, the team says.
paras.zh: 现在，英国的一群天文学家正试图通过招募公众来缩小这一巨大差距。他们的项目名为“黑洞猎人”，正在寻找拥有计算机和几分钟空闲时间的志愿者来筛选美国宇航局太空望远镜收集的大量数据。研究小组表示，通过标记可能指向“失踪”黑洞的可识别模式，志愿者可以帮助快速进行搜索，否则可能需要数年时间。

paras.en: "You'll be narrowing down precisely where we need to point our telescopes next," project co-lead Adam McMaster, an astronomer at the University of Southampton in the U.K., said in a statement, "and you might be the one to discover a black hole."
paras.zh: 项目联合负责人、英国南安普顿大学天文学家亚当·麦克马斯特在一份声明中表示：“你将精确地缩小我们接下来需要将望远镜瞄准的位置，而你可能就是那个发现黑洞的人。”

paras.en: Black holes form when massive stars roughly 20 times heavier than our sun run out of fuel and collapse, leaving behind an abyss with gravity so immense that even light cannot escape. While invisible themselves, these cosmic behemoths reveal their presence by bending the light of nearby objects, and the Black Hole Hunters project is searching for one specific manifestation of this effect.
paras.zh: 当比太阳重大约 20 倍的大质量恒星耗​​尽燃料并坍塌时，黑洞就会形成，留下一个引力巨大的深渊，甚至连光也无法逃脱。虽然这些宇宙庞然大物本身是隐形的，但它们通过弯曲附近物体的光线来揭示它们的存在，黑洞猎人项目正在寻找这种效应的一种具体表现。

paras.en: It happens thanks to the fact that massive stars often form in pairs, and a star can sometimes survive the violent supernova explosion that turns its companion into a black hole. When that happens, the two bodies continue to orbit each other. If such a duo aligns just right with Earth, the black hole will periodically pass directly between its companion star and our planet. And when it does, the black hole's gravity acts like a cosmic magnifying glass, bending and magnifying the star's light, causing it to briefly appear brighter to watchful telescopes.
paras.zh: 这种情况的发生要归功于大质量恒星通常成对形成，并且恒星有时能够在猛烈的超新星爆炸中幸存下来，将其伴星变成黑洞。当这种情况发生时，两个物体继续绕彼此运行。如果这样的二重奏与地球恰好对齐，那么黑洞将定期直接从其伴星和我们的星球之间经过。当它发生时，黑洞的引力就像一个宇宙放大镜，弯曲和放大恒星的光线，使其在观察望远镜中短暂地显得更亮。

paras.en: To find these hidden giants, the project relies on data from NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite, or TESS. Although the satellite's primary mission is to hunt for planets beyond our solar system, its method of data collection — tracking tiny, continuous changes in a star's brightness over time — is ideally suited for identifying black hole magnification events, the project description notes.
paras.zh: 为了找到这些隐藏的巨人，该项目依赖于美国宇航局凌日系外行星勘测卫星（TESS）的数据。项目描述指出，尽管这颗卫星的主要任务是寻找太阳系以外的行星，但其数据收集方法——跟踪恒星亮度随时间的微小、连续变化——非常适合识别黑洞放大事件。

paras.en: "It's a simple task with no expertise required," McMaster said in the statement. "We will show volunteers examples of what to look for so all they have to do is recognise the right patterns."
paras.zh: 麦克马斯特在声明中说：“这是一项简单的任务，不需要专业知识。” “我们将向志愿者展示要寻找什么的示例，这样他们所要做的就是识别正确的模式。”

paras.en: Automated algorithms conduct a preliminary sweep of the TESS data, screening millions of potential stars for the most obvious black hole candidate locations, according to the project description. But, the researchers say, artificial intelligence struggles with the messy realities of the cosmos, such as stellar flares and the natural pulsations of stars that can trick the algorithms into false positives.
paras.zh: 根据项目描述，自动化算法对 TESS 数据进行初步扫描，筛选数百万颗潜在恒星，寻找最明显的黑洞候选位置。但是，研究人员表示，人工智能与宇宙的混乱现实作斗争，例如恒星耀斑和恒星的自然脉动，这些可能会欺骗算法产生误报。

paras.en: That makes human volunteers a key part of the search. To keep errors in check, each graph is shown to multiple volunteers, and their answers are combined so that individual mistakes average out, according to the project's website.
paras.zh: 这使得人类志愿者成为搜索的关键部分。据该项目的网站称，为了控制错误，每个图表都会向多名志愿者展示，并将他们的答案合并起来，以便平均个别错误。

paras.en: "I can search for black holes on my laptop from my bedroom — and could make a real impact on real space science," Grace Clarke, an undergraduate student of physics and astronomy at the University of Southampton who's involved with the project, said in the same statement. "The data's easy to understand — it's just pattern recognition — and you don't need a degree in astronomy to read it."
paras.zh: 参与该项目的南安普顿大学物理和天文学本科生格蕾丝·克拉克在同一份声明中表示：“我可以在卧室里用笔记本电脑搜索黑洞，这可能会对真正的空间科学产生真正的影响。” “这些数据很容易理解——这只是模式识别——而且你不需要天文学学位来阅读它。”

paras.en: The crowdsourced shortlist of promising signals lets astronomers aim follow-up observations at specific stars, such as precise measurements of whether a star is being tugged at by an unseen companion. Those measurements take time and are expensive, so a good shortlist helps researchers spend scarce telescope time wisely, the team says.
paras.zh: 众包的有希望信号的候选名单让天文学家可以针对特定恒星进行后续观测，例如精确测量恒星是否被看不见的伴星牵引。研究小组表示，这些测量需要时间且成本高昂，因此一份好的候选名单可以帮助研究人员明智地利用有限的望远镜时间。

paras.en: Since launching on the Zooniverse platform in October 2021, the project has attracted nearly 23,000 volunteers, who have completed more than 12 million classifications, according to its website.
paras.zh: 据其网站称，自 2021 年 10 月在 Zooniverse 平台上线以来，该项目已吸引了近 23,000 名志愿者，已完成超过 1200 万个分类。

paras.en: Before turning to TESS, the team ran a similar search using data from SuperWASP, a ground-based survey that, like TESS, monitored stars for signs of planets from 2004 to 2016. Those results are still being analyzed and are expected to be published soon.
paras.zh: 在转向 TESS 之前，该团队使用 SuperWASP 的数据进行了类似的搜索，SuperWASP 是一项地面调查，与 TESS 一样，从 2004 年到 2016 年监测恒星是否有行星迹象。这些结果仍在分析中，预计很快就会发布。

paras.en: The team also plans to widen its search with observations from other instruments, including the European Space Agency's Euclid mission and NASA's recently launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 该团队还计划利用其他仪器的观测来扩大搜索范围，包括欧洲航天局的欧几里得任务和美国宇航局最近发射的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。

paras.en: "With potentially thousands of new discoveries, we need all the help we can get," McMaster said in the statement.
paras.zh: 麦克马斯特在声明中说：“可能有数千个新发现，我们需要尽可能获得的所有帮助。”

paras.en: Sharmila Kuthunur is an independent space journalist based in Bengaluru, India. Her work has also appeared in Scientific American, Science, Astronomy and Live Science, among other publications. She holds a master's degree in journalism from Northeastern University in Boston.
paras.zh: Sharmila Kuthunur 是一位驻印度班加罗尔的独立太空记者。她的作品还发表在《科学美国人》、《科学》、《天文学》和《生活科学》等出版物上。她拥有波士顿东北大学新闻学硕士学位。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 18, 1963: France's Félicette Becomes the 1st Cat in Space! >^..^<
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 18, 1963, a cat went to space! Félicette was a French "catstronaut" who became the first and only feline to fly to space.
paras.zh: 1963年10月18日，一只猫进入了太空！菲利塞特是一位法国“猫宇航员”，她成为第一只也是唯一一只飞向太空的猫科动物。

paras.en: While the U.S. and Soviet Union were busy launching primates, dogs and humans, the French decided to join the space race by launching a cat. Félicette, a stray tuxedo cat from the streets of Paris, was a substitute for another cat named Felix, who somehow escaped on launch day.
paras.zh: 当美国和苏联忙着发射灵长类动物、狗和人类时，法国人决定加入太空竞赛，发射一只猫。菲利塞特是一只来自巴黎街头的流浪猫，它是另一只名叫菲利克斯的猫的替代品，菲利克斯在发布当天不知何故逃脱了。

paras.en: So Félicette went where no cat had ever gone before. She boarded a French Véronique AG1 rocket and soared 130 miles above the Earth before safely parachuting back down.
paras.zh: 于是菲丽塞特去了以前没有猫去过的地方。她登上法国 Véronique AG1 火箭，翱翔在距地球 130 英里的高空，然后安全跳伞返回。

paras.en: Luckily Félicette made it home alive and well, unlike many of the other animal astronauts that flew during the space race.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，与太空竞赛期间飞行的许多其他动物宇航员不同，菲利塞特安然无恙地安全回家。

paras.en: Félicette survived spaceflight, but was short of this world. She was euthanized two months after her recovery so scientists could study her brain.
paras.zh: 菲丽塞特在太空飞行中幸存下来，但却缺少这个世界。她康复两个月后被安乐死，以便科学家研究她的大脑。

paras.en: A second cat was launched by the French on Oct. 24, but its flight did not go so well, veering off course. When the cat was found a day later, it was discovered it have died as a result of the journey. From there on, CERMA (Centre d'Enseignement et de Recherches de Médecine Aéronautique) changed its research to flying monkeys.
paras.zh: 10 月 24 日，法国发射了第二只猫，但它的飞行并不顺利，偏离了航线。一天后，当这只猫被发现时，人们发现它已经在旅途中死亡了。从那时起，CERMA（航空医学研究中心）将其研究转向了会飞的猴子。

paras.en: Félicette may have become a footnote to history had it not been for a crowdfunded effort to raise a statue in her memory nearly 60 years later. The sculpture was unveiled in 2019 at the International Space University in Strasbourg, France. European astronauts Helen Sharman, Paolo Nespoli and Reinhold Ewald were on hand for its reveal.
paras.zh: 如果不是近 60 年后众筹活动为纪念菲丽塞特竖立了一座雕像，菲丽塞特可能已经成为历史的一个脚注。该雕塑于 2019 年在法国斯特拉斯堡国际太空大学揭幕。欧洲宇航员海伦·沙曼、保罗·内斯波利和莱因霍尔德·埃瓦尔德出席了揭幕仪式。

paras.en: To this day, Félicette and her less-fortunate astro-cat classmate remain the only felines to fly on a rocket.
paras.zh: 直到今天，菲利塞特和她不幸的太空猫同学仍然是唯一乘坐火箭飞行的猫科动物。

paras.en: In 2013, reports surfaced that Iran was planning to send a cat into space as soon as the following year. By all accounts, though, that never happened.
paras.zh: 2013年，有报道称伊朗计划最快在次年将一只猫送入太空。但从各方面来看，这从未发生过。

paras.en: In addition to the memorial statue, Félicette has been memorialized on postage stamps issued by Chad and Comoros, both former French colonies.
paras.zh: 除了纪念雕像外，前法国殖民地乍得和科摩罗还发行了纪念费利塞特的邮票。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Computer scientist Margaret Hamilton was a problem-solver for the ages (op-ed)
articles.author: Dean Robbins

paras.en: Dean Robbins is a journalist and children's author. He contributed this article to Space.com's Expert Voices: Op-Ed & Insights.
paras.zh: 迪恩·罗宾斯是一名记者和儿童作家。他将这篇文章贡献给了 Space.com 的专家之声：专栏与见解。

paras.en: The pioneering computer scientist Margaret Hamilton, who died on Sept. 30 at age 90, played a key role in putting astronauts on the moon. She was a problem-solver extraordinaire, and it all started in early childhood.
paras.zh: 计算机科学家先驱玛格丽特·汉密尔顿 (Margaret Hamilton) 于 9 月 30 日去世，享年 90 岁，她在将宇航员送上月球的过程中发挥了关键作用。她是一位非凡的问题解决者，这一切都始于童年时期。

paras.en: Considering the name "daddy longlegs" unfair to female arachnids, young Margaret decided to call half of them "mommy longlegs." Wondering why the neighborhood baseball players were all boys, she determined to join the team herself.
paras.zh: 考虑到“长腿爸爸”这个名字对雌性蜘蛛纲动物不公平，年轻的玛格丽特决定称其中一半为“长腿妈妈”。她想知道为什么附近的棒球运动员都是男孩，她决定自己加入球队。

paras.en: As she grew up in the 1940s and '50s, Margaret noticed a similar problem with various professions. Why were doctors, judges and scientists almost always men? The solution: she would study hard in school and prepare herself for any job she might care to do.
paras.zh: 随着 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代的成长，玛格丽特注意到各种职业都存在类似的问题。为什么医生、法官和科学家几乎都是男性？解决方案：她会在学校努力学习，为自己想做的任何工作做好准备。

paras.en: It's no surprise that a born problem-solver would gravitate to computers. In the late 1950s, the new technology offered mind-bending possibilities, and this college math major saw a chance to put her skills to use on a cosmic scale.
paras.zh: 天生的问题解决者会被计算机所吸引，这并不奇怪。 20 世纪 50 年代末，新技术提供了令人费解的可能性，这位大学数学专业的学生看到了将自己的技能运用到宇宙范围内的机会。

paras.en: Hamilton had long been a stargazer, thanks to a philosophical father who taught her to love the night sky. In 1965, after stints in meteorology and satellite tracking, she became interested in a Massachusetts Institute of Technology project that designed in-flight computers for NASA's moon mission.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿长期以来一直是一位观星者，这要归功于一位哲学父亲教会她热爱夜空。 1965 年，在从事气象学和卫星跟踪工作后，她对麻省理工学院的一个项目产生了兴趣，该项目为 NASA 的月球任务设计飞行计算机。

paras.en: The team, of course, consisted solely of men. But, just as with her neighborhood baseball team, Hamilton refused to accept limitations for herself or anybody else. She kicked open the door and quickly rose to director of software engineering.
paras.zh: 当然，这个团队完全由男性组成。但是，就像她附近的棒球队一样，汉密尔顿拒绝接受对自己或其他任何人的限制。她踢开了大门，很快就晋升为软件工程总监。

paras.en: With her knack for devising novel solutions to seemingly insoluble problems, no one was better suited for the job. Working with the era's primitive technology, Margaret thought through the various mishaps that could occur on a spaceflight and designed the software to handle every contingency.
paras.zh: 凭借她为看似无法解决的问题设计新颖解决方案的能力，没有人比她更适合这份工作。玛格丽特利用那个时代的原始技术，思考了太空飞行中可能发生的各种事故，并设计了软件来处理每一种意外情况。

paras.en: The epochal Apollo 11 moon mission of 1969 put her planning to the test. As astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin neared the moon's surface in their lunar module, an error overloaded the onboard computer's processing unit. Mission Control faced the prospect of aborting the landing, but Margaret's ingenious programming allowed the system to prioritize essential tasks while canceling the inessential ones. The lunar module touched down without a hitch, and Armstrong and Aldrin became famous.
paras.zh: 1969 年具有划时代意义的阿波罗 11 号登月任务对她的计划进行了考验。当宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗和巴兹·奥尔德林乘坐登月舱接近月球表面时，一个错误导致机载计算机的处理单元超载。任务控制中心面临着中止着陆的前景，但玛格丽特巧妙的编程使系统能够优先考虑重要任务，同时取消不重要的任务。登月舱顺利着陆，阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林名声大噪。

paras.en: Sadly, Margaret Hamilton did not. She continued to work behind the scenes, contributing to the five additional lunar landings as well as Skylab and the space shuttle. In 1976, she struck off on her own to start a software company. She might have lived the rest of her life in obscurity if not for a fateful black-and-white photograph from 1969.
paras.zh: 可悲的是，玛格丽特·汉密尔顿没有。她继续在幕后工作，为另外五次登月以及天空实验室和航天飞机做出了贡献。 1976年，她独自创业创办了一家软件公司。如果不是 1969 年一张决定命运的黑白照片，她可能会默默无闻地度过余生。

paras.en: This image began to attract attention on the internet in the 2010s. It showed Margaret wedged between a coatrack and a blackboard at MIT, standing beside a towering stack of her printed code from the Apollo missions. Bespectacled and smiling, she radiates the confidence of a scientist who had stormed the boys' club and conquered the universe.
paras.zh: 这张图片在 2010 年代开始在互联网上引起关注。照片中，玛格丽特挤在麻省理工学院的衣帽架和黑板之间，旁边站着一大堆她在阿波罗任务中打印出来的代码。她戴着眼镜，面带微笑，散发着科学家的自信，这位科学家曾闯入男孩俱乐部并征服了宇宙。

paras.en: I was one of those fascinated by the photograph, and I contacted Margaret about the possibility of profiling her in a children's book. She initially resisted, uncomfortable with being the center of attention. But she came to see the appeal of a book about herself that she could read to her great-grandchildren, so that they might be inspired to break barriers themselves one day. She warmed to the task of telling her life story and even sent me examples of her Apollo code, which Lucy Knisley incorporated in the illustrations for "Margaret and the Moon: How Margaret Hamilton Saved the First Lunar Landing."
paras.zh: 我是那些对这张照片着迷的人之一，我联系了玛格丽特，商量在一本儿童读物中描写她的可能性。她最初拒绝这样做，因为对成为关注的焦点感到不舒服。但她开始看到一本关于她自己的书的吸引力，她可以把这本书读给她的曾孙们听，这样他们有一天可能会受到启发，自己打破障碍。她热衷于讲述自己的人生故事，甚至给我发送了她的阿波罗代码示例，露西·尼斯利将其纳入了《玛格丽特与月球：玛格丽特·汉密尔顿如何拯救第一次登月》的插图中。

paras.en: With the 2016 book and movie "Hidden Figures" calling attention to women's overlooked contributions to the space program, Hamilton soon had to get used to being the center of attention. She received a Presidential Medal of Freedom and achieved LEGO immortality in the "Women of NASA" set. In 2019, to mark the 50th anniversary of the first moon landing, Google used reflected moonlight to create a massive portrait of Margaret in the Mojave Desert. Rarely has so humble a soul received so grand a tribute.
paras.zh: 随着 2016 年出版的书籍和电影《隐藏人物》呼吁人们关注女性对太空计划的被忽视的贡献，汉密尔顿很快就不得不习惯成为关注的焦点。她获得了总统自由勋章，并在“NASA 女性”套装中实现了乐高不朽。 2019 年，为了纪念首次登月 50 周年，谷歌利用反射月光在莫哈韦沙漠拍摄了玛格丽特的巨型肖像。如此卑微的灵魂很少受到如此盛大的致敬。

paras.en: The world will miss Margaret Hamilton, but, just like her great-grandchildren, we will always have her example to inspire us. She showed that, no matter how daunting the obstacles, there are few problems we can't solve.
paras.zh: 世界将会怀念玛格丽特·汉密尔顿，但是，就像她的曾孙一样，我们将永远有她的榜样来激励我们。她表明，无论障碍有多么艰巨，没有什么问题是我们解决不了的。

articles.title: Deposition Sciences, Inc. Expands Sunshade® Tape Offering with New 12″ × 30″ Format
articles.author: Deposition Sciences, Inc

paras.en: Santa Rosa, CA — October 2026 — Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI), a leader in advanced thin film coatings, proudly announces the introduction of a new 12″ × 30″ format for its Sunshade® Tape thermal control material. This expanded size provides engineers and designers with greater flexibility for integrating thermal protection into larger aerospace and industrial systems.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣罗莎 — 2026 年 10 月 — 先进薄膜涂层领域的领导者 Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI) 自豪地宣布为其 Sunshade® Tape 热控制材料推出新的 12" × 30" 格式。这种扩大的尺寸为工程师和设计人员提供了更大的灵活性，可以将热保护集成到更大的航空航天和工业系统中。

paras.en: Sunshade® Tape is engineered for solar reflectance, thermal stability, and durability in extreme environments. Its lightweight, flexible design reduces energy demands while safeguarding sensitive components from heat exposure. The new format ensures easier application across broader surfaces, enhancing mission reliability and equipment performance.
paras.zh: Sunshade® 胶带专为极端环境下的太阳反射率、热稳定性和耐用性而设计。其轻质、灵活的设计降低了能源需求，同时保护敏感部件免受热暴露。新格式确保更轻松地在更广泛的表面上应用，从而提高任务可靠性和设备性能。

paras.en: “Our customers asked for more versatility, and we delivered,” said Justin Mosier, Sr. Mgr Space Materials at DSI. “The new 12″ × 30″ format makes Sunshade® Tape even more adaptable to complex thermal control challenges.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户要求更多的多功能性，我们满足了，”DSI 空间材料高级经理 Justin Mosier 说道。 “新的 12 英寸 × 30 英寸规格使 Sunshade® 胶带更能适应复杂的热控制挑战。”

paras.en: For more information about Sunshade® Tape and its applications, visit Deposition Sciences, Inc. at https://www.depsci.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Sunshade® Tape 及其应用的更多信息，请访问 Deposition Sciences, Inc.，网址为 https://www.depsci.com。

articles.author: SpaceNews Editor
