Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. articles.title: What to Know about Static and Dynamic ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Choosing between static and dynamic ADAS calibration depends on the procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer. Regardless of the method, the vehicle and its surroundings must meet the manufacturer’s requirements.
paras.zh: 静态和动态 ADAS 校准之间的选择取决于车辆制造商指定的程序。无论采用哪种方法，车辆及其周围环境都必须满足制造商的要求。

paras.en: ADAS systems affected by a repair may need to be calibrated, relearned or re-zeroed. Terminology may vary, but the purpose is to establish an accurate reference point for the system.
paras.zh: 受维修影响的 ADAS 系统可能需要校准、重新学习或重新调零。术语可能有所不同，但目的是为系统建立准确的参考点。

paras.en: A static calibration is performed while the vehicle remains stationary.
paras.zh: 静态校准是在车辆保持静止时执行的。

paras.en: Technicians position targets at exact distances and heights. The targets must also be square to the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 技术人员将目标定位在精确的距离和高度。目标还必须与车辆中心线成直角。

paras.en: The vehicle must meet specified requirements for weight, ride height, tire pressure, fluid levels, lighting and background conditions.
paras.zh: 车辆必须满足重量、行驶高度、轮胎压力、液位、照明和背景条件的规定要求。

paras.en: Dynamic calibration takes place while driving. The technician places the system into calibration mode and drives the vehicle under specified conditions.
paras.zh: 动态校准在驾驶时进行。技术人员将系统置于校准模式并在指定条件下驾驶车辆。

paras.en: During the drive, the sensors verify that they can identify the roadway, recognize objects and align correctly with the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 在驾驶过程中，传感器验证它们是否可以识别道路、识别物体并与车辆中心线正确对齐。

paras.en: Extra weight, improper tire pressure, incorrect ride height or environmental interference can cause calibration to fail. These conditions can also establish an inaccurate reference.
paras.zh: 额外的重量、不正确的轮胎压力、不正确的行驶高度或环境干扰都可能导致校准失败。这些条件也可能建立不准确的参考。

paras.en: Whether the procedure is static or dynamic, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions exactly. ADAS calibration depends on precision, and even small inconsistencies can affect system performance.
paras.zh: 无论程序是静态还是动态，技术人员都必须严格遵循制造商的说明。 ADAS 校准取决于精度，即使很小的不一致也会影响系统性能。

articles.title: AkzoNobel and Axalta to Be Called Axanzo Following Merger
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems have announced Axanzo as the name of the combined company following completion of their intended merger.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得涂料系统公司宣布，在完成合并计划后，合并后的公司名称将更名为 Axanzo。

paras.en: The planned merger, announced in November 2025, will create a global coatings leader with the scale, strength and reach to accelerate sustainable growth and deliver breakthrough innovation. The envisaged post-closing NYSE and Euronext Amsterdam ticker symbol will be AXZ.
paras.zh: 这项计划于 2025 年 11 月宣布的合并将打造一家全球涂料领导者，其规模、实力和影响力足以加速可持续增长并提供突破性创新。预计收盘后纽约证券交易所和阿姆斯特丹泛欧交易所的股票代码将为 AXZ。

paras.en: “We’re excited to announce the new name for our combined company,” said Greg Poux-Guillaume, CEO of AkzoNobel who will also be CEO of the new organization. “Axanzo signals a bold new start for a company which will be stronger in every way. It’s a launchpad for going further and faster than we ever could alone, embodying the pace and power to innovate, the strength to deliver and the excellence to succeed.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔首席执行官格雷格·普吉约姆 (Greg Poux-Guillaume) 表示：“我们很高兴宣布合并后公司的新名称。”他也将担任新组织的首席执行官。 “Axanzo 标志着公司的一个大胆的新开始，它将在各方面变得更加强大。它是一个比我们独自走得更远、更快的发射台，体现了创新的步伐和力量、交付的力量以及成功的卓越能力。”

paras.en: Axalta CEO Chris Villavarayan, who will be deputy CEO of the combined company, added, “Axanzo will continuously reset the standard of what coatings can do. The new name perfectly captures our shared ambition to push boundaries, honoring our heritage and offering an exciting glimpse of what’s to come.”
paras.zh: 艾仕得首席执行官 Chris Villavarayan 将担任合并后公司的副首席执行官，他补充道：“Axanzo 将不断重新设定涂料的标准。新名称完美体现了我们突破界限、尊重我们的传统并令人兴奋地展望未来的共同雄心。”

paras.en: The subtle, but intentional, reference to the heritage of both companies unites both companies’ legacies to usher in a new era for the industry. The combined business will bring together a diversified and balanced portfolio of around 100 highly regarded and trusted brands across paints and coatings, spanning more than 160 countries.
paras.zh: 对两家公司传统的微妙但有意的提及将两家公司的传统结合起来，开创了行业的新时代。合并后的业务将汇集约 100 个备受推崇和信赖的油漆和涂料品牌的多元化、平衡的产品组合，覆盖 160 多个国家。

paras.en: “Axanzo will focus on delivering uncompromising performance to sharpen our competitive edge, while establishing a profitable and sustainable path forward as a world leader in coatings,” Poux-Guillaume said. “By forging our expertise, the best of each of us will become the standard for all of us.”
paras.zh: Poux-Guillaume 表示：“Axanzo 将专注于提供不妥协的性能，以增强我们的竞争优势，同时作为涂料领域的世界领导者建立一条盈利且可持续的前进道路。” “通过锻造我们的专业知识，我们每个人中最好的人将成为我们所有人的标准。”

paras.en: Both AkzoNobel and Axalta will continue to operate as independent companies until closing, which is expected in early 2027 once all regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions have been finalized. The announcement of the new name does not change how customers and partners currently work with either company. They will continue to be served by their existing teams and through the brands and relationships they know and trust.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得都将继续作为独立公司运营，直至交割，预计在所有监管部门批准和惯例交割条件最终确定后，将于 2027 年初完成交割。新名称的公布不会改变客户和合作伙伴目前与任何一家公司的合作方式。他们将继续由现有团队以及他们了解和信任的品牌和关系提供服务。

paras.en: Watch the Axanzo name reveal video here.
paras.zh: 在此观看 Axanzo 名字揭晓视频。

articles.title: NAIC seeks public comment on producer licensing handbook revisions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) working group has adopted revisions to the association’s State Licensing Handbook for insurance producers and has requested public comment.
paras.zh: 全国保险专员协会 (NAIC) 工作组已通过对该协会《保险生产商国家许可手册》的修订，并征求公众意见。

paras.en: The Producer Licensing Uniformity (D) Working Group adopted the revisions on Oct. 7. The Producer Licensing (D) Task Force will review all submitted comments and consider adopting the revised handbook at its Nov. 5 meeting.
paras.zh: 生产者许可一致性 (D) 工作组于 10 月 7 日通过了修订版。生产者许可 (D) 工作组将审查所有提交的意见，并考虑在 11 月 5 日的会议上通过修订后的手册。

paras.en: The revisions include several additions to the recommended best practices for insurance regulators on producer exam content and testing administration. These include establishing a state advisory committee made up of state insurance regulators and the industry to work with testing vendors annually to review examination form questions “for substantive and psychometric requirements.”
paras.zh: 这些修订包括对保险监管机构建议的生产者考试内容和测试管理最佳实践的一些补充。其中包括建立一个由州保险监管机构和行业组成的州咨询委员会，每年与测试供应商合作，审查考试形式的问题“是否符合实质性和心理测量要求”。

paras.en: The working group recommends states should work with testing vendors to approve and issue candidate information bulletins that “accurately describe the examinations and examination policies and procedures, and provide sufficient examination content outline and study references for the candidate to prepare for the examination.”
paras.zh: 工作组建议各州应与考试供应商合作批准和发布考生信息公告，“准确描述考试和考试政策和程序，并为考生准备考试提供充分的考试内容大纲和学习参考”。

paras.en: It’s also recommended that states set clear performance standards for test vendors and require accountability.
paras.zh: 还建议各州为测试供应商制定明确的绩效标准并要求问责。

paras.en: The new recommendations include making testing available at locations reasonably convenient to residents of all areas of the state, with registration available online or by phone and the ability for a candidate to schedule testing within two to five business days of registration, according to the proposed revised handbook. It also recommends that states administer exams through a secure test-center network that employs qualified test proctors.
paras.zh: 根据拟议的修订手册，新的建议包括在该州所有地区的居民相当方便的地点提供测试，可以在线或通过电话注册，并且候选人能够在注册后的两到五个工作日内安排测试。它还建议各州通过雇用合格考试监考人员的安全考试中心网络来管理考试。

paras.en: Another proposed addition to the handbook states that there isn’t a uniform approach nationwide on whether the surplus lines license (for residents and non-residents) is a separate license type or a line of authority on the producer license.
paras.zh: 手册中的另一项提议补充指出，对于剩余线许可证（针对居民和非居民）是单独的许可证类型还是生产者许可证的授权线，全国范围内没有统一的方法。

paras.en: “Regardless of the approach taken, a resident must hold a valid property/casualty producer license to qualify for the issuance of a surplus lines license,” the proposed addition states. “This underlying P&C license requirement is for both individuals and business entities.”
paras.zh: 拟议的补充规定：“无论采取何种方法，居民都必须持有有效的财产/伤亡生产者许可证，才有资格获得剩余额度许可证。” “这一基本的 P&C 许可证要求适用于个人和商业实体。”

paras.en: Proposed requirements for remote testing guidelines are included in the revisions as well.
paras.zh: 远程测试指南的拟议要求也包含在修订中。

paras.en: According to the revisions, remote testing offers the same support as in-person test sites but includes several guidelines for states to follow to ensure proper testing:
paras.zh: 根据修订，远程测试提供与现场测试站点相同的支持，但包括一些供各州遵循的准则，以确保正确的测试：

paras.en: - “Procedures for conducting a system check of the candidate’s computer and internet service are sufficient.
paras.zh: - “对候选人的计算机和互联网服务进行系统检查的程序就足够了。

paras.en: - “The installation of any necessary software to facilitate the delivery of the exam.
paras.zh: - “安装任何必要的软件以方便考试的进行。

paras.en: - “Conduct a comprehensive security check, including verifying the identity of the candidate.
paras.zh: - “进行全面的安全检查，包括验证候选人的身份。

paras.en: - “Candidates must be in a distraction-free environment, where they can complete the exam unassisted in a secure environment.
paras.zh: - “考生必须处于无干扰的环境中，可以在安全的环境中独立完成考试。

paras.en: - “Exams are continuously monitored by video and audio recording similar to in-person test sites, as well as AI-enhanced monitoring proctoring.
paras.zh: - “考试通过类似于现场考试现场的视频和音频记录以及人工智能增强监控监考进行持续监控。

paras.en: - “Exam hours should include evening and weekend hours.
paras.zh: - “考试时间应包括晚上和周末时间。

paras.en: - “Testing vendors should establish procedures that analyze post- exam data for patterns of suspicious activity.”
paras.zh: - “测试供应商应建立程序来分析考后数据以发现可疑活动模式。”

paras.en: The proposed changes also provide additional guidance on approval of continuing education instructors.
paras.zh: 拟议的变更还为继续教育教师的批准提供了额外的指导。

paras.en: Comments on the revisions and additions to the handbook will be accepted through Oct. 30. Written comments should be sent to Tim Mullen, NAIC staff support for the Producer Licensing (D) Task Force, at [email protected].
paras.zh: 有关手册修订和补充的意见将于 10 月 30 日之前接受。书面意见应发送至生产者许可 (D) 工作组的 NAIC 工作人员 Tim Mullen，电子邮件地址为 [email protected]。

paras.en: At the Nov. 5 meeting, the task force will also consider adopting proposed revisions to the NAIC Independent Adjuster Licensing Guideline, the 1033 written consent process template, and proposed 2027 task force charges.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 5 日的会议上，工作组还将考虑通过对 NAIC 独立理算师许可指南、1033 书面同意流程模板的拟议修订，以及拟议的 2027 年工作组收费。

paras.en: The agenda and materials for the meeting will be posted on the task force webpage.
paras.zh: 会议议程和材料将发布在工作组网页上。

articles.title: Rivian and Redwood expand partnership to repurpose EV batteries
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Rivian has expanded its partnership with energy technology company Redwood Materials to recycle production scrap and end-of-life EV batteries, according to a Rivian press release. Redwood will also provide stationary battery storage at its manufacturing plant in Normal, Illinois.
paras.zh: 据 Rivian 新闻稿称，Rivian 扩大了与能源技术公司 Redwood Materials 的合作关系，以回收生产废料和报废电动汽车电池。 Redwood 还将在其位于伊利诺伊州诺莫尔的制造工厂提供固定电池存储。

paras.en: Redwood collects Rivian EV battery packs through Rivian’s nationwide network of service centers when they are no longer suitable for in-vehicle use. Redwood then evaluates each battery pack for energy storage at Rivian’s manufacturing facilities or other locations, or for recycling. Redwood will now also recycle battery scrap generated at Rivian’s manufacturing operations.
paras.zh: 当 Rivian 电动汽车电池组不再适合在车内使用时，Redwood 将通过 Rivian 的全国服务中心网络收集这些电池组。然后，Redwood 评估每个电池组在 Rivian 制造工厂或其他地点的储能或回收利用情况。 Redwood 现在还将回收 Rivian 制造业务中产生的电池废料。

paras.en: Rivian says the partnership expansion builds on existing work, announced in April, that provides 10 megawatt-hours (MWh) of battery energy storage from repurposed Rivian battery packs at the automaker’s Illinois manufacturing plant.
paras.zh: Rivian 表示，此次合作伙伴关系扩展建立在 4 月份宣布的现有工作的基础上，该项目通过该汽车制造商伊利诺伊州制造工厂改造后的 Rivian 电池组提供 10 兆瓦时 (MWh) 的电池储能。

paras.en: “Giving Rivian battery packs a second life in stationary storage is a massive unlock for the energy transition,” said RJ Scaringe, Rivian founder and CEO, in the release. “By partnering with JB and the Redwood team, we’re turning retired EV batteries into a powerful tool to make the grid more reliable and lower energy costs for everyone.”
paras.zh: Rivian 创始人兼首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 在新闻稿中表示：“让 Rivian 电池组在固定存储中获得第二次生命，是能源转型的一次重大解锁。” “通过与 JB 和 Redwood 团队合作，我们正在将退役的电动汽车电池转变为强大的工具，使电网更加可靠，并降低每个人的能源成本。”

paras.en: JB Straubel, Redwood Materials founder and CEO, added that every Rivian battery pack can potentially provide domestic grid energy storage and critical materials.
paras.zh: Redwood Materials 创始人兼首席执行官 JB Straubel 补充说，每个 Rivian 电池组都有可能提供国内电网储能和关键材料。

paras.en: “Redwood’s unique ability to integrate and redeploy Rivian batteries with our technology is an opportunity to enable fast, flexible, and more cost-efficient energy storage,” he said. “As the demand and cost for energy keep rising, working with companies like Rivian is how we help meet these challenges.”
paras.zh: “Redwood 具有将 Rivian 电池与我们的技术集成和重新部署的独特能力，这是实现快速、灵活且更具成本效益的能源存储的机会，”他说。 “随着能源需求和成本不断上升，与 Rivian 这样的公司合作是我们帮助应对这些挑战的方式。”

paras.en: Energy storage applications with repurposed batteries can ease grid stress during periods of high electricity demand, improving grid reliability while reducing energy costs for users and the grid at large, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，采用重新利用电池的储能应用可以缓解电力需求高时期的电网压力，提高电网可靠性，同时降低用户和整个电网的能源成本。

paras.en: During periods of low demand or when low-cost renewable energy is most productive, the packs can store electricity for easy dispatch during periods of higher demand. When paired with EV battery packs from Rivian and others, the release states that Redwood’s proprietary technology architecture offers an integrated system that can respond intelligently to the needs of the facility it is serving.
paras.zh: 在需求低迷时期或低成本可再生能源最具生产力时，电池组可以储存电力，以便在需求较高时期轻松调度。该新闻稿称，当与 Rivian 等公司的电动汽车电池组配合使用时，Redwood 的专有技术架构提供了一个集成系统，可以智能地响应其所服务设施的需求。

paras.en: Then, when batteries are no longer useful in energy storage applications, or when manufacturing generates scrap, they can be recycled.
paras.zh: 然后，当电池不再用于储能应用时，或者当制造产生废料时，它们可以被回收。

paras.en: Redwood’s process can recycle and recover critical minerals, such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper, at rates exceeding 95%, encouraging circular, domestic supply chain development for battery materials in the U.S., according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，Redwood 的工艺可以回收和回收锂、镍、钴和铜等关键矿物，回收率超过 95%，从而鼓励美国电池材料循环国内供应链的发展。

paras.en: “This expanded partnership reflects a broader shift underway in how American manufacturers source power,” the release states. “As grid connections take years to secure and conventional infrastructure remains supply-constrained, companies increasingly need partners who can solve more than one piece of the problem — recovering materials, managing recycling, and deploying storage as a single system rather than separate vendors.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“这种扩大的合作伙伴关系反映了美国制造商获取电力的方式正在发生更广泛的转变。” “由于电网连接需要数年时间才能确保安全，而且传统基础设施仍然供应有限，企业越来越需要能够解决多个问题的合作伙伴——回收材料、管理回收以及将存储部署为单个系统而不是单独的供应商。”

paras.en: BMW and General Motors have also previously announced partnerships with Redwood. BMW’s was to recycle lithium-ion batteries, similar to recycling partnerships Redwood signed with Toyota, Ford, Volvo, and Volkswagen.
paras.zh: 宝马和通用汽车此前也宣布与 Redwood 建立合作伙伴关系。宝马的目标是回收锂离子电池，类似于红木与丰田、福特、沃尔沃和大众签署的回收合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: GM launched a program to accelerate the deployment of energy storage systems using new and second-life battery packs from the automaker’s EVs.
paras.zh: 通用汽车启动了一项计划，利用该汽车制造商电动汽车的新型电池组和二次电池组来加速储能系统的部署。

paras.en: Featured image: Rivian’s manufacturing operations at its Normal, Illinois plant.
paras.zh: 特色图片：Rivian 在伊利诺伊州诺莫尔工厂的制造业务。

articles.title: BMW N54 Cooling System Problems
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The BMW N54 is known for its smooth power delivery, nearly nonexistent turbo lag and robust forged internals. It’s also known to suffer from a few common issues, one of which is its electric water pump. That’s right, the water pump, the component that circulates coolant throughout the engine cooling circuit, is electric.
paras.zh: BMW N54 以其平稳的动力传输、几乎不存在的涡轮迟滞和坚固的锻造内部结构而闻名。众所周知，它还存在一些常见问题，其中之一就是电动水泵。没错，水泵是使冷却剂在整个发动机冷却回路中循环的部件，是电动的。

paras.en: The water pumps we’re discussing are used in a number of vehicles. This includes the 128i, 325i, 325xi, 330i, 330xi, 525i, 525xi, 528i, 528xi, 530i, 530xi, X3, X5, and Z4. Let’s take a closer look at this unique water pump, how to replace it efficiently and what other components should be replaced along with it.
paras.zh: 我们正在讨论的水泵用于许多车辆。其中包括 128i、325i、325xi、330i、330xi、525i、525xi、528i、528xi、530i、530xi、X3、X5 和 Z4。让我们仔细看看这个独特的水泵，如何有效地更换它，以及应该一起更换哪些其他组件。

paras.en: Electric water pumps are becoming more and more common on modern engines. Electric auxiliary water pumps have been around for a long time. Their job is to circulate warm coolant through the heater core or to circulate coolant throughout an additional cooling circuit, such as a water-to-air charge air cooler.
paras.zh: 电动水泵在现代发动机上变得越来越普遍。电动辅助水泵已经存在很长时间了。它们的工作是使温暖的冷却剂循环通过加热器核心或使冷却剂循环通过附加冷却回路，例如水-空气增压空气冷却器。

paras.en: Using an electric water pump instead of the more common belt- or chain-driven mechanical pump does offer a number of advantages to both automakers and customers. The speed of a mechanical pump is directly tied to engine RPM, so the pump is able to circulate coolant only at a given rate. But since there is no mechanical link between the engine and the electric water pump, it is able to circulate coolant at whatever rate is needed based on operating conditions.
paras.zh: 使用电动水泵代替更常见的皮带或链条驱动机械泵确实为汽车制造商和客户提供了许多优势。机械泵的速度与发动机转速直接相关，因此泵只能以给定的速率循环冷却液。但由于发动机和电动水泵之间没有机械连接，因此它能够根据运行条件以所需的任何速率循环冷却剂。

paras.en: The electric water pump on the N54 has a power output of 400W, and a maximum flow rate of 9,000 liters per hour. The motor power is electronically controlled by the control module inside the pump housing, and this module is connected via the communication BUS to the Digital Motor Electrics (DME), also known as the engine control unit or ECU. The DME uses the engine load, the operating mode and the data from the temperature sensors to calculate the required cooling output, then commands the electric pump according to the current operating conditions. The electric pump regulates its speed based on this command from the DME. Coolant flows through the motor inside the pump, providing cooling to both the motor and the electronic module.
paras.zh: N54 上的电动水泵输出功率为 400W，最大流量为每小时 9,000 升。电机功率由泵壳内的控制模块进行电子控制，该模块通过通信总线连接到数字电机电气系统 (DME)，也称为发动机控制单元或 ECU。 DME 使用发动机负载、运行模式和温度传感器的数据来计算所需的冷却输出，然后根据当前运行条件命令电动泵。电动泵根据 DME 的命令调节其速度。冷却剂流过泵内的电机，为电机和电子模块提供冷却。

paras.en: The electric water pump circulates coolant even after the engine has been shut off. Doing this can cool down the turbochargers and help to prolong their service life.
paras.zh: 即使在发动机关闭后，电动水泵也会循环冷却液。这样做可以冷却涡轮增压器并有助于延长其使用寿命。

paras.en: Electric water pumps on the N54 have been known to fail around 60,000-80,000 miles.
paras.zh: 据了解，N54 上的电动水泵在行驶 60,000-80,000 英里左右时会出现故障。

paras.en: When the DME detects an issue with the pump, or if it sees engine coolant temps rising, it will notify the driver through the instrument cluster. This may take the form of one of two different messages: “Engine Temp High – Drive Moderately” displayed in yellow, or “Engine Overheat – Stop” displayed in red. The vehicle may go into “limp mode” which limits the engine RPM and available gear selection in an effort to protect engine components from damage. The electric cooling fan will usually jump to its maximum speed. You may also find stored 2E81 and/or 2E82 trouble codes, which indicate a problem with the pump.
paras.zh: 当 DME 检测到泵出现问题，或者发现发动机冷却液温度上升时，它将通过仪表板通知驾驶员。这可能采用两种不同消息之一的形式：“发动机温度高 - 适度驾驶”显示为黄色，或“发动机过热 - 停止”显示为红色。车辆可能会进入“跛行模式”，限制发动机转速和可用档位选择，以保护发动机部件免受损坏。电动冷却风扇通常会跳至最大速度。您还可能会发现存储的 2E81 和/或 2E82 故障代码，这些代码表明泵存在问题。

paras.en: There are two other cooling system issues you should be on the lookout for whenever you’re inspecting or quoting a replacement to a customer: The coolant inlet pipe, and the “Mickey Mouse” hose.
paras.zh: 每当您检查或向客户报价更换件时，您还应该注意另外两个冷却系统问题：冷却液入口管和“米老鼠”软管。

paras.en: The coolant inlet pipe is an aluminum pipe with a rubber elbow on one end and an aluminum flange on the other end. The aluminum flange bolts up to the cylinder head between the turbochargers, and the rubber elbow connects to the water pump. The aluminum portion of this component should last for a long, long time, but the rubber elbow is prone to failing. This is largely due to the fact that it is mounted so close to the front turbocharger.
paras.zh: 冷却液入口管是一根铝管，一端有橡胶弯头，另一端有铝制法兰。铝制法兰用螺栓固定在涡轮增压器之间的气缸盖上，橡胶弯头连接到水泵。该部件的铝制部分应该可以使用很长很长的时间，但橡胶弯头很容易出现故障。这主要是因为它安装得非常靠近前涡轮增压器。

paras.en: The real issue for customers is that BMW offers only the entire assembly; the hose isn’t available from the dealer separately. The hose clamp on the water pump side is a standard worm-drive unit so it’s easy to remove, but the other clamp is proprietary and it’s extremely difficult to remove without cutting it off. Worst of all, the flanged end of the pipe is tucked between the turbochargers, behind a number of heat shields and the downpipes.
paras.zh: 对于客户来说，真正的问题是宝马只提供整个总成；该软管无法从经销商处单独购买。水泵侧的软管夹是标准的蜗杆驱动装置，因此很容易拆卸，但另一个夹子是专有的，在不切断它的情况下很难拆卸。最糟糕的是，管道的法兰端塞在涡轮增压器之间，在许多隔热罩和落水管后面。

paras.en: All in all, it’ll take 6.7+ hours to replace this pipe, which feels like a waste if the rubber elbow is the only part that really failed. Thankfully, Rein offers the hose by itself, and it should take only an hour to install.
paras.zh: 总而言之，更换这条管道需要 6.7 个多小时，如果橡胶弯头是唯一真正失效的部件，这感觉就像是浪费。值得庆幸的是，Rein 自己提供了软管，安装仅需一个小时。

paras.en: One of the many hoses which connects to the thermostat and water pump connects to the front of the engine just under the valve cover. This hose is commonly referred to as the “Mickey Mouse hose” due to the unique shape of the flange. This flange is made of plastic, and we all know how plastic parts can become brittle and crack after years of heat-cycling.
paras.zh: 连接恒温器和水泵的众多软管之一连接到发动机前部阀盖下方。由于法兰形状独特，这种软管通常被称为“米老鼠软管”。该法兰由塑料制成，我们都知道塑料部件经过多年的热循环后会变脆并破裂。

paras.en: Just like the coolant inlet pipe, this flange is available only from BMW with the hose attached. Rein came up with a solution in the form of a metal replacement connector which can be purchased with or without the hose attached.
paras.zh: 与冷却液入口管一样，该法兰仅由 BMW 提供并附有软管。 Rein 提出了一种金属替换连接器形式的解决方案，可以购买带有或不带有软管的连接器。

articles.title: BendPak Tire Changers, Wheel Balancers Earn Safety Certification
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Wheel balancers and tire changers from the Ranger Division of BendPak have earned ETL certification, the company announced. All current models meet applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the United States and Canada.
paras.zh: 该公司宣布，BendPak Ranger 部门的车轮平衡机和轮胎拆装机已获得 ETL 认证。所有当前型号均符合美国和加拿大适用的 UL 和 CSA 安全标准。

paras.en: Intertek Testing Services independently tested the equipment and validated its compliance with electrical, pneumatic and mechanical safety requirements. Intertek is a nationally recognized testing laboratory.
paras.zh: Intertek 测试服务独立测试了设备并验证其符合电气、气动和机械安全要求。 Intertek是国家认可的测试实验室。

paras.en: BendPak Completes 18-Month Certification Project
paras.zh: BendPak 完成为期 18 个月的认证项目

paras.en: The certification followed an 18-month BendPak project to overhaul critical internal components and safety systems. The company redesigned the equipment to meet applicable standards.
paras.zh: 该认证是在为期 18 个月的 BendPak 项目之后进行的，该项目旨在检修关键的内部组件和安全系统。该公司重新设计了设备以满足适用的标准。

paras.en: The project included upgrades to electrical architecture, structural components and mechanical and pneumatic systems.
paras.zh: 该项目包括电气架构、结构部件以及机械和气动系统的升级。

paras.en: The company redesigned or replaced components that did not meet the required criteria. BendPak also reconfigured systems and incorporated additional safeguards.
paras.zh: 该公司重新设计或更换了不符合要求标准的组件。 BendPak 还重新配置了系统并纳入了额外的防护措施。

paras.en: BendPak says it then subjected every modification to testing before the equipment could achieve certification.
paras.zh: BendPak 表示，在设备获得认证之前，它会对每项修改进行测试。

paras.en: The ETL mark on the product label identifies certified equipment.
paras.zh: 产品标签上的 ETL 标志标识经过认证的设备。

paras.en: Certification Covers Ranger Wheel Service Equipment
paras.zh: 认证涵盖 Ranger Wheel 服务设备

paras.en: Certified Ranger wheel service equipment includes:
paras.zh: 经过认证的 Ranger 车轮维修设备包括：

paras.en: - LS45DS Laser-Spot sonar wheel balancer
paras.zh: - LS45DS 激光点声纳车轮平衡仪

paras.en: - RB30T heavy-duty truck and passenger car wheel balancer
paras.zh: - RB30T重型卡车和客车车轮平衡机

paras.en: - R76ATR single-tower tilt-back tire changer
paras.zh: - R76ATR单塔后倾式轮胎拆装机

paras.en: - R980DP dual-assist swing-arm tire changer
paras.zh: - R980DP 双辅助摆臂式轮胎拆装机

paras.en: - R80EX dual-tower tilt-back tire changer
paras.zh: - R80EX双塔后倾式轮胎拆装机

articles.title: Turning ADAS Calibration into a Competitive Advantage
articles.author: Autel

paras.en: See how Zimbrick of Madison transformed its approach to ADAS calibration by bringing more of the process in-house. With three body shops, 16 automotive brands and a centralized glass and calibration center, Zimbrick partnered with National Calibration and Diagnostic Solutions (NCDS) and Autel to build a more controlled and scalable calibration workflow. The video explores how the right equipment, training and support can help collision repair facilities improve efficiency, documentation, repair quality and customer communication while keeping up with increasingly complex vehicle technology.
paras.zh: 了解 Zimbrick of Madison 如何通过将更多流程引入内部来改变其 ADAS 校准方法。 Zimbrick 拥有 3 个车身修理厂、16 个汽车品牌以及一个集中式玻璃和校准中心，与国家校准和诊断解决方案 (NCDS) 以及 Autel 合作，构建了更加受控和可扩展的校准工作流程。该视频探讨了正确的设备、培训和支持如何帮助碰撞修复机构提高效率、文档记录、维修质量和客户沟通，同时跟上日益复杂的车辆技术的步伐。

paras.en: - Bringing ADAS calibration in-house: Zimbrick reduced its reliance on outside vendors to gain greater control over scanning, calibration and the overall repair process.
paras.zh: - 将 ADAS 校准引入内部：Zimbrick 减少了对外部供应商的依赖，以更好地控制扫描、校准和整个维修过程。

paras.en: - Centralizing calibration services: A hub-and-spoke model allows three body shops to work with a centralized calibration center while maintaining consistent processes.
paras.zh: - 集中校准服务：中心辐射模型允许三个车身修理厂与集中校准中心合作，同时保持一致的流程。

paras.en: - Improving repair quality and accountability: In-house capabilities give Zimbrick greater visibility into technician training, OEM procedures, documentation and how calibrations are completed.
paras.zh: - 提高维修质量和问责制：内部能力使 Zimbrick 能够更好地了解技术人员培训、OEM 程序、文档以及如何完成校准。

paras.en: - Combining glass and calibration: Locating glass replacement and ADAS calibration together allows Zimbrick to complete more windshield installations and calibrations on the same day.
paras.zh: - 将玻璃和校准相结合：将玻璃更换和 ADAS 校准结合在一起，使 Zimbrick 能够在同一天完成更多挡风玻璃安装和校准。

paras.en: - Training the entire team: Education extends beyond technicians to estimators, helping staff better understand ADAS requirements and explain necessary procedures to customers.
paras.zh: - 培训整个团队：教育范围从技术人员延伸到估算人员，帮助员工更好地了解 ADAS 要求并向客户解释必要的程序。

paras.en: - Building customer confidence: Employees can explain why a calibration is required, what equipment is being used and how the procedure fits into a complete repair rather than simply presenting an additional charge.
paras.zh: - 建立客户信心：员工可以解释为什么需要校准、使用什么设备以及该程序如何适应完整的维修，而不是简单地收取额外费用。

paras.en: - Getting more from ADAS technology: Autel equipment provides diagnostic, calibration and documentation capabilities, while NCDS provides tooling recommendations, training, workflow guidance and ongoing technical support.
paras.zh: - 从 ADAS 技术中获得更多收益：Autel 设备提供诊断、校准和文档功能，而 NCDS 提供工具建议、培训、工作流程指导和持续的技术支持。

paras.en: - Creating a scalable operation: With approximately 400 repair orders moving through the operation each month, bringing scans and calibrations under Zimbrick’s control helps turn a necessary repair procedure into an opportunity for greater efficiency and additional in-house service.
paras.zh: - 创建可扩展的运营：每个月约有 400 个维修订单通过运营，将扫描和校准置于 Zimbrick 的控制之下有助于将必要的维修程序转变为提高效率和额外内部服务的机会。

articles.title: NAPA Academy Provides New Training Resources
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Running a successful parts store requires more than knowing which part fits which vehicle. It takes effective inventory management, dependable delivery service, employees who understand customers’ needs and a manager who can connect everyday decisions to the store’s financial performance.
paras.zh: 经营一家成功的零件店需要的不仅仅是知道哪个零件适合哪辆车。它需要有效的库存管理、可靠的送货服务、了解客户需求的员工以及能够将日常决策与商店财务业绩联系起来的经理。

paras.en: NAPA is giving independent store owners new resources to develop those capabilities through NAPA Academy, extending training developed for its company-owned stores to independent businesses. The program was introduced during the 2026 NAPA Store Owner and Field Sales Meeting, held Sept. 21-24 in Atlanta. The initial offering focuses on store managers, combining short online courses with a downloadable resource guide designed to help translate training into daily practice.
paras.zh: NAPA 正在为独立商店所有者提供新的资源，以通过 NAPA 学院发展这些能力，并将为其公司拥有的商店开发的培训扩展到独立企业。该计划是在 9 月 21 日至 24 日在亚特兰大举行的 2026 年 NAPA 商店业主和现场销售会议期间推出的。最初的产品主要针对商店经理，将简短的在线课程与可下载的资源指南相结合，旨在帮助将培训转化为日常实践。

paras.en: Introducing the program, Cassie Bell, NAPA’s senior vice president of HR, said the expansion supports the company’s Drive 2030 strategy and its investment in people. Although owners have requested training for several positions, she said store managers were a logical starting point.
paras.zh: NAPA 人力资源高级副总裁 Cassie Bell 在介绍该计划时表示，此次扩张支持公司的 Drive 2030 战略及其对人才的投资。尽管店主要求对多个职位进行培训，但她表示，商店经理是一个合乎逻辑的起点。

paras.en: “We believe fundamentally that the store manager is critical to obtaining consistent customer service, to building the teams and driving those operational performances inside of our stores,” Bell said.
paras.zh: 贝尔说：“我们从根本上认为，商店经理对于获得一致的客户服务、建设团队和推动商店内部的运营绩效至关重要。”

paras.en: The program’s development began with a practical question: What do successful employees and stores do differently?
paras.zh: 该计划的开发始于一个实际问题：成功的员工和商店的做法有何不同？

paras.en: Jesse Parrish, NAPA’s director of learning and development, said the Academy worked with teams across the organization to identify the knowledge, skills and behaviors that define excellence in specific roles. NAPA partnered with industry professionals to turn those findings into training, reference materials and learning pathways.
paras.zh: NAPA 的学习和发展总监杰西·帕里什 (Jesse Parrish) 表示，学院与整个组织的团队合作，确定定义特定角色卓越表现的知识、技能和行为。 NAPA 与行业专业人士合作，将这些发现转化为培训、参考材料和学习途径。

paras.en: By observing high-performing managers and market directors in top-performing stores, the team identified the practices and strategies driving their success. Those real-world insights became the foundation for new training programs designed to help others apply proven strategies throughout the organization.
paras.zh: 通过观察表现最好的商店中的表现出色的经理和市场总监，团队确定了推动他们成功的实践和策略。这些现实世界的见解成为新培训计划的基础，旨在帮助其他人在整个组织中应用经过验证的策略。

paras.en: For store operations, the resulting framework has four areas of emphasis: driving financial results, leading and developing teams, enabling operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer service.

Those areas address responsibilities ranging from understanding store performance and building improvement plans to coaching employees, managing inventory, optimizing delivery service and building customer loyalty.
paras.zh: 这些领域涉及的职责包括了解商店绩效和制定改进计划、指导员工、管理库存、优化送货服务和建立客户忠诚度。

paras.en: The team documented those practices in how-to guides, training courses and tools intended to help other stores apply them.
paras.zh: 该团队将这些做法记录在操作指南、培训课程和工具中，旨在帮助其他商店应用它们。

paras.en: The online courses generally take 10 to 20 minutes to complete. Owners can take the courses themselves or assign them to employees, allowing training to address specific development needs.
paras.zh: 在线课程通常需要 10 到 20 分钟才能完成。业主可以自己参加课程或将课程分配给员工，从而通过培训来满足特定的发展需求。

paras.en: Although the first offering centers on store management, its usefulness extends to other positions. Parrish pointed to customer service lessons, including effective phone conversations, as examples of content relevant to counter employees.
paras.zh: 尽管第一个产品以商店管理为中心，但它的用处扩展到其他职位。帕里什指出，客户服务课程（包括有效的电话交谈）是与柜台员工相关的内容示例。

paras.en: “It is not just limited to the store manager,” he said. “While the content’s focused on them, there are relevant courses here for others that may be frontline workers working the counter.”
paras.zh: “这不仅限于商店经理，”他说。 “虽然内容主要针对他们，但这里也有针对其他可能是柜台一线工作人员的相关课程。”

paras.en: That connection matters because a store’s customer experience depends on both management decisions and individual employee interactions. Training managers to coach their teams complements instruction that helps counter professionals better serve wholesale and retail customers.
paras.zh: 这种联系很重要，因为商店的客户体验取决于管理决策和员工个人互动。培训经理来指导他们的团队补充了指导，帮助柜台专业人员更好地为批发和零售客户服务。

paras.en: The second major resource is a downloadable store manager guide. It outlines the role’s responsibilities, key functions and performance metrics, with linked how-to guidance covering subjects such as budgeting, performance management, customer service and root cause analysis.
paras.zh: 第二个主要资源是可下载的商店经理指南。它概述了该角色的职责、关键职能和绩效指标，并附有涵盖预算、绩效管理、客户服务和根本原因分析等主题的相关操作指南。

paras.en: Parrish described its purpose in everyday terms: helping employees understand “how do you do the work on a Tuesday morning at nine o’clock?”
paras.zh: 帕里什用日常用语描述了其目的：帮助员工了解“周二早上九点钟你是如何工作的？”

paras.en: The training framework recognizes three proficiency levels: foundation, advanced and mastery. Foundation focuses on performing a job independently and effectively. Advanced emphasizes consistently meeting performance targets and helping others succeed. Mastery involves anticipating opportunities, leading broader improvements and consistently exceeding targets.
paras.zh: 培训框架承认三个熟练程度：基础、高级和精通。基金会专注于独立有效地开展工作。高级强调始终如一地实现绩效目标并帮助他人取得成功。精通包括预测机会、领导更广泛的改进以及持续超越目标。

paras.en: That structure provides a development path for employees with different experience levels, from someone entering a management role to an established leader seeking to improve store performance.
paras.zh: 这种结构为不同经验水平的员工提供了一条发展道路，从进入管理岗位的员工到寻求提高商店绩效的既定领导者。

paras.en: Participation is voluntary, Parrish emphasized, with independent owners able to use the resources as they see fit within their businesses. The materials are intended to remain within the NAPA family. NAPA also is exploring how to tailor resources further to independent owners’ needs.
paras.zh: 帕里什强调，参与是自愿的，独立所有者可以根据自己的业务使用他们认为合适的资源。这些材料旨在保留在 NAPA 系列中。 NAPA 还在探索如何进一步调整资源以满足独立业主的需求。

paras.en: Bell encouraged owners to access the content, develop a plan for using it and return regularly as materials are updated. She also asked them to share feedback about missing resources or opportunities for improvement.
paras.zh: 贝尔鼓励所有者访问这些内容，制定使用计划，并在材料更新时定期返回。她还要求他们分享有关缺少资源或改进机会的反馈。

paras.en: “If you need something more, you need something different, something’s not working, whatever that looks like, please reach back out to us,” Bell said. “We are only as good as the feedback we’re receiving from you.”
paras.zh: 贝尔说：“如果你需要更多东西，你需要一些不同的东西，有些东西不起作用，无论看起来是什么样的，请联系我们。” “我们的表现取决于您从我们那里收到的反馈。”

articles.title: Mysterious hole in Neanderthal shoulder blade may have been a 'kill shot' from a wooden spear, according to archaeologists
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: A Neanderthal who was buried 75,000 years ago in Shanidar Cave in Iraq died from a wooden spear straight through the chest, archaeologists have revealed.
paras.zh: 考古学家透露，一名 75,000 年前埋葬在伊拉克沙尼达尔洞穴的尼安德特人死于木矛直接刺穿胸部。

paras.en: While it's impossible to know exactly what happened, the violence may have been a targeted hit.
paras.zh: 虽然不可能确切知道发生了什么，但暴力事件可能是有针对性的袭击。

paras.en: "The position of the wound and the force required to push it right through the Neanderthal's body bear the hallmarks of an intended kill shot directed towards the heart," study first author Emma Pomeroy, a paleoanthropologist at the University of Cambridge, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者、剑桥大学古人类学家艾玛·波默罗伊在一份声明中说：“伤口的位置以及将伤口直接穿过尼安德特人身体所需的力量具有直接射向心脏的致命射击的特征。”

paras.en: In a study published Thursday (Oct. 15) in the journal Scientific Reports, Pomeroy and co-authors analyzed the bones of Shanidar A, a Neanderthal who died violently at about age 45 and was then buried in Shanidar Cave.
paras.zh: 在周四（10 月 15 日）《科学报告》杂志上发表的一项研究中，波默罗伊和合著者分析了沙尼达尔 A 的骨头，沙尼达尔 A 是一位尼安德特人，他在 45 岁左右暴死，然后被埋在沙尼达尔洞穴中。

paras.en: The archaeological site at Shanidar is famous for its evidence of purposeful burial, which experts once thought was only done by modern humans. Although the Neanderthal "flower burial" at Shanidar has since been debunked, the cave holds other evidence of repeated Neanderthal burials, which shows that these extinct humans placed specific meaning on that location, the authors wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 沙尼达尔考古遗址因其有目的的埋葬证据而闻名，专家们曾认为这种埋葬行为只有现代人类才能完成。作者在研究中写道，尽管沙尼达尔的尼安德特人“花葬”已被揭穿，但该洞穴还保存着尼安德特人重复埋葬的其他证据，这表明这些灭绝的人类对该地点赋予了特定的意义。

paras.en: The skeleton of Shanidar A was incomplete when it was discovered in 2019, consisting of a mostly complete right hand, three ribs, six teeth and a left scapula or shoulder blade, which meant they could not figure out the sex of the Neanderthal.
paras.zh: 沙尼达尔 A 的骨骼在 2019 年被发现时并不完整，由基本完整的右手、三根肋骨、六颗牙齿和左肩胛骨或肩胛骨组成，这意味着他们无法弄清楚尼安德特人的性别。

paras.en: Near the edge of the shoulder blade, archaeologists noticed a round hole about 0.6 inches (1.5 centimeters) in diameter and a round piece of bone that had been punched out of the shoulder blade. The researchers ruled out post-mortem damage to the bone, including animal gnawing and insect burrowing.
paras.zh: 在肩胛骨边缘附近，考古学家发现了一个直径约0.6英寸（1.5厘米）的圆孔，以及从肩胛骨上冲出的一块圆形骨头。研究人员排除了死后对骨头造成的损害，包括动物啃咬和昆虫挖洞。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "The perforation is best explained as resulting from perimortem [around the time of death] penetrating trauma, such as that caused by a projectile or a thrusting implement such as a spear," the researchers wrote in the study. Specifically, the Neanderthal was killed by a spear that entered their chest from the front at a high velocity and pierced their shoulder blade.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道：“穿孔最好的解释是由临死时（死亡前后）穿透性创伤造成的，例如由射弹或矛等刺击工具造成的创伤。” Specifically, the Neanderthal was killed by a spear that entered their chest from the front at a high velocity and pierced their shoulder blade.

paras.en: The shape of the wound in the shoulder blade appears to match experimental evidence of injuries made by wooden spears rather than stone-tipped weapons, the researchers wrote in the study. Neanderthals would have used wooden spears for both thrusting and throwing. But it is unclear if this individual died because of a violent interaction with another Neanderthal or by accident, such as a hunting incident.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道，肩胛骨伤口的形状似乎与木矛而不是石头武器造成的伤害的实验证据相符。尼安德特人会使用木矛进行刺击和投掷。但目前尚不清楚此人是否因与另一名尼安德特人的暴力互动而死亡，或因意外事件（例如狩猎事件）而死亡。

paras.en: "All we can ever know about the end of this Neanderthal's life is that it was violent, and came at the end of a wooden spear," study co-author Graeme Barker, an archaeologist at the University of Cambridge, said in the statement.
"Care and support from other Neanderthals"
paras.zh: “来自其他尼安德特人的关心和支持”

paras.en: Even though this Neanderthal had an untimely demise, evidence on the teeth suggested that the individual was cared for during life.
paras.zh: 尽管这个尼安德特人过早死亡，但牙齿上的证据表明该人生前受到照顾。

paras.en: The six teeth from Shanidar A were heavily worn-down in an unusual manner, the researchers wrote. One of them — a front tooth with a large quantity of tartar on it — had been split in half during the Neanderthal's life, and the individual continued to use the damaged tooth for a considerable amount of time. The collection of teeth suggests the Neanderthal sustained a major trauma to the face that fractured the lower front tooth and may have caused additional injuries to the jaw.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，沙尼达尔 A 的六颗牙齿以一种不寻常的方式严重磨损。其中一颗门牙上有大量牙垢，在尼安德特人的一生中被劈成两半，并且该人在相当长的时间内继续使用受损的牙齿。收集的牙齿表明，尼安德特人的面部遭受了严重创伤，导致下门牙骨折，并可能对下巴造成了额外的伤害。

paras.en: "There’s no doubt that Shanidar A would have had difficulty communicating and been in absolute agony for a long period of time," Pomeroy said in the statement. "Surviving a blow that splits a tooth in this fashion, then continuing to live and eat for a period of at least a year and maybe more, would have required care and support from other Neanderthals."
paras.zh: 波默罗伊在声明中表示：“毫无疑问，沙尼达尔 A 在很长一段时间内会出现沟通困难，并且处于极度痛苦之中。” “以这种方式从牙齿裂开的打击中幸存下来，然后继续生活和进食至少一年甚至更长的时间，需要其他尼安德特人的照顾和支持。”

paras.en: Rebecca Wragg Sykes, an archaeologist and author of "Kindred: Neanderthal Life, Love, Death and Art" (Bloomsbury, 2020) who was not involved in the study, told Live Science in an email that the apparently fatal chest injury is an important addition to our understanding of Neanderthals. While it is plausible the Neanderthal was stabbed by a wooden spear, Wragg Sykes said, "it would be interesting to also compare whether a wild goat horn, the most intensely hunted species at Shanidar, might have been responsible."
paras.zh: 考古学家丽贝卡·拉格·赛克斯 (Rebecca Wragg Sykes) 是《亲属：尼安德特人的生活、爱情、死亡和艺术》（Bloomsbury，2020）一书的作者，她没有参与这项研究，她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志，明显致命的胸部损伤是我们对尼安德特人了解的重要补充。拉格·赛克斯说，虽然尼安德特人可能是被木矛刺伤的，但“比较一下沙尼达尔最受猎杀的物种野山羊角是否可能是造成这种情况的原因也很有趣。”

paras.en: - 100,000 years ago, one of the earliest Homo sapiens outside Africa was stabbed in the face, analysis finds
paras.zh: - 分析发现，10万年前，非洲以外最早的智人之一的脸部被刺伤

paras.en: - Some of the last surviving Neanderthals were remarkably diverse — suggesting inbreeding didn't doom them
paras.zh: - 最后幸存的一些尼安德特人非常多样化——这表明近亲繁殖并没有毁灭他们

paras.en: - Neanderthals may have trekked through the Saudi Arabian desert 55,000 years ago, farther south than experts thought possible
paras.zh: - 尼安德特人可能在 55,000 年前徒步穿越沙特阿拉伯沙漠，比专家认为的更南边

paras.en: Shanidar A is not the first mortally wounded Neanderthal to be found at the site. In 2009, researchers analyzed the skeleton of Shanidar 3, an older adult male who died 50,000 years ago, and found a deep slice in one of his ribs. The researchers suggested that the Neanderthal may have been killed by a stone-tipped spear possibly thrown by a modern human. Although modern humans first reached Europe around 54,000 years ago, experts aren't sure exactly how they interacted with Neanderthals.
paras.zh: 沙尼达尔 A 并不是该地点发现的第一个受致命伤的尼安德特人。 2009年，研究人员分析了沙尼达尔3号（Shanidar 3）的骨骼，这是一位5万年前死亡的老年男性，在他的一根肋骨中发现了深深的切片。研究人员认为，尼安德特人可能是被现代人投掷的石尖长矛杀死的。尽管现代人类在大约 54,000 年前首次到达欧洲，但专家们并不确定他们与尼安德特人的确切互动方式。

paras.en: Pomeroy told Live Science in an email that the discovery at Shanidar of two stabbed Neanderthals 25,000 years apart is interesting but possibly just a coincidence.
paras.zh: 波默罗伊在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》，沙尼达尔发现了两个相隔 25,000 年被刺伤的尼安德特人，这很有趣，但可能只是巧合。

paras.en: "We know from the archaeology that Neanderthals were repeatedly coming back to Shanidar and using it for short periods at a time, both around 75,000 years ago and around 45-50,000 years ago, as well as leaving their dead there," Pomeroy said.
paras.zh: 波默罗伊说：“我们从考古学中得知，大约在 75,000 年前和大约 45-50,000 年前，尼安德特人多次回到沙尼达尔并短暂使用它，并将死者留在那里。”

paras.en: The traumatic injuries, purposeful burial and indirect evidence of wooden spears all show that 75,000 years ago, Neanderthal life — and death — were complex, the researchers wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道，外伤、有目的的埋葬和木矛的间接证据都表明，75,000 年前，尼安德特人的生活和死亡是复杂的。

paras.en: Pomeroy, E., Hunt, C.O., López-Polín, L., Sala, N., Pantoja-Pérez, A., Holman, J., Twyman, J., Bennett, P., Reynolds, T., Lane, R., Pirrie, D., Barker, G. (2026). Evidence for funerary behaviour and lethal trauma in a new Neanderthal individual from Shanidar Cave. Scientific Reports. http://dx.doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-69193-z
paras.zh: Pomeroy, E.、Hunt, C.O.、López-Polín, L.、Sala, N.、Pantoja-Pérez, A.、Holman, J.、Twyman, J.、Bennett, P.、Reynolds, T.、Lane, R.、Pirrie, D.、Barker, G. (2026)。沙尼达尔洞穴的一个新尼安德特人的丧葬行为和致命创伤的证据。科学报告。 http://dx.doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-69193-z

paras.en: How much do you know about our closest relatives? Find out with our Neanderthal quiz.
paras.zh: 你对我们的近亲了解多少？通过我们的尼安德特人测验来找出答案。

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: 'We're not a competitor to fusion. We are fusion': Inside the race to harness unlimited solar power in space
articles.author: Ben Turner

paras.en: The year is 2050, and as the sun sets, the night's first constellations emerge in perfect rows. But these amber-glowing arrays aren't stars at all; they're satellite clusters, harvesting the day's last rays before beaming their power back to Earth.
paras.zh: 今年是 2050 年，随着太阳落山，夜晚的第一个星座完美地排成一排。但这些琥珀色发光的阵列根本不是星星；而是星星。它们是卫星群，收集当天最后的光线，然后将能量传回地球。

paras.en: If it reads like science fiction, that's because it started that way. Called space-based solar power (SBSP), the concept featured prominently in the techno-utopian imaginations of 20th-century visionaries and writers. But for decades, it was dismissed — a pie in the sky proposal.
paras.zh: 如果它读起来像科幻小说，那是因为它就是这样开始的。这一概念被称为天基太阳能（SBSP），在 20 世纪梦想家和作家的技术乌托邦想象中占有重要地位。但几十年来，这个提议一直被驳回——天上掉馅饼的提议。

paras.en: Now, as a new space race heats up, governments and private companies in China, the U.S., the U.K. and Japan are developing several projects to reassess the idea's feasibility. These include China's ZhuRi ("Chase the Sun") program, Japan's OHISAMA project, the U.K.'s Space Solar, and power-beaming experiments by Caltech and the Air Force Research Laboratory in the U.S., all of which are targeting test launches in the next five years.
paras.zh: 现在，随着新一轮太空竞赛的升温，中国、美国、英国和日本的政府和私营公司正在开发几个项目，以重新评估这一想法的可行性。其中包括中国的逐日计划、日本的OHISAMA项目、英国的太空太阳能以及加州理工学院和美国空军研究实验室的功率发射实验，所有这些都计划在未来五年内进行测试发射。

paras.en: Proponents say the technology has the potential to meet Earth's energy needs many times over while causing minimal harm to the environment. But first it needs to get off the ground: In the eyes of critics, space-based solar power is exorbitantly expensive, riddled with untested assumptions, and far too complex to be deployed in time for an urgent green-energy transition.
paras.zh: 支持者表示，这项技术有潜力多次满足地球的能源需求，同时对环境造成的危害最小。但首先它需要起步：在批评者看来，天基太阳能成本过高，充满了未经检验的假设，而且过于复杂，无法及时部署以实现紧急的绿色能源转型。

paras.en: The challenges include getting the massive solar-panel-covered satellites into space; assembling them; getting those solar panels to constantly face our star; and then finding ways to convert, concentrate and transmit their collected power back to Earth.
paras.zh: 挑战包括将大型太阳能电池板卫星送入太空；组装它们；让这些太阳能电池板始终面向我们的恒星；然后寻找方法将其收集的能量转换、集中并将其传输回地球。

paras.en: Despite these hurdles, researchers keep returning to the idea. Perhaps because the most crucial step — generating energy in the first place — is already being done by the sun. Every second, our star fuses hydrogen atoms to expel the same energy as nine trillion atomic bombs. All that's left to do is catch it.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些障碍，研究人员仍然不断回归这个想法。也许是因为最关键的一步——首先产生能量——已经由太阳完成了。每一秒，我们的恒星都会融合氢原子，释放出与九万亿颗原子弹相同的能量。剩下要做的就是抓住它。

paras.en: "We're not a competitor to fusion. We are fusion," Peter Garretson, the U.S. Air Force's former chief of future technology and an SBSP expert, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “我们不是聚变的竞争对手。我们就是聚变，”美国空军前未来技术主管、SBSP 专家彼得·加勒森 (Peter Garretson) 告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The first glimmers of SBSP as a concept came from the Russian rocket scientist and astronautics pioneer Konstantin Tsiolkovsky, who, in 1923, suggested deploying space-based mirrors that could concentrate sunlight to Earth with enough intensity to boil 10 cups of coffee.
paras.zh: SBSP 这个概念的最初曙光来自俄罗斯火箭科学家和航天先驱康斯坦丁·齐奥尔科夫斯基 (Konstantin Tsiolkovsky)，他在 1923 年建议部署天基镜子，将阳光集中到地球，其强度足以煮沸 10 杯咖啡。

paras.en: Tsiolkovsky's fanciful proposal soon entered science fiction, appearing in the British writer Olaf Stapledon's 1937 novel "Star Maker" as a "gauze of light traps" that an advanced alien civilization used to focus "the escaping solar energy for intelligent use" — an idea later formalized by theoretical physicist Freeman Dyson as a Dyson sphere.
paras.zh: 齐奥尔科夫斯基的奇思妙想很快就进入了科幻小说，出现在英国作家奥拉夫·斯塔普尔顿 (Olaf Stapledon) 1937 年的小说《造星者》(Star Maker) 中，作为先进外星文明用来聚焦“逃逸太阳能以供智能使用”的“光陷阱网”——这一想法后来被理论物理学家弗里曼·戴森 (Freeman Dyson) 正式表述为戴森球。

paras.en: Then, in 1941, Isaac Asimov made the clearest, most famous early sketch of SBSP in his short story "Reason," in which a robot colony toils aboard a power station that collects solar energy and fires it back to Earth in the form of microwaves. Asimov provided few details on the fictional station's engineering, instead focusing on the robots' religious worship of the vessel.
paras.zh: 然后，1941 年，艾萨克·阿西莫夫在他的短篇小说《理性》中描绘了 SBSP 最清晰、最著名的早期草图，其中一个机器人群体在一个发电站上辛苦劳作，收集太阳能并将其以微波的形式发射回地球。阿西莫夫没有提供有关虚构空间站工程的细节，而是重点关注机器人对飞船的宗教崇拜。

paras.en: But the transformation from science fiction to a concrete proposal didn't take long. In 1968, aerospace engineer Peter Glaser, a consultant and project manager for the Apollo 11 mission's distance-measuring laser reflectors, drew up an engineering design for a "solar power satellite" consisting of three key elements: a ray-collecting device, a converter and a transmitter.
paras.zh: 但从科幻小说到具体建议的转变并没有花费很长时间。 1968 年，阿波罗 11 号任务测距激光反射器的顾问兼项目经理、航空航天工程师彼得·格拉泽 (Peter Glaser) 制定了“太阳能卫星”的工程设计，由三个关键元件组成：光线收集装置、转换器和发射器。

paras.en: Glaser's collector was a disk of photovoltaic panels that would be lifted some 22,400 miles (36,000 kilometers) off the ground. Locked in a geostationary orbit above Earth and bathed in near-constant sunlight, the satellite would harvest solar rays before converting them into microwaves to be beamed, largely unimpeded through the atmosphere, to receiving antennae on the ground. Once there, the microwaves would be converted into electricity and distributed across the grid.
paras.zh: 格拉泽的收集器是一个光伏板圆盘，它将被提升到距地面约 22,400 英里（36,000 公里）的高度。这颗卫星被锁定在地球上空的对地静止轨道上，沐浴在近乎恒定的阳光下，它会收集太阳光线，然后将其转化为微波，在很大程度上不受阻碍地穿过大气层发送到地面的接收天线。一旦到达那里，微波将被转化为电力并通过电网分配。

paras.en: NASA awarded Glaser a contract to study the concept further, with both domestic and international energy crises (such as the 1973 oil crisis and the 1979 Three-Mile Island nuclear accident) adding wind to his solar sails.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局授予格拉泽一份合同，以进一步研究这一概念，国内和国际能源危机（例如 1973 年石油危机和 1979 年三哩岛核事故）为他的太阳帆增添了风力。

paras.en: But Glaser's design hit technical and financial roadblocks, the most forbidding being the project's sheer size. By 1981, when the U.S. Department of Energy's four-year study of space-based solar power was released, it estimated that a "meaningful" contribution of 300 gigawatts (sufficient to power hundreds of millions of homes) would require 60 satellites, each spanning 21 square miles (55 square kilometers) and weighing 50,000 tons (45,000 metric tons). The plan was deemed unaffordable.
paras.zh: 但格拉泽的设计遇到了技术和财务障碍，其中最令人生畏的是该项目的庞大规模。到 1981 年，美国能源部发布了为期四年的天基太阳能研究报告，估计需要 60 颗卫星才能提供 300 吉瓦（足以为数亿家庭供电）的“有意义”贡献，每颗卫星的面积为 21 平方英里（55 平方公里），重量为 50,000 吨（45,000 公吨）。该计划被认为无法承担。

paras.en: Later reassessments, such as a 1997 report by NASA physicist John Mankins, pointed to advances such as improved solar cells that made the concept more realistic. Yet the overall consensus remained hostile. A 2015 report released by the Strategic Studies Institute (SSI) of the U.S. Army War College stated that while SBSP systems are "technically feasible," there was "no compelling evidence that such systems will be economically competitive" with terrestrial power systems. It concluded that "the reality is that such systems always seem to be seen as just 10 years away by their advocates."
paras.zh: 后来的重新评估，例如 NASA 物理学家约翰·曼金斯 (John Mankins) 1997 年的一份报告，指出改进的太阳能电池等进步使这一概念更加现实。但总体共识仍然是敌对的。美国陆军战争学院战略研究所（SSI）2015年发布的一份报告指出，虽然SBSP系统“在技术上可行”，但“没有令人信服的证据表明此类系统将在经济上与地面电力系统竞争”。报告的结论是：“现实情况是，此类系统的拥护者似乎总是认为 10 年后就会出现。”

paras.en: But a lot can change in a decade, including the cost of firing rockets. Since the SSI report, SpaceX's reusable Falcon 9 rocket has sent launch costs plummeting to around 30 times less than those of NASA's Space Shuttle, with satellites also getting cheaper due to mass production and advances to the clean rooms where they're made. And SpaceX's even bigger Starship rocket promises to more than quintuple Falcon's payload capacity, lowering prices further.
paras.zh: 但十年内可能会发生很多事情，包括发射火箭的成本。自 SSI 报告发布以来，SpaceX 可重复使用的猎鹰 9 号火箭的发射成本已大幅下降至 NASA 航天飞机的 30 倍左右，而且由于大规模生产和制造洁净室的进步，卫星也变得更便宜。 SpaceX 更大的 Starship 火箭有望将 Falcon 的有效载荷能力提高五倍以上，从而进一步降低价格。

paras.en: "What you have is a cadre of people in the space community that have grown up before Starlink and SpaceX," Garretson said. "They literally could not believe that, as your launch rate goes up and you amortize your costs, [the launch cost] approaches the cost of fuel." Some took notice. A 2021 assessment commissioned by the U.K. government estimated that a 2-gigawatt, mile-wide space-based solar power array would cost 17.3 billion British pounds ($23.4 billion) and generate energy at 50 British pounds ($68) per megawatt hour over its century lifetime.
paras.zh: 加勒森说：“太空界有一批在 Starlink 和 SpaceX 之前成长起来的骨干人员。” “他们简直不敢相信，随着发射率上升并且摊销成本，[发射成本]接近燃料成本。”有些人注意到了。英国政府委托进行的 2021 年评估估计，一个 2 吉瓦、一英里宽的太空太阳能发电阵列将耗资 173 亿英镑（234 亿美元），在其一个世纪的使用寿命内每兆瓦时发电 50 英镑（68 美元）。

paras.en: That's the equivalent output of a large power station in the U.K., with the initial costs being 39% to 49% cheaper than biomass, nuclear or the most efficient gas energy sources, according to the assessment. And while it's still 14% to 52% more expensive than current terrestrial wind and solar energy, the technology could be beamed anywhere, even to remote locations.
Based on these findings, in 2023, the U.K. government awarded 4.3 million British pounds ($5.8 million) in seed funding to a handful of companies and universities to develop SBSP further.
paras.zh: 基于这些发现，英国政府于 2023 年向少数公司和大学提供了 430 万英镑（580 万美元）的种子资金，以进一步开发 SBSP。

paras.en: The U.K. report chose one satellite design as its reference architecture: CASSIOPeiA. Belonging to the U.K. SBSP company Space Solar, the satellite's design is an attempt to crack a significant challenge faced by early solar satellite blueprints: how to keep solar panels constantly aligned with the sun to maximize radiation collection.
paras.zh: 英国的报告选择了一种卫星设计作为其参考架构：CASSIOPeiA。该卫星属于英国 SBSP 公司 Space Solar，其设计旨在解决早期太阳能卫星蓝图面临的重大挑战：如何保持太阳能电池板始终与太阳对齐，以最大限度地收集辐射。

paras.en: Unlike other satellite designs, such as China's Multi-Rotary Joint Solar Power Satellite or Mankins' SPS-ALPHA, which rotate the panels or use a system of mirrors to constantly redirect sunlight onto them, CASSIOPeiA is shaped like a gigantic DNA strand.
paras.zh: 与其他卫星设计不同，例如中国的多旋转联合太阳能卫星或曼金斯的 SPS-ALPHA，它们旋转面板或使用镜子系统不断地将阳光重新引导到它们上，CASSIOPeiA 的形状像一条巨大的 DNA 链。

paras.en: This design, alongside a sun-synchronous orbit and a slow spin, enables CASSIOPeiA to constantly receive and transmit solar energy without any heavy or failure-prone moving parts. Space Solar claims that a single CASSIOPeiA satellite, which would be about 1 mile (1.6 km) in diameter, could microwave-beam as much as 2 gigawatts of constant power to a fixed point on the ground — enough to supply a city of 2 million people.
paras.zh: 这种设计加上太阳同步轨道和慢速旋转，使 CASSIOPeiA 能够持续接收和传输太阳能，而无需任何笨重或容易出现故障的移动部件。 Space Solar 声称，一颗直径约为 1 英里（1.6 公里）的 CASSIOPeiA 卫星可以向地面固定点发射高达 2 吉瓦的恒定功率微波束，足以为一座拥有 200 万人口的城市供电。

paras.en: Space Solar says that once the satellite is in space, it will be far more efficient and economical than gathering sunlight on the ground could ever be. That's because the light hitting the space-based power station isn't deflected or attenuated by the atmosphere.
paras.zh: Space Solar表示，一旦卫星进入太空，它将比在地面收集阳光更加高效和经济。这是因为照射到天基发电站的光线不会被大气层偏转或减弱。

paras.en: "You use a lot less materials compared with terrestrial solar, and you utilize them more," Sam Adlen, co-founder and co-CEO of Space Solar, one of the funding recipients, told Live Science. "So it's 100% utilized in space rather than 10% if you're on the ground — and you've got 13 times more instant energy, so you're getting much more out of the materials."
paras.zh: “与地面太阳能相比，你使用的材料要少得多，而且利用率更高，”资助者之一太空太阳能公司的联合创始人兼联合首席执行官萨姆·阿德伦告诉《生活科学》。 “因此，它在太空中得到 100% 的利用，而不是在地面上得到 10% 的利用，并且您获得的即时能量增加了 13 倍，因此您可以从材料中获得更多收益。”

paras.en: However, the next step — beaming gigawatts of energy down and across tens of miles of atmosphere and through potential cloud cover — remains a major technical hurdle.
paras.zh: 然而，下一步——通过潜在的云层向下、穿过数十英里的大气层发射千兆瓦的能量——仍然是一个主要的技术障碍。

paras.en: Proposed power-beaming methods are currently split between two types: lasers and microwaves. California-based startup Aetherflux, which has plans to beam power from satellites in low Earth orbit, has developed an infrared laser transmission system that it will test using a demonstration satellite launched on October 1. The microwave energy will be transmitted at around one kilowatt (enough to supply the basic electrical demands of a household).
paras.zh: 目前提出的功率发射方法分为两种类型：激光和微波。总部位于加利福尼亚州的初创公司 Aetherflux 计划从近地轨道的卫星发射电力，该公司已开发出一种红外激光传输系统，并将使用 10 月 1 日发射的演示卫星进行测试。微波能量的传输速度约为 1 千瓦（足以满足一个家庭的基本用电需求）。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Caltech and Overview Energy, another U.S. startup, have both demonstrated respective microwave and laser-power beaming from orbit and from a plane, respectively, albeit in negligible amounts ( less than a kilowatt).
paras.zh: 与此同时，加州理工学院和另一家美国初创公司Overview Energy都分别展示了从轨道和飞机上发射微波和激光功率的能力，尽管数量可以忽略不计（不到一千瓦）。

paras.en: Despite their efficiency and proven ability to travel vast distances, optical beams in the infrared and near-infrared ranges are easily scattered by water droplets in the atmosphere, preventing power from being transferred on cloudy days. Persisting efficiency issues with optical power transmission also worsen at gigawatt power levels, meaning lasers are less feasible for use at the utility scale.
paras.zh: 尽管其效率很高并且能够远距离传播，但红外和近红外范围内的光束很容易被大气中的水滴散射，从而阻止电力在阴天传输。光功率传输持续存在的效率问题在千兆瓦功率水平下也会恶化，这意味着激光器在公用事业规模上的使用不太可行。

paras.en: Microwaves, on the other hand, can be beamed at frequencies with much higher power and suffer relatively little atmospheric attenuation. That's why Space Solar, Japan's OHISAMA project and China's ZhuRi program all plan to use microwave-beaming systems. Nonetheless, microwaves have comparatively longer wavelengths, so their beams diffract more widely across longer distances. This means that even if beams are sent by transmitters hundreds of meters wide, they would need Earth-based receivers spanning dozens of square miles.
paras.zh: 另一方面，微波可以以更高功率的频率发射，并且受到相对较小的大气衰减。这就是为什么Space Solar、日本的OHISAMA项目和中国的ZhuRi项目都计划使用微波发射系统。尽管如此，微波的波长相对较长，因此它们的光束在较长的距离上衍射范围更广。这意味着即使波束由数百米宽的发射器发送，它们也需要跨越数十平方英里的地面接收器。

paras.en: These limitations mean that "it's going to take many years" before gigawatt-scale power beaming is achieved, Remo Proietti Zaccaria, head of the DELTA Lab at the Italian Institute of Technology, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 意大利理工学院 DELTA 实验室负责人雷莫·普罗耶蒂·扎卡里亚 (Remo Proietti Zaccaria) 告诉《Live Science》，这些限制意味着“需要很多年”才能实现吉瓦级功率发射。

paras.en: Improvements in power-beaming efficiency will bring their own challenges. Even battery-powered laser pointers can blind or burn, so prototypes by laser-beaming SBSP companies like Aetherflux must be designed with that possibility in mind. They promise safety mechanisms that switch off their lasers if anything flies between the transmitter and the receiver.
paras.zh: 功率发射效率的提高也会带来自身的挑战。即使是电池供电的激光笔​​也可能致盲或灼伤，因此 Aetherflux 等激光束 SBSP 公司的原型在设计时必须考虑到这种可能性。他们承诺提供安全机制，如果发射器和接收器之间有任何物体飞过，就会关闭激光器。

paras.en: "Definitely for the weapon side, this technology now can be used efficiently," Proietti Zaccaria said.
paras.zh: “对于武器方面来说，这项技术现在可以得到有效利用，”Proietti Zaccaria 说。

paras.en: If you're imagining an orbital weapon devised by a Bond villain, you may be disappointed — even fully developed power-beaming lasers and microwaves would take a while to cook an egg, or boil Tsiolkovsky's coffees. But beaming technology could still have potent military use: Scrambling communications systems on Earth to create havoc with relatively little effort.
paras.zh: 如果你想象的是邦德恶棍设计的轨道武器，你可能会感到失望——即使是完全开发的功率激光和微波也需要一段时间才能煮鸡蛋或煮齐奥尔科夫斯基的咖啡。但发射技术仍然具有强大的军事用途：扰乱地球上的通信系统，以相对较小的努力造成破坏。

paras.en: "If you throw even that amount of intensity of power to our antennas, you're going to freeze the electronics; that's for sure," Proietti Zaccaria said. "It's not necessary to destroy them. As long as you freeze the electronics, you've done the job."
paras.zh: “如果你向我们的天线施加如此大的功率，你就会冻结电子设备；这是肯定的，”普罗耶蒂·扎卡里亚说。 “没有必要摧毁它们。只要你冷冻电子设备，你就完成了任务。”

paras.en: The challenges associated with power beaming have pushed some engineers to simpler concepts. One (going full circle back to Tsiolkovsky's original proposal) envisions the deployment of space-based mirrors that reflect sunlight back to Earth after sunset, with a single reflector extending the daylight delivered onto solar panels by around 20 minutes.
paras.zh: 与功率发射相关的挑战迫使一些工程师采用更简单的概念。其中之一（绕一圈回到齐奥尔科夫斯基最初的提议）设想部署天基镜子，在日落后将阳光反射回地球，用单个反射器将传递到太阳能电池板上的日光延长约 20 分钟。

paras.en: This may not seem like much on its own, "but then you can increase this with multiple reflectors," Onur Celik, a researcher in space technology at the University of Glasgow, told Live Science. "If you have 10 or more of them, you can arrange them in space in such a way that you can extend this to up to two hours or so at that altitude."
paras.zh: 格拉斯哥大学空间技术研究员奥努尔·塞利克（Onur Celik）告诉《生活科学》杂志，这本身看起来可能没什么，“但你可以通过多个反射器来增加这一点”。 “如果你有 10 个或更多，你可以将它们安排在太空中，这样你就可以在那个高度将时间延长到两个小时左右。”

paras.en: "The sunlight that you deliver, if it all turns into electricity, could power thousands of homes," he concluded.
paras.zh: 他总结道：“如果你发出的阳光全部转化为电力，就可以为数千个家庭提供电力。”

paras.en: The trillion-dollar question is whether that power will be cheaper and more efficient than that generated on the ground. The median cost of the electricity generated by SBSP as estimated by the U.K. government is 50 British pounds per megawatt hour ($68), putting it roughly in line with the costs of offshore wind and terrestrial solar power.
paras.zh: 价值数万亿美元的问题是，这种电力是否会比地面发电更便宜、更高效。据英国政府估计，SBSP 发电的中位成本为每兆瓦时 50 英镑（68 美元），与海上风电和地面太阳能的成本大致一致。

paras.en: However, this estimate is orders of magnitude too sunny for the 2024 NASA cost report, with its projections suggesting SBSP's baseline electricity costs fall between $610 and $1,590 per megawatt hour, depending on the array design. NASA concluded that the U.K.'s median estimate was achievable only after drastic future reductions in launch and manufacturing costs.
paras.zh: 然而，对于 2024 年 NASA 成本报告来说，这一估计数字过于乐观，其预测表明 SBSP 的基准电力成本在每兆瓦时 610 美元至 1,590 美元之间，具体取决于阵列设计。美国宇航局得出的结论是，只有在未来大幅降低发射和制造成本后，英国的中位估计才能实现。

paras.en: Independent studies are also divided over feasibility. One assessment suggests that SBSP could reduce Europe's need for land-based renewable energy by up to 80%, while another counters that the costs could be 12 to 80 times more expensive than those for terrestrial alternatives. This variability exists within the studies themselves, with research published in the journal Acta Astronautica estimating that SBSP could contribute to meeting anywhere from 3% to 31% of global electricity demand, depending on possible constraints in how many satellites can safely fit into an orbit, the receiver size, and where power is beamed to.
paras.zh: 独立研究在可行性方面也存在分歧。一项评估表明，SBSP 可以将欧洲对陆基可再生能源的需求减少高达 80%，而另一项评估则反驳说，其成本可能比陆地替代能源贵 12 至 80 倍。研究本身就存在这种可变性，发表在《宇航学报》杂志上的研究估计，SBSP 可以帮助满足全球 3% 到 31% 的电力需求，具体取决于可安全进入轨道的卫星数量、接收器尺寸以及电力发射地点等可能的限制。

paras.en: "For the numbers we found, I don't believe that this technology could actually be employed to generate energy for Earth," said Proietti Zaccaria, a co-author of the Acta Astronautica study. If humanity had used up all available space for solar panels on Earth, "then I will tell you it would make sense, because at that point, 3%, 5%, 10% could make a difference."
paras.zh: 《宇航学报》研究报告的合著者普罗耶蒂·扎卡里亚 (Proietti Zaccaria) 表示：“根据我们发现的数字，我不认为这项技术实际上可以用来为地球产生能源。”如果人类用完了地球上所有可用的太阳能电池板空间，“那么我会告诉你这是有道理的，因为到那时，3%、5%、10% 就可以产生影响。”

paras.en: Proietti Zaccaria does see use cases for SBSP schemes for future moon or Mars missions, but otherwise, "the cost for building technology of this kind is really very, very high," he said. "Vice versa, the cost nowadays of buying and installing a solar panel on the roof of any building has become extremely cheap."
paras.zh: Proietti Zaccaria 确实看到了 SBSP 计划在未来月球或火星任务中的用例，但除此之外，“构建此类技术的成本确实非常非常高，”他说。 “反之亦然，如今在任何建筑物的屋顶上购买和安装太阳能电池板的成本已经变得非常便宜。”

paras.en: Among the challenges would be ferrying the raw materials for the systems into space and then assembling them. Such a feat would make the construction of the International Space Station — currently the most complex structure built in orbit — seem like child's play. Maintaining arrays and preventing them from crashing into other satellites in Earth's increasingly crowded orbits would also take significant international coordination.
paras.zh: 挑战之一是将系统的原材料运送到太空，然后组装它们。这样的壮举将使国际空间站的建设——目前在轨道上建造的最复杂的结构——看起来像儿戏。维护阵列并防止它们撞上地球日益拥挤的轨道上的其他卫星也需要大量的国际协调。

paras.en: Then there are the unweighed environmental costs. All modern rockets use methane, a potent greenhouse gas, to propel them into space, and they release much of it into Earth's upper atmosphere, where its effects are the strongest.
paras.zh: 然后是未加权的环境成本。所有现代火箭都使用甲烷（一种强效温室气体）将其推入太空，并将其中的大部分释放到地球的高层大气中，在那里其影响最为强烈。

paras.en: "And so clearly, there is a question there on how launching 100,000 of these superheavy vehicles into the atmosphere will actually impact the atmosphere itself, as opposed to the benefit that we get in the next 20 years or so from having solar power from space," Matteo Ceriotti, a senior lecturer in space systems engineering at the University of Glasgow, told Live Science. "It's not entirely clear."
paras.zh: 格拉斯哥大学空间系统工程高级讲师马泰奥·塞里奥蒂 (Matteo Ceriotti) 告诉《Live Science》：“很明显，存在一个问题，即向大气层发射 10 万辆超重型飞行器实际上会对大气本身产生怎样的影响，而不是在未来 20 年左右的时间里我们从太空太阳能中获得的好处。” “还不完全清楚。”

paras.en: Ceriotti said the likeliest route for overcoming all of these difficulties come from smaller companies running, and then streamlining, proof-of-concept tests in space.
paras.zh: 塞里奥蒂表示，克服所有这些困难的最有可能的途径来自于较小的公司在太空中运行并简化概念验证测试。

paras.en: - 'Everything we know about space travel is going to change within a decade': The fusion breakthrough that could unlock a path to the stars
paras.zh: -“我们所知道的关于太空旅行的一切都将在十年内发生变化”：聚变突破可能会开启通往恒星的道路

paras.en: - US military confirms weapons in orbit: Why a space 'arms race' could be extremely hard to stop
paras.zh: - 美国军方确认在轨武器：为何太空“军备竞赛”极难阻止

paras.en: - 'River in the Sky': China's doomed plan to create a 'cloud seeding corridor' tells us how far the country will go to solve its climate crisis
paras.zh: - “天空之河”：中国注定要建立“播云走廊”的计划告诉我们该国将在多大程度上解决其气候危机

paras.en: "Obviously, it's not something that we have ever done," he said. "So clearly, we need to start somewhere, and we need to start small."
paras.zh: “显然，这不是我们曾经做过的事情，”他说。 “很明显，我们需要从某个地方开始，而且需要从小事做起。”

paras.en: The hopes of SBSP proponents remain unclouded by gloomy estimates. They cite several technologies, from personal computers to reusable rockets, that were once thought to be impossibly expensive, even fictitious, that are now ubiquitous and cheap. Their eyes remain fixed on demonstration missions to be launched over the next four years by the likes of Space Solar, Reflect Orbital, Aetherflux and Virtus Solis. If these missions succeed, another once-impossible idea could appear much brighter.
paras.zh: SBSP 支持者的希望并未被悲观的估计所蒙蔽。他们列举了从个人电脑到可重复使用火箭等多种技术，这些技术曾经被认为极其昂贵，甚至是虚构的，但现在却无处不在且便宜。他们的目光仍然集中在未来四年内由 Space Solar、Reflect Orbital、Aetherflux 和 Virtus Solis 等公司发射的演示任务。如果这些任务成功，另一个曾经不可能的想法可能会显得更加光明。

paras.en: "The private sector is good at this, because it has to be," Sanjay Vijendran, an SBSP consultant who led the European Space Agency's now-shuttered SOLARIS project to test the feasibility of SBSP, told Live Science. "It can break the problem down to quite a small level and start to do things with today's technology and today's way of doing things, and start to show that this can be valuable."
paras.zh: “私营部门在这方面很擅长，因为它必须如此，”SBSP 顾问 Sanjay Vijendran 告诉 Live Science，他领导了欧洲航天局现已关闭的 SOLARIS 项目，以测试 SBSP 的可行性。 “它可以将问题分解到相当小的水平，并开始用当今的技术和当今的做事方式来做事，并开始表明这可能是有价值的。”

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Ben Turner is a U.K. based writer and editor at Live Science. He covers physics and astronomy, tech and climate change. He graduated from University College London with a degree in particle physics before training as a journalist. When he's not writing, Ben enjoys reading literature, playing the guitar and embarrassing himself with chess.
paras.zh: 本·特纳 (Ben Turner) 是一位驻英国的作家兼 Live Science 编辑。他的研究领域涵盖物理学和天文学、科技和气候变化。他毕业于伦敦大学学院，获得粒子物理学学位，之后接受记者培训。当他不写作时，本喜欢阅读文学作品、弹吉他和下棋。

articles.title: Has there ever been a mountain taller than Everest?
articles.author: Joshua Rapp Learn

paras.en: Sometimes, it takes a great struggle to build towering peaks. And what more thunderous event is there than the clashing of continental plates?
paras.zh: 有时，需要付出巨大的努力才能建造出巍峨的山峰。还有什么比大陆板块的碰撞更震撼的事件呢？

paras.en: Geological pileups have birthed some of the largest and tallest mountains on the planet, including Mount Everest and its Himalayan neighbors. But has there ever been a peak taller than Mount Everest, which stands 29,032 feet (8,849 meters) above sea level?
paras.zh: 地质连环堆积孕育了地球上一些最大、最高的山脉，包括珠穆朗玛峰及其邻近的喜马拉雅山。但是否还有比海拔 29,032 英尺（8,849 米）的珠穆朗玛峰更高的山峰呢？

paras.en: The answer is still a mystery, but there are some geological clues about where the tallest peaks would have been in the ancient past, experts told Live Science.
paras.zh: 专家告诉《生活科学》，答案仍然是个谜，但有一些地质线索可以说明古代最高山峰的位置。

paras.en: Geologists don't have the level of detail required to pinpoint an exact highest peak hundreds of millions of years ago. "We're never going to get that granularity, unfortunately," Alan Collins, a professor of geology at Adelaide University in Australia, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 地质学家没有足够的细节来确定数亿年前的确切最高峰。澳大利亚阿德莱德大学地质学教授艾伦·柯林斯 (Alan Collins) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“不幸的是，我们永远无法达到这种粒度。”

paras.en: However, clues in residual sediments lodged inside Earth's crust hint at the lost grandeur of primordial snowcaps and summits. Scientists study these crusts to understand how deep they went, which can reveal how tall ancient mountains might have been.
paras.zh: 然而，地壳内残留沉积物的线索暗示着原始雪盖和山峰已经失去的宏伟。科学家研究这些地壳，以了解它们的深度，从而揭示古代山脉的高度。

paras.en: Mountains are really just parts of the continental crust that have been thrust upward as tectonic plates slowly crash together. This crust is very heavy, and there is much more to it than what you see on the surface; even the most spectacularly tall peaks, like Everest, are anchored in deep crust. Just as crust gets thrust up to form mountain peaks, it also gets pushed deep under the surface. Both Collins and Ziyi Zhu, a geochemist at Curtin University in Australia, compared mountains to icebergs, in the sense that only a bit pokes above the surface.
paras.zh: 山脉实际上只是大陆地壳的一部分，随着构造板块慢慢碰撞在一起而被向上推挤。这层地壳非常重，而且里面的东西比你在表面看到的要多得多；即使是最壮观的高山，如珠穆朗玛峰，也都固定在深厚的地壳中。正如地壳被推升形成山峰一样，它也被推到地表深处。柯林斯和澳大利亚科廷大学地球化学家朱子仪都将山脉比作冰山，即只露出水面的一点点。

paras.en: "We can argue or speculate that [the biggest mountain] was in a place where there were deep roots in the crust," Zhu told Live Science.
paras.zh: “我们可以争论或推测，[最大的山]位于地壳深处有根的地方，”朱告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周用一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Geologists estimate that the Himalayas, for example, have a crustal column that goes down as far as 50 miles (80 kilometers). Compare that to Everest's elevation of about 29,000 feet (9,000 m), and the world's tallest mountain at most represents only 14% of the rock slab it's part of. That means there's a limit to how tall mountains can get before they collapse under their own weight.
paras.zh: 例如，地质学家估计喜马拉雅山的地壳柱可向下延伸 50 英里（80 公里）。与珠穆朗玛峰约 29,000 英尺（9,000 米）的海拔相比，世界最高山峰最多只占其所属岩板的 14%。这意味着山脉在因自重而倒塌之前所能达到的高度是有限度的。

paras.en: The Himalayas began forming between 50 million and 40 million years ago from the collision between the Indian Eurasian continental plates. As far as mountains go, they are relatively young. And that's partly why they are still so tall. Tall, jagged mountains erode quickly over time, though the Himalayas are still growing as the two plates continue to collide.
paras.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉于 5000 万至 4000 万年前因印度欧亚大陆板块之间的碰撞而开始形成。就山脉而言，它们相对年轻。这就是他们仍然这么高的部分原因。随着时间的推移，高大、锯齿状的山脉很快就会被侵蚀，但随着两个板块的不断碰撞，喜马拉雅山仍在不断增长。

paras.en: Such continental collisions have happened countless times before, though. For example, the Transgondwanan Supermountain, an ancient range in what is now East Africa, began emerging some 650 million years ago when Africa and South America crashed into Arabia, India, Australia and Antarctica to form the supercontinent Gondwana.
paras.zh: 不过，这样的大陆碰撞以前已经发生过无数次了。例如，跨冈瓦纳超级山脉（Transgondwanan Supermountain）是位于现在东非的一个古老山脉，大约在 6.5 亿年前，当非洲和南美洲撞击阿拉伯、印度、澳大利亚和南极洲形成冈瓦纳超级大陆时，它开始出现。

paras.en: Gondwana split up again, but evidence of these mountains in places like southern India, Sri Lanka, Tanzania and Kenya point to them being three times the length of the Himalayas. "If you walk around there now, you can see rocks that were at the bottom of this mountain belt," Collins told Live Science. On average, the crust is deeper than the crust of the Himalayas. "We think this is at least the scale of the Himalayas if not more," Collins said.
paras.zh: 冈瓦纳大陆再次分裂，但印度南部、斯里兰卡、坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚等地的这些山脉的证据表明它们的长度是喜马拉雅山的三倍。 “如果你现在在那里走动，你可以看到这条山脉底部的岩石，”柯林斯告诉《生活科学》。平均而言，地壳比喜马拉雅山的地壳更深。 “我们认为这至少是喜马拉雅山的规模，如果不是更大的话，”柯林斯说。

paras.en: The crusts found in these areas also hint at how tall the mountains were, with sections that descend up to 18 miles (30 km) deep, despite half a billion years of erosion. "At some point, they were likely halfway down a crustal column that was 60 kilometers [37 miles deep]," Collins said. This means that the mountains above this base could have been as tall as Everest.
paras.zh: 这些地区发现的地壳也暗示了山脉的高度，尽管经过了 5 亿年的侵蚀，部分山脉仍深达 18 英里（30 公里）。 “在某个时刻，他们可能位于 60 公里（37 英里深）的地壳柱的中间，”柯林斯说。这意味着该基地上方的山脉可能与珠穆朗玛峰一样高。

paras.en: In the Himalayas, the tallest mountains sit around the rim of the Tibetan Plateau, which has the highest elevation on the planet, at about 3.7 miles (6 km) above sea level, on average. The Transgondwanan range may have had a similar plateau around southern Madagascar, meaning its rim would have been in eastern Madagascar, southern India and eastern Antarctica, Collins said.
paras.zh: 在喜马拉雅山脉，最高的山脉位于青藏高原边缘，这里是地球上海拔最高的地区，平均海拔约 3.7 英里（6 公里）。柯林斯说，外冈瓦南山脉在马达加斯加南部周围可能有一个类似的高原，这意味着它的边缘可能位于马达加斯加东部、印度南部和南极洲东部。

paras.en: Another candidate for the tallest mountains was the Grenville orogeny, which popped up with the formation of the supercontinent Rodinia starting about 1.3 billion years ago. Its remains can be seen around southeastern Ontario and northwestern Vermont. But less is known about this extinct range, Collins said, with some scholars arguing that it wouldn't have been as tall as the Transgondwanan range or the Himalayas.
paras.zh: 最高山脉的另一个候选者是格伦维尔造山运动，它是在大约 13 亿年前随着超级大陆罗迪尼亚的形成而出现的。在安大略省东南部和佛蒙特州西北部周围可以看到它的遗迹。但柯林斯说，人们对这个灭绝的山脉知之甚少，一些学者认为它不会像外冈瓦南山脉或喜马拉雅山那么高。

paras.en: Further back, some 2 billion years ago, the formation of the supercontinent Nuna (also called Columbia) also left evidence of truly giant mountains. Zhu's paper found evidence of this supermountain by examining the composition of zircon crystals left in the crust underneath this vanished range.
paras.zh: 再往前推，大约 20 亿年前，超级大陆努纳（也称为哥伦比亚）的形成也留下了真正巨大山脉的证据。朱的论文通过检查这个消失山脉下方地壳中残留的锆石晶体的成分，发现了这座超级山脉的证据。

paras.en: Look any further back, however, and the picture gets murkier. When Earth was hotter, mountains likely couldn't get as high because warmer crusts can support less weight, Collins said. Stable continental plates and rocks didn't start to form until about 4 billion years ago, and it took hundreds of millions of additional years for large continents to form.
paras.zh: 然而，再往前看，情况就会变得更加模糊。柯林斯说，当地球更热时，山脉可能不会那么高，因为更温暖的地壳可以支撑更少的重量。稳定的大陆板块和岩石直到大约 40 亿年前才开始形成，而大大陆又花了数亿年的时间才形成。

paras.en: For Zhu, the Nuna, Transgondwana and Himalaya ranges are currently the best candidates for holding the tallest mountains that ever existed. But it's likely impossible to pinpoint the highest specific peak, at least with current scientific methods. "It's an open question," Zhu said.
paras.zh: 对朱来说，努纳山脉、外冈瓦纳山脉和喜马拉雅山脉目前是拥有有史以来最高山脉的最佳候选区域。但至少用目前的科学方法，可能不可能精确定位最高的特定峰值。 “这是一个悬而未决的问题，”朱说。

paras.en: How much do you know about our blue planet? Test your terran knowledge with our Earth quiz!
paras.zh: 你对我们的蓝色星球了解多少？通过我们的地球测验测试您的地球知识！

paras.en: Joshua Rapp Learn is an award-winning science writer who contributes to publications like National Geographic, The New York Times, New Scientist and Science News. A Canadian based in Washington, D.C., he has a master's of journalism from the Toronto Metropolitan University and a bachelor of arts in anthropology from the University of British Columbia. He writes about archaeology, wildlife, the environment, space, dinosaurs and adventure, having floated down the Amazon and hitchhiked across the Western Sahara.
paras.zh: Joshua Rapp Learn 是一位屡获殊荣的科学作家，为《国家地理》、《纽约时报》、《新科学家》和《科学新闻》等出版物撰稿。他是居住在华盛顿特区的加拿大人，拥有多伦多城市大学新闻学硕士学位和不列颠哥伦比亚大学人类学学士学位。他曾沿着亚马逊河漂流，并搭便车穿越西撒哈拉，撰写有关考古学、野生动物、环境、太空、恐龙和冒险的文章。
