articles.title: ‘We’re done’: Ukraine resumes strikes on Russian oil refineries as anger at Trump mounts
articles.author: Dan De Luce

paras.en: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries after President Volodymyr Zelenskyy angrily accused the United States of betraying Kyiv with a “dangerous” withdrawal of support critical to its defense against Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基愤怒地指责美国“危险”地撤回对俄罗斯防御至关重要的支持，从而背叛了基辅，之后乌克兰恢复了对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。

paras.en: Ukraine held off on attacks for three days after President Donald Trump’s unilateral “energy ceasefire” announcement, but it accused Russia of repeatedly attacking its power grid. Zelenskyy voiced mounting frustration over the Kremlin’s failure to abide by the truce and what he sees as U.S. attempts to pressure Kyiv following gaps in intelligence-sharing about Russian attacks and restrictions on the Starlink internet service.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统单方面宣布“能源停火”后，乌克兰推迟了三天的袭击，但指责俄罗斯多次袭击其电网。泽伦斯基对克里姆林宫未能遵守停战协议以及他认为美国试图在有关俄罗斯攻击的情报共享和对星链互联网服务的限制方面向基辅施压表示越来越失望。

paras.en: Satellite internet functionality via Starshield — the military version of the SpaceX service in Ukraine — has resumed at previous speeds for the moment, Ukrainian Chargé d’Affaires Denys Sienik told NBC News on Thursday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰临时代办 Denys Sienik 周四告诉 NBC 新闻，通过 Starshield（乌克兰 SpaceX 服务的军用版本）提供的卫星互联网功能目前已恢复到之前的速度。

paras.en: “We hope it will remain unchanged,” Sienik said. “Speed is critical for logistics and for intercepting the jet-powered Shahed drones.”
paras.zh: “我们希望它保持不变，”西尼克说。 “速度对于后勤和拦截喷气动力沙赫德无人机至关重要。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian government still has received no response from SpaceX or the U.S. Defense Department about the reason for the recent limitations, a Ukrainian official said.
paras.zh: 一名乌克兰官员表示，乌克兰政府尚未收到 SpaceX 或美国国防部关于近期限制原因的回应。

paras.en: In an interview with the Financial Times published Thursday, Zelenskyy indicated his patience had already been exhausted.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在周四接受英国《金融时报》采访时表示，他的耐心已经耗尽。

paras.en: “The block [on attacking refineries] is out. We’re done,” Zelenskyy was quoted as saying.
paras.zh: “（攻击炼油厂的）禁令已经解除。我们已经完成了，”泽伦斯基说道。

paras.en: Hours later, a fire was reported at an oil refinery in the western Ryazan region, Gov. Pavel Malkov said. The Russian Defense Ministry said Ukraine had “attempted a massive attack on the Ryazan oil refinery.”
paras.zh: 州长帕维尔·马尔科夫表示，几小时后，梁赞西部地区的一家炼油厂发生火灾。俄罗斯国防部表示，乌克兰“试图对梁赞炼油厂发动大规模袭击”。

paras.en: Ukraine has been reeling from a sudden shift from Trump, who struck a diesel deal with Russia in an apparent bid to relieve pressure at the pump ahead of the midterm elections. He then demanded that Ukraine stop attacking Russian oil facilities and called for Zelenskyy to be replaced as its leader.
paras.zh: 乌克兰一直因特朗普的突然转变而感到不安，特朗普与俄罗斯达成了一项柴油协议，显然是为了在中期选举前缓解石油压力。随后他要求乌克兰停止袭击俄罗斯石油设施，并呼吁撤换泽连斯基领导人。

paras.en: Trump’s “energy ceasefire” appeared to take both warring sides by surprise. He has blamed the Ukrainian campaign for fueling a rise in energy prices, despite the impact of his own war with Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普的“能源停火”似乎让交战双方都感到惊讶。他指责乌克兰的行动加剧了能源价格的上涨，尽管他自己与伊朗的战争也产生了影响。

paras.en: The moves caused frustration and confusion in Ukraine and Europe, intensifying concerns over how much of an ally the U.S. remained in the fight against Russia.
paras.zh: 这些举动在乌克兰和欧洲引起了挫败感和混乱，加剧了人们对美国在对抗俄罗斯的斗争中还有多少盟友的担忧。

paras.en: That worry was aggravated Wednesday when Kyiv said it was facing a slowdown of Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite terminals, disrupting battlefield missions and its ability to intercept Russian drones.
paras.zh: 周三，基辅表示其星链卫星终端速度放缓，导致战场任务及其拦截俄罗斯无人机的能力受到干扰，这种担忧进一步加剧。

paras.en: Russian drones swarmed Ukraine on Wednesday, and more than 850 had filled the skies over Ukraine since early Thursday, Zelenskyy said. “And this comes precisely at a time when the speed of our defensive capabilities is being artificially restricted,” he said, referring to the Starlink slowdown.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，周三俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰，自周四早些时候以来，乌克兰上空已有超过 850 架无人机。 “而这恰恰发生在我们的防御能力的速度受到人为限制的时候，”他指的是星链减速。

paras.en: Musk, a staunch ally of Trump, wrote on social media that decisions about restricting the use of Starshield were up to the U.S. military and ultimately Trump.
paras.zh: 特朗普的坚定盟友马斯克在社交媒体上写道，限制使用“星盾”的决定取决于美国军方，最终取决于特朗普。

paras.en: Overnight, Musk said it was “time for Zelenskyy to go.”
paras.zh: 一夜之间，马斯克表示“泽连斯基该下台了”。

paras.en: The Defense Ministry source said Kyiv was still seeking clarification of the reasons for Wednesday’s throttling of the technology, which Ukraine relies on for battlefield communication, drone operations and air defense.
paras.zh: 国防部消息人士称，基辅仍在寻求澄清周三限制该技术的原因，乌克兰依赖该技术进行战场通信、无人机行动和防空。

paras.en: Questions are mounting about whether the U.S. has stopped or limited the sharing of critical military intelligence with Ukraine after Zelenskyy said several ballistic strikes on Kyiv did not come with the usual warning from its partners.
paras.zh: 在泽连斯基表示，对基辅的几次弹道袭击并未伴随其合作伙伴的通常警告后，关于美国是否已停止或限制与乌克兰分享关键军事情报的问题越来越多。

paras.en: European and Ukrainian officials told NBC News they believed that the moves, coming only days after Trump eased sanctions on Russia’s diesel exports and railed against Zelenskyy, were most likely aimed at pressuring Kyiv into making concessions at the negotiating table amid a stalemate in peace talks.
paras.zh: 欧洲和乌克兰官员告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他们认为，在特朗普放松对俄罗斯柴油出口制裁并谴责泽连斯基几天后采取的举措很可能是为了迫使基辅在和平谈判陷入僵局的情况下在谈判桌上做出让步。

paras.en: Ukraine was concerned that the chain of events amounted to an effort to pile pressure on Kyiv and backtrack on years of U.S. promises to help fend off the Russian invasion, one of the Ukrainian officials said.
paras.zh: 一名乌克兰官员表示，乌克兰担心这一连串事件旨在向基辅施加压力，并让美国背弃多年来帮助抵御俄罗斯入侵的承诺。

paras.en: Ukraine relies heavily on U.S. intelligence and the Starshield satellite network to defend itself against Russian drone and missile attacks, as well as to target Russian forces with its own drones. A reduction in intelligence assistance or satellite access could seriously undermine Ukraine’s battlefield prospects just as winter sets in, according to military experts.
paras.zh: 乌克兰严重依赖美国情报和星盾卫星网络来防御俄罗斯无人机和导弹袭击，并用自己的无人机瞄准俄罗斯军队。军事专家表示，随着冬季的到来，情报援助或卫星接入的减少可能会严重损害乌克兰的战场前景。

paras.en: Ukrainian military officials were told by their U.S. counterparts that “if you will not stop [the energy strikes], we will block intelligence,” Zelenskyy said, according to the Financial Times, although the incident was subsequently presented to Kyiv as a technical glitch.
paras.zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，泽伦斯基表示，美国同行告诉乌克兰军方官员，“如果你们不停止（能源袭击），我们将封锁情报”，尽管该事件随后被作为技术故障提交给基辅。

paras.en: The withdrawal of the intelligence and the simultaneous weakening of Starlink satellite internet were “dangerous” for Ukraine, he told the newspaper, adding that fighting without the U.S. would be “very difficult.”
paras.zh: 他告诉该报，情报的撤回和星链卫星互联网的同时削弱对乌克兰来说是“危险的”，并补充说，没有美国的战斗将“非常困难”。

paras.en: In a separate interview with Piers Morgan on Wednesday, Zelenskyy acknowledged that he felt “betrayed” by Trump’s actions.
paras.zh: 周三，泽连斯基在接受皮尔斯·摩根的单独采访时承认，他觉得特朗普的行为“背叛了”他。

articles.title: Man in custody after allegedly stabbing woman
articles.author: Jess Scully

paras.en: Man charged after allegedly stabbing woman known to him at Leeton, in southern New South Wales
paras.zh: 一名男子因涉嫌在新南威尔士州南部的利顿刺伤了他认识的女子而被指控

paras.en: A woman is recovering after being allegedly stabbed several times in the head and torso by a man known to her on Thursday afternoon in the Riverina town of Leeton.
paras.zh: 周四下午，一名女子在里顿镇里维纳（Riverina）的利顿镇（Leeton）据称被一名认识的男子刺伤头部和躯干数次，目前正在康复中。

paras.en: Police arrested 38-year-old Rodney James Charles Tatt at a property in Wagga Wagga on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，警方在沃加沃加的一处房产中逮捕了 38 岁的罗德尼·詹姆斯·查尔斯·塔特 (Rodney James Charles Tatt)。

paras.en: Mr Tatt will face Griffith Local Court on December 9.
paras.zh: Tatt 先生将于 12 月 9 日在格里菲斯地方法院出庭受审。

articles.title: Labor pledges $30 toll cap as Coalition targets gas ban
articles.author: Sian Johnson and Alex Sinnott

paras.en: Labor pledges freeway toll cap, Coalition vows gas ban repeal
paras.zh: 工党承诺高速公路收费上限，联盟党誓言废除天然气禁令

paras.en: Victorian Labor has promised a $30 cap on freeway tolls if it wins the state election, mirroring a Coalition pledge outlining a $50 cap.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州工党承诺，如果赢得州选举，高速公路通行费上限为 30 美元，这与联盟党承诺的 50 美元上限相呼应。

paras.en: In a separate announcement, the Victorian Coalition pledged to repeal a ban on gas installations on new buildings within 100 days of winning office.
paras.zh: 在另一份声明中，维多利亚联盟承诺在上任后 100 天内废除在新建筑上安装天然气的禁令。

paras.en: Victorians will head to the polls on November 28.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州民众将于 11 月 28 日前往投票站。

articles.title: Violence forces lockdown, early closure of Perth agricultural show
articles.author: Lucy Murray and Greig Johnston

paras.en: Fighting between groups of youths forced a long-running Perth agricultural show into lockdown and an eventual early closure on Saturday evening.
paras.zh: 青年群体之间的争斗迫使一场长期举办的珀斯农业展被封锁，并最终于周六晚上提前关闭。

paras.en: The Kelmscott Agricultural Show is a family event that has been running for more than 100 years, and features rides, showbags, log-chopping events and livestock exhibitions.
paras.zh: 凯尔姆斯科特农业展是一项家庭活动，已有 100 多年的历史，包括游乐设施、展示袋、砍伐木材活动和牲畜展览。

paras.en: Police were called to the show on Saturday afternoon as dozens of youths tried to enter the venue at Rushton Park on River Road in Kelmscott.
paras.zh: 周六下午，当数十名年轻人试图进入凯尔姆斯科特河路拉什顿公园的演出场地时，警方接到报警。

paras.en: Kelmscott Agricultural Society president Daryl Dawes said fights between youths inside the showgrounds escalated throughout the day, before culminating in between 50 and 70 juveniles trying to enter the venue.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯科特农业协会主席达里尔·道斯 (Daryl Dawes) 表示，表演场地内青少年之间的打斗一整天都在升级，最终导致 50 至 70 名青少年试图进入场地。

paras.en: He said the show went into lockdown about 5pm on Saturday.
paras.zh: 他说节目于周六下午 5 点左右进入封锁状态。

paras.en: "Over the day we had some issues with youth coming in and causing fights on the grounds and it sort of escalated and grew and grew," Mr Dawes said.
paras.zh: 道斯先生说：“这一天，我们遇到了一些年轻人进来并在场地上引发打斗的问题，而且这种情况逐渐升级，而且越来越严重。”

paras.en: "We ejected people that were causing disruptions in the show and it built up, out on River Road it just got worse and worse so unfortunately we had to go into a lockdown.
paras.zh: “我们驱逐了那些对演出造成干扰的人，事情变得越来越严重，河路的情况变得越来越糟，所以不幸的是我们不得不进入封锁状态。

paras.en: "All of our gates got shut … physically padlocked shut until we had a police presence to deal with what was going on outside."
paras.zh: “我们所有的大门都关闭了……物理挂锁关闭，直到我们有警察来处理外面发生的事情。”

paras.en: Mr Dawes described the trouble as "disappointing", saying that it was the first time in his eight years as president of the society that the event had gone into lockdown.
paras.zh: 道斯先生将这次麻烦描述为“令人失望”，并表示这是他担任协会主席八年来第一次该活动被封锁。

paras.en: Mr Dawes said some of the juveniles were walking between the show's River Road entrance and it's Orlando Street entrance, looking for weak points and cutting fences and cable ties to try and gain entry.
paras.zh: 道斯先生说，一些青少年在演出的河路入口和奥兰多街入口之间行走，寻找薄弱点并剪断栅栏和扎带，试图进入。

paras.en: "Our security team did a great job ... anyone that got in was very quickly ejected," he said.
paras.zh: “我们的安全团队做得很好……任何进入的人都会很快被驱逐出去，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Dawes said the crowd dispersed quickly after police arrived.
paras.zh: 道斯先生说，警察到达后人群迅速散去。

paras.en: Police said they received reports of a large group of juveniles causing a disturbance at the show just after 4pm.
paras.zh: 警方表示，下午 4 点刚过，他们就接到报告称，一大群青少年在演出中制造骚乱。

paras.en: A police spokesperson said no charges had been laid, but one juvenile received a caution for disorderly behaviour.
paras.zh: 警方发言人表示，尚未提出任何指控，但一名青少年因扰乱秩序而受到警告。

articles.title: 1 in 4 Ebola deaths are children in Democratic Republic of Congo's worst outbreak
articles.author: Tashauna Reid, Alexandra Mae Jones

paras.en: 1 in 4 Ebola deaths are children in Democratic Republic of Congo's worst outbreak
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国疫情最严重的地区，埃博拉死亡人数中有四分之一是儿童

paras.en: With more than 9,200 confirmed cases and 4,400 deaths, children are vulnerable 'on so many levels'
paras.zh: 确诊病例超过 9,200 例，死亡人数超过 4,400 人，儿童“在很多层面上”都非常脆弱

paras.en: Outside of a treatment centre for Ebola in a northeastern corner of the Democratic Republic of Congo, as the country battles its worst outbreak on record, Neema Nyaloka bounces a baby on her lap.
paras.zh: 在刚果民主共和国东北角的埃博拉治疗中心外，当该国正在与有记录以来最严重的疫情作斗争时，尼玛·尼亚洛卡(Neema Nyaloka)把一个婴儿放在腿上。

paras.en: Nyaloka survived Ebola herself. Now, she works with UNICEF to take care of the droves of children isolating from their parents who are being treated for it.
paras.zh: 尼亚洛卡本人从埃博拉病毒中幸存下来。现在，她与联合国儿童基金会合作，照顾成群结队的与正在接受治疗的父母隔离的儿童。

paras.en: UNICEF is operating 12 other child-care centres next to treatment centres full of Ebola patients. Some kids are waiting for their parents to recover, but others have been left stranded after family members passed away.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会在挤满埃博拉患者的治疗中心旁边还运营着另外 12 个儿童保育中心。一些孩子正在等待父母康复，但另一些孩子则因家人去世而陷入困境。

paras.en: "We have children that are completely orphans, so they lost both parents," Lucia Elmi, director of global emergency programs at UNICEF, said last week.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会全球紧急项目主任露西娅·埃尔米上周表示：“我们的孩子完全是孤儿，因此他们失去了父母。”

paras.en: It's estimated that at least 1,900 children have been separated from their caregivers because of Ebola.
paras.zh: 据估计，至少有 1,900 名儿童因埃博拉病毒而与照顾者失散。

paras.en: It's just one more way that children are bearing the brunt of an outbreak which has spread to at least seven provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo, and outstripped the 2018-2020 outbreak to become the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history.
paras.zh: 这只是儿童在疫情中首当其冲的另一种方式，疫情已蔓延至刚果民主共和国至少七个省，并超过了 2018-2020 年的疫情，成为刚果历史上规模最大、最致命的埃博拉疫情。

paras.en: As of Oct. 15, more than 9,200 cases have been confirmed, while deaths have surpassed 4,400, according to the latest numbers from the D.R.C.'s public health institute.
paras.zh: 根据刚果民主共和国公共卫生研究所的最新数据，截至 10 月 15 日，已确诊病例超过 9,200 例，死亡人数超过 4,400 例。

paras.en: Just over a quarter of those deaths are children. Although most cases are among adults, children have a much higher fatality rate, at 60 per cent compared to 40 per cent for adults, the World Health Organization (WHO) estimates.
paras.zh: 其中超过四分之一是儿童。世界卫生组织 (WHO) 估计，尽管大多数病例发生在成人中，但儿童的死亡率要高得多，为 60%，而成人为 40%。

paras.en: Children walk by posters warning people about Ebola on June 24 in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo. (Daniel Buuma/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 6 月 24 日，刚果民主共和国戈马，孩子们走过警告人们注意埃博拉病毒的海报。 （丹尼尔·布玛/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "Children are really impacted by Ebola on so many levels," Amy Mina, a project leader from Canada with Save the Children, told CBC News.
paras.zh: “儿童确实在很多层面上受到埃博拉病毒的影响，”来自加拿大救助儿童会的项目负责人艾米·米娜告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。

paras.en: "Sixty-one per cent of the children who died of Ebola are under the age of five."
paras.zh: “死于埃博拉病毒的儿童中有 61% 年龄在五岁以下。”

paras.en: Children in the region already face high levels of malnutrition and displacement due to ongoing armed conflict.
paras.zh: 由于持续的武装冲突，该地区的儿童已经面临严重的营养不良和流离失所问题。

paras.en: The Ituri province in northeastern Congo, where Mina works, is where the outbreak began, and is still the heaviest-hit region, accounting for 73 per cent of cases.
paras.zh: 米娜工作的刚果东北部伊图里省是疫情爆发的地方，目前仍然是受灾最严重的地区，占病例的73%。

paras.en: - Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust
paras.zh: - 刚果埃博拉疫情因暴力和不信任导致超过 4,000 人死亡

paras.en: - As Congo Ebola deaths pass 3,000, officials seek to track spread via mobile data
paras.zh: - 随着刚果埃博拉死亡人数超过 3,000 人，官员们寻求通过移动数据追踪传播情况

paras.en: - Schools reopen despite concerns amid Congo's Ebola outbreak
paras.zh: - 尽管刚果埃博拉疫情令人担忧，学校仍重新开放

paras.en: Save the Children works with schools and communities to provide supplies and training for staff to recognize symptoms among their students. Every morning since schools opened, the temperatures of every teacher and student are checked as part of this work.
paras.zh: 救助儿童会与学校和社区合作，为工作人员提供用品和培训，以识别学生中的症状。开学以来，每天早上，我们都会对每位老师和学生进行体温测量，作为这项工作的一部分。

paras.en: But attendance has dropped, Mina says, because many parents worry schools could be transmission sites. They're also avoiding seeking treatment at the hospital for their children for other health issues out of fear of Ebola.
paras.zh: 但米娜说，出勤率有所下降，因为许多家长担心学校可能成为传播地点。由于担心埃博拉病毒，他们还避免为孩子因其他健康问题而去医院寻求治疗。

paras.en: "Children aren't only dying of Ebola," Mina said. "We are seeing a drop in the number of families and children visiting health centres … and children die of malaria, and dysentery and respiratory diseases."
paras.zh: “儿童不仅仅死于埃博拉病毒，”米娜说。 “我们看到前往医疗中心就诊的家庭和儿童数量有所下降……儿童死于疟疾、痢疾和呼吸道疾病。”

paras.en: Cholera is also seeing a rise in the west of the country, with more than 51,000 suspected cases reported since the beginning of 2026.
paras.zh: 该国西部地区霍乱疫情也有所增加，自 2026 年初以来报告了超过 51,000 例疑似病例。

paras.en: A 13-year-old student washes her hands outside her school in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Save the Children is working with schools during the Ebola outbreak, supplying infection-prevention kits and training teachers to counter misinformation about the disease. (Submitted/Save the Children)
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国，一名 13 岁的学生在学校外洗手。在埃博拉疫情爆发期间，救助儿童会正在与学校合作，提供感染预防工具包并培训教师以消除有关该疾病的错误信息。 （提交/救助儿童会）

paras.en: When children contract Ebola, they have to be entirely isolated to combat the disease just like adults are, interacting only with caretakers dressed head to toe in fully protective gear, which can be terrifying for kids, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，当儿童感染埃博拉病毒时，他们必须像成年人一样完全隔离以对抗这种疾病，只能与从头到脚穿着全套防护装备的看护人员互动，这对儿童来说可能是可怕的。

paras.en: Children are already vulnerable to viruses, with fewer reserves to fight off loss of fluids from illness, says Dr. Joanne Liu, director of the Pandemic and Emergency Readiness Lab at the School of Population and Global Health at McGill University. Liu, a pediatric emergency physician, led emergency responses during the 2014-2016 Ebola outbreak in west Africa.
paras.zh: 麦吉尔大学人口与全球健康学院流行病和紧急情况准备实验室主任乔安妮·刘（Joanne Liu）博士说，儿童本来就很容易受到病毒的感染，而用于抵抗疾病造成的体液流失的储备也较少。刘是一名儿科急诊医生，在 2014 年至 2016 年西非埃博拉疫情期间领导了应急响应工作。

paras.en: "Can you imagine fighting for your life on your own without your parents?" she said. "We know that that kind of isolation … creates emotional stress, agitation and irritability in the children."
paras.zh: “你能想象没有父母的帮助，独自为生活奋斗吗？”她说。 “我们知道，这种孤立……会给孩子们带来情绪压力、烦躁和易怒。”

paras.en: Amid the surge in Ebola, pregnant women are also avoiding clinics, missing prenatal care and choosing to deliver their babies at home.
paras.zh: 在埃博拉病毒激增的情况下，孕妇也避开诊所、错过产前护理并选择在家分娩。

paras.en: The UN says, compared to last year, maternal deaths in the region have nearly doubled.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，与去年相比，该地区孕产妇死亡人数几乎翻了一番。

paras.en: And most deaths from Ebola are happening outside of treatment centres, meaning medical workers can't fully track the chains of transmission to stop them.
paras.zh: 大多数埃博拉死亡病例发生在治疗中心之外，这意味着医务人员无法完全追踪传播链以阻止死亡。

paras.en: "They're dying at home, which represents a huge opportunity for more transmission because they're being cared for by their family, their community members," said Stephanie Hoffmann, a project co-ordinator with Doctors Without Borders in North Kivu, D.R.C.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国北基伍省无国界医生组织的项目协调员斯蒂芬妮·霍夫曼（Stephanie Hoffmann）说：“他们在家里死去，这代表了更多传播的巨大机会，因为他们受到家人和社区成员的照顾。”

paras.en: - Canada extends Ebola travel restrictions for another 30 days
paras.zh: - 加拿大将埃博拉病毒旅行限制再延长 30 天

paras.en: - Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: What's going on and why is the outbreak so alarming?
paras.zh: - 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉病毒：正在发生什么以及为什么疫情如此令人震惊？

paras.en: Part of the reason this has gotten so "out of control," she said, is because of the gutting of the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID), a foreign aid program dismantled in 2025 due to alleged inefficiency and wasteful spending, according to the Trump administration. Researchers have estimated that the shuttering of services has already caused the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people worldwide.
paras.zh: 她说，这种情况变得如此“失控”的部分原因是美国国际开发署 (USAID) 的崩溃，据特朗普政府称，该对外援助项目因涉嫌效率低下和支出浪费而于 2025 年被撤销。研究人员估计，服务的关闭已经导致全世界数十万人死亡。

paras.en: When USAID was operating in the region, cases of Ebola were detected earlier on, Hoffmann said, allowing for tracking and isolating. But with less funding and support, cases had already spread dangerously far by the time the outbreak was official.
paras.zh: 霍夫曼说，当美国国际开发署在该地区开展业务时，很早就发现了埃博拉病例，从而可以进行跟踪和隔离。但由于资金和支持较少，当疫情正式爆发时，病例已经危险地蔓延到很远的地方。

paras.en: "I can't say that with the current response, there's going to be an end in sight."
paras.zh: “我不能说以目前的反应来看，事情即将结束。”

paras.en: The U.S. announced Friday that it had struck a new deal to supply some of the world's poorest nations with maternal and child health supplies, including Congo, through UNICEF.
paras.zh: 美国周五宣布，已达成一项新协议，通过联合国儿童基金会向包括刚果在内的世界上一些最贫穷国家提供妇幼保健用品。

paras.en: The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain — a rare strain of Ebola for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, although clinical trials are underway.
paras.zh: 目前的疫情是由本迪布焦病毒株引起的，这是一种罕见的埃博拉病毒株，尽管临床试验正在进行中，但尚无批准的治疗方法或疫苗。

paras.en: Congo's deadly Ebola surge is second only to the 2014-2016 outbreak in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, which killed more than 11,000 people.
paras.zh: 刚果致命的埃博拉疫情激增仅次于2014-2016年在几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂爆发的埃博拉疫情，那次疫情导致11,000多人死亡。

paras.en: Two volunteers wearing personal protective equipment carry the coffin of a three-year-old child, presumed to have died of Ebola virus disease, in Bunia, D.R.C., on June 11. (Benediction Murhabazi/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 6 月 11 日，在刚果民主共和国布尼亚，两名穿着个人防护装备的志愿者抬着一名三岁儿童的棺材，该儿童被认为死于埃博拉病毒病。（Benediction Murhabazi/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: And it's affecting other regions as well. So far, two people have died of the virus in neighbouring Uganda, which declared itself Ebola free in August.
paras.zh: 它也影响到其他地区。到目前为止，邻国乌干达已有两人死于埃博拉病毒，该国于八月宣布消除埃博拉病毒。

paras.en: Three cases in Kenya are linked to Congo's outbreak — authorities confirmed the third patient on Friday, adding that she is a close relative of the first and second cases. The first case was a Kenyan man who died in early October in Kenya after returning from travelling in Congo.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚的三例病例与刚果的疫情爆发有关——当局周五确认了第三名患者，并补充说她是第一例和第二例病例的近亲。第一个病例是一名肯尼亚男子，他于10月初从刚果旅行返回后在肯尼亚死亡。

paras.en: - Kenya confirms 2nd case of Ebola in relative of patient who died earlier this month
paras.zh: - 肯尼亚确认第二例埃博拉病例，患者亲属于本月早些时候死亡

paras.en: - Kenya confirms 1st Ebola case imported from Congo
paras.zh: - 肯尼亚确认第一例从刚果输入的埃博拉病例

paras.en: Aid groups say while more treatment centres and funding are badly needed to address the health needs in the Democratic Republic of Congo, so is building trust and education.
paras.zh: 援助组织表示，虽然刚果民主共和国急需更多的治疗中心和资金来满足健康需求，但建立信任和教育也同样如此。

paras.en: "There's a lot of mistrust about the response in general," Hoffmann said. "People have a lot of mistrust and a lot of fear about how they'll be treated in a treatment centre. There is a lack of education and awareness about what happens to the body when you have Ebola, what happens in a treatment centre."
paras.zh: 霍夫曼说：“总体而言，人们对这种反应存在很多不信任。” “人们对自己在治疗中心受到的待遇抱有很大的不信任和恐惧。对于感染埃博拉病毒时身体会发生什么以及治疗中心会发生什么，人们缺乏教育和认识。”

paras.en: It's another battle health-care workers on the ground are fighting, as they desperately try to save lives.
paras.zh: 这是当地医护人员正在拼命拯救生命的另一场战斗。

articles.title: France shaken by fiery street protests uniting students, workers and 'yellow vests'

paras.en: France shaken by fiery street protests uniting students, workers and 'yellow vests'
paras.zh: 学生、工人和“黄背心”联合起来的激烈街头抗议活动震惊了法国

paras.en: What began over under-funded high schools has converged with a fierce anti-austerity movement
paras.zh: 从资金不足的高中开始的事情已经与激烈的反紧缩运动融合在一起

paras.en: France is about to wake up to an uneasy morning after.
paras.zh: 法国即将在一个不安的早晨醒来。

paras.en: On Saturday, the country saw massive — and unusually violent — cross-generational protests that brought together high schoolers, trade unions and "yellow vest" demonstrators, all choking the streets of Paris, Lille and other French cities.
paras.zh: 周六，法国发生了大规模且异常暴力的跨代抗议活动，高中生、工会和“黄背心”示威者聚集在一起，堵塞了巴黎、里尔和其他法国城市的街道。

paras.en: While many aspects of this day of protests were peaceful, there were also fierce confrontations between brick-throwing protesters dressed in black and police armed with water cannons and tear gas.
paras.zh: 虽然这一天的抗议活动在许多方面都是和平的，但身着黑衣的投掷砖块的抗议者与配备水炮和催泪瓦斯的警察之间也发生了激烈的对抗。

paras.en: The confrontations left parts of Paris looking like a war zone.
paras.zh: 这些对抗使巴黎部分地区看起来像战区。

paras.en: One minister estimated 400 people had been arrested, with 110,000 demonstrators in Paris alone. French TV aired video of businesses and retail stores that had been looted and the city's mayor said entire streets had been vandalized.
paras.zh: 一位部长估计已有 400 人被捕，仅巴黎就有 110,000 名示威者。法国电视台播放了企业和零售商店被抢劫的视频，该市市长表示整条街道都遭到破坏。

paras.en: While the tear gas and smoke from burning vehicles cleared relatively quickly, the violence will no doubt leave a deep scar on the city.
paras.zh: 虽然燃烧车辆产生的催泪瓦斯和烟雾相对较快地消散，但暴力事件无疑将给这座城市留下深深的伤痕。

paras.en: Saturday's events also speak to a deeper, more ideological cleavage over values, spending priorities and crucially, whether the French state should protect its economic standing, or its most vulnerable first.
paras.zh: 周六的事件还表明，在价值观、支出优先事项以及最重要的问题上，法国政府是否应该保护其经济地位，还是首先保护最脆弱的地位，存在更深层次、更具意识形态的分歧。

paras.en: What began weeks ago as high schoolers demanding repaired classroom boilers has transformed into an existential battle over the very definition of the French Republic.
paras.zh: 几周前，高中生要求修理教室锅炉的事件开始演变成一场围绕法兰西共和国定义的生死之战。

paras.en: "France is coming to a major turning point," Bally Bagayoko, the left-wing mayor of the working-class Paris suburb of Saint-Denis, told CBC News.
paras.zh: “法国即将迎来一个重大转折点，”巴黎工人阶级郊区圣但尼的左翼市长巴利·巴加约科 (Bally Bagayoko) 告诉 CBC 新闻。

paras.en: "Today, unfortunately, this France is in sadness. It is unable to provide concrete answers to the legitimate demands of high schoolers ... and the only concrete answer it can provide is a heavy handed police response.”
paras.zh: “不幸的是，今天，这个法国正处于悲伤之中。它无法为高中生的合法要求提供具体答案……而它能提供的唯一具体答案就是警方的严厉回应。”

paras.en: Over the last three weeks of the teenagers' protest, supporters have harshly criticized police tactics. One young person lost part of an arm during an especially violent confrontation and there were reports Saturday in Paris of other people enduring similar injuries.
paras.zh: 在过去三周的青少年抗议活动中，支持者严厉批评了警察的策略。一名年轻人在一场特别暴力的冲突中失去了一条手臂，周六有报道称巴黎其他人也遭受类似伤害。

paras.en: A view of the momument in La Place de la République after police fired tear gas at protesters to try to disperse the crowd. (Chris Brown/CBC News)
paras.zh: 警察向抗议者发射催泪瓦斯试图驱散人群后，共和广场上的纪念仪式。 （克里斯·布朗/CBC 新闻）

paras.en: The involvement of the yellow vest movement amplifies the stakes for France's government. Initially formed by disillusionsed working class voters nearly a decade ago to battle high fuel prices, the movement petered out during COVID lockdown. Its reconstitution now could help potentially transform the student's school-focussed protests into a cause with much longer staying power.
paras.zh: 黄背心运动的参与放大了法国政府的赌注。该运动最初是近十年前由失望的工人阶级选民发起的，旨在对抗高油价，但在新冠疫情封锁期间逐渐消失。现在它的重组可能有助于将学生以学校为中心的抗议活动转变为具有更长持久力的事业。

paras.en: In the aftermath of Saturday's violence, France's key political leaders were unanimous in their condemnation of the violence on the streets, and attempted to separate the instigators from those who were there peacefully.
paras.zh: 周六的暴力事件发生后，法国主要政治领导人一致谴责街头暴力，并试图将煽动者与和平在那里的人分开。

paras.en: "We will all stand united against the sowers of chaos, who seek only to bring down our institutions and prevent those who peacefully express their demands from doing so," posted French President Emmanuel Macron.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示：“我们将团结起来，反对制造混乱的人，他们只想摧毁我们的机构，并阻止那些和平表达诉求的人这样做。”

paras.en: The country's centrist Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu took a similar approach.
paras.zh: 该国中间派总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努也采取了类似的做法。

paras.en: "Today, ultra-left groups have orchestrated violence in several French cities; delinquents have joined in to pillage and destroy," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“今天，极左团体在法国几个城市策划了暴力事件；犯罪分子加入了掠夺和破坏的行列。”

paras.en: France's far-right party, the Rassemblement National (RN), rejected the protesters and their message, and instead praised the conduct of the security forces.
paras.zh: 法国极右翼政党国民联盟（RN）拒绝接受抗议者及其信息，而是赞扬了安全部队的行为。

paras.en: Mayor Bally Bagayoko represents the Paris subburb of Saint-Denis. He put himself between protesters and police at a student demonstration earlier this month. (Adrian Di Virgilio/CBC News)
paras.zh: 市长巴利·巴加约科代表巴黎圣但尼郊区。在本月早些时候的一次学生示威中，他将自己置于抗议者和警察之间。 （阿德里安·迪·维尔吉里奥/CBC 新闻）

paras.en: On the surface, the current crisis looks like a familiar French budget dispute.
paras.zh: 从表面上看，当前的危机看起来就像一场熟悉的法国预算争端。

paras.en: But on the ground, the view from inside the student movement reveals a toxic convergence of fiscal collapse, class warfare, systemic racism and a worrying escalation of state force.
paras.zh: 但从实际情况来看，学生运动内部的观点揭示了财政崩溃、阶级斗争、系统性种族主义和令人担忧的国家武力升级的有毒融合。

paras.en: In the days leading up to this weekend's mass protests, CBC News went inside the student movement in the northern city of Lille to better understand the issues driving it.
paras.zh: 在本周末大规模抗议活动之前的几天里，加拿大广播公司新闻频道深入了解了北部城市里尔的学生运动，以更好地了解推动这场运动的问题。

paras.en: Many of the organizers are very young — some just 14 years old. CBC News required their parents' permission to speak to them.
paras.zh: 许多组织者都很年轻——有些只有 14 岁。 CBC 新闻需要获得父母的许可才能与他们交谈。

paras.en: At the fences of Lycée Faidherbe, amidst the thick black smoke of smouldering plastic bins that some students had set ablaze, the teenagers' demands sounded immediate and concrete.
paras.zh: 在费代尔布高中的围墙外，一些学生点燃的塑料垃圾箱冒着浓浓的黑烟，青少年们的要求听起来既直接又具体。

paras.en: "We hope the school will be closed," Lille organizer Soan Rauch, 16, told CBC News, standing near the barricades.
paras.zh: “我们希望学校能够关闭，”16 岁的里尔组织者索恩·劳赫 (Soan Rauch) 站在路障附近告诉 CBC 新闻。

paras.en: Soan Rauch, 16, has taken a lead role organizing high schoolers in the city of Lille, France. (Jason Ho/CBC News)
paras.zh: 16 岁的索恩·劳奇 (Soan Rauch) 在组织法国里尔市的高中生方面发挥了带头作用。 （杰森·何/CBC新闻）

paras.en: When asked why shutting down their own education is a victory, his fellow classmate, 15-year-old James Caron, didn't hesitate.
paras.zh: 当被问及为什么关闭自己的教育是一种胜利时，他的同学、15 岁的詹姆斯·卡伦 (James Caron) 毫不犹豫。

paras.en: "It helps put pressure on the government," Caron said. "Because if everything is burning, the government can't ignore us."
paras.zh: “这有助于向政府施加压力，”卡伦说。 “因为如果一切都在燃烧，政府就不能忽视我们。”

paras.en: While conservative critics have attempted to dismiss the movement as the political manipulation of minors by populist left-wing politicians, independent analysts say the teenagers' grievances are grounded in real, physical decline.
paras.zh: 尽管保守派批评人士试图将这场运动斥为民粹主义左翼政客对未成年人的政治操纵，但独立分析人士表示，青少年的不满源于实际的身体衰退。

paras.en: "Actually, they do understand what they're doing, and they're not manipulated," Blanche Leridon, a political analyst with the Paris-based think-tank Institut Montaigne, told CBC News.
paras.zh: 巴黎智库蒙田研究所的政治分析师布兰奇·莱里登 (Blanche Leridon) 告诉 CBC 新闻：“事实上，他们确实了解自己在做什么，而且没有被操纵。”

paras.en: "There is a huge topic about the deterioration of the condition of education, and deterioration of their buildings. [Teachers] are missing and it's really hard for them to learn in good conditions."
paras.zh: “教育条件的恶化和建筑物的恶化是一个很大的话题。[老师]失踪了，他们很难在良好的条件下学习。”

paras.en: Rauch took CBC News to Lycée Fénelon, his shuttered school, pointing out student-painted banners demanding "respect" written in multiple languages.
paras.zh: 劳赫带着 CBC 新闻前往他已关闭的学校费内隆中学 (Lycée Fénelon)，指出学生用多种语言绘制的要求“尊重”的横幅。

paras.en: Beyond the political slogans, he said that the daily reality inside French public classrooms has become untenable.
paras.zh: 他说，除了政治口号之外，法国公共课堂内的日常现实已经变得站不住脚。

paras.en: "We ask for classrooms that are much less crowded — we are 35 students per class," said Rauch. "More particularly, we have problems with hallways and thermal boilers. It means that it's very hot in summer and very, very cold in winter."
paras.zh: “我们要求教室不那么拥挤——每个班有 35 名学生，”Rauch 说。 “更具体地说，我们在走廊和热锅炉方面存在问题。这意味着夏天非常热，冬天非常非常冷。”

paras.en: French riot police stand in position amid clashes with protesters during a demonstration at La Place de la République in Paris. (Abdul Saboor/Reuters)
paras.zh: 在巴黎共和国广场的示威活动中，法国防暴警察在与抗议者的冲突中坚守岗位。 （阿卜杜勒·萨布尔/路透社）

paras.en: As the student disruptions have rippled across the nation, the Macron government attempted to quell the anger by offering a temporary package consisting of thousands of new substitute teachers. The student unions swiftly dismissed the proposal, calling it an empty gesture.
paras.zh: 随着学生骚乱波及全国，马克龙政府试图通过提供由数千名新代课教师组成的临时方案来平息愤怒。学生会很快驳回了这一提议，称其为空谈。

paras.en: Mayor Bagayoko argues that this structural neglect is concentrated heavily in diverse, working-class communities plagued by high unemployment, like Saint-Denis, which sits at a staggering 35 per cent jobless rate.
paras.zh: 巴加约科市长认为，这种结构性忽视主要集中在受高失业率困扰的多元化工薪阶层社区，比如圣但尼，失业率高达 35%。

paras.en: "When you grow up in the working-class neighbourhoods, you are treated less well than in the beautiful Parisian neighbourhoods," said Bagayoko.
paras.zh: “当你在工人阶级社区长大时，你所受到的待遇不如美丽的巴黎社区好，”巴加约科说。

paras.en: "All the children of France must be treated equally."
paras.zh: “法国的所有儿童都必须受到平等对待。”

paras.en: The Macron administration continues to claim its hands are tied, pointing to a crushing sovereign debt crisis and severe warnings from global credit rating agencies.
paras.zh: 马克龙政府继续声称自己束手无策，指出严重的主权债务危机和全球信用评级机构的严厉警告。

paras.en: But inside the student strategy meetings that CBC News sat in on, that economic narrative is rejected as a corporate myth.
paras.zh: 但在 CBC 新闻参加的学生战略会议中，这种经济叙事被视为企业神话而被拒绝。

paras.en: "I don't think the government should reduce its social spending, but they should rather try to increase [it]," argued 14-year-old Lille student Bastien Duprez. "And probably decrease budgets to, for example, budgets to the army and, for instance, subsidies to big corporations.”
paras.zh: 14 岁的里尔学生巴斯蒂安·杜普雷 (Bastien Duprez) 表示：“我认为政府不应该减少社会支出，而应该尝试增加社会支出。” “并且可能会减少预算，例如对军队的预算，以及对大公司的补贴。”

paras.en: "We know that a lot of money from the government goes to rich people," added Alice Note, 17. "So we also think that the money that the rich people have will go to us, to education."
paras.zh: “我们知道政府的很多钱都流向了富人，”17 岁的爱丽丝·诺特 (Alice Note) 补充道，“所以我们也认为富人拥有的钱会流向我们，用于教育。”

paras.en: Leridon, the French political analyst, sees France as a country stuck in an economic vice.
paras.zh: 法国政治分析家莱里东认为法国是一个陷入经济困境的国家。

paras.en: "We are really aware of the specific difficulties we have regarding our debt or deficits ... but [people] are not prepared to make any sacrifices. They don't want higher taxes, they don't want to work longer," she said.
paras.zh: “我们确实意识到我们在债务或赤字方面遇到的具体困难......但[人们]不准备做出任何牺牲。他们不想要更高的税收，他们不想工作更长时间，”她说。

paras.en: Masked protesters walk past burning barricades amid clashes in Paris. (Jack Taylor/Reuters)
paras.zh: 在巴黎的冲突中，蒙面抗议者走过燃烧的路障。 （杰克·泰勒/路透社）

paras.en: This clash of priorities has translated into an exceptionally aggressive law-and-order response.
paras.zh: 这种优先事项的冲突已转化为异常激进的治安应对措施。

paras.en: Prior to the weekend, more than 8,000 high school students had been arrested nationwide, the vast majority of them minors. Mayor Bagayoko claims hospital rooms continue to fill up with teenagers suffering from broken jaws, fractured limbs, and severe chemical gas inhalation.
paras.zh: 周末之前，全国已有 8000 多名高中生被捕，其中绝大多数是未成年人。巴加约科市长称，医院病房里继续挤满了下巴骨折、四肢骨折和严重吸入化学气体的青少年。

paras.en: The protest line violence became so intense that on Oct. 6 in Paris, he physically placed his own body between charging riot police and fleeing high schoolers during a protest at Place de la Nation.
paras.zh: 抗议线上的暴力变得如此激烈，以至于10月6日，在巴黎民族广场的一次抗议活动中，他将自己的身体挡在冲锋的防暴警察和逃跑的高中生之间。

paras.en: "I made the choice to intervene by trying as much as possible to protect the high schoolers first, because I remember that they were minors," Bagayoko said.
paras.zh: 巴加约科说：“我选择进行干预，首先尽可能保护高中生，因为我记得他们是未成年人。”

paras.en: The video of his intervention flashed around the country, transforming him into a central figure in the ongoing crisis.
paras.zh: 他的干预视频在全国各地流传，使他成为这场持续危机的核心人物。

paras.en: France is less than six months away from a pivotal presidential election.
paras.zh: 法国距离关键的总统选举还有不到六个月的时间。

paras.en: With the centrist government entirely paralyzed and unable to pass a budget through a deeply fractured Parliament, the political void is rapidly being filled by the far right.
paras.zh: 由于中间派政府完全瘫痪，无法在严重分裂的议会中通过预算，政治真空正迅速被极右翼填补。

paras.en: Marine Le Pen, who will be the Rassemblement National's candidate in the upcoming presidential election this spring, appears to be in a commanding position. She has called for strengthened anti-riot legislation and largely ignored the issues at the centre of the student's complaints, instead focusing on the need to restore order on the streets.
paras.zh: 玛丽娜·勒庞将作为国民联盟候选人参加今年春天即将举行的总统选举，她似乎处于主导地位。她呼吁加强防暴立法，并在很大程度上忽视了学生投诉的核心问题，而是将重点放在恢复街道秩序的必要性上。

paras.en: For the teenagers holding the barricades, a right-wing takeover isn't just a political shift, it's a direct threat to their safety.
paras.zh: 对于守卫路障的青少年来说，右翼接管不仅仅是政治转变，更是对他们安全的直接威胁。

paras.en: "We're afraid. We have a lot of fear," Rauch admitted. "We don't know what's going to happen tomorrow.
paras.zh: “我们很害怕。我们有很多恐惧，”劳奇承认。 “我们不知道明天会发生什么。

articles.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery

paras.en: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery
paras.zh: 教皇利奥在肺癌手术后返回梵蒂冈

paras.en: Surgeon says pontiff should be fit for upcoming Latin American tour
paras.zh: 外科医生表示教皇应该适合即将到来的拉丁美洲之行

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV returned to the Vatican on Saturday days after lung cancer surgery, as his surgeon said there are "no clinical reasons" to prevent his planned trip to Latin America next month.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世在肺癌手术后几天返回梵蒂冈，他的外科医生表示“没有临床原因”阻止他下个月计划的拉丁美洲之行。

paras.en: "The Holy Father has put his heart and soul into his recovery," Dr. Stefano Margaritora told Vatican News, adding that he expected the pope to recover fully from surgery "in another 10 days or so."
paras.zh: 斯特凡诺·马加里托拉博士告诉梵蒂冈新闻：“教宗全心全意地致力于康复。”他补充说，他预计教皇“再过十天左右”就能从手术中完全康复。

paras.en: Leo, 71, is scheduled to make an ambitious Nov. 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Peru and Argentina, including a dozen flights and two helicopter rides to high altitudes.
paras.zh: 71 岁的 Leo 计划于 11 月 6 日至 17 日进行一次雄心勃勃的旅行，前往乌拉圭、秘鲁和阿根廷，其中包括十几次飞行和两架直升机飞往高海拔地区。

paras.en: "As for a long trip involving air travel in about three weeks, I would say there are no clinical reasons why it should not take place," Margaritora said.
paras.zh: 马加里托拉说：“至于大约三周内涉及航空旅行的长途旅行，我认为没有任何临床原因不应该进行。”

paras.en: Leo had the lower lobe of his right lung removed on Tuesday in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer. He left the hospital on Saturday, well ahead of the weeklong hospital stay the Vatican had initially anticipated.
paras.zh: 周二，利奥的右肺下叶被切除，这是他就任教皇 17 个月以来的第一次重大健康事件。手术证实他患有腺癌，这是最常见的肺癌类型。他于周六出院，远远早于梵蒂冈最初预计的为期一周的住院时间。

paras.en: "I am much better, thank you," the pope said when asked how he was as he was driven away in a black SUV.
paras.zh: 当被问及他被一辆黑色SUV开走时，教皇说：“我好多了，谢谢。”

paras.en: Leo greeted patients inside the hospital accompanied by his surgeon, before waving to well-wishers outside who cried out "Holiness" as he walked to a waiting vehicle.
paras.zh: 利奥在外科医生的陪同下向医院内的病人致意，然后向外面的祝福者挥手致意，当他走向一辆等候的车辆时，祝福者高呼“神圣”。

paras.en: He paused when a 13-year-old Ukrainian girl presented him with a homemade papal doll that she said had helped her through successful cancer treatment. She had briefly met Leo at an audience in St. Peter's Square last December — an encounter she told reporters "gave her the strength to overcome the illness."
paras.zh: 当一名 13 岁的乌克兰女孩向他赠送了一个自制的教皇娃娃时，他停了下来，她说这个娃娃帮助她成功治疗了癌症。去年12月，她在圣彼得广场的观众席上短暂见到了利奥——她告诉记者，这次会面“给了她战胜疾病的力量”。

paras.en: Since the surgery, Leo has shown signs of recovering well. He had a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin, held meetings with senior aides and celebrated mass in a makeshift hospital chapel.
paras.zh: 手术后，利奥表现出恢复良好的迹象。他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通了电话，与高级助手举行了会议，并在临时医院教堂举行了弥撒。

paras.en: He will take on his first official duty on Sunday, delivering the traditional Angelus blessing to the faithful in St. Peter's Square. It comes exactly one week after the pontiff revealed to throngs in the square that the nodule had been found and would be surgically removed — an unusually candid revelation for the Vatican.
paras.zh: 他将于周日开始他的首次公务，为圣彼得广场的信徒提供传统的三钟经祝福。就在一周前，教皇向广场上的人群透露，该结节已经被发现，并将通过手术切除——这对梵蒂冈来说是一个不同寻常的坦率透露。

paras.en: Margaritora, the chief thoracic surgeon at Rome's Gemelli hospital, also confirmed that the nodule was discovered by chance during routine abdominal examinations. It appeared as "a small spot" at the base of the lung, which extends down to the diaphragm, he said.
paras.zh: 罗马Gemelli医院的首席胸外科医生马加里托拉也证实，这个结节是在例行腹部检查时偶然发现的。他说，它看起来像是肺底部的“一个小点”，向下延伸到膈肌。

paras.en: He added that if the spot had been higher up, "it certainly would not have been seen."
paras.zh: 他补充说，如果这个地方在更高的地方，“肯定不会被看到。”

paras.en: The cancer was in its early stages, and the pope had "no respiratory symptoms, and felt perfectly well," Margaritora said.
paras.zh: 马加里托拉说，癌症处于早期阶段，教皇“没有呼吸道症状，感觉很好”。

paras.en: He described Tuesday's procedure to remove the lobe as "routine" and "without complications," but acknowledged that it "stirred deep feelings ... to operate on a pope, who for the first time — at least in modern history — is undergoing surgery for a malignant tumour."
paras.zh: 他称周二的肺叶切除手术是“例行公事”且“没有并发症”，但他承认，“对教皇进行手术激起了深深的感情……至少在现代历史上，教皇第一次接受恶性肿瘤手术。”

paras.en: The Vatican did not disclose that the tumour was malignant until after Tuesday's successful surgery. It later confirmed that the pope had undergone a biopsy before being admitted to Gemelli. Experts say the state-of-the-art Ion robotic bronchoscopy would have indicated whether the tumour was malignant and possibly whether cancer had spread to the lymph nodes.
paras.zh: 直到周二成功手术后，梵蒂冈才透露肿瘤是恶性的。后来证实，教皇在被送进 Gemelli 医院之前接受了活检。专家表示，最先进的离子机器人支气管镜检查可以表明肿瘤是否是恶性的，以及癌症是否已经扩散到淋巴结。

paras.en: Histological testing of the tumour and related lymph nodes was underway. The results, along with details of the tumour's molecular and genetic makeup, will help doctors determine whether the pope needs additional treatment. Options include chemotherapy, a combination of chemotherapy and immunotherapy, or targeted oral therapy based on the tumour's genetic characteristics.
paras.zh: 肿瘤和相关淋巴结的组织学检测正在进行中。结果以及肿瘤分子和基因组成的详细信息将帮助医生确定教皇是否需要额外治疗。选择包括化疗、化疗和免疫治疗相结合，或根据肿瘤的遗传特征进行靶向口服治疗。

paras.en: Margaritora said the pope's recovery so far had required "very little assistance from us."
paras.zh: 马加里托拉表示，到目前为止，教皇的康复只需要“我们提供的帮助很少”。

paras.en: "His determination to recover quickly has been effective in every respect. It was truly commendable," the surgeon said.
paras.zh: “他迅速康复的决心在各个方面都发挥了作用。这确实值得称赞，”外科医生说。

articles.title: Oregon school shooting: Police praise 'heroism' of those who intervened to stop more killing

paras.en: Police in the northwestern US state of Oregon have identified a teenage gunman who shot dead four people at a school as a former special needs student there, while praising people who stepped in to stop more killings.
paras.zh: 美国西北部俄勒冈州警方确认，一名在学校开枪打死四人的青少年枪手曾是该校的一名特殊需要学生，同时赞扬了那些介入阻止更多杀戮的人们。

paras.en: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 lost their lives in Thursday's rampage, along with a 25-year-old female teacher, before the shooter was shot dead by a father of two pupils at the school, located in the town of Bend.
paras.zh: 周四的枪击事件中，三名年龄分别为 5 岁、8 岁和 11 岁的儿童以及一名 25 岁的女教师丧生，枪手在位于本德镇的学校被两名学生的父亲开枪打死。

paras.en: Another young child and a teacher were also injured in the attack.
paras.zh: 另一名幼儿和一名老师也在袭击中受伤。

paras.en: Who intervened to prevent more deaths in Oregon?
paras.zh: 谁进行干预以防止俄勒冈州出现更多死亡？

paras.en: A man in a vehicle outside the school who was shot at and missed by the 16-year-old gunman was the first to alert police to the danger.
paras.zh: 学校外车内的一名男子被 16 岁枪手开枪射击，但没有击中，他是第一个向警方发出危险警报的人。

paras.en: Before they arrived, however, a female teacher tackled the shooter after he had already killed the victims with a pump-action 12-gauge shotgun in the school's special needs classroom.
paras.zh: 然而，在他们到达之前，一名女教师在枪手已经在学校的特殊需要教室里用泵动式 12 号霰弹枪杀死了受害者后，制服了枪手。

paras.en: While the two wrestled with each other, a man identified by family as Kaylub Giamanco, a 36-year-old father of two girls at the school, rushed in with his legally held weapon and shot the gunman dead.
paras.zh: 当两人扭打在一起时，一名被家人确认为凯鲁布·贾曼科 (Kaylub Giamanco) 的男子持合法持有的武器冲进来，将枪手击毙。凯鲁布·贾曼科是学校两个女孩的父亲，36 岁。

paras.en: "He heard shooting and saw a teacher involved in a physical altercation with the suspect ... and fired his weapon, striking the suspect multiple times," Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz told reporters.
paras.zh: 本德警察局长迈克·克兰茨告诉记者：“他听到枪声，看到一名老师与嫌疑人发生肢体冲突……他开枪，多次击中嫌疑人。”

paras.en: "When someone is willing to risk their own life for others, we recognize that. The teacher who is willing to stand and fight for her children ... incredible. That is true heroism, and we don't see that a lot in society," he said.
paras.zh: “当有人愿意为他人冒生命危险时，我们认识到这一点。愿意为孩子们挺身而战的老师......令人难以置信。这是真正的英雄主义，我们在社会上并不多见，”他说。

paras.en: Praise from Trump as gun control debate revived
paras.zh: 枪支管制辩论重燃特朗普称赞

paras.en: Giamanco's mother told the local branch of Fox News that she was "very proud" and that her son was "an absolute hero."
paras.zh: 贾曼科的母亲告诉福克斯新闻当地分社，她“非常自豪”，她的儿子是“绝对的英雄”。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump also hailed Giamanco's actions.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也对贾曼科的行动表示赞赏。

paras.en: "It's a terrible thing, but thank goodness for a man that had a gun and knew how to use it," he told reporters.
paras.zh: “这是一件可怕的事情，但谢天谢地，这个人有枪并且知道如何使用它，”他告诉记者。

paras.en: The shooting in Bend has triggered the usual responses from both sides in the everlasting debate about gun control laws in the US.
paras.zh: 本德枪击案引发了美国枪支管制法旷日持久的争论中双方的惯常反应。

paras.en: The National Rifle Association (NRA), one of the main and most powerful opponents of tighter laws on the possession of weapons by civilians, hailed the actions of the armed bystander.
paras.zh: 全国步枪协会（NRA）是对平民拥有武器实施更严格法律的主要和最有力的反对者之一，它对武装旁观者的行为表示欢迎。

paras.en: "Yesterday's terrible act of violence in Oregon serves as another reminder of the importance of a law-abiding armed citizenry," the NRA said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 全国步枪协会在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“昨天俄勒冈州发生的可怕暴力行为再次提醒我们，守法的武装公民的重要性。”

paras.en: Gun control advocates, however, once more condemned the relative ease with which firearms can be procured in the US, which they see as the main factor in the country's high rate of gun-related deaths compared with most other developed countries.
paras.zh: 然而，枪支管制倡导者再次谴责在美国购买枪支相对容易，他们认为与大多数其他发达国家相比，这是该国枪支相关死亡率较高的主要因素。

paras.en: "America's gun violence crisis is killing our babies. Enough is enough," gun-control group GIFFORDS said.
paras.zh: “美国的枪支暴力危机正在杀死我们的婴儿。我们受够了，”枪支管制组织吉福德说。

paras.en: According to an analysis by the education information portal Education Week, there have been 26 shootings at US schools so far this year that have resulted in injuries or deaths.
paras.zh: 据教育资讯门户网站《教育周刊》分析，今年以来美国学校已发生26起枪击事件，造成人员伤亡。

paras.en: More than 360 mass shootings have been recorded across the country this year, according to the Gun Violence Archive.
paras.zh: 根据枪支暴力档案馆的数据，今年全国各地记录了 360 多起大规模枪击事件。

paras.en: It defines mass shootings as incidents in which at least four people are shot, excluding the shooter.
paras.zh: 它将大规模枪击事件定义为除枪手之外至少有四人被枪击的事件。
