paras.en: The squid populations in the Falklands waters, on which his company and the islands rely, are hugely variable and it is clear that “catches are declining”, he said. “We have commissioned a bunch of inshore work to see what is happening but the answer is that we don’t yet know,” he said. But there is another natural resource on which the islanders’ hopes are pinned.
paras.zh: 他说，他的公司和岛屿所依赖的福克兰群岛水域的鱿鱼数量变化很大，而且很明显“捕获量正在下降”。 “我们已经委托进行了一系列近岸工作来看看正在发生什么，但答案是我们还不知道，”他说。但岛民们的希望还寄托在另一种自然资源上。

paras.en: About 136 miles north of the Falkland Islands, work is continuing at pace on the Sea Lion oil project led by Israeli firm Navitas and its British partner, Rockhopper Exploration.
paras.zh: 位于福克兰群岛以北约 136 英里处，由以色列公司 Navitas 及其英国合作伙伴 Rockhopper Exploration 牵头的海狮石油项目的工作正在稳步推进。

paras.en: Independent estimates suggest the offshore oil field could triple the Falkland Islands’ GDP and deliver a Norway-style sovereign wealth fund. The companies involved remain confident that drilling will commence within months. A new jetty is busy with activity. But the impact of Argentinian pressure cannot be discounted. Two major contractors recently pulled out of the project.
paras.zh: 独立估计表明，海上油田可以使福克兰群岛的国内生产总值增加两倍，并建立挪威式的主权财富基金。相关公司仍然对钻探将在几个月内开始充满信心。新码头正忙于活动。但阿根廷压力的影响不容忽视。两家主要承包商最近退出了该项目。

paras.en: Andrea Clausen, as chief executive of the Falklands government, its top civil servant, works from a building on Thatcher Drive. Her office is opposite the room where Brig Gen Mario Menéndez signed Argentina’s letter of surrender on 14 June 1982. The letter remains on the wall.
paras.zh: 安德里亚·克劳森（Andrea Clausen）是福克兰群岛政府的首席执行官，也是其最高公务员，在撒切尔大道上的一栋大楼里工作。她的办公室位于马里奥·梅南德斯准将于 1982 年 6 月 14 日签署阿根廷投降书的房间对面。这封信至今还挂在墙上。

paras.en: Clausen was 10 at the time of the invasion and remembers the Argentinian solders’ arrival. She also recalls cowering with her family in their home in Goose Green, 60 miles west of Stanley, as the British Harrier jets came in with their cluster bombs. “Even now I struggle to cope with the sound of fast jets,” she said.
paras.zh: 入侵时克劳森只有 10 岁，他还记得阿根廷士兵的到来。她还回忆起，当英国鹞式喷气式飞机携带集束炸弹飞来时，她和家人躲在斯坦利以西 60 英里古斯格林的家中。 “即使是现在，我仍难以应对快速喷气式飞机的声音，”她说。

paras.en: Clausen sees trauma throughout the islands. “I guess, some extreme behaviour,” she said. “Anger, aggression on certain political subjects.” She is evidently frustrated by the recent Argentinian actions.
paras.zh: 克劳森在整个岛屿上都看到了创伤。 “我猜是一些极端行为，”她说。 “对某些政治话题的愤怒和攻击。”她显然对阿根廷最近的行动感到沮丧。

paras.en: “The Falklands has since [19]82 ensured that we are financially independent – save for defence,” she said. “We had no money in 82 and we never want to be in that position again.”
paras.zh: “自[19]82以来，福克兰群岛一直确保我们在经济上独立——除了国防之外，”她说。 “我们在 82 年没有钱，我们再也不想陷入那样的境地了。”

paras.en: The oil is their insurance, she suggested. “I like to think that better people will de-escalate this because, honestly, we are 4,000 people minding our own business, we have a history deeper and older than theirs.”
paras.zh: 她建议说，石油是他们的保险。 “我认为更好的人会缓和局势，因为说实话，我们有 4,000 名员工，各司其职，我们的历史比他们更深厚、更悠久。”

paras.en: There are cycles to Argentinian bellicosity. The opportunistic but ill-fated invasion ordered by Argentina’s dictator general Leopoldo Galtieri, leading to the death of 649 Argentinians and 255 British military personnel, along with three islanders, has cast a pall over Argentinian-UK relations ever since.
paras.zh: 阿根廷人的好战情绪是有周期的。阿根廷独裁将军莱奥波尔多·加尔铁里 (Leopoldo Galtieri) 下令发动机会主义但命运多舛的入侵，导致 649 名阿根廷人和 255 名英国军人以及三名岛民死亡，自此给阿根廷与英国的关系蒙上了一层阴影。

paras.en: But at times, notably in the 1990s, Buenos Aires adopted a hearts-and-minds approach to the islanders, sending videos of the animated series Pingu to their children. Such kindness has tended to evaporate away, though, when an Argentinian government is losing public support at home, as Milei is experiencing now.
paras.zh: 但有时，尤其是在 20 世纪 90 年代，布宜诺斯艾利斯对岛民采取了一种以心换心的方式，向他们的孩子们发送动画系列《Pingu》的视频。然而，当阿根廷政府像米莱现在所经历的那样，在国内失去公众支持时，这种善意往往会消失。

paras.en: But if any one attribute sums up the islanders, it is resilience, said Dot Gould, an assembly member who owns Pebble, a 20-mile long island north-west of the Falklands. She and her husband share the island with a couple who run a lodge, 5,000 sheep, 100 cattle, a load of spectacular wildlife, but not much else.
paras.zh: 但拥有圆石岛（位于福克兰群岛西北部、长 20 英里的岛屿）的议会议员多特·古尔德 (Dot Gould) 表示，如果用任何一个特质来概括岛民的话，那就是韧性。她和她的丈夫与一对经营旅馆的夫妇共享这个岛屿，他们饲养着 5,000 只羊、100 头牛、大量壮观的野生动物，但除此之外就没有其他的了。

paras.en: Rampaging around the undulating terrain in her 4x4 vehicle, avoiding colonies of Rockhopper and Gentoo penguins, Gould points out the scattered remains of an Argentinian fighter jet and the graves of two of the airmen killed during battle. As a child on Pebble, she used to play with the parachutes left by the Argentinians, using them as sails for a go-kart.
paras.zh: 古尔德开着四驱车在起伏的地形上横冲直撞，避开了跳岩企鹅和巴布亚企鹅的群落，她指出了一架阿根廷战斗机散落的残骸和两名在战斗中阵亡的飞行员的坟墓。小时候，她在圆石滩上玩过阿根廷人留下的降落伞，用它们作为卡丁车的帆。

paras.en: “I think, since 1982, this is probably the most serious it’s been for us,” she said. “How effective they will be, we don’t know yet … it’s almost two fingers up: we’ll get on with it, we have to.” But there is much that they want to do.
paras.zh: “我认为，自 1982 年以来，这可能是我们经历的最严重的一次，”她说。 “我们还不知道它们的效果如何……几乎举起了两根手指：我们会继续下去，我们必须这样做。”但他们想做的事情还有很多。

paras.en: The islands are dependent on a narrow range of freight links from the UK and South America for much of their fresh produce. Any glitch, and peculiar shortages can emerge. There was a period without milk. A time without beer. During one cherry tomato shortage, which saw their price shoot up, the main supermarket opted to cut them in half and sell them like that to spread the joy.
paras.zh: 这些岛屿的大部分新鲜农产品依赖于来自英国和南美洲的有限货运线路。任何故障和特殊的短缺都可能出现。有一段时间没有奶。没有啤酒的时代。在一次樱桃番茄短缺期间，其价格飙升，主要超市选择将其切成两半并以这种方式出售，以传播欢乐。

paras.en: A sorry-looking cabbage will set you back £8 at the West Store on the front. The local newspaper is the Penguin News (“This one’s not for Penguin News but …” is the traditional opening when disseminating islands gossip). But Facebook is the key means of communication. “Grown men and women use Snapchat like teenagers, often to arrange their extramarital affairs,” said one local.
paras.zh: 在前面的 West Store 里，一棵看起来很糟糕的卷心菜要花 8 英镑。当地报纸是《企鹅新闻》（“这不是企鹅新闻，而是……”是传播岛屿八卦时的传统开场白）。但 Facebook 是主要的沟通方式。 “成年男女像青少年一样使用 Snapchat，通常是为了安排婚外情，”一位当地人说道。

paras.en: Other peculiarities include the Falklands government paying for children from the age of 16 to complete their secondary and university education in the UK. The size of the islands’ population makes it impractical to offer such levels of education at home, said Sarah Stannard, the islands’ director of education.
paras.zh: 其他特色包括福克兰群岛政府资助 16 岁以上的儿童在英国完成中学和大学教育。群岛教育总监莎拉·斯坦纳德 (Sarah Stannard) 表示，群岛的人口规模使得在国内提供如此水平的教育是不切实际的。

paras.en: But if the oil money comes online, she would rebuild the primary school. Children from the countryside – it is known locally as “camp” – are offered board in Stanley, although there are also peripatetic teachers and lessons done on the telephone.
paras.zh: 但如果石油资金到位，她就会重建小学。来自乡村（当地被称为“营地”）的孩子可以在斯坦利获得食宿，但也有四处走动的老师并通过电话上课。

paras.en: The children grow up quickly here, and tend to be keen to broaden their horizons. Oliver Lee, 15, was keen to join the merchant navy. “I would like to see other places,” he said. “The Mediterranean, hotter places basically.” Layla-May Vatemanu, 14, said: “A lot of the boys especially in my class do a lot of sport. Our [friendship group] doesn’t have a lot to do.”
paras.zh: 孩子们在这里成长得很快，而且往往渴望开阔视野。 15 岁的奥利弗·李 (Oliver Lee) 渴望加入商船队。 “我还想看看其他地方，”他说。 “地中海，基本上是更热的地方。” 14 岁的莱拉-梅·瓦特马努 (Layla-May Vatemanu) 说：“很多男孩，尤其是我班的男孩，都做很多运动。我们的[友谊小组]没有太多事情可做。”

paras.en: There are no bus services anywhere, and the more distant parts of the islands are only accessible via boat or the Falkland government’s twin-engine aircraft service. On a landmass half the size of Wales, there is only one cashpoint.
paras.zh: 任何地方都没有巴士服务，岛屿较远的地方只能乘船或福克兰政府的双引擎飞机服务到达。在相当于威尔士一半大小的土地上，只有一个自动取款机。

paras.en: Touch rugby – rather than full-contact rugby – is played, in part because the islands’ hospital does not have the capability to deal with complex injuries. Much of the health budget goes on medi-evacs to South America. Yet, for all that, most of the children who leave at 16 do return.
paras.zh: 比赛采用接触式橄榄球，而不是全接触式橄榄球，部分原因是岛上的医院没有能力处理复杂的伤病。大部分卫生预算用于向南美运送医疗物资。然而，尽管如此，大多数 16 岁离开的孩子还是回来了。

paras.en: All places are shaped by their history and geography, but some have more history and geography than others. “We are British with a twist,” said Stacy Bragger, a former journalist who represents the Stanley constituency in the assembly.
paras.zh: 所有地方都受到其历史和地理的影响，但有些地方比其他地方拥有更多的历史和地理。 “我们是有特色的英国人，”在议会中代表斯坦利选区的前记者史黛西·布拉格 (Stacy Bragger) 说。

paras.en: “We have our own identity. If you were to ask what are the traits of a Falkland islander – resourcefulness, resilience, making do. Because if something breaks you can’t just go down the road. You have to make do. That’s our version of Britishness.”
paras.zh: “我们有自己的身份。如果你要问福克兰岛民的特质是什么——足智多谋、坚韧不拔、凑合着。因为如果出了什么问题，你就不能继续走下去。你必须凑合着。这就是我们版本的英国性。”

paras.en: The islanders also have long memories. “I used to read the Guardian when I was a good deal younger,” said Mike Summers, 73, who sits on the board of the local chamber of commerce. “But I stopped reading it in 1982 when [the editor] Peter Preston just fucked me off so much. He was: ‘Oh well they are a long way away and there is only a few of them – so why don’t we just sell them?’”
paras.zh: 岛民们也有着悠久的记忆。 “我年轻的时候经常读《卫报》，”当地商会董事会成员、73 岁的迈克·萨默斯 (Mike Summers) 说。 “但我在 1982 年就不再读这本书了，当时（编辑）彼得·普雷斯顿（Peter Preston）把我彻底搞砸了。他说：‘哦，好吧，它们离我们很远，而且数量也很少，所以我们为什么不把它们卖掉呢？’”

paras.en: On the Argentinian rhetoric, Summers added: “There are a lot of people who still suffer effects from the war – PTSD among the older people. I bumped into someone at the supermarket the other day who I have known for ever. She said: ‘Oh, I’m wondering if I should sell my house and move away. The Argies are going to invade again.’ It seriously affects some people and it is cruel actually.”
paras.zh: 关于阿根廷人的言论，萨默斯补充道：“有很多人仍然受到战争的影响，即老年人中的创伤后应激障碍。前几天我在超市遇到了一个我一直认识的人。她说：‘哦，我在想我是否应该卖掉我的房子搬走。阿吉人会再次入侵。’这严重影响了一些人，实际上很残酷。”

paras.en: Roxy King-Clarke, 40, describes herself as the Falklands’ biggest influencer, with about 60,000 followers. She picked up a major following when posting in response to the Argentinian men’s football team brandishing a “Las Malvinas son Argentinas” [The Malvinas are Argentinian] banner at the World Cup.
paras.zh: 40 岁的罗克西·金-克拉克 (Roxy King-Clarke) 将自己描述为福克兰群岛最大的影响者，拥有约 60,000 名追随者。当她发帖回应阿根廷男子足球队在世界杯上挥舞着“拉斯马尔维纳斯群岛的儿子阿根廷人”（马尔维纳斯群岛是阿根廷人）横幅时，她获得了大批追随者。

paras.en: She is regularly subjected to abuse for her posts. “The most common insults are to call us pirates, usurpers and colonisers,” she said. “It’s a bizarre thing to be on the receiving end of it all as they speak like we’ve just tipped up here. I can trace my family back to my earliest ancestor arriving here in 1842.”
paras.zh: 她经常因其帖子而受到辱骂。 “最常见的侮辱是称我们为海盗、篡夺者和殖民者，”她说。 “成为这一切的接收端是一件很奇怪的事情，因为他们说话的语气就像我们刚刚来到这里一样。我的家族可以追溯到 1842 年抵达这里的最早的祖先。”

paras.en: Her generation too, she suggests, have taken lessons from what happened four decades ago. King-Clarke said she would take a “hard line” to avoid any misinterpretation. “We need to learn from history,” she said, “and not make the same mistakes.”
paras.zh: 她表示，她这一代人也从四十年前发生的事情中汲取了教训。金-克拉克表示，她将采取“强硬路线”以避免任何误解。 “我们需要从历史中吸取教训，”她说，“不要犯同样的错误。”

articles.title: ‘I felt disgusted’: MEP speaks out over nude deepfakes and urges EU action
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam European community affairs correspondent

paras.en: An Austrian MEP has spoken out about her experience of being “stripped naked” online without her consent and has urged the EU to take action, as a report found that one in six female MEPs had been targeted by sexualised AI-generated content.
paras.zh: 一名奥地利欧洲议会议员在未经本人同意的情况下在网上讲述了她被“脱光衣服”的经历，并敦促欧盟采取行动，因为一份报告发现，六分之一的女性欧洲议会议员曾成为人工智能生成的色情内容的目标。

paras.en: Lena Schilling of the Green party said she had learned last month about nude deepfakes of herself circulating online. When she opened the links, she found herself staring at images from one of her first ever press conferences – but the images had been digitally altered to remove her clothing.
paras.zh: 绿党的莉娜·席林 (Lena Schilling) 表示，她上个月了解到网上流传着自己的裸体深度假货。当她打开链接时，她发现自己盯着她第一次新闻发布会上的照片，但这些照片已经过数字修改，以脱掉她的衣服。

paras.en: It was a shocking twist on a defining moment of her career. “I felt disgusted,” she said. “I remember how nervous I was and how much I had prepared for the press conference. And then to see someone using this image in a way aimed at harming and humiliating me was really hard to grasp.”
paras.zh: 这是她职业生涯的决定性时刻的一个令人震惊的转折。 “我感到恶心，”她说。 “我记得我当时有多紧张，也记得我为新闻发布会做了多少准备。然后看到有人使用这张照片来伤害和羞辱我，真的很难理解。”

paras.en: Schilling is one of 50 MEPs – 46 of them women – who have been targeted by sexualised deepfakes, according to a report by Agora Digitale Transformation (ADT).
paras.zh: 根据 Agora Digitale Transformation (ADT) 的一份报告，席林是 50 名欧洲议会议员（其中 46 名女性）成为色情深度假货的目标之一。

paras.en: The Berlin-based thinktank, which alerted Schilling to the presence of the images online, said the finding laid bare how deepfake pornography had become a “systemic threat to women in European politics”.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于柏林的智库向席林发出了网络图像存在的警告，称这一发现揭示了深度伪造色情内容如何成为“欧洲政治中女性的系统性威胁”。

paras.en: An earlier ADT report found that 138 female parliamentarians from 22 EU countries had been affected, and that women were 33 times more likely than their male colleagues to be depicted in or associated with deepfake pornography.
paras.zh: 早些时候的 ADT 报告发现，来自 22 个欧盟国家的 138 名女议员受到影响，女性被描绘或与深度伪造色情内容相关的可能性是男同事的 33 倍。

paras.en: Schilling described the images as a form of “digital violence against women” piled on top of the already disproportionate amount of sexist abuse, harassment and violence that women in politics faced.
paras.zh: 席林将这些图像描述为一种“针对女性的数字暴力”，是在政界女性面临的性别歧视虐待、骚扰和暴力已经不成比例的情况之上叠加的。

paras.en: The result was a potent threat to democracy, she said: “These things make going into politics even harder than it is already. Just imagine what would happen to our society if more and more women disappear from public life.”
paras.zh: 其结果是对民主的严重威胁，她说：“这些事情使得从政变得比现在更加困难。想象一下，如果越来越多的女性从公共生活中消失，我们的社会会发生什么。”

paras.en: Schilling said she had spoken to some of the other female MEPs targeted, but they had expressed fears about coming forward. “But there’s nothing to be ashamed of. People misused your photos, you did nothing wrong,” she said. “And I think that’s the moment when you say: ‘OK, this has to stop.’”
paras.zh: 席林说，她已经与其他一些受到攻击的女性欧洲议会议员进行了交谈，但她们表示担心站出来。 “但没有什么可羞耻的。人们滥用了你的照片，你没有做错任何事，”她说。 “我认为那一刻你会说：‘好吧，这必须停止。’”

paras.en: The sentiment was captured in a recent letter to the EU initiated by Schilling and the German Green MEP Terry Reintke. Signed by 119 MEPs, it called on officials to ensure that a forthcoming ban on apps and websites that use AI to undress women, scheduled to take effect across the EU on 2 December, would be paired with mechanisms capable of enforcing the prohibition.
paras.zh: 席林和德国绿党议员特里·雷因特克(Terry Reintke)最近向欧盟发起的一封信中体现了这种情绪。该法案由 119 名欧洲议会议员签署，呼吁官员确保即将于 12 月 2 日在欧盟范围内实施的禁止使用人工智能为女性脱衣的应用程序和网站的禁令，与能够执行该禁令的机制相配合。

paras.en: “A ban on paper protects no one until it is enforced,” the letter said, pointing to the widespread use of “nudifier” apps in which photos of women can be undressed with just one click.
paras.zh: 信中说：“纸质禁令在执行之前不能保护任何人。”信中指出，“裸体器”应用程序的广泛使用，只需点击一下即可脱掉女性照片的衣服。

paras.en: “Its purpose is humiliation and control over women’s bodies, and its effect is to make public life more hostile for female politicians,” the letter said. “Every young woman considering a political career now must factor in that this could happen to her.”
paras.zh: 信中说：“其目的是羞辱和控制女性身体，其效果是让公共生活对女性政客更加敌视。” “现在每个考虑从政的年轻女性都必须考虑到这种情况可能会发生在她身上。”

paras.en: Schilling said the aim was to push national authorities to close any loopholes or workarounds that would allow the apps to continue to function in the EU. “We were stripped naked without our consent,” she said. “This cannot become the new normal.”
paras.zh: 席林表示，此举的目的是推动国家当局堵住任何漏洞或解决办法，使这些应用程序能够继续在欧盟运行。 “未经我们同意，我们就被剥光了，”她说。 “这不能成为新常态。”

paras.en: The call for action was why she had decided to speak up, she said, in the hope that sharing her story would convince member states to crack down on tech companies for which this sort of digital violence could be a viable business model.
paras.zh: 她说，呼吁采取行动是她决定发声的原因，希望分享她的故事能够说服成员国打击科技公司，因为这种数字暴力可能是一种可行的商业模式。

paras.en: “It’s quite simple,” she said. “Every woman who wants to run for office should be able to do so without being afraid of being undressed against her will.”
paras.zh: “这很简单，”她说。 “每个想要竞选公职的女性都应该能够这样做，而不必担心被违背她的意愿脱光衣服。”

articles.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat

paras.en: An 80m (263ft) luxury vessel has been repeatedly spotted in satellite images off North Korea's Wonsan coast from July to mid-October this year.
paras.zh: 今年7月至10月中旬，朝鲜元山海岸的卫星图像中多次发现一艘80m（263英尺）长的豪华船只。

paras.en: What stands out is the 50m swimming pool along the deck, with a cluster of waterslides at one end.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的是甲板上的 50m 游泳池，一端设有一组滑水道。

paras.en: After sitting idle for months at a maintenance facility, it relocated in early July to waters off a strip of coastline known as the Kalma Peninsula.
paras.zh: 在维修设施闲置数月后，它于 7 月初搬迁到卡尔马半岛海岸线附近的水域。

paras.en: This is close to Wonsan, a seaside resort with a sprawling villa used by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and his family.
paras.zh: 这里靠近元山，这是一个海滨度假胜地，拥有朝鲜领导人金正恩及其家人使用的大型别墅。

paras.en: It was not the only large vessel on the move. A handful of others were also repeatedly seen near Kim's villa, in satellite images analysed by the BBC.
paras.zh: 它并不是唯一一艘移动的大型船只。英国广播公司分析的卫星图像显示，在金正恩的别墅附近还多次看到其他一些人。

paras.en: The vessels are widely believed to be used by Kim and his family. Former North Korean officials, defectors and experts say it would be difficult for anyone unconnected to the regime's leadership to own or freely use vessels of this size.
paras.zh: 人们普遍认为这些船只是金正恩及其家人使用的。朝鲜前官员、脱北者和专家表示，任何与朝鲜政权领导层无关的人都很难拥有或自由使用如此规模的船只。

paras.en: "In winter, they would keep them at the shipyard. When summer came, they would bring them out and move them to Kim Jong Un's villa or towards Kalma, and use them for swimming and recreation," says Ri Jong Ho.
paras.zh: “冬天，他们会把它们放在造船厂。夏天来临时，他们会把它们带出来，搬到金正恩的别墅或卡尔马，用它们游泳和娱乐，”李正浩说。

paras.en: Ri was once an official at the Workers' Party's Office 39, which is believed to be involved in raising and managing foreign currency for the leadership.
paras.zh: 李曾是劳动党第39办公室的官员，据信该办公室参与为领导层筹集和管理外汇。

paras.en: The wealth of those who sit at the top of the secretive North Korean dictatorship is just as hard to pin down as the country's economic figures.
paras.zh: 朝鲜秘密独裁政权高层的财富与该国的经济数据一样难以确定。

paras.en: The United Nations and others rely on estimates to classify North Korea as one of the world's poorest countries, with an especially large military budget that funds a sanctioned nuclear programme.
paras.zh: 联合国和其他机构根据估计将朝鲜列为世界上最贫穷的国家之一，其军事预算特别庞大，用于资助经批准的核计划。

paras.en: Most North Koreans, according to a 2025 UN report, live under "systematic, widespread and gross human rights violations" with total state control, widespread forced labour, and chronic food shortages that leave an estimated 40% of the population undernourished.
paras.zh: 根据 2025 年联合国报告，大多数朝鲜人生活在“系统性、广泛性和严重侵犯人权的情况下”，国家全面控制、普遍强迫劳动和长期粮食短缺，导致估计 40% 的人口营养不良。

paras.en: But the regime has long been known to live in luxury.
paras.zh: 但长期以来，该政权一直以奢侈的生活着称。

paras.en: We don't know the cost of the vessels seen in the satellite imagery, but comparable luxury yachts run from tens of millions to over $100m (Â£75m). Kim's much smaller, 29-metre Princess yacht was previously estimated to be worth about $7m.
paras.zh: 我们不知道卫星图像中看到的船只的成本，但类似的豪华游艇的价格从数千万到超过 1 亿美元（7500 万英镑）不等。 Kim 的公主号游艇要小得多，长 29 米，此前估计价值约 700 万美元。

paras.en: While vessel locations alone cannot definitively establish the family's whereabouts, their movements - which overlap with gaps in Kim's public appearances - point to activities that would otherwise remain out of public view.
paras.zh: 虽然仅凭船只位置无法确定这家人的下落，但他们的活动（与金正日公开露面的间隙重叠）表明了一些原本不会出现在公众视野中的活动。

paras.en: Wonsan is where Kim Jong Un spent part of his childhood with his mother, according to biographers and intelligence reports, and one expert told the BBC the city has been associated with the family since his father Kim Jong Il's rule.
paras.zh: 据传记作者和情报报告称，元山是金正恩与母亲一起度过童年时光的地方，一位专家告诉英国广播公司，自其父亲金正日统治以来，这座城市就与金正恩家族有联系。

paras.en: A defector who served for 13 years guarding residences used by then leader Kim Jong Il - through the 1990s to the early 2000s - told the BBC the villas around Wonsan were used as a retreat by the elite. He recalls seeing dozens of children and teens waterskiing during summer.
paras.zh: 一名叛逃者在 1990 年代至 2000 年代初为时任领导人金正日的住所守卫了 13 年，他告诉 BBC，元山周围的别墅被用作精英阶层的避难所。他回忆起夏天看到数十名儿童和青少年滑水。

paras.en: North Korean state media rarely publishes reports about Kim being on holiday, instead framing such visits as official inspections or guidance. But defectors interviewed by the BBC appeared to be aware that the family spent holidays in Wonsan, suggesting that at least some North Koreans knew about it.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方媒体很少发表有关金正恩度假的报道，而是将此类访问视为官方视察或指导。但接受英国广播公司采访的脱北者似乎知道这家人在元山度假，这表明至少有一些朝鲜人知道这件事。

paras.en: North Korean state media also claims Wonsan is home to high-rise hotels, restaurants, shops, sports facilities and water parks, and can accommodate nearly 20,000 visitors.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方媒体还称，元山拥有高层酒店、餐馆、商店、体育设施和水上乐园，可容纳近2万名游客。

paras.en: State media and Russian outlets have published images of small groups of Russian tourists visiting the Wonsan Kalma resort, which opened in July 2025. Although developed to attract foreign visitors, the resort is also open to local tourists.
paras.zh: 官方媒体和俄罗斯媒体发布了小群俄罗斯游客参观元山卡尔马度假村的图片，该度假村于 2025 年 7 月开业。虽然该度假村是为了吸引外国游客而开发的，但也向当地游客开放。

paras.en: A South Korean news report, citing an unnamed source, says some locals were offered four-night tour packages for around $100, a substantial sum for most North Koreans. The country's per capita GDP - around $667 in 2024, according to the UN - is a small fraction of South Korea's $36,227.
paras.zh: 韩国新闻报道援引一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士的话称，向一些当地人提供了四晚的旅游套餐，价格约为 100 美元，这对大多数朝鲜人来说是一笔巨款。根据联合国的数据，该国的人均 GDP 到 2024 年约为 667 美元，而韩国的人均 GDP 仅为 36,227 美元的一小部分。

paras.en: For the majority of North Koreans, holidays are out of reach. And while a growing middle class does exist, they might not have much time for leisure.
paras.zh: 对于大多数朝鲜人来说，假期是遥不可及的。尽管中产阶级确实存在，但他们可能没有太多休闲时间。

paras.en: Defectors told the BBC that workers, office employees and cooperative farmers are legally entitled to 14 days of annual leave, but this is rarely followed.
paras.zh: 脱北者告诉 BBC，工人、办公室职员和合作农民依法享有 14 天的年假，但很少有人遵守。

paras.en: Taking consecutive days off to travel is unusual. People typically take weekend trips or travel during national holidays instead of designated "summer holidays".
paras.zh: 连续几天休假去旅行是不寻常的。人们通常会在周末旅行或在国定假日期间旅行，而不是指定的“暑假”。

paras.en: Even if leave is granted, travel itself is restricted, with official permission required for people to travel outside their city or county. Moving freely is sometimes as much a luxury as the holiday itself.
paras.zh: 即使获得许可，旅行本身也会受到限制，人们要在所在城市或县外旅行需要获得官方许可。自由活动有时与假期本身一样奢侈。

paras.en: The BBC tracked four large vessels around Wonsan, measuring approximately 50m, 55m, 60m and 80m. All four vessels repeatedly appeared around Kim's Wonsan villa this year.
paras.zh: BBC 在元山周围追踪了四艘大型船只，测量尺寸分别为 50m、55m、60m 和 80m。今年，这四艘船都多次出现在金正恩的元山别墅周围。

paras.en: The largest vessel showed the clearest activity, moving from the dock to the waters off the Kalma Peninsula, where it has been since July.
paras.zh: 最大的船只表现出最明显的活动，从码头移动到卡尔马半岛附近的水域，自七月以来一直在那里。

paras.en: Two of the other vessels - 50m and 55m - were repeatedly seen until the end of August around Tae and Sin islands, close to Wonsan.
paras.zh: 直到 8 月底，另外两艘船只——50m 和 55m——在元山附近的泰岛和新岛周围反复出现。

paras.en: Satellite images also showed four smaller boats alongside the 50m vessel.
paras.zh: 卫星图像还显示，这艘 50m 长的船只旁边有四艘较小的船只。

paras.en: Satellite imagery expert Jeong Seong-hak said the smaller boats ferried people, fuel and supplies to the larger vessel, adding that small islands like Tae and Sin offered "secluded maritime retreats where privacy can be maintained away from public view".
paras.zh: 卫星图像专家 Jeong Seong-hak 表示，较小的船只将人员、燃料和补给品运送到较大的船只上，并补充说，像泰岛和新岛这样的小岛提供了“僻静的海上隐居处，可以在远离公众视野的地方保持隐私”。

paras.en: The 60m vessel was repeatedly seen near Kim's Wonsan villa until as recently as last week.
paras.zh: 直到上周，这艘 60m 长的船只多次出现在 Kim 的元山别墅附近。

paras.en: Though North Korea has never publicly disclosed the vessels' official ownership, BBC's analysis of historical satellite imagery found a large vessel with the same distinctive characteristics in Wonsan in 2002, when Kim Jong Il ruled North Korea.
paras.zh: 尽管朝鲜从未公开披露这些船只的官方所有权，但英国广播公司 (BBC) 对历史卫星图像的分析发现，2002 年金正日统治朝鲜时，在元山发现了一艘具有相同特征的大型船只。

paras.en: Former NBA star Dennis Rodman, who visited the North in 2013, told The Sun that he had spent much of his seven-day visit with Kim Jong Un around Wonsan, where they went jet-skiing and horse riding.
paras.zh: 2013年访问朝鲜的前NBA球星丹尼斯·罗德曼告诉《太阳报》，他与金正恩在7天的访问中大部分时间都在元山附近度过，他们在那里玩水上摩托艇和骑马。

paras.en: He also described a 60m vessel they used as a cross between a ferry and a Disney boat. It is not clear if this is the same 60m boat pictured in the above satellite imagery.
paras.zh: 他还描述了他们将一艘 60m 长的船只用作渡轮和迪士尼船的交叉体。目前尚不清楚这是否是上述卫星图像中所示的同一艘 60m 船。

paras.en: To most North Koreans, the life lived by the Kims and others who support the regime would seem not just extravagant but unimaginable. Especially because state propaganda is dedicated to presenting the "supreme leader" as a selfless man who always puts the nation first.
paras.zh: 对于大多数朝鲜人来说，金氏家族和其他支持朝鲜政权的人的生活不仅奢侈，而且难以想象。特别是因为国家宣传致力于将“最高领导人”描绘成一个始终把国家放在第一位的无私之人。

paras.en: "Kim Jong Un is supposed to be a 'leader of the people'," Ri Jong Ho says, "yet he has four luxury vessels like these while ordinary people are struggling just to get one meal a day."
paras.zh: “金正恩应该是‘人民的领袖’，”李正浩说，“但他却拥有四艘这样的豪华船只，而普通人却每天只为吃一顿饭而苦苦挣扎。”

articles.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank

paras.en: A delegation of European diplomats has been attacked by masked Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 一个欧洲外交官代表团在被占领的约旦河西岸遭到蒙面以色列定居者的袭击。

paras.en: Belgium condemned the assault on its consul general and the other envoys and called for Israel to bring those responsible to justice.
paras.zh: 比利时谴责袭击其总领事和其他特使的事件，并呼吁以色列将责任人绳之以法。

paras.en: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) also condemned what they called "the severe act of violence" and said they were investigating.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军（IDF）也谴责了他们所说的“严重暴力行为”，并表示正在调查。

paras.en: But the office of the Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cast doubt on what happened and suggested it was part of a "coordinated campaign to smear Israel".
paras.zh: 但总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的办公室对所发生的事情表示怀疑，并暗示这是“抹黑以色列的协调行动”的一部分。

paras.en: The attack came only a day after a number of Palestinians and Heidi Levine, a Washington Post photographer, were injured in a separate assault by settlers in another village in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 就在这次袭击发生的前一天，一些巴勒斯坦人和《华盛顿邮报》摄影师海蒂·莱文在约旦河西岸另一个村庄的另一次定居者袭击中受伤。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the attack on Levine was "disturbing" and "not a good look".
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，对莱文的袭击“令人不安”且“不好看”。

paras.en: It was also condemned by the US Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, who called it a "despicable act of terror carried out by masked cowards". A staunch ally of Israel, Huckabee said the assailants must face "prosecution to the fullest extent of the law".
paras.zh: 美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比也谴责了这一行为，称这是“蒙面懦夫实施的卑鄙恐怖行为”。哈卡比是以色列的坚定盟友，他表示袭击者必须面临“法律最严厉的起诉”。

paras.en: In Saturday's incident the European diplomats - from Belgium, France, Poland and the Catholic Church - had come to the largely Christian village of Taybeh near Ramallah.
paras.zh: 在周六的事件中，来自比利时、法国、波兰和天主教会的欧洲外交官来到拉马拉附近以基督教为主的泰贝村。

paras.en: They were there to assess the situation on the ground after almost near daily attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians trying to bring in their olive harvest.
paras.zh: 在以色列定居者几乎每天都会袭击试图收获橄榄的巴勒斯坦人后，他们在那里评估当地局势。

paras.en: Video footage from the scene showed masked settlers confronting the convoy. Reports suggest stones were thrown.
paras.zh: 现场视频显示，蒙面定居者与车队对峙。报道称有人投掷石块。

paras.en: The Belgian authorities said a car from its consulate had a window smashed and a French mayor was assaulted. Video showed a man wearing a French tricolor sash slumped beside a vehicle.
paras.zh: 比利时当局表示，其领事馆的一辆汽车的窗户被砸碎，一名法国市长遭到袭击。视频显示，一名佩戴法国三色腰带的男子倒在一辆汽车旁边。

paras.en: Belgium's foreign minister Maxime Prevot condemned the attack and said Israel had a responsibility to bring those responsible to justice.
paras.zh: 比利时外交部长马克西姆·普雷沃谴责这起袭击事件，并表示以色列有责任将肇事者绳之以法。

paras.en: "Palestinians face this violence every day. Settlers also target journalists reporting on it and diplomats. Harvesting olives, reporting the news or carrying out diplomatic duties should never put anyone at risk of attack," he said.
paras.zh: “巴勒斯坦人每天都面临这种暴力。定居者还以​​报道此事的记者和外交官为目标。收获橄榄、报道新闻或履行外交职责绝不能让任何人面临遭受袭击的风险，”他说。

paras.en: "As the occupying power, Israeli authorities must protect Palestinians, ensure the safety of diplomats and journalists, and bring those responsible to justice.
paras.zh: “作为占领国，以色列当局必须保护巴勒斯坦人，确保外交官和记者的安全，并将责任人绳之以法。

paras.en: "Impunity for violent settlers must end. Belgium will continue to press for EU sanctions against those responsible for this violence and those who support them."
paras.zh: “暴力定居者有罪不罚的现象必须结束。比利时将继续敦促欧盟对那些应对暴力事件负责的人和支持他们的人实施制裁。”

paras.en: Gideon Sa'ar, Israel's foreign minister, said he strongly condemned the violence by what he called "Israeli rioters". He said the foreign ministry was in contact with the ambassadors of the countries involved.
paras.zh: 以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔表示，他强烈谴责他所谓的“以色列骚乱者”的暴力行为。他说，外交部正在与有关国家的大使保持联系。

paras.en: But he added: "Without detracting from the severity of the incident, it is unfortunate that the visit was not coordinated with the IDF in advance. Such coordination could have helped safeguard the visitors' security."
paras.zh: 但他补充说：“虽然事件的严重性不减，但不幸的是，这次访问没有事先与以色列国防军协调。这种协调本来可以帮助保障访客的安全。”

paras.en: The IDF said they "strongly condemn the severe act of violence that took place in the area of Taybeh, during which diplomatic representatives were attacked by Israeli rioters."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军表示，他们“强烈谴责在泰贝地区发生的严重暴力行为，外交代表在此期间遭到以色列骚乱者的袭击”。

paras.en: "According to a preliminary inquiry, no IDF soldiers were present at the scene at the time of the attack," they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“根据初步调查，袭击发生时现场没有以色列国防军士兵。”

paras.en: But Netanyahu's office urged "caution before drawing conclusions" from reports about the attack.
paras.zh: 但内塔尼亚胡办公室敦促从有关袭击的报道中“得出结论之前要谨慎”。

paras.en: It said the images on social media "do not establish the complete sequence of events or individual responsibility".
paras.zh: 它表示，社交媒体上的图像“并未确定事件的完整顺序或个人责任”。

paras.en: A statement continued: "Those circumstances remain under investigation. Israeli police and forensic investigators have launched an investigation to establish the facts and identify those responsible."
paras.zh: 一份声明继续说道：“这些情况仍在调查中。以色列警方和法医调查人员已展开调查，以查明事实并查明责任人。”

paras.en: It added that "these reports come amid concerns about a coordinated campaign to smear Israel and the Jewish residents of Judea and Samaria during the annual olive harvest, relying on sensational headlines before the full facts emerge".
paras.zh: 它补充说，“这些报道是在人们担心在每年的橄榄收获期间，依靠耸人听闻的头条新闻，在全部事实浮出水面之前，协调一致地抹黑以色列以及朱迪亚和撒玛利亚的犹太居民的活动中出现的”。

paras.en: Netanyahu's office named the injured French official as Bernard Baudoux. The left-wing mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries in northern France told the AFP news agency the attack showed a tolerance by Israel's right-wing government for settler violence.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室称受伤的法国官员为伯纳德·博杜。法国北部奥尔诺耶-艾梅里斯的左翼市长告诉法新社，这次袭击表明以色列右翼政府对定居者暴力的容忍。

paras.en: The mayor said the settlers kicked him and beat him with iron bars, throwing him to the ground.
paras.zh: 市长说，定居者用脚踢他，用铁棍殴打他，把他摔倒在地。

paras.en: "It's the gratuitous nature of the violence that stuns me," he said. "They arrived completely enraged."
paras.zh: “令我震惊的是暴力的无端性质，”他说。 “他们到达时完全被激怒了。”

paras.en: "The whole world needs to know what's happening there. For me, I'll go back to my country and everything will be fine. Those who continue to suffer the most are those who are here," he said.
paras.zh: “全世界都需要知道那里发生了什么。对我来说，我会回到我的国家，一切都会好起来的。那些继续受苦最深的人就是这里的人，”他说。

articles.title: Deadly fire breaks out at Canada military base

paras.en: A large fire near a Canadian military base in Alberta has killed and injured some people, the defence minister said, without confirming the number of casualties.
paras.zh: 加拿大国防部长表示，加拿大艾伯塔省一处军事基地附近发生大火，造成多人死伤，但未确认伤亡人数。

paras.en: The Canadian Armed Forces were working with local authorities to manage the fire and were looking into what caused it, David McGuinty said, describing the situation as "very, very active and delicate".
paras.zh: 大卫·麦坚蒂表示，加拿大武装部队正在与地方当局合作控制火灾，并调查起火原因，并称局势“非常非常活跃和微妙”。

paras.en: Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said on X that a "serious incident creating a major fire" had occurred, adding his "thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected".
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼 (Mark Carney) 在 X 上表示，发生了“引发大火的严重事件”，并补充说，他“与所有受影响的勇敢的女性和男性同在”。

paras.en: Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, where the fire broke out, is one of the country's busiest military training bases.
paras.zh: 发生火灾的加拿大温赖特军事基地是该国最繁忙的军事训练基地之一。

paras.en: The Canadian Broadcasting Corporation describes it as "the principal base for live fire training exercises". About 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers are on site on a regular day, according to the CBC.
paras.zh: 加拿大广播公司将其描述为“实弹射击训练演习的主要基地”。据 CBC 报道，每天约有 690 名军事人员和 300 名文职人员在现场。

paras.en: Saturday's blaze "spread rapidly due to high winds" and had torn through the fences of the base, the Municipal District of Wainwright said.
paras.zh: 温赖特市政府表示，周六的大火“由于大风而迅速蔓延”，并冲破了基地的围栏。

paras.en: McGuinty told reporters he "cannot recall an incident like this in recent memory".
paras.zh: 麦坚蒂告诉记者，他“最近不记得发生过这样的事件”。

paras.en: Alberta's premier Danielle Smith says the "significant and tragic fire" is "affecting many of [the province's] brave military personnel". Provincial authorities are in touch with the central government in managing and investigating the situation, she added.
paras.zh: 艾伯塔省省长丹妮尔·史密斯表示，这场“重大而悲惨的火灾”正在“影响该省许多勇敢的军事人员”。她补充说，省级当局正在与中央政府保持联系，管理和调查这一情况。

paras.en: It is unclear when the fire broke out, but the district first posted about the incident at about 17:30 local time (23:30 GMT).
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚火灾何时发生，但该学区于当地时间 17:30 左右（格林威治标准时间 23:30）首次发布了有关该事件的信息。

paras.en: Local authorities have urged residents to avoid the area and give all emergency vehicles right of way.
paras.zh: 地方当局敦促居民避开该地区，并给所有紧急车辆让路。

paras.en: Neighbouring provinces have offered their support.
paras.zh: 周边省份纷纷表示支持。

paras.en: Saskatchewan premier Scott Moe says he has deployed resources to Alberta and is "ready to provide more if required", while British Columbia premier David Eby says his government has "reached out to Alberta to offer all possible assistance".
paras.zh: 萨斯喀彻温省省长斯科特·莫 (Scott Moe) 表示，他已向阿尔伯塔省部署资源，并“准备在需要时提供更多资源”，而不列颠哥伦比亚省省长戴维·伊比 (David Eby) 表示，他的政府已“与阿尔伯塔省联系，提供一切可能的援助”。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您有没有想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶级运动员一样，其表现受到“场地”、“装备”和“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: “我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪，”大卫·史密斯说。 “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
paras.zh: 汉威尔市长对 CarlisleCBF 来到该市表示感谢。 “近 65 年来，卡莱尔一直是麦地那社区的一部分，提供了良好的就业机会和强大的经济基础，”汉威尔市长说。 “我们很自豪能够庆祝他们的 100 周年纪念日，并认识到他们在我们城市的发展和繁荣中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，成立于 1925 年，现已发展成为该领域的全球领导者，服务于农业、建筑和采矿等广泛市场。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，是一家为各种工业应用提供精心设计的集成制动和摩擦解决方案的全球领先供应商。该公司拥有 100 多年的经验，致力于为全球客户提供创新、可靠和高性能的产品。

articles.title: BendPak Launches Ranger DST30PX Balancer
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Ranger Division of BendPak has introduced the next-generation DST Series wheel balancer, the DST30PX. As shops face larger OEM wheel assemblies and heavy aftermarket truck tires, older balancing platforms can slow production. The DST30PX is built to handle oversized wheels and prevent bottlenecks with a new hood design, larger shaft and overhauled structural chassis.
paras.zh: BendPak 的 Ranger 部门推出了下一代 DST 系列车轮平衡机 DST30PX。由于商店面临更大的 OEM 车轮组件和重型售后卡车轮胎，旧的平衡平台可能会减慢生产速度。 DST30PX 旨在处理超大车轮并通过新的引擎盖设计、更大的轴和大修的结构底盘来防止瓶颈。

paras.en: The hood accommodates a wider range of tire shapes and sizes, including oversized off-road and fleet tires, without repositioning. An open-side design allows wider tires, aggressive offsets and bulky sidewalls to slide in more easily, reducing setup time and enabling operators to position wheel assemblies up to 43 inches in diameter.
paras.zh: 该引擎盖可容纳更广泛的轮胎形状和尺寸，包括超大越野轮胎和车队轮胎，而无需重新定位。开放式设计允许更宽的轮胎、激进的偏置和笨重的侧壁更容易滑入，从而减少设置时间并使操作员能够定位直径达 43 英寸的车轮组件。

paras.en: Ranger reinforced the chassis and hood assembly to handle the added mass of larger assemblies without flexing, compromising alignment or generating excess vibration. The added rigidity helps maintain consistent measurements for accuracy. A 40 mm shaft increases stiffness and accuracy for heavier wheels while supporting standard cones and accessories.
paras.zh: Ranger 加固了底盘和引擎盖组件，以应对较大组件增加的质量，而不会弯曲、影响对准或产生过度振动。增加的刚性有助于保持一致的测量精度。 40 毫米轴提高了较重车轮的刚度和精度，同时支持标准锥体和配件。

paras.en: “The Ranger DST30PX represents a fundamental shift in how modern shops handle today’s radically heavier, oversized wheel configurations,” said Sean Price, director of product development for BendPak Inc. “By optimizing the physical layout and integrating a high-precision sensor array, we ensure technicians can mount, spin and perfectly balance oversized assemblies without a single second of wasted motion — turning massive wheel packages into a rapid, routine six-second floor-to-floor operation.”
paras.zh: BendPak Inc. 产品开发总监 Sean Price 表示：“Ranger DST30PX 代表了现代商店处理当今极其重的超大车轮配置方式的根本性转变。通过优化物理布局和集成高精度传感器阵列，我们确保技术人员能够安装、旋转和完美平衡超大组件，无需浪费一秒钟的运动时间，将大型车轮套件转变为快速、常规的六秒楼层到楼层操作。”

paras.en: The DST30PX features a 64-tooth magnetic transducer encoder with precision-cut square teeth to convert rotary position into a digital electronic signal, helping achieve accurate profile readings and top-dead-center positioning for precise weight placement. The extra encoder resolution supports cleaner correction, smaller weight changes and better placement accuracy for performance wheels, larger tiresand customers sensitive to vibration.
paras.zh: DST30PX 采用 64 齿磁传感器编码器，具有精密切割的方齿，可将旋转位置转换为数字电子信号，有助于实现精确的轮廓读数和上止点定位，以实现精确的重量放置。额外的编码器分辨率支持更清晰的校正、更小的重量变化以及更好的性能车轮、更大的轮胎和对振动敏感的客户的放置精度。

paras.en: User-friendly Design for Fast Turnarounds
paras.zh: 用户友好的设计可实现快速周转

paras.en: The DST30PX streamlines repetitive wheel service by reducing unnecessary motion. Simple wheel data entry, precise rolling weight readings, automatic braking, manual or automatic hood-start operation, and a rapid cycle time help technicians balance more wheels with fewer errors.
paras.zh: DST30PX 通过减少不必要的运动来简化重复的车轮维修。简单的车轮数据输入、精确的滚动重量读数、自动制动、手动或自动发动机罩启动操作以及快速的循环时间可帮助技术人员以更少的错误平衡更多的车轮。

paras.en: A quick-release hub nut, side-position brake, top-dead-center weight indicator, and tiered placement indicators accelerate setup and correction. Onboard storage includes a high-volume top tray, side cone pegs, and a side shelf designed to accommodate Ranger Quick-Peel adhesive tape weight rolls.
paras.zh: 快速释放轮毂螺母、侧位制动器、上止点重量指示器和分层放置指示器可加速设置和校正。机载存储包括大容量顶部托盘、侧锥钉和侧架，设计用于容纳 Ranger 快速剥离胶带配重卷。

paras.en: - 145-lb. capacity, 30-in. wheel diameter range, and 43-in. max tire diameter
paras.zh: - 145 磅。容量，30 英寸。车轮直径范围和 43 英寸。最大轮胎直径

paras.en: - Low-RPM balancing operation and six-second cycle time
paras.zh: - 低转速平衡操作和六秒循环时间

paras.en: - Dynamic, Static and Performance Alloy settings
paras.zh: - 动态、静态和高性能合金设置

paras.en: - 16-bit processor and multi-directional quartz piezoelectric sensors
paras.zh: - 16位处理器和多向石英压电传感器

paras.en: - Ergonomic controls and full-tilt LED display control panel
paras.zh: - 符合人体工程学的控制装置和全倾斜 LED 显示控制面板

paras.en: - Automatic braking and self-calibration
paras.zh: - 自动制动和自校准

paras.en: The DST30PX is positioned as an upgrade for shops seeking higher precision, faster workflow and an advanced measuring system for modern wheels without moving to a larger machine. It is ETL-certified to meet applicable UL and CSA safety standards in the U.S. and Canada. It comes with a starter kit of adhesive and clip-on steel wheel weights. Ranger Select setup and training is available.
paras.zh: DST30PX 的定位是为寻求更高精度、更快的工作流程和先进的现代车轮测量系统而无需迁移到更大机器的商店的升级产品。它经过 ETL 认证，符合美国和加拿大适用的 UL 和 CSA 安全标准。它配备了粘合剂和夹式钢轮配重的入门套件。提供 Ranger Select 设置和培训。

articles.title: Building Circle Track Engines for Endurance and Control
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: Circle track racing represents one of the most technically demanding environments for an internal combustion engine. Whether the surface is dirt or asphalt, these engines must survive sustained high rpm, extreme lateral g-forces and the unpredictable conditions that develop over the course of a race night. Unlike drag racing engines built for seconds of peak output, circle track powerplants must deliver broad, controllable power for hundreds of laps while maintaining durability.
paras.zh: 环形赛道赛车是对内燃机技术要求最高的环境之一。无论路面是泥土还是沥青，这些发动机都必须能够承受持续的高转速、极端的横向重力以及比赛之夜过程中出现的不可预测的条件。与专为数秒峰值输出而设计的飙车发动机不同，环形轨道动力装置必须在数百圈内提供广泛、可控的动力，同时保持耐用性。

paras.en: That balance between power, drivability and longevity defines successful circle track engine development. According to Luke Wilson of 4 Piston Racing and Jack Cornett of Cornett Racing Engines, designing an engine for this environment requires a different mindset than nearly any other racing discipline. The two builders gave us their perspectives on engines for this application.
paras.zh: 动力、驾驶性能和寿命之间的平衡决定了环形轨道发动机开发的成功。根据 4 Piston Racing 的 Luke Wilson 和 Cornett Racing Engines 的 Jack Cornett 的说法，为这种环境设计发动机需要与几乎任何其他赛车学科不同的思维方式。两位构建者向我们提供了他们对此应用程序引擎的看法。

paras.en: One of the defining characteristics of a competitive circle track engine is how usable its power is throughout the race. Conditions change constantly during an event, particularly on dirt tracks where the racing surface evolves lap after lap.
paras.zh: 竞技环形赛道发动机的定义特征之一是其动力在整个比赛过程中的可用性。赛事期间，条件不断变化，特别是在泥土赛道上，赛车路面一圈又一圈地变化。

paras.en: Early in the evening, dirt tracks may be heavy and fast, rewarding engines that produce strong high-rpm horsepower. But as the racing surface changes and slicks off, the characteristics required from the engine can shift dramatically.
paras.zh: 傍晚时分，土路可能又重又快，这对发动机来说是有益的，可以产生强大的高转速马力。但随着赛车表面的变化和光滑，发动机所需的特性可能会发生巨大变化。

paras.en: “In qualifying and early heat races, the tracks can be heavy, so big, high-rpm power can be the fastest thing out there,” Wilson explains. “If there are yellow flags and restart after restart, a good, strong, low-end grunt engine may work you through to the front.”
paras.zh: “在排位赛和早期热身赛中，赛道可能很重，因此大、高转速的动力可能是最快的，”威尔逊解释道。 “如果出现黄旗并在重新启动后重新启动，一个好的、强大的、低端的引擎可能会让你走到前面。”

paras.en: Later in the night, drivers may be forced to maintain speed with minimal throttle input as traction becomes scarce.
paras.zh: 到了晚上，由于牵引力变得稀缺，驾驶员可能被迫以最小的油门输入保持速度。

paras.en: “As the track slicks off in the longer races, the driver has to have the ability to run around the track fast at as little as 40% throttle…then be able to dig into their bank of power as they find places in the dirt that will hold more,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: “随着赛道在较长距离的比赛中变得越来越光滑，车手必须能够以低至 40% 的油门速度在赛道上快速奔跑……然后能够在泥土中找到可以容纳更多能量的地方，从而挖掘出自己的能量储备，”威尔逊说道。

paras.en: This constantly changing environment means builders rarely chase peak dyno numbers alone. Instead, they focus on creating an engine with a broad, controllable powerband.
paras.zh: 这种不断变化的环境意味着构建者很少单独追求峰值动态数。相反，他们专注于创建具有广泛、可控功率带的发动机。

paras.en: “The real balance is in making sure an engine is responsive on a restart, strong through the middle and can carry rpm to your mandated rpm,” Wilson says. “The engine has to be smooth and controllable by the driver, who is sitting in a strange position and bouncing all over the place.”
paras.zh: “真正的平衡在于确保发动机在重新启动时反应灵敏，在中间强劲，并且可以将转速提高到您规定的转速，”威尔逊说。 “发动机必须平稳并且可由驾驶员控制，因为驾驶员坐在一个奇怪的位置并且到处弹跳。”

paras.en: While power delivery is critical, durability is equally important. Circle track engines spend extended periods operating at extremely high rpm, which creates unique challenges for internal components.
paras.zh: 虽然电力输送至关重要，但耐用性也同样重要。环形轨道发动机长时间以极高的转速运行，这给内部组件带来了独特的挑战。

paras.en: “In circle track racing, the engine has to be built with endurance and longevity in mind,” Cornett says. “It’s completely opposite of drag racing or tractor pulling. Our engines must go 600 miles at 9,000 rpm.”
paras.zh: “在环形赛道比赛中，发动机的制造必须考虑到耐用性和使用寿命，”科内特说。 “这与飙车或拖拉机牵引完全相反。我们的发动机必须以 9,000 rpm 的转速行驶 600 英里。”

paras.en: Sustained operation at these speeds places enormous stress on the rotating assembly and valvetrain components. Builders must carefully balance lightweight choices for acceleration with materials capable of surviving long-term fatigue.
paras.zh: 在这些速度下持续运行会给旋转组件和气门机构部件带来巨大的压力。建造者必须仔细平衡加速的轻量化选择与能够承受长期疲劳的材料。

paras.en: “Selecting bottom end components is a balancing act,” Cornett explains. “You want the lightest components possible for acceleration, but they have to be durable enough to last thousands of miles.”
paras.zh: “选择底端组件是一种平衡行为，”Cornett 解释道。 “您需要尽可能轻的组件来加速，但它们必须足够耐用，能够持续数千英里。”

paras.en: This philosophy extends to the entire engine package, from connecting rods and pistons to camshaft profiles and valvetrain components.
paras.zh: 这一理念延伸到整个发动机套件，从连杆和活塞到凸轮轴型材和气门机构部件。

paras.en: “Compromises have to be made in an endurance application with camshaft profiles and valvetrain components, compression ratio and ignition timing, plus carb jetting,” Cornett says. “All these factor heavily into the longevity of the engine.”
paras.zh: “在耐用性应用中，必须在凸轮轴轮廓和气门机构部件、压缩比和点火正时以及碳水化合物喷射方面做出妥协，”科内特说。 “所有这些因素都很大程度上影响了发动机的使用寿命。”

paras.en: One of the most critical systems in a circle track engine is lubrication. Sustained lateral forces during cornering can starve engines of oil if the system is not designed specifically for oval racing.
paras.zh: 环形轨道发动机中最关键的系统之一是润滑。如果系统不是专门为椭圆形赛车设计的，转弯时持续的侧向力可能会导致发动机缺油。

paras.en: “The oiling system in our engines has to be dry sump only,” Cornett says. “There is no way the engine can survive without it.”
paras.zh: “我们发动机中的供油系统只能是干式油底壳，”科内特说。 “没有它，发动机就无法生存。”

paras.en: Dry sump systems allow builders to maintain a stable oil supply while also managing oil control within the engine. Specialized oil pans and tanks are engineered specifically for left-turn racing and the lateral g-forces the engines and cars experience.
paras.zh: 干式油底壳系统使制造商能够保持稳定的供油，同时管理发动机内的油控制。专用油底壳和油箱专为左转赛车以及发动机和汽车所经历的横向重力而设计。

paras.en: “Good, clean, non-aerated oil is critical to longevity,” Wilson says. “These engines typically have good dry sump systems that will work well on these short runs. Controlling where that oil goes and how clean the oil supply is gives you a longer-lasting engine.”
paras.zh: “优质、清洁、不充气的油对于使用寿命至关重要，”威尔逊说。 “这些发动机通常具有良好的干式油底壳系统，可以在短期运行中正常工作。控制机油的流向以及机油供应的清洁程度可以让您的发动机更耐用。”

paras.en: Because engine architectures vary widely across circle track classes, oil pressure requirements can differ significantly as well.
paras.zh: 由于不同环形轨道类别的发动机架构差异很大，因此油压要求也可能存在显着差异。

paras.en: “There are very short-stroke engines with big pins on both ends, and there are smaller-displacement, small-bore, large-stroke engines – like what we build – that really require a different type of oil pressure and rebuild schedule,” Wilson notes.
paras.zh: “有两端带有大销钉的短冲程发动机，也有小排量、小缸径、大冲程发动机——就像我们制造的发动机——确实需要不同类型的油压和重建时间表，”威尔逊指出。

paras.en: Temperature management is another critical factor in circle track engine performance and reliability. Unlike many drag racing engines that run relatively cool, circle track engines often operate at significantly higher temperatures for extended periods.
paras.zh: 温度管理是环轨发动机性能和可靠性的另一个关键因素。与许多运行温度相对较低的飙车发动机不同，环形轨道发动机通常在明显更高的温度下长时间运行。

paras.en: “In dirt midget racing, engines are preheated to 190 degrees F with diesel or electric units and then they go push off and run,” Wilson explains. “They never have a problem having temperature in them. In fact, many of them are run too hot.”
paras.zh: “在泥土小型赛车中，发动机通过柴油或电动装置预热至 190 华氏度，然后启动并运行，”威尔逊解释道。 “它们从来不存在温度问题。事实上，它们中的许多都运行得太热。”

paras.en: Limited cooling capacity and the challenges of racing on dirt often contribute to high operating temperatures.
paras.zh: 有限的冷却能力和泥土赛车的挑战通常会导致较高的工作温度。

paras.en: “They have small radiators with no fans, and they can get packed with dirt,” Wilson says. “Teams often come off the track with engines that have more temperature in them than the engine builders want to see.”
paras.zh: “它们的散热器很小，没有风扇，而且容易沾满灰尘，”威尔逊说。 “车队在冲出赛道时，发动机的温度常常超出了发动机制造商的预期。”

paras.en: Cornett notes that maintaining proper operating temperatures is essential for engine survival.
paras.zh: 科内特指出，保持适当的工作温度对于发动机的生存至关重要。

paras.en: “Heat management is very important and it becomes critical on dirt due to the surface you are racing on,” Cornett says. “We want to keep the water temp in the 200-240 degree F range and the oil temp in the 220-260 degree F range.”
paras.zh: “热管理非常重要，而且由于比赛场地的原因，它在泥土上变得至关重要，”科内特说。 “我们希望将水温保持在 200-240 华氏度范围内，将油温保持在 220-260 华氏度范围内。”

paras.en: Fuel tuning is sometimes used as an additional method of temperature control. “They often are running rich lambda outside of optimal to help keep the engines cool,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: 燃料调节有时被用作温度控制的附加方法。 “他们经常运行超出最佳值的富拉姆达值，以帮助保持发动机冷却，”威尔逊说。

paras.en: Clearances, Bearings and Ring Strategies
paras.zh: 间隙、轴承和环策略

paras.en: While circle track engines operate in extreme conditions, many builders rely on proven fundamentals when it comes to internal clearances.
paras.zh: 虽然环形轨道发动机在极端条件下运行，但许多制造商在内部间隙方面依赖于经过验证的基本原理。

paras.en: “There is no black magic here,” Wilson says. “Run your bearing clearance that you would normally run for your engine you are building and the oil you are running.”
paras.zh: “这里没有黑魔法，”威尔逊说。 “按照您通常为正在制造的发动机和正在运行的机油运行的轴承间隙进行检查。”

paras.en: For the engines built at 4 Piston Racing, that typically means clearances between .0018” and .0022”. However, Wilson notes that he’s seen other run larger clearances without engine issues as well.
paras.zh: 对于 4 Piston Racing 制造的发动机，这通常意味着间隙在 0.0018” 和 0.0022” 之间。然而，威尔逊指出，他也看到过其他发动机在没有出现问题的情况下运行更大的间隙。

paras.en: Ring gap selection follows a similar philosophy. Run the ring gaps that your piston design engineer determined for your piston. “Adjust as you analyze your engines when they come back for service,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: 环隙选择遵循类似的理念。运行活塞设计工程师为活塞确定的环间隙。 “当你的发动机回来维修时对其进行分析时进行调整，”威尔逊说。

paras.en: One factor builders must monitor carefully is the presence of excess fuel in the ring lands, particularly when running methanol with constant-flow fuel systems.
paras.zh: 建造商必须仔细监控的一个因素是环形区域中是否存在过量燃料，特别是在使用恒流燃料系统运行甲醇时。

paras.en: “I have observed many times where teams run overly rich on these constant flow systems and will have a lot of unburned methanol sitting in the ring lands,” Wilson says. “There is power and longevity in having this properly managed.”
paras.zh: “我多次观察到，团队在这些恒流系统上运行得过于丰富，并且在环形区域中会有大量未燃烧的甲醇，”威尔逊说。 “如果管理得当，就会产生力量和长寿。”

paras.en: Cornett notes that ring gap strategies continue to evolve as piston and ring designs become thinner, narrower and more efficient.
paras.zh: Cornett 指出，随着活塞和环设计变得更薄、更窄和更高效，环间隙策略不断发展。

paras.en: As with most forms of motorsport, rulebooks play a major role in shaping circle track engine architecture.
paras.zh: 与大多数形式的赛车运动一样，规则手册在塑造环形赛道发动机架构方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: “Rules dictate everything we do,” Wilson admits. “But this type of racing can often leave you a lot of flexibility in individual internal decisions.”
paras.zh: “规则决定了我们所做的一切，”威尔逊承认。 “但这种类型的比赛通常可以让你在个人内部决策上有很大的灵活性。”

paras.en: Builders typically maximize displacement and rpm within the limits set by sanctioning bodies, but internal design decisions still allow room for innovation.
paras.zh: 制造商通常会在制裁机构设定的限制内最大限度地提高排量和转速，但内部设计决策仍然留有创新的空间。

paras.en: “If you took the top five engines out there, you’d see some significant differences in how they are built because the engine architecture is so different,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: “如果你把排名前五的引擎拿出来，你会发现它们的构建方式存在一些显着差异，因为引擎架构非常不同，”威尔逊说。

paras.en: In some classes, that freedom is one of the reasons circle track racing remains attractive to engine builders.
paras.zh: 在某些类别中，这种自由是环形赛道赛车对发动机制造商仍然有吸引力的原因之一。

paras.en: “There is a lot of parity in midget engines,” Wilson says. “It is about as blank sheet as you can get for wanting to build something you can call yours. Many other types of racing have gone too far on requiring a spec engine.”
paras.zh: “小型发动机有很多相似之处，”威尔逊说。 “对于想要打造属于自己的东西来说，这几乎是一张白纸。许多其他类型的赛车在需要规格引擎方面已经走得太远了。”

paras.en: Cornett echoes that sentiment from the perspective of dirt late model racing, saying, “Rules are obviously always a big concern on how to build your engine. Luckily, in dirt late model racing, there aren’t many rules.”
paras.zh: 科内特从后期模型赛车的角度呼应了这种观点，他说：“规则显然始终是如何构建引擎的一个大问题。幸运的是，在后期模型赛车中，没有太多规则。”

paras.en: Despite careful engineering, circle track engines face numerous potential failure points based on engine type as each has a different Achillies heel. According to Cornett, two issues appear more frequently than others.
paras.zh: 尽管经过精心设计，环形履带发动机仍面临着许多基于发动机类型的潜在故障点，因为每种发动机都有不同的致命弱点。根据科内特的说法，有两个问题比其他问题出现得更频繁。

paras.en: “The two most common failures in circle track racing are bearing failure and overheating,” he says. “I think most bearing failures are caused by not properly warming up the oil temp before you race. Overheating issues are usually caused by racing on dirt.”
paras.zh: “环形跑道赛中最常见的两种故障是轴承故障和过热，”他说。 “我认为大多数轴承故障都是由于比赛前未正确加热油温引起的。过热问题通常是由于在泥土上比赛引起的。”

paras.en: Wilson notes that valvetrain components and timing drive systems can also be vulnerable.
paras.zh: 威尔逊指出，气门机构组件和正时驱动系统也可能容易受到攻击。

paras.en: “Engines can see valvetrain and rod bearing issues because of how the racers beat them on the limiter repeatedly,” he says. “Crashes can create additional risks. The most common failure is in the timing drive system when a car is turned backwards, flipped, or crashed in a bad way.”
paras.zh: “由于赛车手在限制器上反复击败发动机，发动机可能会发现气门机构和连杆轴承问题，”他说。 “碰撞会产生额外的风险。最常见的故障是当汽车倒退、翻转或严重碰撞时，正时驱动系统出现故障。”

paras.en: Ignition system limitations can also contribute to engine stress in some racing classes.
paras.zh: 点火系统的限制也会导致某些赛车级别的发动机压力。

paras.en: “We have observed repeatedly where we are asking for 25 degrees of timing and will see an engine walk around as much as 10 degrees in either direction,” Wilson explains. “This is really hard on engines and easily resolved by putting a modern motorsports grade ignition system on the engine.”
paras.zh: “我们多次观察到，当我们要求 25 度的正时时，会发现发动机在任一方向上旋转了 10 度，”Wilson 解释道。 “这对发动机来说确实是一个难题，但通过在发动机上安装现代赛车级点火系统即可轻松解决。”

paras.en: Because circle track engines operate under extreme conditions, regular service and inspection are essential for maintaining performance and reliability. Cornett Racing Engines typically bases rebuild intervals on total laps run.
paras.zh: 由于环形轨道发动机在极端条件下运行，因此定期维护和检查对于保持性能和可靠性至关重要。 Cornett Racing Engines 通常根据总圈数来确定重建间隔。

paras.en: “Based on our experience, we have developed a lap strategy to know when to rebuild the engine,” Cornett says. “The customer keeps up with how many laps he races.”
paras.zh: “根据我们的经验，我们制定了一项单圈策略，以了解何时重建发动机，”科内特说。 “客户可以随时了解他跑了多少圈。”

paras.en: Most engines are serviced after roughly 1,200 to 1,500 laps, which equates to approximately 600 to 750 miles of racing.
paras.zh: 大多数发动机在大约 1,200 至 1,500 圈后进行保养，这相当于大约 600 至 750 英里的比赛。

paras.en: Wilson notes that service intervals can vary widely depending on how teams operate their equipment.
paras.zh: 威尔逊指出，根据团队操作设备的方式，维护间隔可能会有很大差异。

paras.en: “I have the same engine that I’m confident that team A can run for 25 shows and then bring it for service,” he says. “I have the same engine with team B and I have them bring it back after 10 shows, sometimes in a box and not on a stand.”
paras.zh: “我拥有同样的发动机，我相信 A 团队可以运行 25 场演出，然后将其投入使用，”他说。 “我和 B 队有同样的引擎，我让他们在 10 场演出后把它带回来，有时放在盒子里，而不是放在架子上。”

paras.en: Driver behavior, maintenance practices and tuning decisions all influence how long an engine survives between rebuilds.
paras.zh: 驾驶员行为、维护实践和调整决策都会影响发动机在重建之间的存活时间。

paras.en: “Some teams beat the hell out of stuff and aren’t kind to their engines,” Wilson admits. “You have to handle each team on a case-by-case basis and then develop a plan going forward.”
paras.zh: “有些车队竭尽全力，而且对他们的引擎并不友善，”威尔逊承认。 “你必须根据具体情况处理每个团队，然后制定未来的计划。”

paras.en: The Future of Circle Track Engine Technology
paras.zh: 环形轨道发动机技术的未来

paras.en: Even with decades of development behind them, circle track engines continue to evolve. Wilson believes that modern electronics and fuel systems could significantly improve reliability and performance in some classes.
paras.zh: 尽管经历了数十年的发展，环形轨道发动机仍在不断发展。威尔逊认为，现代电子和燃油系统可以显着提高某些类别的可靠性和性能。

paras.en: “Midget racing specifically needs to allow some modern electronics and fueling,” he says. “Many series still rely on constant-flow fuel injection systems, which came about in the 1940s. The reality is the guys who know it well and tune it well are aging out.”
paras.zh: “小型赛车特别需要一些现代电子设备和燃料，”他说。 “许多系列赛仍然依赖 20 世纪 40 年代出现的恒流燃油喷射系统。现实情况是，那些熟悉并善于调节它的人已经过时了。”

paras.en: Wilson has personally tested modern electronic fuel injection systems against traditional mechanical setups. The results demonstrated that modern systems can be competitive while offering improved tuning efficiency.
paras.zh: 威尔逊亲自测试了现代电子燃油喷射系统与传统机械装置的对比。结果表明，现代系统可以在提供改进的调整效率的同时具有竞争力。

paras.en: “With a highly experienced constant flow pro we spent more than six hours tuning that engine,” Wilson recalls. “I swapped the injection over to my EFI, hooked up my ECU and swung a dyno pull. It cleared what we achieved on the first pull.”
paras.zh: “在一位经验丰富的恒流专家的帮助下，我们花了六个多小时来调整该发动机，”威尔逊回忆道。 “我将喷射换成了我的 EFI，连接了我的 ECU 并摆动了测功机拉力。它清除了我们在第一次拉力时取得的成果。”

paras.en: Within a handful of pulls, the EFI system produced measurable gains.
paras.zh: 经过几次拉动，EFI 系统产生了可衡量的收益。

paras.en: “After six dyno pulls we had a smoother power curve, more responsive power and more peak power by 8–10 horsepower on a 400-hp engine,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: “经过六次测功机拉动后，我们在 400 马力的发动机上获得了更平滑的功率曲线、更灵敏的功率和更高的峰值功率 8-10 马力，”Wilson 说。

paras.en: Despite the results, many teams remain loyal to traditional systems – a reminder that racing technology often evolves as much through culture as engineering.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了这样的成绩，许多车队仍然忠于传统系统——这提醒人们，赛车技术往往通过文化和工程来发展。

paras.en: For engine builders, circle track racing offers a unique challenge. The engines must deliver high power, survive extreme conditions and adapt to constantly changing track surfaces – all while operating within rulebooks that vary widely from one class to another. That complexity is exactly what keeps builders engaged.
paras.zh: 对于发动机制造商来说，环形赛道赛车提供了独特的挑战。发动机必须提供高功率、能够承受极端条件并适应不断变化的赛道表面，同时在不同级别之间差异很大的规则手册内运行。这种复杂性正是让建筑商保持参与的原因。

paras.en: “This always changing dynamic is what makes the engines in this racing so much fun to work with,” Wilson says.
paras.zh: “这种不断变化的动态使得这场比赛中的引擎使用起来非常有趣，”威尔逊说。

paras.en: As both Wilson and Cornett emphasize, success in circle track racing ultimately comes down to balancing engineering precision with real-world durability – building engines that can not only make power, but keep making it lap after lap.
paras.zh: 正如威尔逊和科内特所强调的那样，环形赛道赛车的成功最终取决于平衡工程精度与现实世界的耐用性——制造出不仅能够提供动力，而且能够一圈又一圈地保持动力的发动机。

articles.title: Free Webinar: Performance EVs, Specialized Tires
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: As premium and performance EVs become more common, tire professionals face a new set of expectations from both the vehicle and the customer. EV weight, instant torque and sophisticated vehicle dynamics can place unique demands on tires, while drivers still expect the performance, comfort, quiet ride, and efficiency their vehicles were designed to deliver.
paras.zh: 随着优质和高性能电动汽车变得越来越普遍，轮胎专业人士面临着车辆和客户的一系列新期望。电动汽车的重量、瞬时扭矩和复杂的车辆动力学对轮胎提出了独特的要求，而驾驶员仍然期望车辆的性能、舒适性、安静的行驶和效率。

paras.en: In this free 30-minute webinar, the editorial team from Tire Review will examine what makes tire replacement for performance EVs different and what tire professionals should consider when inspecting, fitting and recommending replacement tires. Using the Hankook iON evo AS and Lucid Gravity as a real-world case study, they will explore how tire design can address the competing demands of today’s premium electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 在这个时长 30 分钟的免费网络研讨会中，《轮胎评论》的编辑团队将研究高性能电动汽车轮胎更换的不同之处，以及轮胎专业人员在检查、安装和推荐更换轮胎时应考虑的因素。他们将使用 Hankook iON evo AS 和 Lucid Gravity 作为现实案例研究，探索轮胎设计如何满足当今高端电动汽车的竞争需求。
